ɔzele, na ɔyɛle zɔ.
10Ɛdɛnkɛma maa maanle maanle adwenle
ngyehyɛlɛ yɛ mgbane;
ɔsɛkye menli ngyehyɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛhyehyɛ la.
11Ɛdɛnkɛma ngyehyɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu,
ɔbɔ kpɔkɛ a ɔka awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti.
12Nyilalɛ ɛha maanle ne mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma le ye Nyamenle la,
nyilalɛ ɛha menli ne mɔɔ yeye bɛ yeyɛ bɛ ye menli la.
13Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ anwuma lɔ, ɔto ɔ nye ɔnea aze,
na ɔnwu menli kɔsɔɔti.
14Ɔde ye belemgbunli ebia nu lɔ,
ɔbele ɔ nye ɔnea ewiade amra amuala.
15Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔmaa bɛ adwenle a,
yɛɛ ɔnwu mɔɔ bɛyɛ la amuala.
16Belemgbunli biala ɛlɔne kpole ɛngola ɛnlie ye,
ɛlɔnenli biala anwosesebɛ kpole ɛngola ɛnlie ye.
17Konle ɛkpɔnwɔ ɛnle konimlilɛ anyelazo,
yɛɛ ye anwosesebɛ kpole ne ɛngola sonla ngoane die.
18Bɛnlea, Ɛdɛnkɛma anye wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye,
yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye la ye ɛhulolɛ
kpundii ne azo la anwo zo,
19amaa yealie bɛ yeavi ewule nu,
na ɛhɔne ba a bɛanwu.
20Yɛ ɛkɛla kendɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma;
ɔle yɛ moalɛ nee yɛ enyinlike.
21Ɛhɛe, yemɔ ɔ ti yɛdi fɛlɛko,
ɔboalekɛ yɛ rɛle wɔ ye duma nwuanzanwuanza ne anu.
22O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne
ɛrɛla yɛ nwo zo,
ɔluakɛ yɛ anyelazo a le wɔ.

english_text:
(Written by David when he pretended to be crazy in front of Abimelech, so that Abimelech would send him away, and David could leave.)
Honor the Lord
1 I will always praise the Lord.
2With all my heart,
I will praise the Lord.
Let all who are helpless,
listen and be glad.
3Honor the Lord with me!
Celebrate his great name.
4I asked the Lord for help,
and he saved me
from all my fears.
5Keep your eyes on the Lord!
You will shine like the sun
and never blush with shame.
6I was a nobody, but I prayed,
and the Lord saved me
from all my troubles.
7If you honor the Lord,
his angel will protect you.
8 Discover for yourself
that the Lord is kind.
Come to him for protection,
and you will be glad.
9Honor the Lord!
You are his special people.
No one who honors the Lord
will ever be in need.
10Young lions may go hungry
or even starve,
but if you trust the Lord,
you will never miss out
on anything good.
11Come, my children, listen
as I teach you
to respect the Lord.
12 Do you want to live
and enjoy a long life?
13Then don't say cruel things
and don't tell lies.
14Do good instead of evil
and try to live at peace.
15If you obey the Lord,
he will watch over you
and answer your prayers.
16But God despises evil people,
and he will wipe them all
from the earth,
till they are forgotten.
17When his people pray for help,
he listens and rescues them
from their troubles.
18The Lord is there to rescue
all
who are discouraged
and have given up hope.
19The Lord's people
may suffer a lot,
but he will always
bring them safely through.
20 Not one of their bones
will ever be broken.
21Wicked people are killed
by their own evil deeds,
and if you hate God's people
you will be punished.
22The Lord saves the lives
of his servants.
Run to him for protection,
and you won't be punished.
translation_text:
Nyamenle kpalɛyɛlɛ ne ayɛlɛyelɛ
1Mebayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo dahuu;
dahuu mebaye ye ayɛlɛ.
2Me ɛkɛla fa Ɛdɛnkɛma tu ɔ nwo;
anwubɛnyunluma ɛdie na bɛli fɛlɛko.
3O bɛ nee me ɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma;
bɛmaa yɛbɔ nu yɛkpogya ye duma ne zo.
4Menzɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma, na ɔliele zo,
na ɔliele me ɔvile me ɛzulolɛ muala anu.
5Bɛva bɛ nye bɛdo ɔ nwo zo na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie,
amaa bɛ nyunlu angua aze ɛlɛ.
6Ehyianli ɛhye zunle, na Ɛdɛnkɛma diele ye,
na ɔliele ye ɔvile ye amaneɛnwunlɛ muala anu.
7Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ sinza bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la,
na ɔdie bɛ ngoane.
8 O bɛzɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛnlea na bɛkɛnwu kɛ ɔle kpalɛ!
Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ nriandi kɔtane ye la.
9O bɛmɛ Nyamenle menli, bɛzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma,
ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la ɛngyia ɛhwee!
10Awenade ngakula bɔbɔ kyia na ɛhɔne ku bɛ,
noko bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma abo zo la
ɛngyia debie kpalɛ biala anwo.
11Bɛrɛla, O ayi mɔ, bɛdie me,
mebahilehile bɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ ne.
12 Sonla boni a kpondɛ ngoane,
na ɔkpondɛ kenle dɔɔnwo,
amaa ɔ nye alie kpalɛ nwo a?
13Sɔ ɛ nloa, mmaka ɛtane,
yɛɛ mmabɔ adalɛ biala.
14Twe ɛ nwo fi ɛtane nwo, na di boɛ;
kpondɛ anzonudwolɛ na di ɔ nzi.
15Ɛdɛnkɛma anye wɔ tenlenema anwo zo,
yɛɛ ɔte bɛ ɛzunlɛ.
16Ɛdɛnkɛma fa ɔ nye wula nindavoma anyunlu,
kɛ ɔminli bɛ bo zo wɔ ewiade.
17Saa tenlenema biza moalɛ a, Ɛdɛnkɛma tie bɛ,
na ɔdie bɛ ɔfi bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu.
18Ɛdɛnkɛma bikye mɔɔ nyane ɛha ye la,
na ɔdie mɔɔ ye anyelazo ɛwie la.
19Sonlakpalɛ nwu amaneɛ dɔɔnwo,
noko Ɛdɛnkɛma ye ye fi ɔ muala anu.
20 Ɔsie ye gyɛlɛɛnye,
ɔmmaa ye bowule ko bɔbɔ ɛmbu.
21Ɛtane bahu amumuyɛma;
yɛɛ bɛbabua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi tenlenema la ewule fɔlɛ.
22Ɛdɛnkɛma die ye sonvolɛma ngoane;
bɛnrɛbua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtane ye la ewule fɔlɛ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
A Prayer for Protection from Enemies
1Fight my enemies, Lord!
Attack my attackers!
2Shield me and help me.
3Aim your spear at everyone
who hunts me down,
but promise to save me.
4Let all who want to kill me
be disgraced
and put to shame.
Chase away and confuse
all who plan to harm me.
5Send your angel after them
and let them be like straw
in the wind.
6Make them run in the dark
on a slippery road,
as your angel chases them.
7I did them no harm,
but they hid a net
to trap me,
and they dug a deep pit
to catch and kill me.
8 Surprise them with disaster!
Trap them in their own nets
and let them fall and rot
in the pits they have dug.
9I will celebrate and be joyful
because you, Lord,
have saved me.
10Every bone in my body
will shout:
“No one is like the Lord!”
You protect the helpless
from those in power;
you save the poor and needy
from those who hurt them.
11Liars accuse me of crimes
I know nothing about.
12They repay evil for good,
and I feel all alone.
13When they were sick,
I wore sackcloth
and went without food.
I truly prayed for them,
14as I would for a friend
or a relative.
I was in sorrow and mourned,
as I would for my mother.
15I have stumbled,
and worthless liars
I don't even know
surround me and sneer.
16Worthless people make fun
and never stop laughing.
17But all you do is watch!
When will you do something?
Save me from the attack
of those vicious lions.
18And when your people meet,
I will praise you
and thank you, Lord,
in front of them all.
19 Don't let my brutal enemies
be glad because of me.
They hate me for no reason.
Don't let them wink
behind my back.
20They say hurtful things,
and they lie to people
who want to live in peace.
21They are quick to accuse me.
They say, “You did it!
We saw you ourselves.”
22You see everything, Lord!
Please don't keep silent
or stay so far away.
23Fight to defend me, Lord God,
24and prove that I am right
by your standards.
Don't let them laugh at me
25or say to each other,
“Now we've got what we want!
We'll gobble him up!”
26Disappoint and confuse
all who are glad
to see me in trouble;
disgrace and embarrass
my proud enemies who say to me,
“You are nothing!”
27Let all who want me to win
be happy and joyful.
From now on let them say,
“The Lord is wonderful!
God is glad when all goes well
for his servant.”
28Then I will shout all day,
“Praise the Lord God!
He did what was right.”
translation_text:
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ko tia menli mɔɔ ko tia me,
na ko tia menli mɔɔ nee me ko la!
2Fa ɛ sa nu enyinlike ne,
na dwazo baboa me.
3Twe wɔ atwɛ ne nee wɔ ɛtweneɛ ne
wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtu me mgbaliko la anwo zo!
Ka kile me ɛkɛla kɛ,
“Mele wɔ ngoanedievolɛ!”
4Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ bɛku me la
anyunlu ɛzi bile, bɛ nyunlu ɛgua aze!
Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me nee munzule la
anye zo ɛda bɛ na bɛzia bɛ nzi.
5Maa bɛyɛ kɛ abonle wɔ anwoma gye nu,
na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne ɛlɛpia bɛ ahɔ la.
6Maa bɛ adenle nu ɛyɛ awozinli, ɛyɛ teteletetele,
na Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne ɛlɛtu bɛ ako la.
7Ɔluakɛ mgbane gyɛne ne ala bɛzuale me ɛhane;
mgbane gyɛne ne ala bɛpɛle me nwo kuma.
8Maa bɛpe kpotekpote arɛlevilɛ nu!
Na maa bɛ ngome bɛ ɛhane ɛhye bɛ;
maa bɛgua nu bɛwu.
9Ɛdɛnkɛma ati, akee me ɛkɛla anye balie,
na meava ye ngoanelielɛ ne meadu me nwo.
10Me sonlabaka ne baha kɛ,
“O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwane a le kɛ ɛdawɔ a?
Wɔmɔ a ɛdie mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ la.
ɛfi mɔɔ anwo yɛ se tɛla ye la asa anu,
na ɛdie ehyianli nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ la
ɛfi awule asa anu a.”
11Ahɔdiawu alasevolɛ dwazo;
bɛbiza me mɔɔ menze nwolɛ bie la.
12Bɛfa ɛtane bɛtua me kpalɛyɛlɛ kakɛ;
me ɛkɛla ɛwie me nwo minli.
13Noko mame, mɔɔ bɛnde kpɔkɛ la,
mengedale ɛrele,
mengyele ɛhɔne, mengilele me nwo nyane.
Membɔle me ti aze menzɛlɛle
14kɛ asɛɛ melɛdi nyane meamaa agɔnwolɛ
anzɛɛ adiema nrenya.
Menluale kɛ asɛɛ melɛsu ɔmɔ,
menzile me ti aze menlile nyane.
15Noko mendule koti la bɛyiale bɛzelele,
bɛhuohuanle bɛ nloa bɛtiale me;
abuburama mɔɔ menze bɛ la
zɔle me nwo nzekuebɔlɛ nu a bɛangyakyi.
16Bɛzile me amgbu dɔɔnwo kpalɛ,
bɛzelele me, bɛgolole me nwo.
17O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛnea ye zɛ wɔahɔdwu kenlenzu?
Die me fi bɛ amumuyɛ ɛtetalɛ nu;
die me ngoane fi awenadema ne mɔ asa anu!
18Na mebayɛ wɔ mo wɔ wɔ menli ne nyianu kpole ne anu;
na meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ wɔ bɛ muala bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ.
19 Mmamaa adalɛma mɔɔ kpɔ me la
si me nwo zo agole,
yɛɛ mmamaa me kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ mgbane gyɛne ne ala kpɔ me la
fedevede bɛ nye kile me.
20Ɔluakɛ bɛnga anzonudwolɛ edwɛkɛ,
bɛtendɛ bɛtia awienvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la,
na bɛboɔboa bɛbɔ adalɛ.
21Bɛbuke bɛ nloa bɛka mgbole bɛkile me;
bɛka kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, ɛhɛe!
Yɛ nye ɛnwu ye!”
22O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛdawɔ wɔnwu ye; mmayɛ koonwu!
O Awulae, mmafi me nwo ɛkɔ moa.
23Keha ɛ nwo, na dwazo die me ti,
me Nyamenle nee me Awulae, di me edwɛkɛ maa me.
24O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me Nyamenle, ɛle tenlenenli na bua me benle;
mmamaa bɛsi me nwo zo agole!
25Mmamaa bɛka bɛkile bɛ nwo kɛ,
“Ɛhɛe, akee yɛ kunlu ɛdwo!”
Mmamaa bɛka kɛ, “Yɛ sa ɛha ye.”
26Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi fɛlɛko wɔ me anwubɛnyunlu nwo la
ɛbɔ anyiemgba na bɛ adwenle ɛbɔ nu!
Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo bɛtia me la
anyunlu ɛzi bile na bɛbɔ anyiemgba.
27Maa menli mɔɔ akunlu anrɛɛ bɛbua me benle la
ɛva anyelielɛ nee fɛlɛkolilɛ ɛdea nuhua dahuu,
na bɛha kɛ,
“Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole,
ɔ nye die ye sonvolɛ ne kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo!”
28Na mebabɔ wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne nolo,
na meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ dahuu.

english_text:
(For the music leader by David, the Lord's servant.)
Human Sin and God's Goodness
1 Sinners don't respect God;
sin is all they think about.
2They like themselves too much
to hate their own sins
or even to see them.
3They tell deceitful lies,
and they don't have the sense
to live right.
4Those people stay awake,
thinking up mischief,
and they follow the wrong road,
refusing to turn from sin.
5Your love is faithful, Lord,
and even the clouds in the sky
can depend on you.
6Your decisions are always fair.
They are firm like mountains,
deep like the sea,
and all people and animals
are under your care.
7Your love is a treasure,
and everyone finds shelter
in the shadow of your wings.
8You give your guests a feast
in your house,
and you serve a tasty drink
that flows like a river.
9The life-giving fountain
belongs to you,
and your light gives light
to each of us.
10Our Lord, keep showing love
to everyone who knows you,
and use your power to save all
whose thoughts please you.
11Don't let those proud
and merciless people
kick me around
or chase me away.
12Look at those wicked people!
They are knocked down,
never to get up again.
translation_text:
Sonla amumuyɛyɛlɛ
1 Ɛtane tendɛ kile amumuyɛnli ne wɔ ye ahonle nu;
ɔkpo Nyamenle yɛɛ ɔnzulo ye adenle biala anu.
2Ɔluakɛ ɔbɛlɛbɛla ɔ nwo kɛ
ye ɛtane ne ɛnrɛvinde na awie ahyi ye.
3Ɔle ngunzi yɛɛ ɔbɔ adalɛ,
yegyakyi nrɛlɛbɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nee boɛlilɛ.
4Ɔda ye ɛkpa zo ɔbɔ adwenle ɛtane;
ɔfa ndenle mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la anu;
ɔngyi debie mɔɔ le ɛtane la.
Nyamenle kpalɛyɛlɛ ne
5O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne dwu anwomanyunlu,
wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne dwu amungu ne mɔ anu.
6Wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne kpole le kɛ Nyamenle awoka ne mɔ,
wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ abo kuma le kɛ azule buma;
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛdie menli nee nane ngoane.
7O Nyamenle, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne sonle bolɛ!
Menli kɔsɔɔti nriandi fea ɛ ndɛba abo.
8Bɛdi bɛ ko yi wɔ wɔ sua nu,
na ɛmaa bɛ nzule mɔɔ vi wɔ anyelielɛ azule nu la bɛno.
9Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle ngoane nzufeanvea a;
wɔ wienyi ne anu yɛɛ yɛnwu wienyi a.
10O kile wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne
wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze wɔ la anwo zo,
na maa mɔɔ ahonle nu te la wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne.
11Mmamaa adubɛnwonli bikye me,
mmamaa amumuyɛnli asa ka me.
12Nea, kɛ amumuyɛma ɛdu ɛgua ɛ,
bɛvuandi bɛ bɛgua, bɛngola dwazo.

english_text:
(By David.)
Trust the Lord
1Don't be annoyed by anyone
who does wrong,
and don't envy them.
2They will soon disappear
like grass without rain.
3Trust the Lord and live right!
The land will be yours,
and you will be safe.
4Do what the Lord wants,
and he will give you
your heart's desire.
5Let the Lord lead you
and trust him to help.
6Then it will be as clear
as the noonday sun
that you were right.
7Be patient and trust the Lord.
Don't let it bother you
when all goes well for those
who do sinful things.
8Don't be angry or furious.
Anger can lead to sin.
9All sinners will disappear,
but if you trust the Lord,
the land will be yours.
10Sinners will soon disappear,
never to be found,
11 but the poor will take the land
and enjoy a big harvest.
12Merciless people make plots
against good people
and snarl like animals,
13but the Lord laughs and knows
their time is coming soon.
14The wicked kill with swords
and shoot arrows to murder
the poor and the needy
and all who do right.
15But they will be killed
by their own swords,
and their arrows
will be broken.
16It is better to live right
and be poor
than to be sinful and rich.
17The wicked will lose all
of their power,
but the Lord gives strength
to everyone who is good.
18Those who obey the Lord
are daily in his care,
and what he has given them
will be theirs forever.
19They won't be in trouble
when times are bad,
and they will have plenty
when food is scarce.
20Wicked people are enemies
of the Lord
and will vanish like smoke
from a field on fire.
21An evil person borrows
and never pays back;
a good person is generous
and never stops giving.
22Everyone the Lord blesses
will receive the land;
everyone the Lord curses
will be destroyed.
23If you do what the Lord wants,
he will make certain
each step you take is sure.
24The Lord will hold your hand,
and if you stumble,
you still won't fall.
25As long as I can remember,
good people have never
been left helpless,
and their children have never
gone begging for food.
26They gladly give and lend,
and their children
turn out good.
27If you stop sinning
and start doing right,
you will keep living
and be secure forever.
28The Lord loves justice,
and he won't ever desert
his faithful people.
He always protects them,
but destroys the children
of the wicked.
29God's people will own the land
and live here forever.
30Words of wisdom come
when good people speak
for justice.
31They remember God's teachings,
and they never take
a wrong step.
32The wicked try to trap
and kill good people,
33but the Lord is on their side,
and he will defend them
when they are on trial.
34Trust the Lord and follow him.
He will give you the land,
and you will see
the wicked destroyed.
35I have seen brutal people
abuse others and grow strong
like trees in rich soil.
36Suddenly they disappeared!
I looked, but they were gone
and no longer there.
37Think of the bright future
waiting for all the families
of honest, innocent,
and peace-loving people.
38But not a trace will be left
of the wicked
or their families.
39The Lord protects his people,
and they can come to him
in times of trouble.
40The Lord helps his people
and saves them from the wicked
because they run to him.
translation_text:
Amumuyɛma nee kpalɛma awieleɛ
1Mmafonla ɛ nwo wɔ amumuyɛma ati;
mmamaa ɛ nye bolo ɛtanema!
2Ɔluakɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ na bɛanwoso kɛ ndile,
na bɛawe kɛ nya amolɛ.
3Fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu na di boɛ,
amaa wɔadɛnla azɛlɛ ne azo, ɛ nwo adɔ wɔ.
4Maa ɛ nye ɛlie Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo,
na ɔbamaa wɔanyia mɔɔ ɛkpondɛ la.
5Fa ɛ nwo maa Ɛdɛnkɛma;
fa ɛ rɛle wula ye nu, ɔbali yeamaa wɔ.
6Ɔbamaa wɔ benlelilɛ ala ali wienyi,
wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ada kɛ ewiazo sɛnzɛne.
7Gyinla ɛ nwo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu,
na si abotane kendɛ ye;
mmafonla ɛ nwo wɔ mɔɔ ɛkpazi la anwo,
anzɛɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɔ adwenle ɛtane la anwo.
8Mmafa ɛya, yɛɛ mmamaa wɔ ahonle futu!
Mmafonla ɛ nwo; ɔwie munzule.
9Ɔluakɛ bɛbaminli amumuyɛma abo zo;
na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la bava azɛlɛ ne.
10Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala ɛnee amumuyɛnli ne abo zo ɛminli,
ɛbahɔnlea ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ la, na ɛnrɛnwu ye.
11 Na bɛlɛvoma bava azɛlɛ ne ayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ,
na bɛ nye alie bɛ ɛkpazilɛ nwo.
12Amumuyɛnli pepɛ tenlenenli agyakɛ anzi,
ɔkpɔ ye, na ɔbu ye anyehoanlɛ.
13Na Ɛdɛnkɛma sele amumuyɛnli ne,
ɔluakɛ ɔnwu kɛ ye awieleɛ ɛbikye.
14Amumuyɛma twe dadeɛ na bɛkpo bɛ ɛda ne mɔ,
kɛ bɛku ehyianli ne nee mɔɔ ɛhyia la,
kɛ bɛku bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi pɛlepɛle la;
15bɛ dadeɛ bawɔ bɛ ngome bɛ ahonle nu,
yɛɛ bɛ ɛda ne mɔ babubu.
16Ekyi mɔɔ tenlenenli lɛ la le kpalɛ
tɛla amumuyɛma ɛdeɛ dɔɔnwo ne.
17Ɔluakɛ bɛbabubu amumuyɛma asa;
na Ɛdɛnkɛma bazɔ tenlenema nu.
18Ɛdɛnkɛma ze mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la kenle,
bɛ agyadeɛ bayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ dahuu.
19Munzule ba a bɛ nyunlu ɛngua aze,
ɛhɔne mekɛ nu bɛlɛ aleɛ molozo.
20Noko amumuyɛma abo zo minli;
Ɛdɛnkɛma kpɔvolɛma anyunlunyia le kɛ ndile,
bɛminli, bɛle kɛ esike, bɛ bo zo minli bɔkɔɔ.
21Amumuyɛnli biza bosea a ɔndua,
na tenlenenli asa do, ɔbuke ɔ sa nu;
22ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila bɛ la bava azɛlɛ ne,
na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ yedua bɛ kakɛ la abo zo baminli.
23Ɛdɛnkɛma a maa sonla tudu ɔ gyakɛ a,
na ɔmaa mɔɔ ɔ nye die ɔ nwo la kpazi.
24Saa ɔtɔ aze bɔbɔ a, ɔnrɛha ɛkɛ,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma bakpogya ye zo.
25Ɛnee mele kakula, na kɛkala meyɛ kpanyinli;
na metɛnwunle kɛ bɛkpo tenlenenli ɛlɛ;
yɛɛ metɛnwunle kɛ ɔ mra ɛlɛsɛlɛzɛlɛ aleɛ ali.
26Ɔ sa dwu menli nwo zo yɛɛ ɔbɔ awie biala bosea;
ɔ mra le nyilalɛ kpole.
27Twe ɛ nwo fi ɛtane nwo na di boɛ,
na wɔadɛnla aze wɔahyɛ.
28Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo pɛlepɛlelilɛ;
ɔnrɛkpo ye menli ne mɔɔ di nɔhalɛ la.
Ɔbabɔ tenlenema anwo bane dahuu,
na yeaminli amumuyɛma abo zo.
29Tenlenema bava azɛlɛ ne ayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ,
na bɛadɛnla zolɛ dahuu.
30Tenlenenli ka nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ,
yɛɛ ɔdi pɛlepɛle wɔ ye edwɛkɛhanlɛ nu.
31Ye Nyamenle ne mɛla wɔ ye ahonle nu;
ɔndwe ɔ nwo ɔnvi nwolɛ.
32Amumuyɛnli bu tenlenenli anyehoanlɛ,
na ɔbɔ mɔdenle kɛ ɔku ye.
33Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnrɛye ye ɛnrɛmaa ɔ sa ɛnrɛha ye,
bɛdi ye edwɛkɛ a, ɔnrɛmaa bɛnrɛbua ye ewule fɔlɛ.
34Fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu na dua ye adenle ne anu,
na ɔbakpogya wɔ zo yeamaa wɔanyia azɛlɛ ne;
ɛbanwu amumuyɛma ɛzɛkyelɛ.
35Menwu nrenya amumuyɛnli atisesebɛ bie,
ye anwonyia hɔle anwuma kɛ Lɛbanɔn sida baka.
36Nzinlii menzenle ɛkɛ ne, na nea, ɔnle ɛkɛ;
memkpondɛle ye, na meannwu ye.
37Nea sonla ne mɔɔ di boɛ, na nea tenlenenli ne,
ɔluakɛ anzonudwolɛ sonla lɛ ɔ bo zo amra.
38Na bɛbazɛkye mɛladonlɛma,
amumuyɛma ɛnrɛnyia bɛ bo zo amra.
39Tenlenema ngoanelielɛ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma,
ɔle bɛ ɛvealeka wɔ ngyegyelɛ nu.
40Ɛdɛnkɛma boa bɛ na ɔdie bɛ ngoane;
ɔye bɛ ɔfi amumuyɛma asa anu, ɔdie bɛ ngoane;
ɔboalekɛ bɛnriandi bɛbafea ye nu.

english_text:
(A psalm by David to be used when an offering is made.)
A Prayer in Times of Trouble
1When you are angry, Lord,
please don't punish me
or even correct me.
2You shot me with your arrows,
and you struck me
with your hand.
3My body hurts all over
because of your anger.
Even my bones are in pain,
and my sins 4are so heavy
that I am crushed.
5Because of my foolishness,
I am covered with sores
that stink and spread.
6My body is twisted and bent,
and I groan all day long.
7Fever has my back in flames,
and I hurt everywhere.
8I am worn out and weak,
moaning and in distress.
9You, Lord, know every one
of my deepest desires,
and my noisy groans
are no secret to you.
10My heart is beating fast.
I feel weak all over,
and my eyes are red.
11Because of my sickness,
no friends or neighbors
will come near me.
12All who want me dead
set traps to catch me,
and those who want
to harm and destroy me
plan and plot all day.
13I am not able to hear
or speak a word;
14I am completely deaf
and can't make a sound.
15I trust you, Lord God,
and you will do something.
16I said, “Don't let them laugh
or brag when I slip and fall.”
17I am about to collapse
from constant pain.
18I told you my sins,
and I am sorry for them.
19Many deadly and powerful
enemies hate me,
20and they repay evil for good
because I try to do right.
21You are the Lord God!
Stay nearby
and don't desert me.
22You are the one who saves me.
Please hurry and help.
translation_text:
Sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la nzɛlɛlɛ (Devidi edwɛne - awolɛyelɛ)
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmafa ɛya ɛtea me,
anzɛɛ mmafa ɛya ɛtwe me nzo!
2Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛda ne mɔ ɛboda me,
yɛɛ ɛ sa ɛla me nwo zo.
3Wɔ ɛya kpole ne ati me nwonane nu ɛnde,
me ɛtane ti, mende kpɔkɛ.
4Ɔluakɛ me amumuyɛ ɛbo me nwo zo,
bɛ ɛnlomboɛ ɛyɛ adesoa ɛbo me nwo zo.
5Me nganlɛ ne mɔ ɛkpɔlɔ na bɛbɔ,
ɔboalekɛ meyɛ ngoasea ninyɛne.
6Megolo megua mutulɛ nu,
alehyenlɛ kɔsɔɔti medi nyane.
7Ɔluakɛ me nze nu dwe me
yɛɛ me nwonane nu ɛnde.
8Menwa nrenzenrenze, me ɛnwomenle ɛwie,
me ahonle nriandi me kunlu maa mekponle.
9Awulae, ɛze me ngyianlɛ muala,
me ɛkponlenlɛ ɛnvea wɔ.
10Me ahonle si me kunlu, me anwosesebɛ ɛwie;
me nye zo ɛyɛ awozinli.
11Me gɔnwo mɔ gyinla ahane nea me nee me anwubɛnyunlu,
yɛɛ me nwo amra ɛmbikye me.
12Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me nee ewule la suozua me ngane,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me nee nyane la nwunlonwunla me,
yɛɛ dahuu bɛkɔ me ti akpamo.
13Mele kɛ anzondiliravolɛ, mende ɛhwee,
medɔ mumule, membuke me nloa.
14Ɛhɛe, mele kɛ anzondiliravolɛ,
ɔmbuke ɔ nloa ɔndwi awie anyunlu.
15O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔmɔ yɛɛ me rɛle wɔ wɔ nu a;
O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛbabua me a.
16Ɔluakɛ mesɛlɛ kɛ, “Mmamaa bɛsi me nwo zo agole,
bɛmɛ mɔɔ metu koti a bɛsele me la!”
17Ɔluakɛ asɛɛ medɔ aze mewie,
yɛɛ dahuu mete nyane me nu.
18Meka me ɛtane meto gua,
medi me ɛtane nwo nyane.
19Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ mgbane gyɛne ne ala bɛkpɔ me la anwo yɛ se,
yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ mgbane gyɛne ne ala bɛkyi me la zonle.
20Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa ɛtane bɛtua me kpalɛyɛlɛ kakɛ la
le me kpɔvolɛma, ɔboalekɛ medi kpalɛ nzi.
21O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmakpo me!
O me Nyamenle, mmafi me nwo ɛkɔ moa!
22Ka ɛ nwo baboa me,
O Awulae, me ngoanedievolɛ!

english_text:
(A psalm by David for Jeduthun, the music leader.)
A Prayer for Forgiveness
1I told myself, “I'll be careful
not to sin by what I say,
and I'll muzzle my mouth
when evil people are near.”
2I kept completely silent,
but it did no good,
and I hurt even worse.
3I felt a fire burning inside,
and the more I thought,
the more it burned,
until at last I said:
4“Please, Lord,
show me my future.
Will I soon be gone?
5You made my life short,
so brief that the time
means nothing to you.
“Human life is but a breath,
6and it disappears
like a shadow.
Our struggles are senseless;
we store up more and more,
without ever knowing
who will get it all.
7“What am I waiting for?
I depend on you, Lord!
8Save me from my sins.
Don't let fools sneer at me.
9You treated me like this,
and I kept silent,
not saying a word.
10“Won't you stop punishing me?
You have worn me down.
11You punish us severely
because of our sins.
Like a moth, you destroy
what we treasure most.
We are as frail as a breath.
12“Listen, Lord, to my prayer!
My eyes are flooded with tears,
as I pray to you.
I am merely a stranger
visiting in your home
as my ancestors did.
13Stop being angry with me
and let me smile again
before I am dead and gone.”
translation_text:
Anwubɛnyunlu sonla ɛtanehanlɛ
1Menganle kɛ, “Mebanlea me nwo boɛ,
amaa meanva me nloa meanga ɛtane;
mebazɔ me nloa,
mekɛ mɔɔ amumuyɛma gyigyi me nyunlu la.”
2Memuanle me nloa na menyɛle diinyi,
menzɔle me nwo biala na yeanyɛ boɛ,
me nyanelilɛ ne yɛle kpole,
3na me ahonle mɔɔ la me kunlu la lɔle katukatu.
Mendwenledwenlenle nwolɛ la, me nwo yelɛyelale me;
akee mendendɛle menzele kɛ,
4“Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa menwu me awieleɛ,
nee me ngoane mekɛ ne tendenle;
maa menwu kɛ me mekɛ ne ɛlɛsi anriandi la.”
5Nea, wɔyɛ me mekɛ ne ezinraa,
me ngoane mekɛ ɛnle ɛhwee ɛ nye zo.
Nɔhalɛ, awie biala ngoane le kɛ anwoma ala la!
6Nɔhalɛ, sonla le kɛ ɛlawolɛ!
Nɔhalɛ, sonla fonla ɔ nwo mgbane;
ɔkuohua, na ɔnze sonla mɔɔ bava la!
7Awulae, na kɛkala, mekendɛ duzu?
Me anyelazo wɔ wɔ nu.
8Die me fi me mɛladonlɛ kɔsɔɔti anu.
Mmamaa ahoasea sele me!
9Medɔ mumule, membuke me nloa,
ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔyɛ a.
10Gyakyi me ɛbolɛ;
wɔ adɛka ne mɔ ɛbo me nwo zo.
11Saa sonla ɛtane ti ɛtwe ɔ nzo a,
ɛsɛkye ye kɛ ɛlɛtɛba sɛkye ye ninyɛnkpa la;
nɔhalɛ, sonla biala le kɛ anwoma ala la.
12O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tie me nzɛlɛlɛ,
na gyele ɛ nzo tie me ɛzunlɛ;
mmamaa me monle ɛhwinlɛ yɛ mgbane ɛ nyunlu.
Ɔluakɛ mele wɔ ɛyɛvolɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛpɛ nu aze,
adendulɛnli, kɛ yɛ nlenya mɔ la.
13Gyakyi me, amaa meali me ti ekyii,
kolaa na meavi nu mɔɔ bɛnnwu me ko a!

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Help
1I patiently waited, Lord,
for you to hear my prayer.
You listened 2and pulled me
from a lonely pit
full of mud and mire.
You let me stand on a rock
with my feet firm,
3and you gave me a new song,
a song of praise to you.
Many will see this,
and they will honor and trust
you, the Lord God.
4You bless all of those
who trust you, Lord,
and refuse to worship idols
or follow false gods.
5You, Lord God, have done
many wonderful things,
and you have planned
marvelous things for us.
No one is like you!
I would never be able to tell
all you have done.
6 Sacrifices and offerings
are not what please you;
gifts and payment for sin
are not what you demand.
But you made me willing
to listen and obey.
7And so, I said, “I am here
to do what is written
about me in the book,
where it says,
8‘I enjoy pleasing you.
Your Law is in my heart.’ ”
9When your people worshiped,
you know I told them,
“Our Lord always helps!”
10When all your people met,
I did not keep silent.
I said, “Our Lord is kind.
He is faithful and caring,
and he saves us.”
11You, Lord, never fail
to have pity on me;
your love and faithfulness
always keep me secure.
12I have more troubles
than I can count.
My sins are all around me,
and I can't find my way.
My sins outnumber
the hairs on my head,
and I feel weak.
13Please show that you care
and come to my rescue.
Hurry and help me!
14Disgrace and confuse
all who want me dead;
turn away and disgrace
all who want to hurt me.
15Embarrass and shame
everyone who says,
“Just look at you now!”
16Our Lord, let your worshipers
rejoice and be glad.
They love you for saving them,
so let them always say,
“The Lord is wonderful!”
17I am poor and needy,
but, Lord God,
you care about me,
and you come to my rescue.
Please hurry and help.
translation_text:
Ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne
1Menzile abotane mengendɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma;
na ɔdiele me na ɔdele me ɛzunlɛ.
2Ɔyele me ɔvile kuma anu ɛzulolɛ ne anu,
ɔyele me ɔvile moto ne anu,
na ɔvale me ɔziele bodane zo,
ɔmanle mengyinlanle boɛ.
3Ɔmanle mendole edwɛne fofolɛ,
mendole ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne memanle yɛ Nyamenle ne.
Dɔɔnwo banwu ye na bɛazulo,
na bɛava bɛ rɛle bɛawula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu.
4Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ɔ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu,
na ɔnva ɔ nwo ɔndo mgbanyizonlema anwo,
anzɛɛ menli mɔɔ sonle awozonle
na bɛkpo Nyamenle la anwo la.
5O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, wɔmaa wɔ adwenle,
nee wɔ nwanwane nyɛleɛ wɔ yɛ nwo ɛyɛ mɔnwo;
awie biala nee wɔ ɛnzɛ!
Saa mebɔ nolo meaha bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ a,
anrɛɛ bɛzonle somaa mɔɔ bɛngola bɛ tia a.
6 Ɛmkpondɛ azubɔlɛ nee azubɔdeɛ;
noko wɔmaa me ɛnzonlɛ kɛ menva mendie wɔ.
Ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee ɛtane azubɔdeɛ,
wɔamkpondɛ ɛhye mɔ biala.
7Akee menganle kɛ, “Medame ɛ, mera;
bɛhɛlɛ me nwo edwɛkɛ wɔ buluku ne anu;
8O me Nyamenle, mekulo kɛ meyɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛdeɛ;
wɔ mɛla ne wɔ me ahonle nu.”
9Meha wɔ ngoanelielɛ nwo edwɛkɛ fɛlɛko ne,
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ wɔ menli ne amuala yiale la.
Kɛmɔ ɛdawɔ ɛze la,
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, metɛgyakyile wɔ nolobɔlɛ ne.
10Metɛkedale wɔ ngoanelielɛ nwo edwɛkɛ ne azo.
Meha wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ nee wɔ ngoanelielɛ nwo edwɛkɛ ne;
meanva wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne
meanvea wɔ menli ne wɔ nyianu kpole ne anu.
11O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmakpo kɛ ɛkɛze me anwunvɔne,
maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne
ɛbɔ me nwo bane dahuu.
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
(Edw 70)
12Munzule dɔɔnwo, menze bɛ nloa, ɛbɔ ɛyia me;
me ɛtane ne mɔ ɛbo me nwo zo,
mennwu aze; bɛzonle bɛtɛla me ti enrinli;
me nwo ɛgolo me.
13O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mesɛlɛ wɔ, die me!
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ka ɛ nwo baboa me!
14Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la,
maa bɛbɔ anyiemgba na bɛ adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ medi nyane la,
maa bɛzia bɛ nzi na bɛ nyunlu ɛzi bile.
15Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgolo me nwo kɛ, “Ɛhɛɛ, Ɛhɛɛ” la,
anyunlu ɛgua aze na bɛ rɛle ɛbɔ.
16Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ɛ bo zo la
anye ɛlie na wɔmɔ ɛ ti bɛli fɛlɛko.
Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne la,
ɛha ye dahuu kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma le bedevinli.”
17Mame, mele ehyianli, menlɛ bie;
na Awulae dwenle me nwo.
O me Nyamenle, ɛle me boavolɛ,
ɛle me ngoanedievolɛ, mmakyɛ!

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer in Time of Sickness
1You, Lord God, bless everyone
who cares for the poor,
and you rescue those people
in times of trouble.
2You protect them
and keep them alive.
You make them happy here
in this land,
and you don't hand them over
to their enemies.
3You always heal them
and restore their strength
when they are sick.
4I prayed, “Have pity, Lord!
Heal me, though I have sinned
against you.”
5My vicious enemies ask me,
“When will you die
and be forgotten?”
6When visitors come,
all they ever bring
are worthless words,
and when they leave,
they spread gossip.
7My enemies whisper about me.
They think the worst,
8and they say,
“You have some fatal disease!
You'll never get well.”
9 My most trusted friend
has turned against me,
though he ate at my table.
10Have pity, Lord! Heal me,
so I can pay them back.
11Then my enemies
won't defeat me,
and I will know
that you really care.
12You have helped me
because I am innocent,
and you will always
be close to my side.
13 You, the Lord God of Israel,
will be praised forever!
Amen and amen.
translation_text:
Wuleravolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ
1Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ dwenle ehyianvolɛma anwo la!
Ɛdɛnkɛma die ye wɔ ye amaneɛnwunlɛ nu;
2Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ ɔ nwo bane na ɔmaa ye ngoane;
bɛfɛlɛ ye kɛ ɔle nyilalɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo;
Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnye ye ɛmmaa ye kpɔvolɛma.
3Ɛdɛnkɛma maa ye anwosesebɛ wɔ ye anwondolɛ nu;
ye anwonyane nu, ɛyɛ ye ewule biala ayile.
4Menganle kɛ, “O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu me anwunvɔne;
meyɛ ɛtane metia wɔ na yɛ me ayile.”
5Me kpɔvolɛma fa adwenle ɛtane ka kɛ,
“Kenlenzu a ɔkɛwu na ye duma aminli a?”
6Saa bɛ bie ba kɛ ɔbanlea me a, ɔka ye menlemenle,
noko ye ahonle nu le asayɛlɛ ngome;
ɔfinde ɔkɔ a, ɔkɔbɔ me ewule ne nolo.
7Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi me la tu bɛ nwo azukue wɔ me nwo;
bɛdwenle mɔɔ ɛnle kpalɛ la a bɛmaa me a.
8Bɛka kɛ, “Anwonyane mɔɔ ɛbɔ ye la le kpole;
ɔ nwo mɔɔ ɛdo ye la, ɔnrɛdwazo bieko.”
9 Me gɔnwo kpalɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ me rɛle wɔ ye nu,
mɔɔ nee me yɛto ɛsalɛ ɛyɛba ko anu la,
ɛhakyi ɔ nzi ɛzi me.
10Noko, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu me anwunvɔne,
na dwazo me, amaa medame noko meadua bɛ kakɛ bie.
11Ɛhye bamaa meanwu kɛ ɛ nye die me nwo,
kɛ wɔammaa me kpɔvolɛma anli me nwo zo konim.
12Kɛmɔ medi boɛ la ati, wɔboa me,
na wɔva me wɔzie ɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne dahuu.
13 Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne,
ɔvi aloamɔleɛ kɔdwu melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ!
Amen! Amen!

english_text:
BOOK II
(Psalms 42–72)
(A special psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
Longing for God
1As a deer gets thirsty
for streams of water,
I truly am thirsty
for you, my God.
2In my heart, I am thirsty
for you, the living God.
When will I see your face?
3Day and night my tears
are my only food,
as everyone keeps asking,
“Where is your God?”
4Sorrow floods my heart,
when I remember
leading the worshipers
to your house.
I can still hear them shout
their joyful praises.
5Why am I discouraged?
Why am I restless?
I should trust you, Lord.
I will praise you again
because you help me,
6and you are my God.
I am deeply discouraged,
and so I think about you
here where the Jordan begins
at Mount Hermon
and at Mount Mizar.
7Your vicious waves
have swept over me
like an angry ocean
or a roaring waterfall.
8Every day, you are kind,
and at night
you give me a song
as my prayer to you,
the God of my life.
9You are my mighty rock.
Why have you forgotten me?
Why must enemies mistreat me
and make me sad?
10Even my bones are in pain,
while all day long
my enemies sneer and ask,
“Where is your God?”
11Why am I discouraged?
Why am I restless?
I trust you, Lord!
And I will praise you again
because you help me,
and you are my God.
translation_text:
BULUKU MƆƆ TƆ ZO NWIƆ
(Edwɛndolɛ 42—72)
Sonla mɔɔ bɛhye ye bɛhɔ nlɔnu la nzɛlɛlɛ (Kɔla amra mrenya ne mɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ)
1Kɛ weɛlɛ anwo si dɔ azule mɔɔ se la,
O Nyamenle, zɔhane ala yɛɛ me nwo dɔ wɔ a.
2Nyamenle anwo nzuhɔne ku me ɛkɛla,
tease Nyamenle ne anwo nzuhɔne ku me.
Kenlenzu yɛɛ mebara mearanwu Nyamenle anyunlu a?
3Alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ, me monle ɛyɛ me aleɛ,
na menli biza me dahuu kɛ,
“Wɔ Nyamenle ne wɔ ni?”
4Meka me nyane edwɛkɛ a,
mekakye ɛhye mɔ amuala;
kɛ menzile me nee ɛlɔne ne luale,
na menlile bɛ ti, yɛdole ɛlɔnwɔne,
yɛdole moyɛlɛ edwɛne, yɛvale fɛlɛko yɛdeɛdeanle nu,
yɛhɔle Nyamenle sua nu yɛlile ɛvoyia la.
5O me ɛkɛla, duzu ati a nyane ɛha wɔ zɛhae ɛ,
duzu ati a ɛ nwo mɔra ɛdu zɛhae ɛ?
Nyia anyelazo wɔ Nyamenle anu,
na mebaye ye ayɛlɛ bieko kɛ,
ɔle me boavolɛ nee me Nyamenle.
6-7Melɛdi nyane kpole wɔ nlɔnu ɛke,
yemɔti me adwenle ɛrape ɛ nwo zo.
Nyane ne ɛyɛ kɛ azɛlɛkye ɛbu ɛva me nwo zo,
yemaa me adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu
kɛ azuyilɛ mɔɔ vi Hɛmɔn Boka nee Mezaa Boka
ɛlɛwola bobobobo agua Azule Dwɔdan ne anu la.
8Alehyenlɛ nu, Ɛdɛnkɛma kile ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne;
aledwolɛ nu, meto edwɛne memaa ye,
mefa mesɛlɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ le me ngoane la.
9Meka mekile Nyamenle, me bodane ne kɛ,
“Duzu ati a ɛ rɛle ɛvi me ɛ?
Duzu ati a ɔwɔ kɛ medi nyane
kɛ me kpɔvolɛma ɛholo me nwo zo a?”
10Me kpɔvolɛma wowɔ me safule,
bɛmaa ɔyɛ me nyane kɛ nganlɛ wɔ me nwonane nu;
na bɛkɔ zo bɛbiza me kɛ,
“Wɔ Nyamenle ne wɔ ni?”
11O me ɛkɛla, duzu ati a nyane ɛha wɔ zɛhae ɛ,
duzu ati a ɛ nwo mɔra ɛdu zɛhae ɛ?
Nyia anyelazo wɔ Nyamenle anu,
ɔluakɛ mebaye ye ayɛlɛ bieko kɛ,
ɔle me boavolɛ nee me Nyamenle.

english_text:
A Prayer in Times of Trouble
1Show that I am right, God!
Defend me against everyone
who doesn't know you;
rescue me from each
of those deceitful liars.
2I run to you for protection.
Why do you turn me away?
Why must enemies mistreat me
and make me sad?
3Send your light and your truth
to guide me.
Let them lead me to your house
on your sacred mountain.
4Then I will worship
at your altar because you
make me joyful.
You are my God,
and I will praise you.
Yes, I will praise you
as I play my harp.
5Why am I discouraged?
Why am I restless?
I trust you, Lord!
And I will praise you again
because you help me,
and you are my God.
translation_text:
Sonla mɔɔ bɛhye ye bɛhɔ nlɔnu la nzɛlɛlɛ (Edwɛndolɛ 42 nzɔzo)
1Bua me benle, O Nyamenle, na die me ti
wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la asa anu;
die me fi adalɛma nee amumuyɛma asa anu!
2Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle
mɔɔ menriandi mefea wɔ nu a;
duzu ati a wɔkpo me a?
Duzu ati a medi nyane
kɛ me kpɔvolɛma ɛholo me nwo zo a?
3O soa wɔ wienyi ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛ ne;
maa bɛli me nyunlu,
bɛva me bɛhɔ wɔ boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo,
nee ɛleka mɔɔ ɛde la.
4Akee mebahɔ Nyamenle azukponle ne anwo,
meahɔ me Nyamenle, me anyelielɛ kpole ne ɛkɛ;
na meava getaa kpole meado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
O Nyamenle, me Nyamenle.
5O me ɛkɛla, duzu ati a nyane ɛha wɔ zɛhae ɛ,
duzu ati a ɛ nwo mɔra ɛdu zɛhae ɛ?
Nyia anyelazo wɔ Nyamenle anu,
ɔluakɛ mebaye ye ayɛlɛ bieko kɛ,
ɔle me boavolɛ nee me Nyamenle.

english_text:
(A special psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
A Prayer for Help
1Our God, our ancestors told us
what wonders you worked
and we listened carefully.
2You chased off the nations
by causing them trouble
with your powerful arm.
Then you let our ancestors
take over their land.
3Their strength and weapons
were not what won the land
and gave them victory!
You loved them and fought
with your powerful arm
and your shining glory.
4You are my God and King,
and you give victory
to the people of Jacob.
5By your great power,
we knocked our enemies down
and trampled on them.
6I don't depend on my arrows
or my sword to save me.
7But you saved us
from our hateful enemies,
and you put them to shame.
8We boast about you, our God,
and we are always grateful.
9But now you have rejected us;
you don't lead us into battle,
and we look foolish.
10You made us retreat,
and our enemies have taken
everything we own.
11You let us be slaughtered
like sheep,
and you scattered us
among the nations.
12You sold your people
for little or nothing,
and you earned no profit.
13You made us look foolish
to our neighbors;
people who live nearby
insult us and sneer.
14Foreigners joke about us
and shake their heads.
15I am embarrassed every day,
and I blush with shame.
16But others mock and sneer,
as they watch my enemies
take revenge on me.
17All this happened to us,
though we didn't forget you
or break our agreement.
18We always kept you in mind
and followed your teaching.
19But you crushed us,
and you covered us
with deepest darkness
where wild animals live.
20We did not forget you
or lift our hands in prayer
to foreign gods.
21You would have known it
because you discover
every secret thought.
22 We face death all day for you.
We are like sheep on their way
to be slaughtered.
23Wake up! Do something, Lord!
Why are you sleeping?
Don't desert us forever.
24Why do you keep looking away?
Don't forget our sufferings
and all our troubles.
25We are flat on the ground,
holding on to the dust.
26Do something! Help us!
Show how kind you are
and come to our rescue.
translation_text:
Nyamenle ɛwowalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ (Kɔla amra mrenya ne mɔ edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ)
1O Nyamenle, yɛde ye yɛ nzo nu,
yɛ nlenya mɔ ɛha ɛhile yɛ,
ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ ɛyɛle bɛ mekɛ zo,
wɔ mɔmoane mɔmoane ne.
2Ɛvale wɔ tumi ɛvoanle maanle maanle,
na ɛvale bɛmɛ ɛziele bɛ gyakɛ anu.
Ɛmanle menli ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ nwunle nyane,
na ɛmanle bɛmɛ bɛvale bɛ nwo dwɔɔ.
3Bɛdabɛ bɛanva bɛ dadeɛ bɛango bɛanva azɛlɛ,
bɛdabɛ bɛanva bɛ anwosesebɛ bɛanli konim;
na ɛvale wɔ tumi kpole ne nee wɔ anwosesebɛ ne,
yɛɛ ɛ nyunlu ɛdalɛ kpole ne ɛlile konim;
ɔluakɛ ɛ nye die bɛ nwo.
4Ɛle me Belemgbunli nee me Nyamenle,
mɔɔ maa Gyekɔbo di konim a.
5Yɛdua ɛ nwo zo a, yɛka yɛ agbɔvolɛ yɛgua;
yɛdua wɔ duma nu yɛtietia yɛ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo.
6Menva me rɛle mendo me ɛda zo,
yɛɛ me dadeɛ ɛnrɛhola me ngoane die.
7Wɔmɔ yɛɛ wɔlie yɛ wɔvi yɛ kpɔvolɛma asa anu,
na wɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi yɛ la anye zo ɛda bɛ a.
8Yɛva Nyamenle yɛdu yɛ nwo dahuu,
na yɛbayɛ ye mo dahuu.
9Noko wɔkpo yɛ wɔmaa bɛli yɛ nwo zo konim,
ɛ nee yɛ ɛlɔnema ne angɔ konle ne.
10Wɔmaa yɛnriandi yɛ kpɔvolɛma ne anyunlu,
na yɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛve yɛ nwo ninyɛne.
11Wɔyɛ yɛ kɛ mboane mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ,
na wɔkponde yɛ maanle maanle zo.
12Wɔdɔne wɔ menli ne anwonyiadeɛ,
kɛ menli mɔɔ anwo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ biala la.
13Wɔmaa yɛ nwo ɛyɛ menli mɔɔ zuozua yɛ la ahyi,
yɛɛ bɛgolo yɛ nwo, bɛsi yɛ amgbu a.
14Wɔmaa yɛyɛ ɛfenle yɛmaa maanle maanle,
yɛ nwo yɛ menli kɔsɔɔti ɛzelekɛ.
15Alehyenlɛ muala nyiane ala a ku me a;
nyiane ɛkpɔlɔ me betaa,
16wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtwi me nyunlu la edwɛkɛ ti,
wɔ me kpɔvolɛ ne nee me senravolɛ ne anyunlu.
17Ɛhye mɔ amuala ɛra yɛ nwo zo,
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛ rɛle ɛtɛfile wɔ,
anzɛɛ yɛtɛtulule ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee yɛ kyekyele la.
18Yɛtɛkpole wɔ wɔ yɛ ahonle nu,
yɛɛ yɛtɛkakyile yɛ nzi yɛtɛsile wɔ ndenle ne,
19mɔɔ yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ ɛye yɛ ɛgua nanemgbole avinli,
na ɛfa awozinli kabii ɛkeda yɛ nwo zo a.
20Saa yɛ rɛle ɛvi yɛ Nyamenle ne duma,
anzɛɛ yɛzonle nyamenle gyɛne bie a,
21asoo anrɛɛ Nyamenle ɛnrɛnwu ye ɔ?
Ɔluakɛ ɔze ahonle muala anu.
22 Kyɛkyɛ, wɔmɔ ti bɛku yɛ alehyenlɛ biala,
na bɛbu yɛ kɛ mboane mɔɔ bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ.
23Maa ɛ nwo zo! O Awulae, duzu ati a ɛlɛda ɛ?
Dwazo! Mmakpo yɛ bɔkɔɔ!
24Duzu ati a wɔva ɛ nye wɔvea ɛ?
Duzu ati a ɛ rɛle ɛvi yɛ nyane nee yɛ amaneɛ ne mɔ ɛ?
25Nyane ɛlɛku yɛ ɛkɛla ahɔ ewule nu;
yɛmaa yɛ nwo zo a ɔnyɛ boɛ.
26Maa ɛ nwo zo, bɛla baboa yɛ!
Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati die yɛ!

english_text:
(A special psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader. To the tune “Lilies.” A love song.)
For a Royal Wedding
1My thoughts are filled
with beautiful words
for the king,
and I will use my voice
as a writer would use
pen and ink.
2No one is as handsome as you!
Your words are always kind.
That is why God
will always bless you.
3Mighty king, glorious ruler,
strap on your sword
4and ride out in splendor!
Win victories for truth
and mercy and justice.
Do fearsome things
with your powerful arm.
5Send your sharp arrows
through enemy hearts
and make all nations fall
at your feet.
6 You are God, and you will rule
forever as king.
Your royal power
brings about justice.
7You love justice and hate evil.
And so, your God chose you
and made you happier
than any of your friends.
8The sweet aroma of the spices
myrrh, aloes, and cassia
covers your royal robes.
You enjoy the music of harps
in palaces decorated
with ivory.
9Daughters of kings are here,
and your bride stands
at your right side,
wearing a wedding gown
trimmed with pure gold.
10Bride of the king,
listen carefully to me.
Forget your own people
and your father's family. 11The king adores you.
He is your master,
so do what he desires.
12All of the richest people
from the city of Tyre
will try to influence you
13with precious treasures.
Your bride, my king,
has inward beauty,
and her wedding gown is woven
with threads of gold.
14Wearing the finest garments,
she is brought to you,
followed by her young friends,
the bridesmaids.
15Everyone is excited,
as they follow you
to the royal palace.
16Your sons and your grandsons
will also be kings
as your ancestors were.
You will make them rulers
everywhere on earth.
17I will make your name famous
from now on,
and you will be praised
forever and ever.
translation_text:
Belemgbunli atɔfolɛlielɛ edwɛne (Kɔla amra mrenya ne mɔ edwɛne; ɛhulolɛ edwɛne)
1Adwenle kpalɛ ɛyi me ahonle nu tɛkɛɛ,
meto edwɛne memaa belemgbunli ne;
me tafinlima le kɛ kɛlɛvolɛ
mɔɔ anwo yɛ ndɛ la pɛne.
2Ɛ nwo yɛ fɛ tɛla mgbavolɛ kɔsɔɔti,
ɛlolɛ ɛyi wɔ ɛdendɛlɛ tɛkɛɛ,
yemɔti Nyamenle ɛyila wɔ dahuu.
3Fa wɔ dadeɛ ne kenda ɛ bo anwo, O katakyie,
wɔ wɔ anyunlunyia nee wɔ belemgbunlililɛ nu.
4Dua wɔ belemgbunlililɛ zo kɔli konim
maa nɔhalɛ ne, na die fɔɔnwoma ati;
maa wɔ tumi ne ɛli konim mgbole.
5Wɔ ɛda mbaka ti yɛ nla,
bɛwɔ bɛwolo belemgbunli ne kpɔvolɛma ahonle nu;
maanle maanle tu gua ɛ nyunlu.
6 Wɔ belemgbunlililɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.
Ɛfa pɛlepɛlelilɛ a ɛdi wɔ ebia ne a;
7ɛkulo pɛlepɛlelilɛ, ɛkyi amumuyɛ.
Yemɔti Nyamenle, wɔ Nyamenle ne, ɛva anyelielɛ nwole
ɛkpokpa wɔ ɛgyakyi ɛ gɔnwo mɔ.
8Wɔ adɛladeɛ nu bɔ evuanlɛ,
ɔbɔnle alufuanlɛ, kasea, yɛɛ kolɔbo.
Edwɛndolɛma dielie ɛ nye wɔ arelemgbunli azua
mɔɔ bɛva ɛzɛlɛ bɛziezie nu la anu.
9Arelemgbunli mralɛ mraalɛ boka mbɛlɛra
mɔɔ wɔ wɔ suakunlu ɛkɛ ne la anwo;
belemgbunli raalɛ ne gyi wɔ fema zo ɛkɛ,
yeva Ɔfɛ ezukoa nvutuke yeyɛ ɔ nwo sɔɔnwo.
10O ralɛ raalɛ, yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie, na dwenle nwo,
maa ɛ rɛle ɛvi wɔ menli nee ɛ ze sua nu.
11Wɔ anwofɛlɛko ne bahwe belemgbunli ne ahonle;
ɔle ɛ menle, yemɔti tie ɔ ne.
12Tayama barahyɛ wɔ ninyɛne,
sukoavolɛma barahyɛ wɔ ninyɛne ngakyile.
13Belemgbunli ara raalɛ ne wɔ ye sua ne akunlu,
ɔwula ezukoanzule adɛladeɛ.
14Bɛva ye bɛhɔ belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ,
ye avoanlema mɔɔ ravale ye la doa ye.
15Bɛva bɛ anyelielɛ nee fɛlɛko nu
bɛhɔ belemgbunli ne suakunlu ɛkɛ ne.
16Ɛ mra mrenya bayɛ kɛ ɛ ze mɔ,
bɛbayɛ bɛ arelemgbunli wɔ ewiade amuala anu.
17Mebamaa awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti abɔ wɔ duma;
na bɛaye wɔ ayɛlɛ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_text:
(A special song by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
God Is Our Mighty Fortress
1God is our mighty fortress,
always ready to help
in times of trouble.
2And so, we won't be afraid!
Let the earth tremble
and the mountains tumble
into the deepest sea.
3Let the ocean roar and foam,
and its raging waves
shake the mountains.
4A river and its streams
bring joy to the city,
which is the sacred home
of God Most High.
5God is in that city,
and it won't be shaken.
He will help it at dawn.
6Nations rage! Kingdoms fall!
But at the voice of God
the earth itself melts.
7The Lord All-Powerful
is with us.
The God of Jacob
is our fortress.
8Come! See the fearsome things
the Lord has done on earth.
9God brings wars to an end
all over the world.
He breaks the arrows,
shatters the spears,
and burns the shields.
10Our God says, “Calm down,
and learn that I am God!
All nations on earth
will honor me.”
11The Lord All-Powerful
is with us.
The God of Jacob
is our fortress.
translation_text:
Nyamenle nee yɛ de (Kɔla amra mrenya ne mɔ edwɛne)
1Nyamenle le yɛ ɛvealeka nee yɛ anwosesebɛ,
yɛ mgbemgbene nu boavolɛ wɔ anwongyelelɛ nu.
2Yemɔti ewiade kakyi ɔ ti aze bɔbɔ a, yɛnrɛzulo,
saa awoka tudu kɔgua nyevile buma nu,
3saa nyevile fudu na ɔtulutulu ɔ ti ɔgua zo,
na ye ɛvundunlɛ ne maa awoka kpusu a, yɛnrɛzulo.
4Azule bie wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ ye nzule
maa Nyamenle suakpole ne
azo yɛ anyelielɛ;
ɔle Anwuma Anwumanli ne tɛnlabelɛ.
5Nyamenle de ɛkɛ ne, awie ɛnrɛhola ye sɛkye,
Nyamenle baboa ye ndɛndɛ ne ala.
6Maanle maanle ahonle futu,
belemgbunlililɛ to bɛka nu,
ɔ nloa edwɛkɛ kokye maa azɛlɛ kolo.
7Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne nee yɛ de;
Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne le yɛ ɛvealeka.
8Bɛrɛla, baranlea Ɛdɛnkɛma gyima mɔɔ ɛli,
yemaa azɛlɛ ye amuala ɛdɔ mgbane.
9Ɔmaa bɛgyakyi konle wɔ azɛlɛ ye amuala azo;
ɔbubu ɛda nee atwɛ ne mɔ,
ɔfa senle ɔyela konle ehwili ne mɔ!
10Ɔse: “Bɛgyinla diinyi, na bɛnwu kɛ
medame a mele Nyamenle a.
Mebo maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwo zo,
mebo ewiade amuala anwo zo.”
11Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee yɛ de;
Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne le yɛ ɛvealeka.

english_text:
(A psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
God Rules the Nations
1All of you nations,
clap your hands and shout
joyful praises to God.
2The Lord Most High is fearsome,
the ruler of all the earth.
3God has put every nation
under our power,
4and he chose for us the land
that was the pride of Jacob,
his favorite.
5God goes up to his throne,
as people shout
and trumpets blast.
6Sing praises to God our King,
7the ruler of all the earth!
Praise God with songs.
8God rules the nations
from his sacred throne.
9Their leaders come together
and are now the people
of Abraham's God.
All rulers on earth
surrender their weapons,
and God is greatly praised!
translation_text:
Belemgbunli bedevinli ne (Kɔla amra mrenya ne mɔ edwɛne)
1Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti ɛbɔ bɛ sa nu!
Bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdea bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Nyamenle!
2Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Anwuma Anwumanli ne anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ,
ɔle belemgbunli kpole wɔ azɛlɛ ye amuala azo.
3Ɔmanle yɛlile maanle maanle nwo zo konim,
na yɛziele maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti.
4Ɔkpale nu ɔyele yɛ agyadeɛ ɔmanle yɛ,
agyadeɛ mɔɔ ye kulovolɛ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra
fa tu bɛ nwo.
5Nyamenle ɛvo ɛdɛnla ye ebia nu,
bɛlɛbɔ aweɛne ndendenle, bɛtea nu anyelielɛ nu.
6Bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa Nyamenle,
bɛdo edwɛne bɛyeyɛ ye!
Bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa yɛ Belemgbunli ne,
bɛdo edwɛne bɛyeyɛ ye!
7Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle a le ewiade amuala belemgbunli a;
bɛdo edwɛne bɛye ye ayɛlɛ!
8Nyamenle le maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti belemgbunli;
Nyamenle de ye belemgbunli ebia nwuanzanwuanza ne anu.
9Ewiade arelemgbunli boɔboa bɛ nloa,
kɛmɔ Ebileham Nyamenle ne menli ne yɛ la.
Ɔluakɛ ewiade ye enyinlike kɔsɔɔti le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ;
ye belemgbunlililɛ le kpole kpalɛ.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by the clan of Korah.)
The City of God
1The Lord God is wonderful!
He deserves all praise
in the city where he lives.
His holy mountain,
2 beautiful and majestic,
brings joy to all on earth.
Mount Zion, truly sacred,
is home for the Great King.
3God is there to defend it
and has proved to be
its protector.
4Kings joined forces
to attack the city,
5but when they saw it,
they were terrified
and ran away.
6They trembled all over
like women giving birth
7or like seagoing ships
wrecked by eastern winds.
8We had heard about it,
and now we have seen it
in the city of our God,
the Lord All-Powerful.
This is the city that God
will let stand forever.
9Our God, here in your temple
we think about your love.
10You are famous and praised
everywhere on earth,
as you win victories
with your powerful arm.
11Mount Zion will celebrate,
and all Judah will be glad,
because you bring justice.
12Let's walk around Zion
and count its towers.
13We will see its strong walls
and visit each fortress.
Then you can say
to future generations,
14“Our God is like this forever
and will always guide us.”
translation_text:
Nyamenle Suakpole Zayɔn (Kɔla amra mrenya ne mɔ edwɛne)
1Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole, ɔwɔ kɛ bɛye ye ayɛlɛ kpole
wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne suakpole ne azo!
2 Ye boka nwuanzanwuanza ne le kpole, ɔwale,
ɔle ewiade amuala anyelielɛ.
Zayɔn Boka mɔɔ wɔ sɔlɔ afoa nu lɔ,
le Belemgbunli kpole ne suakpole.
3Nyamenle ɛhile kɛ ɔle pepɛdievolɛ
wɔ ye aranemgbole ne mɔ anu.
4Ɔluakɛ, nea, arelemgbunli boɔboale bɛ nloa,
bɛlile anlɔma bɛrale ɔ nwo zo.
5Bɛnwunle ye ala la, ɛzulolɛ hanle bɛ;
bɛ nye zo danle bɛ na bɛnriandile.
6Bɛ nwo wozowozole bɛ wɔ ɛkɛ,
kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo la.
7Ɛvale aduduleɛ anwoma ne ɛbubule
Tahyehye meli ne mɔ amuala.
8Kɛmɔ yɛde la, yemɔ ala a yɛnwu ye
wɔ Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma suakpole ne,
wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne suakpole ne
mɔɔ yekyekye na ɔwɔ ɛkɛ dahuu la azo a.
9O Nyamenle, yɛdwenle wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo,
wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.
10O Nyamenle, kɛ wɔ duma ne si de la,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ wɔ ayɛlɛyelɛ dwu ewiade amuala a.
Konimlilɛ wɔ ɛ sa fema ne anu.
11Maa Zayɔn Boka zo amra ɛli fɛlɛko!
Maa Dwudama anye ɛlie,
ɔboalekɛ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo.
12Bɛkpɔsa Zayɔn azo, bɛbɔ ye mgbɔlɔka bɛyia,
bɛdia ye tawa ne mɔ;
13bɛnlea ye bane ne mɔ ati zo kpalɛ,
bɛhɔ ye aranemgbole ne mɔ anu;
amaa bɛaha bɛahile awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la kɛ,
14“Nyamenle ne ɛne,
ɔle yɛ Nyamenle dahuu.
Ɔbahile yɛ adenle mekɛ biala.”

english_text:
(A psalm by the clan of Korah and for the music leader.)
Don't Depend on Wealth
1Everyone on this earth,
now listen to what I say!
2Listen, no matter who you are,
rich or poor.
3I speak words of wisdom,
and my thoughts make sense.
4I have in mind a mystery
that I will explain
while playing my harp.
5Why should I be afraid
in times of trouble,
when I am surrounded
by vicious enemies?
6They trust in their riches
and brag about
all their wealth.
7You cannot buy back your life
or pay off God!
8It costs far too much
to buy back your life.
You can never pay God enough
9to stay alive forever
and safe from death.
10 We see that wise people die,
and so do stupid fools.
Then their money is left
for someone else.
11The grave will be their home
forever and ever,
although they once had land
of their own.
12Our human glory disappears,
and, like animals, we die.
13Here is what happens to fools
and to those who trust
the words of fools:
14They are like sheep
with death as their shepherd,
leading them to the grave.
In the morning God's people
will walk all over them,
as their bodies lie rotting
in their home, the grave.
15But God will rescue me
from the power of death.
16Don't let it bother you
when others get rich
and live in luxury.
17Soon they will die
and all their wealth
will be left behind.
18We humans are praised
when we do well,
and all of us are glad
to be alive.
19But we each will go down
to our ancestors,
never again to see
the light of day.
20Our human glory disappears,
and, like animals, we die.
translation_text:
Anwonyia nu koaseayɛlɛ (Kɔla amra mrenya ne mɔ edwɛne)
1Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, bɛdie ɛhye!
Ewiade amra amuala, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ,
2bɛmɛ awienvolɛma nee mgbolema,
sukoavolɛma nee ehyianvolɛma, bɛdie!
3Mebaha nrɛlɛbɛ edwɛkɛ,
ndelebɛbo wɔ mɔɔ medwenledwenle nwo la anu.
4Mebagyele me nzo meadie ɛrɛlɛ,
mebabɔ getaa kpole meaye me agyebɛ nloa.
5Duzu ati yɛɛ saa ngyegyelɛ to me,
na menli mɔɔ yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la,
bɔ yia me a, menwɔzulo ɛ?
6Duzu ati a menwɔzulo menli mɔɔ bɛ rɛle
wɔ bɛ anwonyia nu na bɛfa bɛ anwonyia kpole
ne bɛtu bɛ nwo la ɛ?
7Nɔhalɛ, awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɔ nwo kpɔne,
anzɛɛ ye ngoane nwo kakɛ tua maa Nyamenle,
8ɔluakɛ ye ngoane ɛkpɔnedeɛ ne bolɛ yɛ se.
mɔɔ ɔnrɛhola ye tua ɛlɛ,
9amaa yeadɛnla ngoane nu dahuu,
na yeanwu ɛlɛ a.
10Ɛhɛe, yɛkola yɛnwu kɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ bɔbɔ wu,
koasea nee gyibilito wu,
na bɛgyakyi bɛ anwonyia bɛmaa awie mɔ.
11Bɛ nla ne mɔ a le bɛ sua nu dahuu a,
ɔle bɛ tɛnlabelɛ wɔ awolɛndoazo muala anu,
noko bɛka a bɛse azɛlɛ dɔɔnwo le bɛ ɛdeɛ.
12Sonla kpoleyɛlɛ ɛnlie ye,
ɔbawu kɛ nane ala la.
13Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdie bɛ nwo bɛdi koasea nu la awieleɛ ɛne,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye die bɛ ngome bɛ nwo la awieleɛ ɛne.
14Bɛle kɛ mboane la, bɛ muala bɛbawu.
Ewule bayɛ bɛ neavolɛ.
Pɛlepɛlelilɛma bali bɛ nwo zo konim nwonlomɔ ne ala,
na bɛmɛ, bɛ nwonane bakpɔlɔ.
Mɔwuamra maanle nu a le bɛ sua nu a.
15Na Nyamenle bakpɔne me ɛkɛla
avi ewule tumi bo,
ɔluakɛ ɔbalie me ngoane.
16Saa awie nyia ɔ nwo a, mmasulo,
saa ye anwonyia yɛ kpole bɔbɔ a, mmasulo.
17Ɔluakɛ saa ɔwu a ɔnrɛva ɛhwee ɔnrɛhɔ;
ɔ nee ye anwonyia ne ɛnrɛhɔ ɛbolɔ.
18Saa ɔde aze la ɛnee ɔ nye die ɔ nwo,
na ɔnyia ayɛlɛyelɛ wɔ kpalɛ mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo a,
19ɔbadu adenle ne mɔɔ ɔ ze mɔ dule la,
bɛnrɛnwu wienyi ne bieko ɛlɛ
20Sonla ɛnga ye kpoleyɛlɛ nu dahuu,
ɔbawu kɛ nane ala la.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph.)
What Pleases God
1From east to west,
the powerful Lord God
has been calling together
everyone on earth.
2God shines brightly from Zion,
the most beautiful city.
3Our God approaches,
but not silently;
a flaming fire comes first,
and a storm surrounds him.
4God comes to judge his people.
He shouts to the heavens
and to the earth,
5“Call my followers together!
They offered me a sacrifice,
and we made an agreement.”
6The heavens announce,
“God is the judge,
and he is always honest.”
7My people, I am God!
Israel, I am your God.
Listen to my charges
against you.
8Although you offer sacrifices
and always bring gifts,
9I won't accept your offerings
of bulls and goats.
10Every animal in the forest
belongs to me,
and so do the cattle
on a thousand hills.
11I know all the birds
in the mountains,
and every wild creature
is in my care.
12If I were hungry,
I wouldn't tell you,
because I own the world
and everything in it.
13I don't eat the meat of bulls
or drink the blood of goats.
14I am God Most High!
The only sacrifice I want
is for you to be thankful
and to keep your word.
15Pray to me in time of trouble.
I will rescue you,
and you will honor me.
16But to the wicked I say:
“You don't have the right
to mention my laws or claim
to keep our agreement!
17You refused correction
and rejected my commands.
18You made friends
with every crook you met,
and you liked people who break
their wedding vows.
19You talked only about violence
and told nothing but lies;
20you sat around gossiping,
ruining the reputation
of your own relatives.”
21When you did all this,
I didn't say a word,
and you thought,
“God is just like us!”
But now I will accuse you.
22You have ignored me!
So pay close attention
or I will tear you apart,
and no one can help you.
23The sacrifice that honors me
is a thankful heart.
Obey me, and I, your God,
will show my power to save.
translation_text:
Nɔhalɛ ɛzonlenlɛ (Esafe edwɛne)
1Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, Tumivolɛ Ko ne
fɛlɛ na ɔtendɛ ɔkile ewiade amra,
ɔvi sɛnzɛne aduduleɛ mɔɔ kɔdwu adɔleɛ.
2Nyamenle ta fi Zayɔn,
suakpole mɔɔ ye kɛnlɛma di munli.
3Yɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛba, ɔmba ye bɔnwobɔnwo;
sendɔlɔra li ɔ nyunlu,
ahumu kpole ɛbɔ ɛyia ye.
4Ɔlɛfɛlɛ anwumaneamra nee azɛlɛ,
amaa yeabua ye menli ne ndɛne.
5Ɔse, “Bɛboɔboa me menli nɔhavoma ne anloa,
bɛmɛ a bɛbɔle azu bɛ nee me yɛle ngyekyeleɛ a!
6Anwumaneamra kile ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne,
ɔluakɛ Nyamenle mumua ne a le ndɛnebuavolɛ a.
7“O me menli, bɛdie na metendɛ,
O Yizilayɛma, medi daselɛ meatia bɛ.
Medame a mele Nyamenle, bɛ Nyamenle ne a.
8Mendea bɛ wɔ bɛ azubɔlɛ ne mɔ anwo;
bɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ dwu me nyunlu dahuu.
9Menrɛlie nlankɛ nyinli biala menrɛvi bɛ ɛkɛ,
yɛɛ menrɛlie abɔnkye nyinli biala wɔ bɛ ɛkɛ.
10Ɔluakɛ kpɔkɛ nu nane biala le me ɛdeɛ,
awoka apenle apenle zo nlankɛ le me ɛdeɛ.
11Meze anwomanyunlu nloma kɔsɔɔti,
yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ wɔ ɛbɔ nu la le me ɛdeɛ.
12“Saa ɛhɔne ku me a, menrɛha menrɛhile bɛ,
ɔluakɛ ewiade nee nuhua ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti le me ɛdeɛ.
13Asoo medi nlankɛ nane,
anzɛɛ meno mbɔnkye mogya?
14Bɛbɔ moyɛlɛ azu bɛmaa Nyamenle;
bɛye bɛ ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔle Anwuma Anwumanli ne la.
15Bɛzu bɛvɛlɛ me kenle biala mɔɔ ngyegyelɛ kɛdo bɛ la,
na mebalie bɛ, na bɛaye me ayɛlɛ.”
16Na Nyamenle se amumuyɛma kɛ,
“Duzu adenle a bɛlɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛka me mɛla ne mɔ,
anzɛɛ bɛka me ngyekyeleɛ ne a?
17Ɔluakɛ bɛkyi ahwibɛnyunlu,
yɛɛ bɛkpɔla me mɛla ne bɛgua bɛ nzo anzi.
18Bɛnwu awule a, bɛfa ye agɔnwolɛ;
yɛɛ bɛ nee awuvolɛvalɛma tu.
19“Bɛkeha ɛtane ɛtane, yɛɛ bɛbɔ adalɛ.
20Bɛtɛnla bɛye bɛ mediema mrenya ndɛne;
bɛbɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ nli amra mrenya anwo nzekue.
21Bɛyɛ ɛhye mɔ, noko mendɛne bɛ zo,
bɛdwenle kɛ mele kɛ bɛdabɛ la.
Na kɛkala metwi bɛ nyunlu, na meava bɛ nwo edwɛkɛ meado gua.
22“Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle fi Nyamenle la, bɛyɛ ɛhye nzonlɛ,
anrɛɛ menwɔtete bɛ, na bɛnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛlie bɛ!
23Mɔɔ kɛva moyɛlɛ kɛra kɛ ye azubɔdeɛ la di me eni;
mɔɔ kɛva adenle kpalɛ zo la,
mebahile ye Nyamenle ngoanelielɛ ne!”

english_text:
(For the music leader. A psalm by David when the prophet Nathan came to him after David had been with Bathsheba.)
A Prayer for Forgiveness
1 You are kind, God!
Please have pity on me.
You are always merciful!
Please wipe away my sins.
2Wash me clean from all
of my sin and guilt.
3I know about my sins,
and I cannot forget
the burden of my guilt.
4 You are really the one
I have sinned against;
I have disobeyed you
and have done wrong.
So it is right and fair for you
to correct and punish me.
5I have sinned and done wrong
since the day I was born.
6But you want complete honesty,
so teach me true wisdom.
7Wash me with hyssop
until I am clean
and whiter than snow.
8Let me be happy and joyful!
You crushed my bones,
now let them celebrate.
9Turn your eyes from my sin
and cover my guilt.
10Create pure thoughts in me
and make me faithful again.
11Don't chase me away from you
or take your Holy Spirit
away from me.
12Make me as happy as you did
when you saved me;
make me want to obey!
13I will teach sinners your Law,
and they will return to you.
14Keep me from any deadly sin.
Only you can save me!
Then I will shout and sing
about your power to save.
15Help me to speak,
and I will praise you, Lord.
16Offerings and sacrifices
are not what you want.
17The way to please you
is to be truly sorry
deep in our hearts.
This is the kind of sacrifice
you won't refuse.
18Please be willing, Lord,
to help the city of Zion
and to rebuild its walls.
19Then you will be pleased
with the proper sacrifices,
and we will offer bulls
on your altar once again.
translation_text:
Fakyɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Nyamenle, nwu me anwunvɔne,
kɛmɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne de la;
wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ kpole ne ati,
nunu me mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ.
2Nrinzi me ninyɛndane ne mɔ amuala bɔkɔɔ,
na te me nwo fi me ɛtane ne anwo.
3Ɔluakɛ meze me mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ,
yɛɛ me ɛtane gyi me nyunlu dahuu.
4 Wɔmɔ ala yɛɛ mevo wɔ,
na mebɔ munzule ɛbɛla ɛhye wɔ ɛ nyunlu a,
amaa wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ayɛ fɔɔnwo
na wɔanli ɛzonle wɔ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ nu.
5Nea, bɛwole me amumuyɛ nu,
yɛɛ ɛtane nu a ɔmɔ nrenzɛle me a.
6Nea, ɛkpondɛ nɔhalɛ mɔɔ wɔ sonla nu la;
yemɔti kile me nrɛlɛbɛ.
7Fa nyinlanyinla nua me, na me nwo kɛde;
bia me, na menwɔyɛ nwohyee menwɔdɛla ezukɔtweaba.
8Maa me anyelielɛ nee fɛlɛkolilɛ;
maa mbowule mɔɔ wɔbubu nu la anye ɛlie.
9Ye ɛ nye fi me ɛtane ne mɔ anwo,
na nunu me amumuyɛ ne mɔ amuala.
10O Nyamenle, bɔ ahonle mɔɔ anu te la wula me nu,
na maa me sunsum fofolɛ mɔɔ gyi kpundii la.
11Mmafuandi me ɛto,
yɛɛ mmaye wɔ Sunsum Nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛfi me nu.
12Fa wɔ ngoanelielɛ nwo anyelielɛ ne sia bɛlɛ me,
na buke wɔ munli nu sɔ me nu.
13Na menwɔhilehile mɛladonlɛma wɔ adenle ne,
na ɛtanevolɛma bazia ara wɔ ɛkɛ.
14O Nyamenle, die me fi ewule nu,
wɔmɔ Nyamenle, ɛle me ngoanelielɛ,
na mebado wɔ ngoanelielɛ nwo edwɛne.
15O Awulae, buke me nloa,
na mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ.
16Ɔluakɛ ɛ nye ɛnlie azubɔlɛ nwo;
saa mefa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ bɔbɔ memaa wɔ a,
ɛ nye ɛnrɛlie nwolɛ.
17Ahonle bɛlɛvo a le azubɔlɛ mɔɔ sɔ Nyamenle anye a,
O Nyamenle, ɛmkpo ahonle mɔɔ le bɛlɛvo
na yenlu ɔ nwo la.
18Fa fɛlɛkolilɛ yɛ Zayɔn boɛ;
die Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne mɔ fofolɛ,
19na ɛ nye alie azubɔlɛ kpalɛ nwo,
ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ nee nane mumua ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ;
na bɛkɛva nlankɛ bɛkɛbɔ azu wɔ wɔ azukponle zo.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. He wrote this when Doeg from Edom went to Saul and said, “David has gone to Ahimelech's house.”)
God Is in Control
1 You people may be strong
and brag about your sins,
but God can be trusted
day after day.
2You plan brutal crimes,
and your lying words cut
like a sharp razor.
3You would rather do evil
than good, and tell lies
than speak the truth.
4You love to say cruel things,
and your words are a trap.
5God will destroy you forever!
He will grab you and drag you
from your homes.
You will be uprooted
and left to die.
6When good people see
this fearsome sight,
they will laugh and say,
7“Just look at them now!
Instead of trusting God,
they trusted their wealth
and their cruelty.”
8But I am like an olive tree
growing in God's house,
and I can count on his love
forever and ever.
9I will always thank God
for what he has done;
I will praise his good name
when his people meet.
translation_text:
Nyamenle ndeanlɛ nee ye ɛlolɛ
1O katakyie, duzu ati a ɛfa wɔ amumuyɛ ɛtu ɛ nwo zɛhae ɛ?
Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.
2Dahuu ɛfa adwenle kɛ ɛsɛkye awie mɔ.
Ɛ nloa nlane le kɛ dadeɛ dɛma,
ɛpepɛ awie mɔ agyakɛ anzi ndinli.
3Ɛ nye die ɛtane nwo ɛtɛla kpalɛ,
ɛkulo adalɛbɔlɛ ɛtɛla nɔhalɛhanlɛ.
4Ɛkulo edwɛkɛ mɔɔ sɛkye awie mɔ la,
O adalɛ nabalabanli.
5Yemɔti Nyamenle babubu wɔ dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ;
ɔbaye wɔ yeavi wɔ sua nu;
ɔbadu wɔ yeavi teasema azɛlɛ zo.
6Tenlenema banwu ɛhye, na bɛazulo,
na bɛazele ye bɛaha kɛ,
7“Bɛnlea sonla ne mɔɔ anva Nyamenle anyɛ ye ɛvealeka,
na ɔvale ɔ rɛle ɔwulale ye anwonyia kpole ne anu
na ɔvale ye anwonyia ɔyɛle ye ɛvealeka la.”
8Na mame, mele kɛ ɔlivi baka amolɛ
wɔ Nyamenle sua nu.
Me rɛle wɔ Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anu
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
9Mebayɛ wɔ mo dahuu,
ɔboalekɛ ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔyɛ a.
Mebabɔ wɔ duma ne nolo,
wɔ wɔ menli ne anyunlu,
ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ.

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. To the tune “Mahalath.”
)
No One Can Ignore God
1 Only a fool would say,
“There is no God!”
People like that are worthless!
They are heartless and cruel
and never do right.
2From heaven God
looks down to see
if anyone is wise enough
to search for him.
3But all of them
are crooked and corrupt.
Not one of them does right.
4Won't you lawbreakers learn?
You refuse to pray,
and you gobble up
the people of God.
5But you will be terrified
worse than ever before.
God will scatter the bones
of his enemies,
and you will be ashamed
when God rejects you.
6I long for someone from Zion
to come and save Israel!
Our God, when you bless
your people again,
Jacob's family will be glad,
and Israel will celebrate.
translation_text:
Menli amumuyɛ ɛyɛlɛ
(Devidi edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ - Edw 14)
1Koasea edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛnle ɛkɛ.”
Bɛzɛkye, bɛbɔ bɛkyi ɛbɛla;
sonla ko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ a.
2Nyamenle bele ɔ nye anwuma lɔ nea menli,
ɔnea saa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma bie wɔ nu,
mɔɔ sonle Nyamenle a.
3Noko bɛ muala bɛminli,
bɛ muala bɛzɛkye bɔkɔɔ;
sonla ko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɔ ɛbɛla kpalɛ a,
kyɛkyɛ, ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ.
4Asoo amumuyɛma mɔɔ di me menli ne nwonane
kɛ bɛdi aleɛ,
na bɛnzonle Nyamenle la ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo?
5Bɛmɛ a ɛzulolɛ kpole ɛha bɛ la.
ɛzulolɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛnwunle bie ɛlɛ la ɛha bɛ!
Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle babubu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ
bɛnzonle ye la mbowule nu;
nyiane bahu bɛ, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛkpo bɛ.
6O anrɛɛ Yizilayɛma ngoanelielɛ vi Zayɔn ara!
Saa Nyamenle maa ye menli ne eza kpazi a,
Yizilayɛma anye balie na bɛali fɛlɛko

english_text:
(For the music leader. Use with stringed instruments. A special psalm that David wrote when the people of Ziph went to Saul and said, “David is hiding here with us.”)
Trusting God in Times of Trouble
1 Save me, God, by your power
and prove that I am right.
2Listen to my prayer
and hear what I say.
3Cruel strangers have attacked
and want me dead.
Not one of them cares
about you.
4You will help me, Lord God,
and keep me from falling;
5you will punish my enemies
for their evil deeds.
Be my faithful friend
and destroy them.
6I will bring a gift
and offer a sacrifice
to you, Lord.
I will praise your name
because you are good.
7You have rescued me
from all my troubles,
and my own eyes have seen
my enemies fall.

(A special psalm by David for the music leader. Use with stringed instruments.)
Betrayed by a Friend
1Listen, God, to my prayer!
Don't reject my request.
2Please listen and help me.
My thoughts are troubled,
and I keep groaning
3because my enemies attack
with loud shouts.
They treat me terribly
and hold angry grudges.
4My heart is racing fast,
and I am afraid of dying.
5I am trembling with fear,
completely terrified.
6I wish I had wings
like a dove,
so I could fly far away
and be at peace.
7I would go and live
in some distant desert.
8I would quickly find shelter
from howling winds
and raging storms.
9Confuse my enemies, Lord!
Upset their plans.
Cruelty and violence
are all I see in the city,
10and they are like guards
on patrol day and night.
The city is full of trouble,
evil, 11and corruption.
Troublemakers and liars
freely roam the streets.
12My enemies are not the ones
who sneer and make fun.
I could put up with that
or even hide from them.
13But it was my closest friend,
the one I trusted most.
14We enjoyed being together,
when we went with others
to your house, our God.
15All who hate me are controlled
by the power of evil.
Sentence them to death
and send them down alive
to the world of the dead.
16I ask for your help, Lord God,
and you will keep me safe.
17Morning, noon, and night
you hear my concerns
and my complaints.
18I am attacked from all sides,
but you will rescue me
unharmed by the battle.
19You have always ruled,
and you will hear me.
You will defeat my enemies
because they won't turn
and worship you.
20My friend turned against me
and broke his promise.
21His words were smoother
than butter, and softer
than olive oil.
But hatred filled his heart,
and he was ready to attack
with a sword.
22Our Lord, we belong to you.
We tell you what worries us,
and you won't let us fall.
23But what about those people
who are cruel and brutal?
You will throw them down
into the deepest pit
long before their time.
I trust you, Lord!
translation_text:
Sonla mɔɔ ɔ gɔnwo ɛye ye ɛmaa la nzɛlɛlɛ. Devidi edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ
1O Nyamenle, yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie me nzɛlɛlɛ;
mmakakyi ɛ nzi ɛsi me modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ!
2Bele ɛ nye nea me, na bua me;
me amaneɛnwunlɛ ɛbo me nwo zo.
3Me kpɔvolɛma alɛrayɛlɛ ne kpu me ɛbolɛ,
ɔlua amumuyɛma nzisi ne ati.
Ɔluakɛ bɛgyegye me,
bɛva me nwo ɛya, yɛɛ bɛkyi me.
4Me ahonle ɛlɛdi nyane kpole,
ewule nwo ɛzulolɛ ɛdɔ me nwo zo.
5Mesulo yɛɛ me nwo wozo me;
sulosulo ɛbɔ me kpɔkɛ.
6Na mese, “Anrɛɛ meanyia abubule ndɛbalɛ!
Anrɛɛ menwɔdu menwɔhɔlie me ɛnwomenle;
7ɛhɛe, anrɛɛ menwɔhɔ moa moa
menwɔhɔdɛnla fienemgbole ne anu.
8Anrɛɛ menwɔhɔkpondɛ kpɔda bie abo menwɔdɛnla,
menwɔye me nwo menwɔvi anwoma
nee ahumu ne anu ndɛndɛ.”
9O Awulae, sɛkye bɛ ngyehyɛlɛ biala;
mmamaa bɛ adwenle yɛ ko.
Ɔluakɛ menwu konle nee nzaka wɔ suakpole ne azo.
10Alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ bɛdua bane ne mɔ ati zo,
bɛbɔ suakpole ne mgbɔlɔka bɛyia;
ninyɛmunli nee ngyegyelɛ ɛyi ye tɛkɛɛ,
11Awukade wɔ zolɛ ɛleka biala;
nzisi nee awule ɛmkpa ye gua nu.
12Ɔnle kpɔvolɛ mɔɔ si me amgbu ala,
anrɛɛ menwɔhola menwɔgyinla ɔ nloa;
ɔnle kpɔvolɛ mɔɔ tu ɔ nwo kile me ala,
anrɛɛ menwɔnriandi menwɔvea.
13Na wɔmɔ, mɔɔ ɛle me ti pɛne,
mɔɔ me nee wɔ tu, na yɛle agɔnwolɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ
la ɔ.
14Ɛnee yɛ mu nwiɔ yɛdi yɛ nwo adwelie;
yɛdua nwo yɛkɔ Nyamenle sua nu yɛkɔsonle.
15Maa ewule ɛhu bɛ;
maa bɛzie bɛ anyewɔzo!
Amumuyɛ ɛyi bɛ awuke nee bɛ ahonle nu tɛkɛɛ.
16Mesu mefɛlɛ Nyamenle;
na Ɛdɛnkɛma balie me.
17Nɔsolɛ nu, nwonlomɔ nee ewiazo
meka me nyane na mesu,
na ɔbadie me ne.
18Ɔbalie me ɛkɛla yeara ngoane nu,
yeavi konle ɛhye mɔɔ megyi ɔ nloa la anu,
ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee me ɛlɛko la zonle.
19Nyamenle badie me, na yeaha bɛ aze,
yemɔ mɔɔ ɔvi tete ɔle belemgbunli la;
ɔboalekɛ bɛnli mɛla zo,
yɛɛ bɛnzulo Nyamenle.
20Me gɔnwo denrɛle ɔ sa tiale ɔ gɔnwo mɔ,
ɔtulule ye ngyekyeleɛ ne.
21Ɔ nloa anu menlemenle tɛla ngyenle,
noko konle ala yɛɛ ɔzo ɔlua a.
Ye edwɛkɛ yɛ fɛ tɛla asikyelɛ,
noko bɛpɛ kɛ konle dadeɛ.
22Fa wɔ adesoa ne maa Ɛdɛnkɛma,
na ɔbazɔ wɔ nu;
ɔnrɛmaa tenlenenli ɛnrɛkpo aze.
23Na wɔmɔ, O Nyamenle, ɛbavuandi bɛ
wɔagua kuma kpole ne anu;
ahɔdiawu nee ngunzima
ɛnrɛli bɛ mekɛ ne foa ko bɔbɔ.
Na mame, mebava me rɛle meawula wɔ nu.

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “A Silent Dove in the Distance.”
A special psalm by David when the Philistines captured him in Gath.)
A Prayer of Trust in God
1 Have pity, God Most High!
My enemies chase me all day.
2Many of them are pursuing
and attacking me,
3but even when I am afraid,
I keep on trusting you.
4I praise your promises!
I trust you and am not afraid.
No one can harm me.
5Enemies spend the whole day
finding fault with me;
all they think about
is how to do me harm.
6They attack from ambush,
watching my every step
and hoping to kill me.
7They won't get away
with these crimes, God,
because when you get angry,
you destroy people.
8You have kept record
of my days of wandering.
You have stored my tears
in your bottle
and counted each of them.
9When I pray, Lord God,
my enemies will retreat,
because I know for certain
that you are with me.
10I praise your promises!
11I trust you and am not afraid.
No one can harm me.
12I will keep my promises
to you, my God,
and bring you gifts.
13You protected me from death
and kept me from stumbling,
so that I would please you
and follow the light
that leads to life.
translation_text:
Bɛ rɛle mɔɔ wɔ Nyamenle anu nwo nzɛlɛlɛ.
1O Nyamenle, nwu me anwunvɔne,
ɔluakɛ menli tietia me nwo zo;
alehyenlɛ biala me kpɔvolɛma sisi me;
2me kpɔvolɛma tietia me nwo zo alehyenlɛ biala,
ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛko bɛtia me adubɛnwo nu
la zonle.
3Saa ɛzulolɛ ka me a,
mefa me rɛle mewula wɔ nu.
4Nyamenle ne mɔɔ ye edwɛkɛ ti meye ye ayɛlɛ la,
me rɛle wɔ ye nu a menzulo,
Duzu a sonla kɛhola kɛyɛ me a?
5Mekɛ biala bɛkulo kɛ bɛsɛkye me adenle nu;
dahuu bɛdwenle me nwo adwenle ɛtane.
6Bɛkuohua bɛ nloa, bɛkɔ me nwo nzia,
bɛnea me ɛhɔlɛ nee me ɛralɛ nu
kɛ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me.
7Yemɔti maa bɛ munzule ɛbɔ bɛ ti,
O Nyamenle, dua wɔ ɛya ne azo ka menli ne gua.
8Ɛdawɔ ɛze me amaneɛnwunlɛ kɔsɔɔti;
fa me monle gua toba nu ɛ!
Asoo menli ne aluma ɛnle wɔ buluku nu?
9Saa mekɛ dwu na mefɛlɛ wɔ a,
me kpɔvolɛma bagua ye bɛ nzi.
Meze ɛhye, ɔboalekɛ Nyamenle gyi me nzi.
10Mewɔ Nyamenle ne, mɔɔ ye edwɛkɛ ti meye ye ayɛlɛ,
Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ ye edwɛkɛ ti meye ye ayɛlɛ la anu.
11Nyamenle ne mɔɔ me rɛle wɔ ye nu la,
mewɔ ye nu a menzulo.
Duzu yɛɛ sonla kɛhola kɛyɛ me a?
12O Nyamenle, ɛwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ mebɔ la, ɔwɔ kɛ meye;
mebava mo azubɔdeɛ meamaa wɔ.
13Ɔluakɛ wɔye me ɛkɛla wɔvi ewule nu,
ɛhɛe, wɔzɔ me, wɔammaa meandɔ aze,
amaa mealua Nyamenle anyunlu,
wɔ wienyi ne mɔɔ ta teasema anwo zo la anu.

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
A special psalm by David when he was in the cave while running from Saul.)
Praise and Trust in Times of Trouble
1 God Most High, have pity on me!
Have mercy. I run to you
for safety.
In the shadow of your wings,
I seek protection
till danger dies down.
2I pray to you, my protector.
3You will send help from heaven
and save me,
but you will bring trouble
on my attackers.
You are faithful,
and you can be trusted.
4My enemies are fierce,
much worse than lions!
They have spears and arrows
instead of teeth,
and they have sharp swords
instead of tongues.
5May you, my God, be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
6 Enemies set traps for my feet
and struck me down.
They dug a pit in my path,
but fell in it themselves.
7I am faithful to you,
and you can trust me.
I will sing and play music
for you, my God.
8I feel wide awake!
I will wake up my harp
and wake up the sun.
9I will praise you, Lord,
for everyone to hear,
and I will sing hymns to you
in every nation.
10Your love reaches higher
than the heavens;
your loyalty extends
beyond the clouds.
11May you, my God, be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
translation_text:
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1Nwu me anwunvɔne, O Nyamenle, nwu me anwunvɔne,
ɔluakɛ wɔ nuhua yɛɛ me ɛkɛla nriandi fea a;
mebanriandi mearavea ɛ ndɛba abo,
kɔkpula kɛ ahumu mgbole ne mɔ kɛgua la.
2Mesu mefɛlɛ Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle,
Nyamenle mɔɔ maa ye edwɛkɛ di munli maa me la.
3Ɔbazoa yeamaa bɛvi anwuma bɛaralie me,
ɔbamaa nyiane ahu menli mɔɔ sisi me la.
Nyamenle bamaa ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne
nee ye nɔhalɛlilɛ ne ara me nwo zo.
4Mela awenadema avinli,
bɛdi menli adidikpoku nu;
bɛ gye le kɛ atwɛ nee ɛda,
bɛ nloa nlane le kɛ dadeɛ.
5O Nyamenle, kile wɔ kpoleyɛlɛ ne wɔ anwuma lɔ!
Maa wɔ anyunlunyia ne ɛda ewiade amuala!
6Bɛzuale me ɛhane;
nyane bole me nwo zo.
Bɛvunle kuma wɔ me adenle nu,
na bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛgua nuhua.
7O Nyamenle, me ahonle gyi kpundii,
me ahonle gyi kpundii!
Mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ!
8Dwazo, me ɛkɛla!
Bɛdwazo, me getaa mgbole nee ngyikyi!
Mefa ayɛlɛyelɛ meamaa mangyee ye akpudwu.
9O Awulae, mebayɛ wɔ mo,
wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti avinli;
mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ meahile maanle maanle.
10Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne le kpole dwu anwuma,
wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne dwu amungu ne anu lɔ.
11O Nyamenle, kile wɔ kpoleyɛlɛ ne wɔ anwuma lɔ!
Maa wɔ anyunlunyia ne ɛda ewiade amuala!

english_text:
(A special psalm by David for the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
)
A Prayer When All Goes Wrong
1Do you mighty people talk
only to oppose justice?
Don't you ever judge fairly?
2You are always planning evil,
and you are brutal.
3You have done wrong and lied
from the day you were born.
4Your words spread poison
like the bite of a cobra
5that refuses to listen
to the snake charmer.
6My enemies are fierce
as lions, Lord God!
Shatter their teeth.
Snatch out their fangs.
7Make them disappear
like leaking water,
and make their arrows miss.
8Let them dry up like snails
or be like a child that dies
before seeing the sun.
9Wipe them out quicker
than a pot can be heated
by setting thorns on fire.
10Good people will be glad
when they see the wicked
getting what they deserve,
and they will wash their feet
in their enemies' blood.
11Everyone will say, “It's true!
Good people are rewarded.
God does indeed rule the earth
with justice.”
translation_text:
Amumuyɛma ɛdeanlɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1Bɛmɛ maanlebuvoma, asoo bɛka nɔhalɛ?
Asoo bɛbua menli ndɛne nɔhalɛ nu?
2Kyɛkyɛ, ngunzi ɛyi bɛ tɛkɛɛ,
na bɛdi ɛtane wɔ ewiade ye anu.
3Amumuyɛma nee bɛ petebɔlɛ ne vi bɛ nli akunlu,
bɛ nvonleɛ vi bɛ awolɛ nu, yɛɛ bɛbɔ adalɛ.
4Bɛ nloa anu bɔlɔ le kɛ ɛwɔlɛ bɔlɔ,
bɛ nzo ɛdi kɛ ɛwɔlɛ bɔna,
5mɔɔ ɛnde silikyevoma ane,
na yeayɛ ngonyiama edwɛne.
6O Nyamenle, bubu bɛ gye mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nloa anu la;
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tudu awenadema ngyikyi ne mɔ agye ndendenle ne.
7Maa bɛze bɛhɔ kɛ azule mɔɔ ɛdukue la,
maa bɛyɛ kɛ ndile, bɛtietia bɛ nwo zo, bɛgyengye.
8Maa bɛyɛ kɛ ɛnlonkoɛ mɔɔ kolo yɛ ndeteata,
maa bɛyɛ kɛ ralɛ mɔɔ ka nzule nu la.
9Nyamenle bava ɛya kpole apia bɛ anyewɔzo ahɔ;
bɛ nye zo katete bɛ la
ɛnee bɛpɛ bɛ bɛgua kɛ ndile amolɛ.
10Tenlenenli ne nwu nzenralɛ ne a ɔ nye balie;
ɔbawudwu amumuyɛma mogya ne.
11Menli baha kɛ, “Nɔhalɛ, tenlenema ɛnyia bɛ
ahatualɛ;
nɔhalɛ, Nyamenle wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bua ewiade ndɛne a.”

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
A special psalm by David when Saul had David's house watched so that he could kill him.)
A Prayer for Protection
1 Save me, God! Protect me
from enemy attacks!
2Keep me safe from brutal people
who want to kill me.
3Merciless enemies, Lord,
are hiding and plotting,
hoping to kill me.
I have not hurt them
in any way at all.
4But they are ready to attack.
Do something! Help me!
Look at what's happening.
5 Lord God All-Powerful,
you are the God of Israel.
Punish the other nations
and don't pity those terrible
and rebellious people.
6My enemies return at evening,
growling like dogs
roaming the city.
7They curse, and their words
cut like swords,
as they say to themselves,
“No one can hear us!”
8You, Lord, laugh at them
and sneer at the nations.
9You are my mighty fortress,
and I depend on you.
10You love me and will let me
see my enemies defeated.
11Don't kill them,
or everyone may forget!
Just use your mighty power
to make them tremble
and fall.
You are a shield
for your people.
12My enemies are liars!
So let them be trapped
by their boastful lies.
13Get angry and destroy them.
Leave them in ruin.
Then all the nations will know
that you rule in Israel.
14Those liars return at evening,
growling like dogs
roaming the city.
15They search for scraps of food,
and they snarl
until they are stuffed.
16But I will sing about
your strength, my God,
and I will celebrate
because of your love.
You are my fortress,
my place of protection
in times of trouble.
17I will sing your praises!
You are my mighty fortress,
and you love me.
translation_text:
Sonla nwo banebɔlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ
1O me Nyamenle, die me fi me kpɔvolɛma asa anu,
bɔ me nwo bane wɔ menli mɔɔ dwazo me nwo zo la asa anu,
2die me fi menli mɔɔ bɔ amumuyɛ ɛbɛla la asa anu,
na die me fi ahɔdiawu ne mɔ asa anu.
3Ɔluakɛ, nea, bɛhɔ me nwo nzia,
menli atisesebɛ ɛli me ti amonle.
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, metɛyɛle ɛtane, metɛtonle mɛla biala,
4metɛfonle, noko bɛnriandi bɛkɔ me nwo nzia.
Maa ɛ nwo zo, bɛla baboa me, na nea!
5Wɔmɔ, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle, ɛle Yizilayɛ Nyamenle.
Dwazo tea maanle maanle ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti;
mmafavi amumuyɛma atisesebɛ ye anu biala.
6Nɔɔzo biala bɛsia bɛba me nwo zo,
bɛkpo kɛ ahwea
bɛbɔ suakpole ye mgbɔlɔka.
7Kɛ bɛlua lɔ ɛ, bɛlɛtea kɛ bɛli tweanga,
na bɛnrese bɛ gye,
bɛ edwɛkɛ se, “Nwane a kɛde yɛ ne a?”
8Na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛsele bɛ,
ɛsi maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnzonle wɔ la amgbu.
9O me Anwosesebɛ, mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ, O Nyamenle, ɛle me aranemgbole.
10Me Nyamenle balua ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne azo ayia me;
me Nyamenle bamaa meanwu kɛ
me kpɔvolɛma ne ɛho ɛdɔ.
11Mmaku bɛ, anrɛɛ me menli ne arɛle kɛvi;
fa wɔ tumi ne maa bɛyɛ gyigyiligyigyili,
na ka bɛ gua aze,
O Awulae, yɛ wowavolɛ.
12Bɛ nloa edwɛkɛ nee bɛ munzule adwenle biala ati
maa bɛ mgbanyizonle ɛbu ɛzia bɛ.
Kɛmɔ bɛbɔ adalɛ na bɛwa amonle la,
13maa wɔ ɛya kpole ne ɛyela bɛ wee,
ɛmaa bɛdɔ nzonle, bɛ bo zo ɛminli,
amaa menli anwu kɛ Nyamenle le belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ
toonwo ɔdwu ewiade ɛleka biala.
14Nɔɔzo biala bɛsia bɛba me nwo zo,
bɛkpo kɛ ahwea
bɛbɔ suakpole ye mgbɔlɔka.
15Bɛduolua nu bɛkpondɛ aleɛ,
na saa bɛ ko anyi a ɛnee bɛlɛkpo.
16Na mame, mebado wɔ anwosesebɛ nwo edwɛne;
mebado wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo edwɛne nwonlomɔ,
ɔluakɛ wɔyɛ me aranemgbole
nee me ɛvealeka wɔ me amaneɛnwunlɛ mekɛ nu.
17O me Anwosesebɛ, mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ, O Nyamenle, ɛle me aranemgbole,
Nyamenle ne mɔɔ kile ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii me nwo zo la.

english_text:
(For the music leader. To the tune “Lily of the Promise.” A special psalm by David for teaching. He wrote it during his wars with the Arameans of northern Syria,
when Joab came back and killed twelve thousand Edomites
in Salt Valley.)
You Can Depend on God
1 You, God, are angry with us!
We are rejected and crushed.
Make us strong again!
2You made the earth shake
and split wide open;
now heal its wounds
and stop its trembling.
3You brought hard times
on your people,
and you gave us wine
that made us stagger.
4You gave a signal to those
who worship you,
so they could escape
from enemy arrows.
5Answer our prayers, God!
Use your powerful arm
and give us victory.
Then the people you love
will be safe.
6Our God, you solemnly promised,
“I would gladly divide up
the city of Shechem
and give away Succoth Valley
piece by piece.
7The lands of Gilead
and Manasseh are mine.
Ephraim is my war helmet,
and Judah is the symbol
of my royal power.
8Moab is merely my washbasin.
Edom belongs to me,
and I shout in triumph
over the Philistines.”
9Our God, who will bring me
to the fortress,
or lead me to Edom?
10Have you rejected us
and deserted our armies?
11Help us defeat our enemies!
No one else can rescue us.
12You will give us victory
and crush our enemies.
translation_text:
Sonla Ngoanelielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Nyamenle, wɔkpo yɛ,
wɔgologolo yɛ nwo banebɔlɛ;
wɔva yɛ nwo ɛya; O, fa yɛ sie yɛ bo zo ne.
2Wɔmaa azɛlɛ ɛkpusu, wɔmaa yekpuke;
ka mua nwolɛ, na ɔlɛwaye.
3Wɔmaa wɔ menli ne ɛnwu amaneɛ dɔɔnwo;
wɔmaa yɛ nwanye yɛnlo yɛyɛ tindaanwu.
4Wɔvola fɛlɛnra wɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo wɔ la,
kɛ bɛnriandi bɛradane ye.
5Amaa wɔalie menli mɔɔ kulo wɔ la ngoane la,
bua yɛ nwolɛ na maa ɛ sa fema zo, maa yɛli konim.
