6Nyamenle ɛdendɛ wɔ ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne,
ɔse, “Mebahyɛ Hyikɛm anu konimlilɛ nu
na meahyɛ Sɛko Bɔnza meamaa me menli ne.
7Geleade le me ɛdeɛ; Manasɛ le me ɛdeɛ;
Yifelaem le me kyɛlɛ; Dwuda le me tumi kpɔma;
8Mowabe le me kyɛnze bonkuma
mɔɔ menrinzi me sa anwo nu,
mefuandi me mgbɔlaboa megua Yidɔm anwo zo;
metea nu konimlilɛ nu megua Filisitiama anwo zo.”
9Nwane a kɛva me kɛhɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛhye nwo la azo a?
Nwane a kɛva me kɛhɔ Yidɔm a?
10O Nyamenle, asoo ɛtɛkpole yɛ ɛ?
O Nyamenle, ɛ nee yɛ ɛlɔnema ne angɔ.
11O boa yɛ wɔ kpɔvolɛ ne ati,
ɔluakɛ sonla moalɛ le mgbane.
12Saa Nyamenle boka yɛ nwo a yɛbaho yɛadɔ zo;
yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbaha kpɔvolɛma ne yeagua a.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader. Use with stringed instruments.)
Under the Protection of God
1Please listen, God,
and answer my prayer!
2I feel hopeless,
and I cry out to you
from a faraway land.
Lead me to the mighty rock
high above me.
3You are a strong tower,
where I am safe
from my enemies.
4Let me live with you forever
and find protection
under your wings, my God.
5You heard my promises,
and you have blessed me,
just as you bless everyone
who worships you.
6Let the king have a long
and healthy life.
7May he always rule
with you, God, at his side;
may your love and loyalty
watch over him.
8I will sing your praises
forever, God, and will always
keep my promises.
translation_text:
Sonla nwo banebɔlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Nyamenle, tie me ɛzunlɛ,
tie me nzɛlɛlɛ;
2saa nyane bo me nwo zo na mewɔ moa moa a
mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ.
Fa me kɔzie bodane mɔɔ wɔ anwuma tɛla me la azo.
3Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ a ɛle me ɛvealeka,
ɛle me pepɛdievolɛ anwosesebɛ
mɔɔ ko tia me kpɔvolɛ ne a.
4Maa mendɛnla wɔ Ndanlɛ Sua ne anu dahuu,
amaa me nwo ayɛ kɔlɔnwo wɔ ɛ ndɛba abo.
5Ɔluakɛ, wɔmɔ Nyamenle, wɔde me ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ,
na wɔmaa me agyadeɛ ne mɔɔ
menli mɔɔ sulo wɔ la nyia ye la.
6Maa belemgbunli ne ɛnyi ɛhyɛ;
ɔli mekɛ dɔɔnwo ɔdwu awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu.
7Maa ɔli belemgbunli dahuu wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu;
maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne
ɛrɛla ɔ nwo zo ɛzinza ye.
8Yemɔti saa alehyenlɛ biala melɛye wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne a,
mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ duma ne ayɛlɛ.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for Jeduthun, the music leader.)
God Is Powerful and Kind
1Only God can save me,
and I calmly wait for him.
2God alone is the mighty rock
that keeps me safe
and the fortress
where I am secure.
3I feel like a shaky fence
or a sagging wall.
How long will all of you
attack and assault me?
4You want to bring me down
from my place of honor.
You love to tell lies,
and when your words are kind,
hatred hides in your heart.
5Only God gives inward peace,
and I depend on him.
6God alone is the mighty rock
that keeps me safe,
and he is the fortress
where I feel secure.
7God saves me and honors me.
He is that mighty rock
where I find safety.
8Trust God, my friends,
and always tell him
each of your concerns.
God is our place of safety.
9We humans are only a breath;
none of us are truly great.
All of us together weigh less
than a puff of air.
10Don't trust in violence
or depend on dishonesty
or rely on great wealth.
11I heard God say two things:
“I am powerful,
12 and I am very kind.”
The Lord rewards each of us
according to what we do.
translation_text:
Kpundii ɛgyinlanlɛ wɔ Nyamenle banebɔlɛ nwo
1Nyamenle ala yɛɛ me ɛkɛla yɛ koonwu kendɛ ye a,
ye ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ me ngoanelielɛ vi ba a.
2Ɔ ngomekye ala a ɔle me bodane nee me ngoanelielɛ a,
ɔle me aranemgbole; awie ɛnrɛli me nwo zo konim.
3Kenlenzu yɛɛ bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛkɛgyakyi sonla nwo nziahɔlɛ
kɛ bɛku ye a?
Sonla mɔɔ bane mɔɔ ɛhyea bɔbɔ la
lɛ anwosesebɛ tɛla ye la.
4Bɛ adwenle a le kɛ bɛmaa ye dibilɛ abɔ ye,
bɛ anyelielɛ a le adalɛbɔlɛ.
Bɛfa bɛ nloa bɛyileyila,
noko bɛ kunlu ɛdeɛ, ɔle amowa.
5Nyamenle ala yɛɛ me ɛkɛla yɛ koonwu kendɛ ye a,
ɔluakɛ me anyelazo muala vi ye ɛkɛ.
6Ɔ ngomekye ala a ɔle me bodane nee me ngoanelielɛ a,
ɔle me aranemgbole; awie ɛnrɛli me nwo zo konim.
7Nyamenle anwo zo yɛɛ me ngoanelielɛ nee me enililɛ ne gyi a;
Nyamenle le me bodane kpole nee me ɛvealeka.
8O adɛsa, bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula Nyamenle anu dahuu;
bɛha bɛ ngyianlɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛhile ye;
Nyamenle le yɛ ɛvealeka.
9Awienvolɛma le kɛ anwoma,
mgbolema le kɛ ɛlalɛ;
ɛgua bɛ tone zo a bɛndo ɛhwee;
bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ ɛnlomboɛ ɛndo anwoma.
10Mmafa ɛ rɛle ɛwula apobɔlɛ nu,
mmafa ɛ nye ɛto ɛwualɛ zo;
saa anwonyia nu noko a, mmafa wɔ ahonle ɛto zo.
11Nyamenle ɛdendɛ ko;
mede ɛhye fane nwiɔ;
kɛ tumi le Nyamenle ɛdeɛ.
12 O Awulae, wɔmɔ a ɛlɛ ɛhulolɛ kpundii a.
Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛtua sonla kakɛ,
kɛmɔ ye gyima si de la a.

english_text:
(A psalm by David when he was in the desert of Judah.)
God's Love Means More than Life
1 You are my God. I worship you.
In my heart, I long for you,
as I would long for a stream
in a scorching desert.
2I have seen your power
and your glory
in the place of worship.
3Your love means more
than life to me,
and I praise you.
4As long as I live,
I will pray to you.
5I will sing joyful praises
and be filled with excitement
like a guest at a banquet.
6I think about you, God,
before I go to sleep,
and my thoughts turn to you
during the night.
7You have helped me,
and I sing happy songs
in the shadow of your wings.
8I stay close to you,
and your powerful arm
supports me.
9All who want to kill me
will end up in the ground.
10Swords will run them through,
and wild dogs will eat them.
11Because of you, our God,
the king will celebrate
with your faithful followers,
but liars will be silent.
translation_text:
Nyamenle nwo anwoalɔlɛ
1O Nyamenle, wɔmɔ a ɛle me Nyamenle a, mekpondɛ wɔ,
me ɛkɛla anwo ɛlɛdɔ wɔ;
me sonla mumua ne ɛlɛpele akpondɛ wɔ,
kɛ azɛlɛ resee mɔɔ ɛhwie na ɔlɛkpondɛ nzule la.
2Yemɔti menlea ɛ nyunlu wɔ wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne,
na menwu wɔ tumi ne nee wɔ anyunlunyia ne.
3Kɛmɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne le kpalɛ tɛla ngoane la,
mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ.
4Yemɔti sumunli kenle ala mɔɔ mede ngoane nu la,
mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
mebakpogya me sa zo meabɔ wɔ duma.
5Bɛli me ɛkɛla adane bɛmaa yeyɛ belane toboo,
na mefa fɛlɛkolilɛ meye wɔ ayɛlɛ.
6Saa mela me ɛkpa zo a medwenle ɛ nwo,
na me adwenle gyinla ɛ nwo zo nɔe ne amuala.
7Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ, wɔyɛ me moalɛ;
na mefea ɛ ndɛba abo meto anyelielɛ edwɛne.
8Me ɛkɛla beta wɔ kyengye;
ɛ sa fema ne lɛ me nu.
9Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la
bahɔ azɛlɛ bo kuma nu;
10bɛbaye bɛ bɛamaa bɛawu dadeɛ nloa,
na bɛayɛ nanemgbole aleɛ.
11Na Nyamenle ati, belemgbunli ne anye balie;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa ye bɛka ndane la
anyunlu bara anyia;
ɔluakɛ adalɛma baha bɛ nloa ado nu.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
Celebrate because of the Lord
1Listen to my concerns, God,
and protect me
from my enemies' threats.
2Keep me safe from secret plots
of corrupt and evil gangs.
3Their words cut like swords,
and their cruel remarks
sting like sharp arrows.
4They fearlessly ambush
and shoot innocent people.
5They are determined to do evil,
and they tell themselves,
“Let's set traps!
No one can see us.”
6They make evil plans and say,
“We'll commit a perfect crime.
No one knows our thoughts.”
7But God will shoot his arrows
and quickly wound them.
8They will be destroyed
by their own words,
and everyone who sees them
will tremble with fear.
9They will be afraid and say,
“Look at what God has done
and keep it all in mind.”
10May the Lord bless his people
with peace and happiness
and let them celebrate.
translation_text:
Sonla nwo banebɔlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Nyamenle, tie me ne, na ngyegyelɛ ɛdo me;
kpɔvolɛ ne anwo ɛzulolɛ ti, die me ngoane.
2Ye me fi amumuyɛma awozinli nu kpɔkɛ mɔɔ bɛbɔ,
nee ɛtanema adwenle biala anu.
3Bɛsi bɛ tafinlima ne mɔ kɛ dadeɛ,
bɛ edwɛkɛ wowɔ kɛ ɛda mbaka.
4Bɛkɔ nzia na bɛto bɛwowɔ sonla mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie;
bɛto ye arɛlevilɛ nu, yɛɛ bɛnzulo nwolɛ fee.
5Bɛsɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ɛyɛlɛ ne anu kpundii;
bɛdi awozinli nu ɛhane ɛzualɛ nwo adwelie;
bɛka ye bɛ ti anu kɛ, “Nwane a kɛnwu yɛ a?
6Nwane a kɛnwu yɛ maamɔvo ɛbɛla ye anzi a?
Yɛdwenle yɛbɔ amumuyɛ nrɛlɛbɛ kpɔkɛ.”
Ɔluakɛ sonla biala adwenle nee ye ahonle nu le kuma!
7Na Nyamenle bado ye ɛda ne awɔ bɛ;
bɛbaboda arɛlevilɛ nu.
8Bɛ nloa ne ati, ɔbazɛkye bɛ;
awie biala mɔɔ kɛnwu bɛ la bakpusu ɔ ti.
9Akee menli kɔsɔɔti bazulo;
bɛbaha gyima mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛli la,
na bɛadwenle mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo.
10Ɛdɛnkɛma ati bɛmaa tenlenema anye ɛlie,
na bɛvea ye nu!
Bɛmaa awie biala mɔɔ ahonle nu te la anye ɛlie.

english_text:
(A psalm by David and a song for the music leader.)
God Answers Prayer
1Our God, you deserve praise
in Zion, where we keep
our promises to you.
2Everyone will come to you
because you answer prayer.
3When our sins get us down,
you forgive us.
4You bless your chosen ones,
and you invite them
to live near you
in your temple.
We will enjoy your house,
the sacred temple.
5Our God, you save us,
and your fearsome deeds answer
our prayers for justice!
You give hope to people
everywhere on earth,
even those across the sea.
6You are strong,
and your mighty power
put the mountains in place.
7You silence the roaring waves
and the noisy shouts
of the nations.
8People far away marvel
at your fearsome deeds,
and all who live under the sun
celebrate and sing
because of you.
9You take care of the earth
and send rain to help the soil
grow all kinds of crops.
Your rivers never run dry,
and you prepare the earth
to produce abundant grain.
10You water all its fields
and level the lumpy ground.
You send showers of rain
to soften the soil
and help the plants sprout.
11Wherever your footsteps
touch the earth,
a rich harvest is gathered.
12Desert pastures blossom,
and mountains celebrate.
13Meadows are filled
with sheep and goats;
valleys overflow with grain
and echo with joyful songs.
translation_text:
Ayɛlɛyelɛ nee moyɛlɛ
1O Nyamenle, ɔfɛta kɛ yɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ wɔ Zayɔn;
wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛye yɛ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ yɛmaa wɔ a,
2Wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛtie yɛ nzɛlɛlɛ la!
Wɔ ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ menli kɔsɔɔti ba
wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati a.
3Saa yɛ mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ bo yɛ nwo zo a,
ɛfa ɛkyɛ yɛ.
4Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ɛkɛkpa nu ɛkɛye ye,
ɛkɛva ye ɛkɛra kɛ ɔradɛnla wɔ ɛleka
nwuanzanwuanza ne la.
Yɛ kunlu badwo wɔ sua nu,
wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ne kpalɛyɛlɛ nwo.
5Ɛfa nyɛleɛ ɛzulolɛ ɛye yɛ ɛfi ewule nu,
O yɛ ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle,
ɛle ewiade amuala anyelazo,
nyevile nzi amra amuala anyelazo a le wɔ.
6Wɔ anwosesebɛ yɛɛ ɛvale ɛhyehyɛle awoka
ɛhilele wɔ tumi kpole ne a.
7Wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛmaa nyevile gua diinyi,
azɛlɛkye gyakyi ɛbulɛ,
na menli adwenle begyebegyeyɛlɛ gyakyi;
8amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde ewiade ye ati nee ɔ bo la
anwu wɔ sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ na bɛazulo wɔ.
Ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛmaa ɛnyelɛ die
alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ a.
9Ɛkpɔla azɛlɛ ye na ɛtɔ nzule ɛgua zo;
ɛmaa ɔyɛ azɛlɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ la.
Ɛmaa azule ne mɔ yi tɛkɛɛ;
ɛmaa bɛ ma yɛ kpalɛ,
ɔluakɛ kɛ ɛhyehyɛle ye la ɛne.
10Ɛtɔ ezule dɔɔnwo ɛgua ɛya avule ne mɔ azo,
ɛmaa ɔtuodua bɛ ahuma ne mɔ;
ɛtɔ nyenyensuo ɛmaa azɛlɛ ne do,
na ɛyila zo ɛmaa mbaka nyi.
11Ɛmaa bɛ bɛyɔba so dɔɔnwo;
ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɛkɛva la aleɛ bu.
12Adidileka ne mɔ ndile bele gua zo,
anyelielɛ ɛva awoka ne mɔ.
13Mboane ɛyi ɛbɔ ne mɔ abo;
abɛlɛ ɛyi mbɔnza tɛkɛɛ,
na bɛtea nu bɛto anyelielɛ edwɛne.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm for the music leader.)
Shout Praises to God
1Tell everyone on this earth
to shout praises to God!
2Sing about his glorious name.
Honor him with praises.
3Say to God, “Everything you do
is fearsome,
and your mighty power makes
your enemies come crawling.
4You are worshiped by everyone!
We all sing praises to you.”
5Come and see the fearsome things
our God has done!
6 When God made the sea dry up,
our people walked across,
and because of him,
we celebrated there.
7His mighty power rules forever,
and nothing the nations do
can be hidden from him.
So don't turn against God.
8All of you people,
come praise our God!
Let his praises be heard.
9God protects us from death
and keeps us steady.
10Our God, you tested us,
just as silver is tested.
11You trapped us in a net
and gave us heavy burdens.
12You sent war chariots
to crush our skulls.
We traveled through fire
and through floods,
but you brought us
to a land of plenty.
13I will bring sacrifices
into your house, my God,
and I will do what I promised
14when I was in trouble.
15I will sacrifice my best sheep
and offer bulls and goats
on your altar.
16All who worship God,
come here and listen;
I will tell you everything
God has done for me.
17I prayed to the Lord,
and I praised him.
18If my thoughts had been sinful,
he would have refused
to hear me.
19But God did listen
and answered my prayer.
20Let's praise God!
He listened when I prayed,
and he is always kind.
translation_text:
Ayɛlɛyelɛ nee moyɛlɛ edwɛne
1Ewiade amra amuala, bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdeɛdea nu
bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ.
2Bɛdo anyunlunyia edwɛne bɛhanvo ye duma ne;
bɛyeyɛ ye anyunlunyia nu!
3Bɛha bɛhile Nyamenle kɛ, “Wɔ gyima yɛ ɛzulolɛ!
Wɔ tumi ne kpole ti wɔ kpɔvolɛma tu gua ɛ nyunlu.
4Ewiade amuala sonle wɔ;
bɛto ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa wɔ,
bɛto edwɛne bɛye wɔ duma ayɛlɛ.”
5Bɛrɛla bɛranlea debie mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛyɛ la,
ye gyimayɛlɛ wɔ menli avinli yɛ ɛzulolɛ.
6 Ɔmanle nyevile ne yɛle azɛlɛ resee;
menli diale bɛ gyakɛ anu pɛle azule ne.
Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ yɛ nye liele ye nu a.
7Ye tumi ne kpole ti ɔdi belemgbunli dahuu,
ɔ nye wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anwo zo;
mmamaa menli mɔɔ ɛde atua la memaa bɛ nwo zo.
8Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, bɛye yɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ,
bɛmaa bɛ ayɛlɛyelɛ ne ɛdwu ɛleka biala.
9Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔtɛmaa yɛtɛte aze,
na ɔtɛmanle yɛtɛtɔle aze a.
10Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ Nyamenle, wɔzɔ yɛ wɔnlea;
wɔzɔ yɛ wɔnlea kɛ bɛsɔ dwɛtɛ fufule bɛnea la.
11Ɛmanle yɛhɔguale ɛhane nu,
na ɛzoale yɛ ɛnlomboɛ;
12ɛmanle menli tietiale yɛ nwo zo;
yɛluale senle nee nzule nu,
noko wɔva yɛ wɔra azɛlɛ mɔɔ tɛlɛ la azo.
13Mebava ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ meara wɔ sua nu;
mebaye me ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔ
14mɔɔ membɔle,
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ mewɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu la.
15Mebava nane mɔɔ ɛlɔ la
meayɛ ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ meamaa wɔ;
mebava mboane nyinli meabɔ ɛyelalɛ azu meamaa wɔ;
mebava nlankɛ nyinli nee mbɔnkye meabɔ azu meamaa wɔ,
na ye esike adwu anwomanyunlu.
16Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Nyamenle la, bɛrɛla bɛradie,
na mebaha mɔɔ yeyɛ yemaa me la meahile bɛ.
17Menzunle kpole kpalɛ menvɛlɛle ye,
yɛɛ eza menyeyɛle ye.
18Saa ɛnee ɛtane wɔ me ahonle nu a,
anrɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnrɛdie me.
19Na nɔhalɛ, Nyamenle ɛdie me;
yedie me nzɛlɛlɛ.
20Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Nyamenle,
ɔboalekɛ yeamkpo me nzɛlɛlɛ ne,
yɛɛ yeanye ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne me nwo zo!

english_text:
(A psalm and a song for the music leader. Use with stringed instruments.)
Tell the Nations To Praise God
1Our God, be kind and bless us!
Be pleased and smile.
2Then everyone on earth
will learn to follow you,
and all nations will see
your power to save us.
3Make everyone praise you
and shout your praises.
4Let the nations celebrate
with joyful songs,
because you judge fairly
and guide all nations.
5Make everyone praise you, God,
and shout your praises.
6Our God has blessed the earth
with a wonderful harvest!
7Pray for his blessings
to continue
and for everyone on earth
to worship our God.
translation_text:
Moyɛlɛ edwɛne
1Nyamenle ɛnwu yɛ anwunvɔne na ɔyila yɛ,
na ɔmaa ɔ nyunlu ɛda yɛ nwo zo,
2amaa ewiade amuala anwu wɔ adenle ne,
na maanle maanle anwu wɔ ngoanelielɛ tumi ne.
3O Nyamenle, maa menli kɔsɔɔti ɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ;
maa menli kɔsɔɔti ɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ!
4Maa maanle maanle anye ɛlie
na bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdo edwɛne,
ɔluakɛ ɛfa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ɛbua menli ndɛne,
na ɛsinza maanle maanle wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo.
5O Nyamenle, maa menli kɔsɔɔti ɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ;
maa menli kɔsɔɔti ɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ!
6Azɛlɛ ye ɛhye aleɛ dɔɔnwo ɛmaa yɛ,
Nyamenle, yɛ Nyamenle ne, ɛyila yɛ.
7Nyamenle ɛyila yɛ;
bɛmaa ewiade amuala ɛzulo ye!

english_text:
(A psalm and a song by David for the music leader.)
God Will Win the Battle
1Do something, God!
Scatter your hateful enemies.
Make them turn and run.
2Scatter them like smoke!
When you come near,
make them melt
like wax in a fire.
3But let your people be happy
and celebrate because of you.
4Our God, you are the one
who rides on the clouds,
and we praise you.
Your name is the Lord,
and we celebrate
as we worship you.
5Our God, from your sacred home
you take care of orphans
and protect widows.
6You find families
for those who are lonely.
You set prisoners free
and let them prosper,
but all who rebel will live
in a scorching desert.
7You set your people free,
and you led them
through the desert.
8 God of Israel,
the earth trembled,
and rain poured down.
You alone are the God
who rules from Mount Sinai.
9When your land was thirsty,
you sent showers
to refresh it.
10Your people settled there,
and you were generous
to everyone in need.
11You gave the command, Lord,
and a chorus of women told
what had happened:
12“Kings and their armies
retreated and ran,
and everything they left
is now being divided.
13And for those who stayed back
to guard the sheep,
there are metal doves
with silver-coated wings
and shiny gold feathers.”
14God All-Powerful, you scattered
the kings like snow falling
on Mount Zalmon.
15Our Lord and our God,
Bashan is a mighty mountain
covered with peaks.
16Why is it jealous of Zion,
the mountain you chose
as your home forever?
17When you, Lord God, appeared
to your people at Sinai,
you came with thousands
of mighty chariots.
18 When you climbed
the high mountain,
you took prisoners with you
and were given gifts.
Your enemies didn't want you
to live there,
but they gave you gifts.
19We praise you, Lord God!
You treat us with kindness
day after day,
and you rescue us.
20You always protect us
and save us from death.
21Our Lord and our God,
your terrible enemies
are ready for war,
but you will crush
their skulls.
22You promised to bring them
from Bashan
and from the deepest sea.
23Then we could wash our feet
in their blood,
and our dogs could chew
on their bones.
24We have seen crowds marching
to your place of worship,
our God and King.
25Singers come first,
and then the musicians,
surrounded by young women
playing tambourines.
26They come shouting,
“People of Israel,
praise the Lord God!”
27The small tribe of Benjamin
leads the way,
followed by the leaders
from Judah.
Then come the leaders
from Zebulun and Naphtali.
28Our God, show your strength!
Show us once again.
29Then kings will bring gifts
to your temple
in Jerusalem.
30Punish that animal
that lives in the swamp!
Punish that nation
whose leaders and people
are like wild bulls.
Make them come crawling
with gifts of silver.
Scatter those nations
that enjoy making war.
31Force the Egyptians to bring
gifts of bronze;
make the Ethiopians hurry
to offer presents.
32Now sing praises to God!
Every kingdom on earth,
sing to the Lord!
33Praise the one who rides
across the ancient skies;
listen as he speaks
with a mighty voice.
34Tell about God's power!
He is honored in Israel,
and he rules the skies.
35The God of Israel is fearsome
in his temple,
and he makes us strong.
Let's praise our God!
translation_text:
Maanle konimlilɛ edwɛne
1Nyamenle ɛdwazo ɔmaa ye kpɔvolɛma ɛbɔ asande;
menli mɔɔ kyi ye la ɛnriandi ɛvi ɔ nyunlu!
2Wuda bɛ kɔ kɛ bɛwuda esike la;
kolo bɛ kɛ senle kolo ɛyɛlɛ;
maa amumuyɛma ɛminli Nyamenle anyunlu!
3Maa tenlenema ne anye ɛlie;
maa bɛli wulupe wɔ Nyamenle anyunlu;
maa bɛ nye ɛlie na bɛli fɛlɛko.
4Bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Nyamenle;
bɛdo edwɛne bɛye ye duma ne ayɛlɛ;
bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa mɔɔ tɛnla amungu zo tia la;
ye duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛli wulupe wɔ ɔ nyunlu!
5Nrisa bɛ ze nee ahunlanvolɛ pepɛdievolɛ
a le Nyamenle mɔɔ de ye nwuanzanwuanza ɛleka ne la.
6Nyamenle maa mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la awuke maa ɔboa nu;
ɔye pilizama ɔfinde ɔmaa bɛkpazi;
na ɔmaa atuadelɛma tɛnla azɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛhwie la azo.
7O Nyamenle, mɔɔ ɛnee ɛli wɔ menli ne anyunlu,
mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ lua ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la,
8 azɛlɛ kpusule, ezule dɔle,
kɛ ɛdawɔ Nyamenle wɔye ɛ nyunlu a;
Nyamenle, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne yele ɔ nyunlu la,
Saenae Boka kpusule dikyidikyi.
9O Nyamenle, ɛmanle ezule dɔle dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛleka biala.
na ɛmanle agyadeɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛsɛkye la yɛle boɛ.
10Wɔ nyɛmoa nyianle ɛleka nuhua dɛnlanle;
wɔ kpalɛ ti, O Nyamenle,
ɛmanle ɛhyianvolɛma nyianle bɛ kyɛfoa.
11Awulae dendɛle tumi nu;
na menli mɔɔ vale edwɛkɛ ne hɔle la zonle.
12Bɛse, “Ɛlɔnema nee bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ ɛlɛnriandi,
bɛlɛnriandi!”
Mraalɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ wɔ sua nu mɔɔ nee mboane a de la
13kyɛ konle nu afedeɛ ne fa:
abubule ndɛbalɛ mɔɔ bɛholo dwɛtɛ fufule bɛgua nwo,
yɛɛ bɛ ndɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛholo ezukoa nvutuke tagyee bɛgua nwo.
14Tumivolɛ ne bɔle arelemgbunli ne mɔ asande la,
ezukɔtweaba dɔle Zalemɔn Boka.
15O boka kpole, Beehyan boka;
O boka mɔɔ ati zonle, Beehyan Boka!
16O boka ati dɔɔnwo, duzu ati a ɛ nye ɛbolo
boka ne mɔɔ Nyamenle kulo kɛ ɔtɛnla zo la ɛ?
Ɛhɛe, ɛkɛ ne a Ɛdɛnkɛma badɛnla dahuu a.
17Ɔvale konle ehwili dɔɔnwo, apenle bulu mɔnwo,
apenle apenle kɛyɛ nyɛ,
Awulae vi Saenae rale ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne.
18 Ɛvole boka tendenle ne,
ɛzanle menli mɔɔ ɛhyele bɛ la nyɛma zo ɛlile ɛ nzi.
ɛliele ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne ɛvile menli ɛkɛ,
atuadelɛma bɔbɔ hyɛle wɔ bie,
amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne adɛnla ɛkɛ ne.
19Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Awulae,
mɔɔ soa yɛ adesoa ne mɔ dahuu la;
Nyamenle le yɛ ngoanelielɛ.
20Yɛ Nyamenle ne le ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle;
na yɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne ati,
yɛɛ yɛkola yɛnriandi ewule a.
21Nyamenle bagelegele ye kpɔvolɛma ati,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdua fɔlɛlilɛ ndenle nu la.
22Awulae se,
“Me nee bɛ vi Beehyan bazia ara,
me nee bɛ vi nyevile kunlu lɔ bazia ara,
23amaa bɛatietia mogya nu,
na bɛ ahwea ne mɔ noko anyia bɛ afoa nu ɛdeɛ
avi kpɔvolɛma ɛkɛ.”
24O Nyamenle, awie biala ɛnwu
wɔ konimlilɛ ɛlɔnwɔnedolɛ ne;
me Nyamenle, me Belemgbunli ne ɛlɔnwɔne ne
mɔɔ ɔdole ɔhɔle ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne la.
25Edwɛndolɛma ne lumua, agolehanlɛma ne li bɛ nzi;
mbɛlɛra mɔɔ wozo akɛya la li avinli.
26Bɛto edwɛne kɛ,
“Bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ wɔ ye menli ɛwolaa ne ayia ne anu,
bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, O bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma abo zo amra!”
27Bɛngyaman, bɛ nuhua kakula ne a lumua a,
Dwuda arelemgbunli nee bɛ ɛlɔne,
Zɛbulɛn arelemgbunli, Nafetalae arelemgbunli doa zolɛ.
28O Nyamenle, kile wɔ tumi ne;
O Nyamenle mɔɔ wɔho wɔmaa yɛ,
kile wɔ anwosesebɛ ne.
29Wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ati,
arelemgbunli soa ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne bɛlɛ wɔ.
30Tea nanemgbole ne mɔ mɔɔ vea ndɔ ne mɔ abo,
menli ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ bɛ nwo nlankɛ nyinli nee nlankɛ mralɛ la.
Tietia menli mɔɔ anye bolo adwulelielɛ la anwo zo;
bɔ menli mɔɔ anye die konle nwo la asande.
31Maa bɛva kɔbele bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛrɛla;
maa Sudanema ɛyɛ ndɛ ɛmaa bɛ sa zo ɛmaa Nyamenle.
32Azɛlɛ ye azo arelemgbunli maanle,
bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Nyamenle;
bɛdo ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛmaa Awulae,
33bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa mɔɔ dua anwomanyunlu la,
tete anwomanyunlu;
bɛdie, ɔlɛtendɛ, ɔ ne kpole ne dielie.
34Bɛbɔ Nyamenle kpoleyɛlɛ ne nolo,
ye belemgbunlililɛ ne keda Yizilayɛma anwo zo,
ye tumi ne wɔ anwomanyunlu.
35O Nyamenle, ɛvi wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne ɛfinde a
ɛ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ;
Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, yemɔ yɛɛ ɔfa tumi
nee anwosesebɛ ɔmaa ye menli a.
Bɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ.

english_text:
(By David for the music leader. To the tune “Lilies.”)
God Can Be Trusted
1Save me, God!
I am about to drown.
2I am sinking deep in the mud,
and my feet are slipping.
I am about to be swept under
by a mighty flood.
3I am worn out from crying,
and my throat is dry.
I have waited for you
till my eyes are blurred.
4 There are more people
who hate me for no reason
than there are hairs
on my head.
Many terrible enemies
want to destroy me, God.
Am I supposed to give back
something I didn't steal?
5You know my foolish sins.
Not one is hidden from you.
6 Lord God All-Powerful,
ruler of Israel,
don't let me embarrass anyone
who trusts and worships you.
7It is for your sake alone
that I am insulted
and blush with shame.
8I am like a stranger
to my relatives
and like a foreigner
to my own family.
9 My love for your house
burns in me like a fire,
and when others insult you,
they insulted me as well.
10I cried and went without food,
but they still insulted me.
11They sneered at me
for wearing sackcloth
to show my sorrow.
12Rulers and judges gossip
about me,
and drunkards make up songs
to mock me.
13But I pray to you, Lord.
So when the time is right,
answer me and help me
with your wonderful love.
14Don't let me sink in the mud,
but save me from my enemies
and from the deep water.
15Don't let me be
swept away by a flood
or drowned in the ocean
or swallowed by death.
16Answer me, Lord!
You are kind and good.
Pay attention to me!
You are truly merciful.
17Don't turn away from me.
I am your servant,
and I am in trouble.
Please hurry and help!
18Come and save me
from my enemies.
19You know how I am insulted,
mocked, and disgraced;
you know every one
of my enemies.
20I am crushed by insults,
and I feel sick.
I had hoped for mercy and pity,
but there was none.
21 Enemies poisoned my food,
and when I was thirsty,
they gave me vinegar.
22 Make their table a trap
for them and their friends.
23Blind them with darkness
and make them tremble.
24Show them how angry you are!
Be furious and catch them.
25 Destroy their camp
and don't let anyone live
in their tents.
26They cause trouble for people
you have already punished;
their gossip hurts those
you have wounded.
27Make them guiltier than ever
and don't forgive them.
28 Wipe their names from the book
of the living;
remove them from the list
of the innocent.
29I am mistreated and in pain.
Protect me, God,
and keep me safe!
30I will praise the Lord God
with a song
and a thankful heart.
31This will please the Lord
better than offering an ox
or a full-grown bull.
32When those in need see this,
they will be happy,
and the Lord's worshipers
will be encouraged.
33The Lord will listen
when the homeless cry out,
and he will never forget
his people in prison.
34Heaven and earth
will praise our God,
and so will the oceans
and everything in them.
35God will rescue Jerusalem,
and he will rebuild
the towns of Judah.
His people will live there
on their own land,
36and when the time comes,
their children will inherit
the land.
Then everyone who loves God
will also settle there.
translation_text:
Moalɛ nwo ɛzunlɛ
1O Nyamenle, die me!
ɔluakɛ azule ɛyi ɛva me.
2Memi moto kpole nu;
mennyia debie menzɔ nu.
Mehɔ azukunlu kpalɛ,
yɛɛ azuyilɛ ne se me nwo zo.
3Mevɛlɛ dedee me ɛnwomenle ɛwie;
me kɔmenzia ɛyɛ resee.
Mehendɛ me Nyamenle ne toonwo,
akee me nye ɛha adenle zo.
4 Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpɔ me mgbane gyɛne la
zonle tɛla me ti enrinli;
menli mɔɔ kpondɛ ahu me la anwo yɛ se,
yɛɛ adalɛ ala a bɛbɔ ye me nwo a.
Debie mɔɔ meanwua la, ɔwɔ kɛ metua ɔ?
5O Nyamenle, ɛdawɔ ɛze koasea mɔɔ meyɛ la,
ɛtane biala mɔɔ meyɛ la la ɛ nyunlu.
6Mmamaa ɔdua me nwo zo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ
bɛ anyelazo wɔ wɔ nu la anyunlu gua aze,
O Tumivolɛ Awulae Nyamenle;
mmamaa ɔdua me nwo zo bɛdabɛ mɔɔ
bɛkpondɛ ɛ bo zo la anyunlu gua aze,
O Yizilayɛ Nyamenle.
7Ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ ɛ ti yɛɛ bɛbɔ me aholoba,
na nyiane ɛkpɔlɔ me betaa a.
8Meyɛ ɛyɛvolɛ wɔ me mediema avinli,
ɔmɔ akunlu mralɛ bɔbɔ ɛnze me.
9 Ɔluakɛ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo ɛhulolɛ
sɔ kɛ senle wɔ me nu,
yɛɛ aholoba mɔɔ bɛbɔ wɔ la
amuala gua me nwo zo.
10Mɔɔ menzunle mengyele ɛhɔne la,
menli bɔle me nwolɛ aholoba.
11Menvale ɛrele mengedale la,
menyɛle ɛfenle memanle bɛ.
12Me nwo edwɛkɛ ala yɛɛ bɛgua a bɛka a,
yɛɛ nzabovoma fa me to edwɛne.
13Na mame, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nzɛlɛlɛ la ɛ nyunlu.
O Nyamenle, wɔ mekɛ kpalɛ ne dwu a,
dua wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii kpole ne azo bua me.
14Fa wɔ nɔhalɛ moalɛ ne die me,
mmamaa memi mekɔ moto ne abo;
die me fi me kpɔvolɛma asa anu,
nee azule buma ne anu.
15Mmamaa azuyilɛ ne fa me,
anzɛɛ menoma buma ne abo,
anzɛɛ ewule kuma keda me nwo zo.
16O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne di munli na bua me,
wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ bebelebe ne ati, kakyi ɛ nye nea me.
17Mmaye ɛ nye wɔ wɔ sonvolɛ anwo zo;
ɔluakɛ melɛnwu amaneɛ na ka ɛ nwo bua me.
18Twe bikye me, kpɔne me;
maa menyia me ti wɔ kpɔvolɛma asa anu.
19Ɛdawɔ ɛze aholoba mɔɔ bɛbɔ me la,
ɛze me nyiane nee me anyiemgba;
ɛze me kpɔvolɛma amuala.
20Aholoba ne akee ɛbo me nwo zo,
akee meyɛ ɛhwee a ɔnyɛ boɛ.
Memkpondɛle anwunvɔnezelɛ, na meannyia bie;
memkpondɛle arɛlekyekyelɛ, na meannyia bie.
21 Ɛhɔne ku me la, bɛmanle me pɔyezen,
nzuhɔne ku me la, bɛmanle me nzanvinli.
22 Maa bɛ ɛkponledolɛ ɛhakyi ɛhane;
na bɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ɛyɛ ɛhane.
23Maa bɛ nye ɛzi mɔɔ bɛnnwu debie a;
na bɛ gyakɛ ɛbili dahuu kɛ atɛ.
24Wola wɔ ɛya ne gua bɛ nwo zo,
na maa wɔ ɛya ne ɛzɔ ɛyela bɛ.
25 Maa bɛ azokoɛleɛ ɛdɔ mgbane,
mmamaa awie tɛnla bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ anu.
26Ɔluakɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ wɔdea ye la kpɔdekpɔde,
na bɛkondɔ mɔɔ wɔboda ye la nganlɛ.
27Tea bɛ molozo molozo,
mmamaa bɛfa bɛ nwo dwɔɔ.
28 Ye bɛ aluma fi teasema buluku ne anu;
mmakɛlɛ bɛ aluma ɛboka tenlenema anwo.
29Melɛnwu amaneɛ, mete nyane;
O Nyamenle, maa me zo na die me.
30Mebado edwɛne meaye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ;
mebava moyɛlɛ meabɔ ye kpoleyɛlɛ ne nolo.
31Ɛhye bazɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye adɛla ɛnlankɛ,
anzɛɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli mɔɔ ɛwie nyi la.
32Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛsisi bɛ la ɛnwu ɛhye na bɛ nye ɛlie,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ Nyamenle la, bɛzi bɛ ahonle.
33Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma te bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyia la ane,
yɛɛ ɔmkpo ye ɛdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ngyelelɛ nu la.
34Anwuma nee aze ɛye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ,
nyevile nee mɔɔ wɔ nu la amuala ɛye ye ayɛlɛ.
35Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle balie Zayɔn,
na yeakyekye Dwuda azua ne mɔ fofolɛ;
ye sonvolɛma badɛnla ɛkɛ na bɛava azɛlɛ ne;
36bɛ bo zo amra bava ayɛ bɛ agyadeɛ,
na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo ye duma ne la badɛnla ɛkɛ.

english_text:
(By David for the music leader. To be used when an offering is made.)
God Is Wonderful
1Save me, Lord God!
Hurry and help.
2Disappoint and confuse
all who want to kill me.
Turn away and disgrace
all who want to hurt me.
3Embarrass and shame those
who say, “We told you so!”
4Let your worshipers celebrate
and be glad because of you.
They love your saving power,
so let them always say,
“God is wonderful!”
5I am poor and needy,
but you, the Lord God,
care about me.
You are the one who saves me.
Please hurry and help!
translation_text:
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
(Edw 40.13-17)
1O Nyamenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ, die me!
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ka ɛ nwo baboa me!
2Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la,
maa bɛbɔ anyiemgba na bɛ adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu!
Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo kɛ medi nyane la,
maa bɛzia bɛ nzi na bɛ nyunlu ɛzi bile!
3Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgolo me nwo kɛ, “Ɛhɛe! Ɛhɛe.” la,
anyunlu ɛgua aze na bɛ rɛle ɛbɔ.
4Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ɛ bo zo la,
anye ɛlie na wɔmɔ ti bɛli fɛlɛko.
Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne la
dahuu ɛha kɛ, “Nyamenle le bedevinli!”
5Na mame, mele ehyianli, menlɛ bie;
O Nyamenle, ka ɛ nwo bɛla!
Ɛle me boavolɛ nee me dievolɛ;
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mmakyɛ!

english_text:
A Prayer for God's Protection
1I run to you, Lord,
for protection.
Don't disappoint me.
2You do what is right,
so come to my rescue.
Listen to my prayer
and keep me safe.
3Be my mighty rock, the place
where I can always run
for protection.
Save me by your command!
You are my mighty rock
and my fortress.
4Come and save me, Lord God,
from vicious and cruel
and brutal enemies!
5I depend on you,
and I have trusted you
since I was young.
6I have relied on you
from the day I was born.
You brought me safely
through birth,
and I always praise you.
7Many people think of me
as something evil.
But you are my mighty protector,
8and I praise and honor you
all day long.
9Don't throw me aside
when I am old;
don't desert me
when my strength is gone.
10My enemies are plotting
because they want me dead.
11They say, “Now we'll catch you!
God has deserted you,
and no one can save you.”
12Come closer, God!
Please hurry and help.
13Embarrass and destroy
all who want me dead;
disgrace and confuse
all who want to hurt me.
14I will never give up hope
or stop praising you.
15All day long I will tell
the wonderful things you do
to save your people.
But you have done much more
than I could possibly know.
16I will praise you, Lord God,
for your mighty deeds
and your power to save.
17You have taught me
since I was a child,
and I never stop telling about
your marvelous deeds.
18Don't leave me when I am old
and my hair turns gray.
Let me tell future generations
about your mighty power.
19Your deeds of kindness
are known in the heavens.
No one is like you!
20You made me suffer a lot,
but you will bring me
back from this deep pit
and give me new life.
21You will make me truly great
and take my sorrow away.
22I will praise you, God,
the Holy One of Israel.
You are faithful.
I will play the harp
and sing your praises.
23You have rescued me!
I will celebrate and shout,
singing praises to you
with all my heart.
24All day long I will announce
your power to save.
I will tell how you disgraced
and disappointed those
who wanted to hurt me.
translation_text:
Akpanyima nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ kunlu yɛɛ menriandi mefea a;
mmamaa me nyunlu gua aze ɛlɛ!
2Dua wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne azo boa me na die me;
yɛ ɛnzonlɛ tie me, na die me!
3Yɛ me ɛvealeka bodane,
me aranemgbole ɛsesebɛ, na die me.
Ɔluakɛ ɛle me bodane nee me aranemgbole.
4O me Nyamenle, die me fi amumuyɛma asa anu,
yɛɛ sonla atisesebɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnli pɛlepɛle la asa anu.
5Ɔluakɛ O Awulae, ɛle me anyelazo,
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me mgbavolɛ nu
yɛɛ menvale me rɛle menwulale wɔ nu a.
6Ɔvi me awolɛ nu yɛɛ mengisale wɔ a,
wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛyele me ɛvile ɔmɔ akunlu a.
Mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ dahuu.
7Meyɛ ndonwo memaa dɔɔnwo,
noko wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɛle me ɛvealeka ɛsesebɛ a.
8Meye wɔ ayɛlɛ mekɛ biala,
na mebɔ wɔ anyunlunyia ne nolo alehyenlɛ biala.
9Mmakpo me wɔ me mrelera nu;
saa me anwosesebɛ wie a, mmakpo me.
10Ɔluakɛ me kpɔvolɛma keha me nwo edwɛkɛ,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la yia bɔ adwenle,
11na bɛka kɛ, “Nyamenle ɛkpo ye;
bɛvoa ye bɛhye ye,
ɔluakɛ awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ die ye a.”
12O Nyamenle, mmafi me nwo ɛkɔ moa;
O me Nyamenle, ka ɛ nwo balie me!
13Maa menli mɔɔ keha me nwo edwɛkɛ ɛtane ɛtane la
anyunlu ɛgua aze na bɛhu bɛ;
maa nyiane nee anyiemgba ɛbia menli mɔɔ
kpondɛ kɛ bɛkile me nyane la.
14Na mame, me anyelazo wɔ wɔ nu dahuu,
yɛɛ mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ kpole kpalɛ dahuu.
15Mebabɔ wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ,
nee wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne nolo alehyenlɛ biala,
ɔluakɛ bɛ somaa bo me ndelebɛbo zo.
16Mebalua Awulae Nyamenle ne nyɛleɛ mgbole zo meara;
mebaye wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne,
wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne ala ayɛlɛ.
17O Nyamenle, ɔvi me mgbavolɛ nu yɛɛ ɛvale me ɛhilehilelɛ a,
yɛɛ metɛbɔ wɔ nwanwane nyɛleɛ ne mɔ nolo.
18Yemɔti saa menyi, na me ti zo ɛyɛ nwohyee a,
O Nyamenle, mmakpo me,
kɔkpula kɛ menwɔbɔ wɔ tumi kpole ne nolo
menwɔmaa awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la kɛde bie.
19O Nyamenle, wɔ tumi nee wɔ kpalɛyɛlɛ dwu anwuma lɔ.
Wɔyɛ ninyɛne mgbole,
O Nyamenle, nwane a le kɛ ɛdawɔ a?
20Ɛdawɔ mɔɔ wɔmaa menwu amaneɛ mgbole ɛhye mɔ la,
ɛbakpogya me zo bieko wɔavi ɛbɛla kuma nu,
saa mewɔ azɛlɛ kuma bo bɔbɔ a,
ɛbaye me wɔavinde bieko.
21Ɛbamaa meanyia me nyunlu molozo,
na wɔakyekye me rɛle bieko.
22Medame noko mebava getaa kpole meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
O me Nyamenle, wɔ wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne ati.
Mebava getaa ekyi meado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
O Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne.
23Mebadea nu anyelielɛ nu,
mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔha kɛ meye wɔ ayɛlɛ la;
me ɛkɛla mɔɔ ɔdaye noko wɔlie ye la baye wɔ ayɛlɛ.
24Mebaha wɔ tenlene moalɛ ne anwo edwɛkɛ dahuu,
ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ me bɛahu me la
anyunlu ɛgua aze, bɛbɔ anyiemgba.

english_text:
(By Solomon.)
A Prayer for God To Guide and Help the King
1Please help the king
to be honest and fair
just like you, our God.
2Let him be honest and fair
with all your people,
especially the poor.
3Let peace and justice rule
every mountain and hill.
4Let the king defend the poor,
rescue the homeless, and crush
everyone who hurts them.
5Let the king live forever
like the sun and the moon.
6Let him be as helpful as rain
that refreshes the meadows
and the ground.
7Let the king be fair
with everyone,
and let there be peace
until the moon
falls from the sky.
8 Let his kingdom reach
from sea to sea,
from the Euphrates River
across all the earth.
9Force the desert tribes
to accept his rule,
and make his enemies
crawl in the dirt.
10Force the rulers of Tarshish
and of the islands
to pay taxes to him.
Make the kings of Sheba
and of Seba bring gifts.
11Make other rulers bow down
and all nations serve him.
12Do this because the king
rescues the homeless
when they cry out,
and he helps everyone
who is poor and in need.
13The king has pity
on the weak and the helpless
and protects those in need.
14He cares when they hurt,
and he saves them from cruel
and violent deaths.
15Long live the king!
Give him gold from Sheba.
Always pray for the king
and praise him each day.
16Let cities overflow with food
and hills be covered with grain,
just like Mount Lebanon.
Let the people in the cities
prosper like wild flowers.
17May the glory of the king
shine brightly forever
like the sun in the sky.
Let him make nations prosper
and learn to praise him.
18 Lord God of Israel,
we praise you.
Only you can work miracles.
19We will always praise
your glorious name.
Let your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
Amen and amen.
20This ends the prayers
of David, the son of Jesse.
translation_text:
Belemgbunli ati nzɛlɛlɛ (Sɔlɔmɔn edwɛne)
1O Nyamenle, kilehile belemgbunli ne wɔ pɛlepɛlelilɛ ne,
na kilehile ɔ ra nrenya ne wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne.
2Maa ɔva tenleneyɛlɛ ɔbua ye menli ne ndɛne,
na ɔva pɛlepɛle ɔbua ehyianvolɛma ndɛne.
3Maa menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la ɛkpazi,
na awoka ne mɔ azo ɛhye aleɛ ɛmaa menli ne,
na tenleneyɛlɛ ɛyi maanle ne tɛkɛɛ.
4Maa belemgbunli ne ɛlie ehyianvolɛma ati,
ɔye mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la ɔvi ɛhyianlɛ nu,
na ɔbubu mɔɔ di nzisi la dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ.
5Maa wɔ menli ne ɛzonle wɔ alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ
ɔhɔdwu awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anu.
6Maa belemgbunli ɛyɛ kɛ ezule mɔɔ tɔ doɔloa ndile,
ɔyɛ kɛ nyenyensuo, ɔzia azɛlɛ ye.
7Maa tenleneyɛlɛ ɛdende ye mekɛ zo,
na anzonudwolɛ ɛrɛla dahuu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
8 Maa ye belemgbunlililɛ ɛdwu ɛnwea ɛnwea,
ɔvi Azule Yufileti ne anloa ɔhɔdwu azɛlɛ ye awieleɛ.
9Maa ɛsɛlɛ zo amra ɛbu ndwɛlɛ wɔ ɔ nyunlu,
na ye kpɔvolɛma ɛli anwea.
10Maa Sepeen nee bɔra ne mɔ arelemgbunli
ɛdua adwule ɛmaa ye,
na Areleebea nee Yiteɔpea arelemgbunli ɛhyɛ ye ninyɛne.
11Maa arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti ɛdu ɛgua ɔ nyunlu,
na maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti ɛzonle ye.
12Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la fɛlɛ a ɔdie ye zo,
ɔdie ehyianli nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ boavolɛ la zo.
13Ɔnwu mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la anwunvɔne,
na ɔdie mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la ngoane.
14Ɔdie bɛ ɔfi nzisi nee konle nu;
bɛ mogya sonle bolɛ wɔ ɔ nye zo.
15Belemgbunli ɛnyi ɛhyɛ!
Maa bɛva Areleebea ezukoa nvutuke bɛrɛlɛ ye.
Maa bɛyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ bɛmaa belemgbunli ne,
na bɛzɛlɛ nyilalɛ bɛmaa ye dahuu.
16Maa aleɛ ɛbu azɛlɛ ne azo;
maa abɛlɛ ɛzi agole wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo,
na bɛvievia mralɛ kɛ Lɛbanɔn ɛdeɛ ne la.
Maa menli ɛyi azuamgbole ne mɔ azo gbudugbudu,
na bɛ nwo ɛzo kɛ ɛbɔ nu ndile.
17Ye duma ɛdɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu,
na ye anyunlunyia ɛda kɛ sɛnzɛne.
Menli kɔsɔɔti ɛva ye ɛyila bɛ nwo,
na maanle maanle ɛzuzu ye boɛ.
18Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ,
ɔ ngomekye ala a ɔyɛ nwanwane ninyɛne a.
19Bɛye ye duma nwuanzanwuanza ne ayɛlɛ dahuu;
bɛmaa ye anyunlunyia ɛyi ewiade tɛkɛɛ!
Amen. Amen!
20Gyɛsi ara Devidi nzɛlɛlɛ ne mɔ awieleɛ ɛne.

english_text:
BOOK III
(Psalms 73–89)
(A psalm by Asaph.)
God Is Good
1God is truly good to Israel,
especially to everyone
with a pure heart.
2But I almost stumbled and fell,
3because it made me jealous
to see proud and evil people
and to watch them prosper.
4They never have to suffer,
they stay healthy,
5and they don't have troubles
like everyone else.
6Their pride is like a necklace,
and they commit sin more often
than they dress themselves.
7Their eyes bulge with fat,
and their minds are flooded
with foolish thoughts.
8They sneer and say cruel things,
and because of their pride,
they make violent threats.
9They dare to speak against God
and to order others around.
10God will bring his people back,
and they will drink the water
he so freely gives.
11Only evil people would say,
“God Most High cannot
know everything!”
12Yet all goes well for them,
and they live in peace.
13What good did it do me
to keep my thoughts pure
and refuse to do wrong?
14I am sick all day,
and I am punished
each morning.
15If I had said evil things,
I would not have been loyal
to your people.
16It was hard for me
to understand all this!
17Then I went to your temple,
and there I understood
what will happen
to my enemies.
18You will make them stumble,
never to get up again.
19They will be terrified,
suddenly swept away
and no longer there.
20They will disappear, Lord,
despised like a bad dream
the morning after.
21Once I was bitter
and brokenhearted.
22I was stupid and ignorant,
and I treated you
as a wild animal would.
23But I never really left you,
and you hold my right hand.
24Your advice has been my guide,
and later you will welcome me
in glory.
25In heaven I have only you,
and on this earth
you are all I want.
26My body and mind may fail,
but you are my strength
and my choice forever.
27All-Powerful Lord God,
those who stay far from you
will be lost,
and you will destroy those
who are unfaithful.
28It is good for me
to be near you.
I choose you as my protector,
and I will tell about
your wonderful deeds.
translation_text:
BULUKU MƆƆ TƆ ZO NSA
(Edwɛndolɛ 73—89)
Nyamenle pɛlepɛlelilɛ (Esafe edwɛne)
1Nɔhalɛ, Nyamenle le kpalɛ maa mɔɔ di boɛ la,
ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ahonle nu te la.
2Na mame, mendule koti menwiele,
me gyakɛ ɛdudulɛ nu, ɔhale kyɛkyɛ na meatele.
3Ɔluakɛ me nye bolole adubɛnwoma,
mekɛ mɔɔ menwunle kɛ amumuyɛma ɛkpazi la.
4Ɔboalekɛ bɛnde nyane;
bɛte kpɔkɛ, bɛ nwonane tutoboo.
5Bɛ nwo ɛngyele bɛ kɛ bie mɔ la;
edwɛkɛ ɛndo bɛ kɛ bie mɔ la.
6Yemɔti bɛgua adubɛnwo ndweabane;
bɛwulowula nzisi adɛladeɛ.
7Ɛhyenlɛ ngome ɛmaa bɛ nyunlu ɛyɛ totofoo,
mgbane mgbane ɛyɛlɛ ɛyi bɛ ahonle ne mɔ.
8Bɛle agolobɛnwo, bɛka ɛtane;
bɛtu bɛ nwo na bɛbɔ adwenle kɛ bɛsisi awie mɔ.
9Bɛtendɛ bɛtia anwuma,
bɛka mgbole wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo ɛleka biala.
10Ɔlua zo menli tu toa bɛ na bɛyeyɛ bɛ;
bɛnnwu ɛtane biala wɔ bɛ nwo.
11Na bɛka kɛ, “Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na Nyamenle anwu ye ɛ?
Asoo Anwuma Anwumanli ne lɛ nwolɛ adwenle?”
12Nea, kɛ amumuyɛma de la ɛne;
bɛnyia anwonyia dɔɔnwo, dahuu bɛ nwo tɔ bɛ.
13Meyɛ me ahonle nu bɔkɔbɔkɔ mgbane,
menrinzi me sa anwo kɛ menze nwolɛ bie mgbane.
14Ɔluakɛ alehyenlɛ muala menwu amaneɛ,
nwonlomɔ biala menyia ndeanlɛ.
15Saa menganle kɛ, “Mebaha ye zɛhae” a,
anrɛɛ meanga nɔhalɛ meangile ɛ mra
awolɛndoazo ye.
16Na mɔɔ mendwenlenle kɛ menwɔzi menwɔde ɛhye abo la,
ɔyɛle me nye zo gyima ɛsesebɛ bie,
17kɔkpula kɛ mengɔle Nyamenle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu;
na menwunle bɛ muala bɛ awieleɛ la.
18Nɔhalɛ, ɛfa bɛ ɛsie ɛleka teteletetele;
ɛmaa bɛtu bɛgua, bɛ bo zo minli bɔkɔɔ.
19Ndɛndɛ ne ala ɛnee bɛ bo zo ɛbɔ,
bɛ bo zo ɛminli ɛzulolɛ ɛzulolɛ bie.
20Bɛle kɛ sonla mɔɔ kɛlafe kɛdunwue la ɛlalɛ,
ɔtunwue a ɛmbu ye ɛlalɛ ne bie.
21Mekɛ mɔɔ nyane hanle me,
mekɛ mɔɔ me ahonle futule la,
22menyɛle koasea anzenwolɛbie,
menyɛle kɛ nane la mentiale wɔ.
23Noko akee dahuu me nee wɔ a de a;
ɛlɛ me sa fema ne anu dahuu.
24Ɛfa wɔ ngilehilelɛ ne ɛsinza me,
na nzinlii ɛbalie me anyunlunyia nu.
25Menlɛ awie wɔ anwuma kɛ ɛdawɔ,
yɛɛ memkpondɛ ɛhwee wɔ ewiade kɛ wɔmɔ.
26Me nwonane bawie, me ahonle ayɛ bɛtɛɛ,
noko Nyamenle le me anwosesebɛ nee me kyɛfoa dahuu.
27Na nea, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee wɔ bɛ avinli twe la baminli;
ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnli nɔhalɛ bɛmmaa wɔ la abo zo bɔ.
28Na mame, ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menwɔbikye Nyamenle;
meyɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne me ɛvealeka,
amaa meabɔ wɔ gyima ne mɔ nolo.

english_text:
(A special psalm by Asaph.)
A Prayer for the Nation in Times of Trouble
1Our God, why have you
completely rejected us?
Why are you so angry
with the ones you care for?
2Remember the people
you rescued long ago,
the tribe you chose
for your very own.
Think of Mount Zion,
your home;
3walk over to the temple
left in ruins forever
by those who hate us.
4Your enemies roared like lions
in your holy temple,
and they have placed
their banners there.
5It looks like a forest
chopped to pieces.
6They used axes and hatchets
to smash the carvings.
7They burned down your temple
and badly disgraced it.
8They said to themselves,
“We'll crush them!”
Then they burned every one
of your meeting places
all over the country.
9There are no more miracles
and no more prophets.
Who knows how long
it will be like this?
10Our God, how much longer
will our enemies sneer?
Won't they ever stop
insulting you?
11Why don't you punish them?
Why are you holding back?
12Our God and King,
you have ruled
since ancient times;
you have won victories
everywhere on this earth.
13 By your power you made a path
through the sea,
and you smashed the heads
of sea monsters.
14 You crushed the heads
of the monster Leviathan,
then fed him to wild creatures
in the desert.
15You opened the ground
for streams and springs
and dried up mighty rivers.
16You rule the day and the night,
and you put the moon
and the sun in place.
17You made summer and winter
and gave them to the earth.
18Remember your enemies, Lord!
They foolishly sneer
and won't respect you.
19You treat us like pet doves,
but they mistreat us.
Don't keep forgetting us
and letting us be fed
to those wild animals.
20Remember the agreement
you made with us.
Violent enemies are hiding
in every dark corner
of the earth.
21Don't disappoint those in need
or make them turn from you,
but help the poor and homeless
to shout your praises.
22Do something, God!
Defend yourself.
Remember how those fools
sneer at you all day long.
23Don't forget the loud shouts
of your enemies.
translation_text:
Maanle ɛlielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ (Esafe ɛdwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ)
1O Nyamenle, duzu ati a wɔpɛ yɛ wɔgua bɔkɔɔ ɛ?
Duzu ati a wɔ ɛya kpu esike
yelɛyela wɔ adidileka mboane ɛ?
2Kakye wɔ menli ne mɔɔ mɔmoane ɛvale bɛ ɛyɛle wɔ ɛdeɛ,
na wɔlie bɛ wɔyɛ bɛ wɔ agyadeɛ, abusua ekpunli la.
Kakye Zayɔn Boka mɔɔ wɔdɛnla zolɛ ɛlɛ la.
3Kpɔsa ninyɛne ne mɔɔ ɛzɛkye bɔkɔɔ la avinli;
yɛ kpɔvolɛma ɛzɛkye Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu debie biala.
4Wɔ kpɔvolɛma ɛva konimlilɛ ɛdeɛdea nu
wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu;
bɛdabɛ bɛkpɔnla bɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ sɛkɛlɛneɛ zo.
5Bɛvale akuma bɛbubule anwuma anuhɔlɛ ne anlenkɛ ne.
6Bɛvale hamenle nee akuma bɛbubule taboa biala
mɔɔ bɛli adwinli bɛgua zo la.
7Bɛdole senle wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu;
bɛyelale wɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne wee.
8Bɛhanle bɛhilele bɛ nwo kɛ,
“Yɛtɛnla bɛ kɔme zo kpalɛ kpalɛ;”
bɛyelale Nyamenle nyianu ɛleka ne mɔ
mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la amuala.
9Yɛnnwu yɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ;
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ,
yɛɛ awie ɛnze kenle mɔɔ ɛhye mɔ kɛze a.
10O Nyamenle, kenlenzu yɛɛ kpɔvolɛ ne kɛgyakyi
agolobɛnwo ye a?
Asoo ɔwɔ kɛ kpɔvolɛ ne sɛkye wɔ duma bɔkɔɔ?
11Duzu ati a wɔdo ɛ sa wɔbɛla nu
na wɔva ɛ sa fema ne wɔwula ɛ nvɔnlɔma anu ɛ?
12Noko ɔvi tete, ɛle Nyamenle, me Belemgbunli
mɔɔ die ngoane wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo a.
13 Ɛvale wɔ tumi ne ɛhyɛle nyevile ne anu,
na ɛgelegelele nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne ati azule nye.
14 Ɛgelegelele Lɛveatan ati,
na ɛvale ye nane ɛmanle fienemgbole nu nanemgbole lile.
15Ɛmanle nzufeanvea nee azule mralɛ zenzenle,
na ɛmanle azudenle sesanle wele resee.
16Alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ ne le wɔ ɛdeɛ;
ɛdawɔ a ɛbɔle sɛnzɛne nee anwumaneamra a.
17Ɛdawɔ a ɛhyehyɛle ɛleka mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ azɛlɛ ne dwu la a;
ɛdawɔ a ɛbɔle wawaa nee fɔsɛlɛ a.
18O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye ɛhye, nee kpɔvolɛ ne agolobɛnwo ne,
menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la sɛkye wɔ duma.
19Mmaye wɔ abubule ne ɛmaa ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole;
mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi wɔ menli mɔɔ ɛhyia la fee.
20Kakye wɔ ngyekyeleɛ ne,
ɔluakɛ ahɔdiawu ɛhɔ nzia
wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo ahodoka anu awozinli ne mɔ anu.
21Mmamaa mɔɔ bɛsisi ye la anyunlu gua aze;
maa ehyianli ne nee mɔɔ ɛhyia la ɛye wɔ ayɛlɛ.
22O Nyamenle, dwazo, na die wɔ duma ne sie aze.
Kakye kɛ anzenyamenlema si golo ɛ nwo dahuu la.
23Mmamaa ɛ rɛle fi wɔ kpɔvolɛma mɔɔ di wulupe,
nee bɛ alɛra mɔɔ bɛyɛ ye dahuu la.

english_text:
(A psalm and a song by Asaph for the music leader. To the tune “Don't Destroy.”
)
Praise God for All He Has Done
1Our God, we thank you
for being so near to us!
Everyone celebrates
your wonderful deeds.
2You have set a time
to judge with fairness.
3The earth trembles,
and its people shake;
you alone keep
its foundations firm.
4You tell every bragger,
“Stop bragging!”
And to the wicked you say,
“Don't boast of your power!
5Stop bragging! Quit telling me
how great you are.”
6Our Lord and our God,
victory doesn't come
from the east or the west
or from the desert.
7You are the one who judges.
You can take away power
and give it to others.
8You hold in your hand
a cup filled with wine,
strong and foaming.
You will pour out some
for every sinful person
on this earth,
and they will have to drink
until it is gone.
9But I will always tell about
you, the God of Jacob,
and I will sing your praise.
10Our Lord, you will destroy
the power of evil people,
but you will give strength
to those who are good.
translation_text:
Ndɛnebuavolɛ Nyamenle ne (Esafe edwɛne)
1O Nyamenle, yɛyɛ wɔ mo; yɛyɛ wɔ mo;
yɛbɔ wɔ duma na yɛka wɔ nwanwane gyima ne mɔ.
2Nyamenle se, “Saa mekɛ ne mɔɔ mehile la dwu a,
mebabua ndɛne wɔ ye adenle zo.
3Saa azɛlɛ kpusu, maa abɔdeɛ muala kpusu a,
medame a mesɔ ye memaa ɔgyinla kpundii a.
4Meka mekile adubɛnwonli ne kɛ, ‘Gyakyi adubɛnwo,’
na mese amumuyɛnli ne kɛ, ‘Mmaka mgbole,
5mmaka mgbole ɛmemaa ɛ nwo zo,
anzɛɛ mmatwe ɛ kɔme ɛka mgbole’ ”
6Ɔluakɛ ndɛnebualɛ ɛnvi aduduleɛ anzɛɛ adɔleɛ,
yɛɛ ɔmkpogya ɔ nwo zo ɔnvi ɛsɛlɛ nu ɔmba;
7Nyamenle ala a bua ndɛne a,
ɔbɛlɛ bie aze, ɔmaa bie zo.
8Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ kɔpo ɔ sa nu,
ɔlɛ nwanye mɔɔ ɛwie be na ɔlɛwu awubue la wɔ nu;
ɔbawola ekyi bie yeagua,
na azɛlɛ ye azo amumuyɛma banlo ɔ muala.
9Na mame, me nye balie dahuu,
mebado edwɛne meaye Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ.
10Ɔbazɛkye amumuyɛma tumi ne
na tenlenema tumi ne bayɛ kpole.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by Asaph for the music leader. Use stringed instruments.)
God Always Wins
1You, our God,
are famous in Judah
and honored in Israel.
2Your home is on Mount Zion,
the city of peace.
3There you destroyed
fiery arrows, shields, swords,
and all the other weapons.
4You are more glorious than
the eternal mountains.
5Brave warriors were robbed
of what they had taken,
and now they lie dead,
unable to lift an arm.
6God of Jacob, when you roar,
enemy chariots and horses
drop dead in their tracks.
7Our God, you are fearsome,
and no one can oppose you
when you are angry.
8From heaven you announced
your decisions as judge!
And all who live on this earth
were terrified and silent
9when you took over as judge,
ready to rescue
everyone in need.
10Even the most angry people
will praise you
when you are furious.
11Everyone, make your promises
to the Lord your God
and do what you promise.
The Lord is fearsome,
and all his servants
should bring him gifts.
12God destroys the courage
of rulers and kings
and makes cowards of them.
translation_text:
Konimnli Nyamenle (Esafe edwɛne)
1Bɛze Nyamenle wɔ Dwuda,
ye duma le kpole wɔ Yizilayɛ.
2Bɛkyekye ye tɛnlabelɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm,
ye sua nu wɔ Zayɔn Boka.
3Ɛkɛ ne a ɔbubule kpɔvolɛma ne ɛda ne mɔ,
bɛ enyinlike, konle dadeɛ nee konle ninyɛne muala a.
4Wɔ anyunlunyia le kpole, wɔ belemgbunlililɛ le kpole;
ɔtɛla awoka mgbole kɔsɔɔti!
5Bɛkpokpole akɛnrasesebɛma bɛliele bɛ sa nu ninyɛne;
bɛguale aze bɛwule;
ɛlɔnema ne amuala annyia gyinlagyakɛ.
6O Gyekɔbo Nyamenle, ɛdeanle bɛ nu ala la,
ɛkpɔnwɔ nee ye kavolɛ ne dule guale.
7Na wɔmɔ, ɛ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole!
Saa ɛfa ɛya a nwane a kɛhola kɛgyinla ɛ nyunlu a?
8Ɛwɔ anwuma lɔ yɛɛ ɛbuale ndɛne a;
azɛlɛ zulole na ɔgyinlanle diinyi,
9wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle dwazole kɛ ɔbua ndɛne
yealie menli mɔɔ bɛsisi bɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo la.
10Sonla ɛyavalɛ wie Nyamenle ayɛlɛyelɛ
ɛyavalɛ nee konle ne anzi,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛha la bali wɔ eni.
11Maa wɔ ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ne ɛdwu Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ,
na ye bɛ muala;
maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbikye ye la ɛva bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ
ɛrɛlɛ ye,
yemɔ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsulo ye a.
12Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbɛlɛ arelemgbunli aze a,
ɔ nwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ maa aleɛabo arelemgbunli.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph for Jeduthun, the music leader.)
In Times of Trouble God Is with His People
1I pray to you, Lord God,
and I beg you to listen.
2In days filled with trouble,
I search for you.
And at night I tirelessly
lift my hands in prayer,
refusing comfort.
3When I think of you,
I feel restless and weak.
4Because of you, Lord God,
I can't sleep.
I am restless
and can't even talk.
5I think of times gone by,
of those years long ago.
6Each night my mind
is flooded with questions:
7“Have you rejected me forever?
Won't you be kind again?
8Is this the end of your love
and your promises?
9Have you forgotten
how to have pity?
Do you refuse to show mercy
because of your anger?”
10Then I said, “God Most High,
what hurts me most
is that you no longer help us
with your mighty arm.”
11Our Lord, I will remember
the things you have done,
your miracles of long ago.
12I will think about each one
of your mighty deeds.
13Everything you do is right,
and no other god
compares with you.
14You alone work miracles,
and you have let nations
see your mighty power.
15With your own arm you rescued
your people, the descendants
of Jacob and Joseph.
16The ocean looked at you, God,
and it trembled deep down
with fear.
17Water flowed from the clouds.
Thunder was heard above
as your arrows of lightning
flashed about.
18Your thunder roared
like chariot wheels.
The world was made bright
by lightning,
and all the earth trembled.
19You walked through the water
of the mighty sea,
but your footprints
were never seen.
20You guided your people
like a flock of sheep,
and you chose Moses and Aaron
to be their leaders.
translation_text:
Ngyianlɛ nu arɛlekyekyelɛ (Esafe edwɛne)
1Metea nu kpole mefɛlɛ Nyamenle,
metea nu kpole, amaa Nyamenle ade me ne.
2Mekpondɛ Awulae wɔ me amaneɛnwunlɛ mekɛ nu;
aledwolɛ nu metɛlɛdɛlɛ me sa nu mesɛlɛ, menvɛ fee;
me ɛkɛla ɛmkponle kɛ bɛkɛkyekye ɔ rɛle.
3Medwenle Nyamenle anwo a, megu ɛnwomenle,
medwenledwenle nwo nzɛlɛlɛ nu a, me rɛle bɔ.
4Ɛlɛ me nye anzi nwoma ne anu, ɛmmaa menlafe;
me rɛle ɛbɔ kpole, mengola tendɛ.
5Medwenle mekɛ mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la anwo,
mekakye ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la.
6Mendole edwɛne nɔɔzo wɔ me ahonle nu;
medwenledwenle nwo meneɛnlea me ahonle nu kɛ:
7“Asoo Awulae bakpo me dahuu,
mɔɔ ɔnrɛnwu me anwunvɔne ɛlɛ a?
8Asoo ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛkpa nwo bɔkɔɔ?
Asoo ye ɛwɔkɛbɔlɛ ne ɛwie bɔkɔɔ?
9Asoo Nyamenle arɛle ɛvi kɛ ɔkɛyɛ ahunlunyele?
Asoo yeva ɛya yeminli ye anwunvɔnezelɛ ne?”
10Na mese, “Medame me nyane mɔɔ medi la
yɛɛ ɛmaa Anwuma Anwumanli ne tumi ɛhakyi a.”
11Mebahakye mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la amuala;
ɛhɛe, mebahakye wɔ mɔmoane nwanwane gyima ne.
12Mebadwenledwenle wɔ gyima ne amuala anwo,
na meadwenle wɔ gyima mgbole ne mɔ anwo.
13O Nyamenle, wɔ adenle le nwuanzanwuanza;
nyamenle boni a le kpole kɛ yɛ Nyamenle ne a?
14Wɔmɔ a ɛle Nyamenle mɔɔ yɛ nwanwane ninyɛne,
mɔɔ wɔhile wɔ tumi ne wɔ menli avinli a.
15Ɛvale wɔ tumi ne ɛliele wɔ menli,
Gyekɔbo nee Dwosefi abo zo amra.
16O Nyamenle, mɔɔ azule ne mɔ nwunle wɔ la,
mɔɔ azule ne mɔ nwunle wɔ la, bɛzulole;
ɛhɛe, buma fonyianle.
17Nzulemungu dɔle ezule bilididi,
anwomanyunlu hulule; wɔ ɛda ne mɔ vedele ɛleka biala.
18Wɔ ɛhululɛ ne liele ahumuakyima ne anu,
wɔ ɛsɛnlɛmanye ne mɔ kpakyele dale ewiade amuala;
azɛlɛ kpusule dikyidikyi.
19Wɔ adenle la nyevile ne anu,
ɛ gyakɛ abo adenle la buma mgbole ne mɔ anu,
noko awie anwu ɛ gyakɛ abo zo.
20Ɛhanle wɔ menli ne kɛ mboane na ɛlile bɛ nyunlu,
Mosisi nee Aalɔn a nleanle bɛ nwo zo a.

english_text:
(A special psalm by Asaph.)
What God Has Done for His People
1My friends, I beg you
to listen as I teach.
2 I will give instruction
and explain the mystery
of what happened long ago.
3These are things we learned
from our ancestors,
4and we will tell them
to the next generation.
We won't keep secret
the glorious deeds
and the mighty miracles
of the Lord.
5God gave his Law
to Jacob's descendants,
the people of Israel.
And he told our ancestors
to teach their children,
6so that each new generation
would know his Law
and tell it to the next.
7Then they would trust God
and obey his teachings,
without forgetting anything
God had done.
8They would be different
from their ancestors,
who were stubborn, rebellious,
and unfaithful to God.
9The warriors from Ephraim
were armed with arrows,
but they ran away
when the battle began.
10They broke their agreement
with God,
and they turned their backs
on his teaching.
11They forgot all he had done,
even the mighty miracles
12 he did for their ancestors
near Zoan in Egypt.
13 God made a path in the sea
and piled up the water
as he led them across.
14 He guided them during the day
with a cloud,
and each night he led them
with a flaming fire.
15 God made water flow
from rocks he split open
in the desert,
and his people drank freely,
as though from a lake.
16He made streams gush out
like rivers from rocks.
17But in the desert,
the people of God Most High
kept sinning and rebelling.
18 They stubbornly tested God
and demanded from him
what they wanted to eat.
19They challenged God by saying,
“Can God provide food
out here in the desert?
20It's true God struck the rock
and water gushed out
like a river,
but can he give his people
bread and meat?”
21When the Lord heard this,
he was angry and furious
with Jacob's descendants,
the people of Israel.
22They had refused to trust him,
and they had doubted
his saving power.
23But God gave a command
to the clouds,
and he opened the doors
in the skies.
24 From heaven he sent grain
that they called manna.
25He gave them more than enough,
and each one of them ate
this special food.
26God's mighty power
sent a strong wind
from the southeast,
27and it brought birds
that covered the ground,
like sand on the beach.
28Then God made the birds fall
in the camp of his people
near their tents.
29God gave his people
all they wanted,
and each of them ate
until they were full.
30But before they had swallowed
the last bite,
31God became angry and killed
the strongest and best
from the families of Israel.
32But the rest kept on sinning
and would not trust
God's miracles.
33So he cut their lives short
and made them terrified.
34After he killed some of them,
the others turned to him
with all their hearts.
35They remembered God Most High,
the mighty rock
that kept them safe.
36But they tried to flatter God,
and they told him lies;
37 they were unfaithful
and broke their promises.
38Yet God was kind.
He kept forgiving their sins
and didn't destroy them.
He often became angry,
but never lost his temper.
39God remembered that they
were made of flesh
and were like a wind
that blows once
and then dies down.
40While they were in the desert,
they often rebelled
and made God sad.
41They kept testing him
and caused terrible pain
for the Holy One of Israel.
42They forgot about his power
and how he had rescued them
from their enemies.
43God showed them all kinds
of wonderful miracles
near Zoan in Egypt.
44 He turned the rivers of Egypt
into blood,
and no one could drink
from the streams.
45 He sent swarms of flies
to pester the Egyptians,
and he sent frogs
to cause them trouble.
46 God let worms and grasshoppers
eat their crops.
47 He destroyed their grapevines
and their fig trees
with hail and floods.
48Then he killed their cattle
with hail
and their other animals
with lightning.
49God was so angry and furious
that he went into a rage
and caused them great trouble
by sending swarms
of destroying angels.
50God released his anger
and slaughtered them
in a terrible way.
51 He killed the first-born son
of each Egyptian family.
52 Then God led his people
out of Egypt
and guided them in the desert
like a flock of sheep.
53 He led them safely along,
and they were not afraid,
but their enemies drowned
in the sea.
54 God brought his people
to the sacred mountain
that he had taken
by his own power.
55 He made nations run
from the tribes of Israel,
and he let the tribes
take over their land.
56 But the people tested
God Most High,
and they refused
to obey his laws.
57They were as unfaithful
as their ancestors,
and they were as crooked
as a twisted arrow.
58God demanded all their love,
but they made him angry
by worshiping idols.
59So God became furious
and completely rejected
the people of Israel.
60 Then he deserted his home
at Shiloh, where he lived
here on earth.
61 He let enemies capture
the sacred chest
and let them dishonor him.
62God took out his anger
on his chosen ones
and let them be killed
by enemy swords.
63Fire destroyed the young men,
and the young women were left
with no one to marry.
64Priests died violent deaths,
but their widows
were not allowed to mourn.
65Finally the Lord woke up,
like a soldier
startled from a drunken sleep.
66God scattered his enemies
and made them ashamed
forever.
67Then the Lord decided
not to make his home
with Joseph's descendants
in Ephraim.
68Instead he chose the tribe
of Judah,
and he chose Mount Zion,
the place he loves.
69There he built his temple
as lofty as the mountains
and as solid as the earth
he made to last forever.
70 The Lord God chose David
to be his servant and took him
from tending sheep
71and from caring for lambs.
Then God made him the leader
of Israel, his own nation.
72David treated the people fairly
and guided them with wisdom.
translation_text:
Nyamenle nee ye menli ne (Esafe edwɛkɛdwɛndolɛ)
1O me menli, bɛdie me ngilehilelɛ;
bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie me nloa edwɛkɛ!
2 Mebabuke me nloa meava mrɛlɛbulɛ
meaha bɛ mɔmoane awozinli nu edwɛkɛ,
3edwɛkɛ mɔɔ yɛde na yɛze,
yɛ nlenya mɔ a ɛha ɛhile yɛ a.
4Yɛnrɛva yɛnrɛvea bɛ nlɔnra,
yɛbaha yɛahile awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la.
Ɛdɛnkɛma lile gyima mgbole, ɔlɛ tumi,
yɛɛ ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne dɔɔnwo.
5Ɔvale ye ngyehyɛlɛ ɔmanle Gyekɔbo abo zo amra,
na ɔlile mɛla ɔmanle Yizilayɛma,
ɔzele yɛ nlenya mɔ kɛ bɛhilehile bɛ mra;
6amaa awolɛndoazo bieko anu amra
nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛwole bɛ la anwu ye,
na bɛdabɛ bɛaha bɛahile bɛ mra;
7amaa bɛanyia Nyamenle nu anyelazo,
amaa bɛ rɛle anvi Nyamenle gyima ne mɔ,
na bɛali ye mɛla ne mɔ azo;
8amaa bɛanyɛ kɛ bɛ nlenya mɔ,
bɛanyɛ awolɛndoazo atuadelɛma nee anzosesebɛ;
awolɛndoazo mɔɔ ɛnnea ɛleka ko,
mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ ɛmmaa Nyamenle la.
9Yifelaemma vale ɛda,
noko konle kenle ne, bɛguale ɛbɔ nu.
10Bɛanli Nyamenle ngyekyeleɛ ne azo,
na bɛkpole kɛ bɛnrɛlua ye mɛla adenle ne anu.
11Bɛ rɛle vile mɔɔ yeyɛ,
nee nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ yeyɛ yehile bɛ la.
12 Ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne ɔhilele bɛ nlenya mɔ
wɔ Zowan fienemgbole nu, wɔ Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo.
13 Ɔkpakyele nyevile ne anu nwiɔ ɔmanle bɛzenle,
ɔmanle azule ne dwazole bolonwonwo yɛle kɛ bane.
14 Alehyenlɛ nu ɔyɛle amungu ɔlile bɛ nyunlu,
aledwolɛ nu ɔyɛle senle guaanye.
15 Ɔkpukele bodane wɔ fienemgbole ne anu
na ɔmanle bɛ nzule dɔɔnwo kɛ buma nu nzule la bɛnlonle.
16Ɔmanle azudenle vi bodane nu zenzenle,
na ɔmanle nzule ne zenle kɛ azule.
17Noko bɛyɛle ɛtane dɔɔnwo bɛtiale ye,
bɛdele Anwuma Anwumanli ne anwo atua wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo.
18 Bɛ ahonle nu, bɛzɔle Nyamenle bɛnleanle,
na bɛbizale aleɛ mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la.
19Bɛdendɛle bɛtiale Nyamenle bɛhanle kɛ,
“Asoo Nyamenle kɛhola kɛmaa yɛ aleɛ wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ye azo?
20Ɔbɔle bolɛ ne ɔmanle nzule vi nu vindele,
na azudenle yile bule aze.
Asoo eza ɔkɛhola ɔkɛmaa yɛ aleɛ,
anzɛɛ ɔkɛmaa ye menli ne nane bɛkɛli?”
21Yemɔti mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dele la, ɔvale ɛya kpole,
ye ɛya ne zɔle kɛ senle tiale Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne,
ye ɛya ne yɛle kpole wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo zo;
22ɔboalekɛ bɛnlɛ diedi wɔ Nyamenle anu,
yɛɛ bɛanva bɛ rɛle bɛanwula
ye ngoanelielɛ tumi ne anu.
23Na ɔdendɛle ɔhilele anwomanyunlu,
na ɔbukele anwuma nlenkɛ ne mɔ;
24 ɔmanle mana dɔle kɛ ezule ɔmanle bɛ;
na ɔmanle bɛ anwuma aleɛ bɛlile.
25Menli lile anwuma soanvolɛma aleɛ;
ɔmanle aleɛ bule bɛ nwo zo.
26Ɔmanle aduduleɛ anwoma bɔle anwuma lɔ,
na ɔvale ye tumi ne ɔhwenle nyiakɛ anwoma ne ɔhɔle.
27Ɔmanle nane bule bɛ nwo zo kɛ munlutu,
nloma yɛle dɔɔnwo kɛ ɛnweazo anwea.
28Ɔmanle bɛtetele bɛguale bɛ azokoɛleɛ ɛkɛ ne,
ɛleka mɔɔ bɛde la yɛle totɔɔ.
29Bɛlile na bɛ ko yile,
ɔboalekɛ ɔmanle bɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ la.
30Noko mɔɔ bɛ atiakunluwɔzo ne kaye,
mɔɔ ɛnee bɛtɛwiele aleɛ ne di la,
31Nyamenle vale bɛ nwo ɛya,
na ɔhunle bɛ nuhua mɔɔ anwo yɛ se kpalɛ la,
na ɔmanle Yizilayɛ ɛlɔnema anwo hanle aze.
32Noko ɛhye mɔ amuala anzi, bɛhɔle zo bɛyɛle ɛtane;
ye nwanwane nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anzi, bɛanlie bɛanli.
33Yemɔti ɔmanle bɛ mekɛ zenle waa kɛ ɛnwomenle,
na ɔpɛle bɛ ngoane sinli ɛzulolɛ nu.
34Ɔhunle bɛ la, bɛkpondɛle ɔ bo zo;
bɛnlunle bɛ nwo na bɛkpondɛle Nyamenle ɛsesebɛ.
35Bɛhakyele kɛ Nyamenle le bɛ bodane,
Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne le bɛ dievolɛ.
36Noko bɛvale bɛ nloa bɛbɔle awuye ala;
bɛbɔle adalɛ, bɛ nee ye lile amanie.
37Bɛanva bɛ ahonle bɛammaa ye;
bɛanli nɔhalɛ wɔ ye ngyekyeleɛ ne anwo.
38Noko yemɔ, kɛmɔ ɔse anwunvɔne la ati,
ɔvale bɛ ɛtane ɔhyɛle bɛ, yɛanzɛkye bɛ;
mekɛ dɔɔnwo ɔmenle ye ɛya ne,
yeanva ye ɛya ne amuala yeangua bɛ nwo zo.
39Ɔhakyele kɛ bɛle nwonane ala,
bɛle kɛ anwoma mɔɔ se na ɔnzia ko la.
40Bɛdele ɔ nwo atua dɔɔnwo wɔ fienemgbole ne anu,
bɛmanle ɔlile nyane wɔ ɛsɛlɛ ne azo.
41Bɛzɔle ye bɛnleanle fane dɔɔnwo,
na bɛhanle Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne ɛya.
42Bɛanva ye tumi ne anzɛɛ kenle ne mɔɔ ɔyele bɛ
ɔvile bɛ agbɔvolɛ asa nu la bɛangɔ adwenle nu bɔbɔ,
43na yeayɛ ye nwanwane sɛkɛlɛneɛ mɔɔ ɔyɛle wɔ Yigyibiti,
anzɛɛ nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔyɛle wɔ Zowan fienemgbole nu la.
44 Ɔhakyile bɛ azule ne mɔ mogya,
mɔɔ ɛnee bɛngola nuhua nzule no a.
45 Ɔyele nrɛzenra adɔka ɔmanle bɛgyegyele bɛ,
ahɛlɛne ɔmanle bɛzɛkyele bɛ azɛlɛ ne.
46 Ɔmanle nyangomango lile bɛ ɛbɔ nu aleɛ,
ɔmanle abɛbɛ lile bɛ egyinli nu aleɛ.
47 Ɔvale ezuawolɛ ɔzɛkyele bɛ vanye egyinli,
na ɔvale nzulemungu ɔzɛkyele bɛ sekamɔ mbaka.
48Ɔdɔle ezuawolɛ ɔhunle bɛ nlankɛ,
yɛɛ ɛsɛnlɛmanye pepenle bɛ mboane nwo zo hunle bɛ.
49Ɔgyakyile ye ɛya ne anu ɔguale bɛ nwo zo,
ɔvale ɛya, abodelɛ, yɛɛ nyane ɔ rale bɛ nwo zo
kɛ anwuma soanvolɛma la ɔrazɛkyele bɛ.
50Ɔkpakyele adenle ɔmanle ye ɛya ne;
yeanlie biala yeanvi ewule nu,
na ɔmanle ewule nzane hunle bɛ muala.
51 Ɔhunle Yigyibiti belamunli mralɛ mrenya kɔsɔɔti,
Ham awuke biala anu nyianle ye ɛdeɛ.
52 Akee ɔhanle ye menli ne kɛ mboane na ɔlile bɛ nyunlu,
na ɔwowale bɛ wɔ fienemgbole ne anu.
53 Ɔbɔle bɛ nwo bane, yemɔti bɛanzulo;
na nyevile ne bule vale bɛ kpɔvolɛma ne anwo zo.
54 Ɔvale bɛ ɔrale ye azɛlɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne azo,
awoka ne mɔ mɔɔ yeva ye tumi yelie la anu.
55 Ɔvoanle maanle maanle ɔvile bɛ nye zo;
ɔhyɛle azɛlɛ ne ɔmanle bɛvale bɛyɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ,
na ɔmanle Yizilayɛma dɛnlanle bɛ azua ne mɔ anu.
56 Noko bɛzɔle Anwuma Anwuma Nyamenle ne bɛnleanle,
na bɛdele ɔ nwo atua; bɛanli ye mɛla ne mɔ azo.
57Bɛkpole ye na bɛyɛle ngunzi kɛ bɛ nlenya mɔ;
bɛhyibale bɛ nwo kɛ ɛdabaka kyealera.
58Bɛvale bɛ ɛleka mɔɔ bɛsonle la bɛhanle ye ɛya;
bɛvale bɛ ananze mɔɔ bɛguale la bɛfutule ye ahonle.
59Nyamenle nwunle ye la, ɔvale ɛya kpole,
na ɔkpole Yizilayɛma bɔkɔɔ.
60 Ɔkpole ye tɛnlabelɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ Hyaelo,
ɛleka mɔɔ ɔdɛnlanle ye menli ne avinli la.
61 Ɔmanle bɛhyele ye tumi ne nuokɛ,
ɔyele ye anyunlunyia ɔwulale kpɔvolɛma ne asa anu.
62Ɔmanle bɛhunle ye menli ne,
na ɔkpule ye ɛya ne ɔguale bɛ nwo zo.
63Bɛ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ hale esike nu,
yɛɛ bɛ mbɛlɛra ne mɔ annyia agyalɛ angɔ.
64Bɛ sɛlɛvolɛma dɔle dadeɛ nloa,
yɛɛ bɛ ahunlanvolɛ angola awolɛ ye.
65Akee Awulae dwazole kɛ asɛɛ ɔvi nafelɛ nu,
na ɔlɛtea kɛ katakyie mɔɔ nza wɔ ɔ nye zo la.
66Ɔmanle ye kpɔvolɛma guale ɛbɔ nu,
na ɔguale bɛ nyunlu aze kpɔtɔɔ.
67Ɔkpole Dwosefi awuke nu amra,
yeanva Yifelaem abusua ekpunli ne;
68ɔnleanle nu ɔyele Dwuda abusua ekpunli ne,
Zayɔn Boka mɔɔ ɔkulo ye somaa la.
69Ɔzile ye Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne
kɛ ye sua nu mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la;
ɔzile ye kpundii kɛ azɛlɛ ye mɔɔ yebɔ,
na ɔla ɛkɛ ne dahuu la.
70 Ɔnleanle nu ɔyele ye sonvolɛ Devidi,
ɔyele ye ɔvile mboane zo ɛnleanlɛ,
71ɔmanle ɔgyakyile mboane mralɛ ɛnleanlɛ, na ɔ nee ye rale kɛ ɔranlea ye menli Gyekɔbo abo zo amra,
Yizilayɛma mɔɔ le ye agyadeɛ la.
72Ɔvale ahonle kpalɛ ɔnleanle bɛ,
na ɔvale nrɛlɛbɛ kpole ɔzinzale bɛ.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph.)
Have Pity on Jerusalem
1 Our God, foreign nations
have taken your land,
disgraced your temple,
and left Jerusalem in ruins.
2They have fed the bodies
of your servants
to flesh-eating birds;
your loyal people are food
for savage animals.
3All Jerusalem is covered
with their blood,
and there is no one left
to bury them.
4Every nation around us
sneers and makes fun.
5Our Lord, will you keep on
being angry?
Will your angry feelings
keep flaming up like fire?
6Get angry with those nations
that don't know you
and won't worship you!
7They have gobbled up
Jacob's descendants
and left the land in ruins.
8 Don't make us pay for the sins
of our ancestors.
Have pity and come quickly!
We are completely helpless.
9Our God, you keep us safe.
Now help us! Rescue us.
Forgive our sins
and bring honor to yourself.
10Why should nations ask us,
“Where is your God?”
Let us and the other nations
see you take revenge
for your servants who died
a violent death.
11Listen to the prisoners groan!
Let your mighty power save all
who are sentenced to die.
12Each of those nations sneered
at you, our Lord.
Now let others sneer at them,
seven times as much.
13Then we, your people,
will always thank you.
We are like sheep
with you as our shepherd,
and all generations
will hear us praise you.
translation_text:
Maanle ne ɛlielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ (Esafe edwɛne)
1 O Nyamenle, menli mɔɔ ɛnzonle wɔ la
ɛrawolo wɔ agyadeɛ ye anu,
bɛgua wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo evinli;
bɛbɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɔkɔbɔkɔ.
2Bɛva wɔ sonvolɛma ne mɔ avunli
bɛmaa anwomanyunlu nloma kɛ bɛli,
bɛva wɔ menli ne nwonane bɛmaa azɛlɛ ye azo nanemgbole.
3Bɛhwi bɛ mogya bɛgua kɛ nzule,
bɛkponde ye Gyɛlusalɛm amuala,
yɛɛ awie ɛnle ɛkɛ na yeazie bɛ.
4Maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia yɛ la bɔ yɛ aholoba,
bɛsi yɛ amgbu na bɛsele yɛ.
5O Ɛdɛnkɛma, na kenlenzu?
Asoo ɛfa ɛya mɔɔ ɛnrɛgyakyi ɛlɛ?
Asoo ɛmaa wɔ ɛya kpole ne azɔ kɛ senle?
6Wola wɔ ɛya ne gua maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnze wɔ,
nee arelemgbunli maanle mɔɔ ɛnzonle wɔ la anwo zo.
7Ɔluakɛ bɛhu Yizilayɛma amuala,
na bɛmaa bɛ tɛnlabelɛ ɛdɔ mgbane.
8Mmatea yɛ wɔ yɛ nlenya mɔ ɛtane ne mɔ ati;
maa wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne ɛrɛla yɛ nwo zo ndɛndɛ,
ɔluakɛ yɛ anyelazo ɛwie.
9O yɛ ngoanelielɛ Nyamenle, boa yɛ,
wɔ wɔ duma ne anyunlunyia ti;
fa yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kyɛ yɛ na die yɛ,
wɔ wɔ duma ne ati.
10Duzu ati yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ maanle maanle ka kɛ,
“Bɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ nienwu?” a.
Maa wɔ sonvolɛma mɔɔ bɛha bɛ mogya bɛgua la
anwo nzenralɛ ɛrɛla maanle maanle ne mɔ
anwo zo wɔ yɛdayɛ yɛ nye zo.
11Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ la ɛzunlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu;
fa wɔ tumi kpole ne die bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkahu bɛ la.
12O Awulae, maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ wɔ aholoba la,
kile bɛdabɛ abodelɛ mɔnwo fane nsuu.
13Na wɔ menli, wɔ adidileka mboane,
yɛbayɛ wɔ mo dahuu;
ɔvi awolɛndoazo kɔdwu awolɛndoazo,
yɛbaye wɔ ayɛlɛ.

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph for the music leader. To the tune “Lilies of the Agreement.”)
Help Our Nation
1 Shepherd of Israel, you lead
the descendants of Joseph,
and you sit on your throne
above the winged creatures.
Listen to our prayer
and let your light shine
2for the tribes of Ephraim,
Benjamin, and Manasseh.
Save us by your power.
3Our God, make us strong again!
Smile on us and save us.
4 Lord God All-Powerful,
how much longer
will the prayers of your people
make you angry?
5You gave us tears for food,
and you made us drink them
by the bowlful.
6Because of you,
our enemies who live nearby
laugh and joke about us.
7Our God, make us strong again!
Smile on us and save us.
8We were like a grapevine
you brought out of Egypt.
You chased other nations away
and planted us here.
9Then you cleared the ground,
and we put our roots deep,
spreading over the land.
10Shade from this vine covered
the mountains.
Its branches climbed
the mighty cedars
11and stretched to the sea;
its new growth reached
to the river.
12Our Lord, why have you
torn down the wall
from around the vineyard?
You let everyone who walks by
pick the grapes.
13Now the vine is gobbled up
by pigs from the forest
and other wild animals.
14God All-Powerful,
please do something!
Look down from heaven
and see what's happening
to this vine.
15With your own hands
you planted its roots,
and you raised it
as your very own.
16Enemies chopped the vine down
and set it on fire.
Now show your anger
and destroy them.
17But help the one who sits
at your right side,
the one you raised
to be your very own.
18Then we will never turn away.
Put new life into us,
and we will worship you.
19 Lord God All-Powerful,
make us strong again!
Smile on us and save us.
translation_text:
Maanle ne boɛyɛlɛ bieko anwo nzɛlɛlɛ (Esafe edwɛne)
1 O Yizilayɛma anwo zo neavolɛ, tie yɛ,
wɔmɔ, ɛhanle Dwosefi abo zo amra
kɛ mboane na ɛlile bɛ nyunlu.
Wɔmɔ mɔɔ wɔ belemgbunli ebia
gyi tease abɔdeɛma azo a, ta bɛla,
2maa Yifelaem, Bɛngyaman, yɛɛ Manasɛ ɛnwu ye.
Kile wɔ tumi ne, na balie yɛ!
3O Nyamenle, fa yɛ sie yɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne;
kile wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne yɛ nwo zo,
amaa yɛanyia ngoane.
4O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle,
ɛfa wɔ menli ne nzɛlɛlɛ nwo ɛya wɔahɔdwu kenlenzu?
5Wɔmaa bɛ nyane kɛ bɛli kɛ aleɛ,
wɔmaa bɛ monle kɛ nzule kɛ bɛnlo bɛmaa ɔde bɛ.
6Maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia yɛ la zo konle doa yɛ,
yɛɛ yɛ kpɔvolɛma yia nu a bɛsele yɛ.
7O Tumivolɛ Nyamenle, fa yɛ sie yɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne;
kile wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne yɛ nwo zo,
amaa yɛanyia ngoane
8Ɛvale vanye baka ɛvile Yigyibiti ɛrale;
ɛvoanle maanle maanle ne mɔ na ɛluale.
9Ɛzieziele azɛlɛ ne ɛmanle ye;
ɔzɔle ndinli ɔhɔle aze kpalɛ na ɔvale azɛlɛ ne.
10Ye alubo hedale awoka ne mɔ azo,
ɔvale ye ngane ɔguale sida mbaka mgbole zo;
11ye ngane dwule Mɛdetɛlenia nyevile nu,
ɔdendenle ɔdwule Azule Yufileti ne anloa.
12Duzu ati a akee wɔbubu ye bane ne mɔ,
na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa adenle ne azo la tete ye ma ɛ?
13Kɔkɔte vi kpɔkɛ nu batietia zo,
yɛɛ ɛbɔ nu debie biala di bie.
14O Tumivolɛ Nyamenle, kakyi ɛ nye bieko!
Wɔ anwuma nehane, to ɛ nye nea,
na bu vanye baka ɛhye bie,
15baka ne mɔɔ ɛvale wɔ tumi ɛluale,
ɛnleanle ɛmanle ɔyɛle kpole ɔmanle wɔ la.
16Bɛpɛ ye bɛdo aze, bɛva senle bɛdo nu;
twi bɛ nyunlu na bɔ bɛ bo zo.
17Fa ɛ sa to sonla ne mɔɔ wɔ wɔ fema zo la anwo zo,
sonla ra ne mɔɔ wɔwula ye anwosesebɛ wɔmaa ɛ nwo la!
18Yɛnrɛhakyi yɛ nzi yɛnrɛzi wɔ bieko;
maa yɛ ngoane, na yɛkɛzonle wɔ.
19O Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, fa yɛ sie yɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne,
kile wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ ne yɛ nwo zo,
amaa yɛanyia ngoane.

english_text:
(By Asaph for the music leader.
)
God Makes Us Strong
1Be happy and shout to God
who makes us strong!
Shout praises to the God
of Jacob.
2Sing as you play tambourines
and the lovely sounding
stringed instruments.
3 Sound the trumpets and start
the New Moon Festival.
We must also celebrate
when the moon is full.
4This is the law in Israel,
and it was given to us
by the God of Jacob.
5The descendants of Joseph
were told to obey it,
when God led them out
from the land of Egypt.
In a voice unknown to me,
I heard someone say:
6“I lifted the burden
from your shoulder
and took the heavy basket
from your hands.
7 When you were in trouble,
I rescued you,
and from the thunderclouds,
I answered your prayers.
Later I tested you
at Meribah Spring.
8“Listen, my people,
while I, the Lord,
correct you!
Israel, if you would only
pay attention to me!
9 Don't worship foreign gods
or bow down to gods
you know nothing about.
10I am the Lord your God.
I rescued you from Egypt.
Just ask, and I will give you
whatever you need.
11“But, my people, Israel,
you refused to listen,
and you would have nothing
to do with me!
12So I let you be stubborn
and keep on following
your own advice.
13“My people, Israel,
if only you would listen
and do as I say!
14I, the Lord, would quickly
defeat your enemies
with my mighty power.
15Everyone who hates me
would come crawling,
and that would be the end
of them.
16But I would feed you
with the finest bread
and with the best honey
until you were full.”
translation_text:
Ɛvoyialilɛ nwo edwɛne (Esafe edwɛne)
1Bɛdea nu bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa Nyamenle yɛ anwosesebɛ ne;
bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdea nu bɛmaa Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne!
2Bɛvɛlɛ edwɛne ne, bɛbɔ akɛya ne,
bɛbɔ getaa ngyikyi ne nee mgbole ne mɔ.
3 Siane ne fi fofolɛ a bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu,
siane ne yɛ mumua a bɛwu nu bɛli ɛvoyia ne.
4Ɔluakɛ ɔle mɛla ɔmaa Yizilayɛma,
ɔle Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne mɛla.
5Ɔluale Dwosefi abo zo amra anwo zo ɔyɛle ye mɛla,
mekɛ mɔɔ ɔtetale Yigyibitima la.
Mete ɛnelɛ bie mɔɔ metɛtele ye ɛlɛ a; ɔse,
6“Menyele bɛ kɔme zo adesoa;
menliele bɛ ahɛndɛne menvile bɛ sa nu.
7 Bɛvɛlɛle me wɔ bɛ anwongyelelɛ nu, na menliele bɛ;
mewɔ me feabelɛ wɔ ahumu ne anu la, menliele bɛ zo;
menzɔle bɛ meneanle wɔ Mɛleba nzubula ne mɔ azo.
8Bɛdie, O me menli, mebɔ bɛ kɔkɔ,
O Yizilayɛ, saa bɛkɛdie me angome ɛdeɛ a!
9 Ɔnle kɛ bɛnyia nyamenle gyɛne biala bɛ avinli;
bɛmmabɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa nyamenle gyɛne biala.
10Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne,
mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti azɛlɛ zo rale la.
Bɛbuke bɛ nloa kpalɛ, na menwɔmaa bɛ aleɛ.
11“Na me menli ne andie me ne;
Yizilayɛma ɛnva me ɛnyɛ ɛhwee.
12Yemɔti mengyakyile bɛ memanle bɛdabɛ bɛ anzosesebɛ ne,
kɛ bɛdabɛ bɛyɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo la.
13O anrɛɛ me menli ne adie me,
anrɛɛ Yizilayɛma alua me adenle ne anu!
14Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meali bɛ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim,
na meava me sa meazie menli mɔɔ kyi bɛ la anwo.
15Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi Ɛdɛnkɛma la baradane ye,
bɛ ndeanlɛ bo ɛnrɛdu ɛlɛ.
16Mebava hwiiti kpalɛ meadane bɛ,
na meamaa bɛ bodane nu wolɛ bɛanlo.”

english_text:
(A psalm by Asaph.)
Please Do Something, God!
1When all the other gods
have come together,
the Lord God judges them
and says:
2“How long will you
keep judging unfairly
and favoring evil people?
3Be fair to the poor
and to orphans.
Defend the helpless
and everyone in need.
4Rescue the weak and homeless
from the powerful hands
of heartless people.
5“None of you know
or understand a thing.
You live in darkness,
while the foundations
of the earth tremble.
6 “I, the Most High God, say
that all of you are gods
and also my own children.
7But you will die,
just like everyone else,
including powerful rulers.”
8Do something, God!
Judge the nations of the earth;
they belong to you.
translation_text:
Nyamenle le Belemgbunli Bedevinli (Esafe edwɛne)
1Nyamenle ɛdɛnla ye ebia nu
wɔ ayia nwuanzanwuanza ne anu;
saa awozonle ne mɔ yia nu a ɔbua bɛ ndɛne kɛ,
2“Kenlenzu a bɛkɛgyakyi mgbɔvodɛne ɛbualɛ,
na bɛkɛgyakyi kɛ bɛdi bɛaboa amumuyɛma a?
3Bɛli pɛlepɛle bɛmaa mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ɔ ze la,
na bɛli bɛmaa mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la.
4Die mɔɔ ɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ nee mɔɔ ɛnlɛ bie la;
die bɛ fi amumuyɛma asa anu.”
5“Bɛnlɛ adwenle yɛɛ bɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo,
bɛluolua awozinli nu;
azɛlɛ ye adiabo ne mɔ ɛkpusu.
6 Mese, ‘Bɛle nyamenle,
bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛle Anwuma Anwumanli ne amra;’
7noko bɛbawu kɛ menli wu la,
na bɛakpo aze kɛ belemgbunli biala la.”
8Dwazo, O Nyamenle, bua ewiade ndɛne;
ɔluakɛ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti le wɔ ɛdeɛ!

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by Asaph.)
God Rules All the Earth
1Our God, don't just sit there,
silently doing nothing!
2Your hateful enemies
are turning against you
and rebelling.
3They are sly, and they plot
against those you treasure.
4They say, “Let's wipe out
the nation of Israel
and make sure that no one
remembers its name!”
5All of them fully agree
in their plans against you,
and among them are
6Edom and the Ishmaelites;
Moab and the Hagrites;
7Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek;
Philistia and Phoenicia.
8Even Assyria has joined forces
with Moab and Ammon.
9 Our Lord, punish all of them
as you punished Midian.
Destroy them, as you destroyed
Sisera and Jabin
at Kishon Creek 10near Endor,
and let their bodies rot.
11 Treat their leaders as you did
Oreb and Zeeb,
Zebah and Zalmunna.
12All of them said, “We'll take
God's valuable land!”
13Our God, scatter them around
like dust in a whirlwind.
14Just as flames destroy forests
on the mountains,
15pursue and terrify them
with storms of your own.
16Make them blush with shame,
until they turn and worship
you, our Lord.
17Let them be forever ashamed
and confused.
Let them die in disgrace.
18Make them realize that you
are the Lord Most High,
the only ruler of earth!
translation_text:
Yizilayɛ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konimlilɛ nzɛlɛlɛ (Esafe edwɛne)
1O Nyamenle, mmayɛ koonwu;
O Nyamenle, mmayɛ kɛnlanana!
2Nea, wɔ kpɔvolɛma ne ɛlɛtu fonyia;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi wɔ la ɛmaa bɛ ti zo.
3Bɛhɔ wɔ menli ne ati akpamo,
bɛtu bɛ nwo azukue wɔ menli ne
mɔɔ wɔbɔ bɛ nwo bane la ati.
4Bɛse, “Bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛbɔ bɛ maanle ne bɔkɔɔ;
amaa bɛangakye duma Yizilayɛ ne bieko ɛlɛ.”
5Ɛhɛe, bɛ muala bɛbɔ nu bɛfa adwenle ko,
bɛkyekye bɛkye ɔ bo bɛtia wɔ:
6Yidɔmma nee Yehyemeeyɛlema,
Mowabema nee Hagelaema,
7Gibalema, Amɔnoma, nee Amalɛkema,
Filisitiama yɛɛ menli mɔɔ wɔ Taya la.
8Aseleama noko boka bɛ nwo;
bɛmɛ a bɛle Lɔɔto abo zo amra mɔɔ anwo yɛ se kpalɛ a.
9 Yɛ bɛ kɛ ɛyɛle Medeanema la,
kɛ ɛyɛle Sesɛla nee Gyeeben wɔ Azule Kaehyɔn anloa,
10mɔɔ bɛzɛkyele bɛ wɔ Ɛndɔ,
na bɛ avunli kpɔlɔle azɛlɛ ne azo la.
11 Yɛ bɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ ɛyɛle Ɔlɛbe nee Ziibi la;
na yɛ bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ kɛ ɛyɛle Ziba nee Zalemɛna,
12mɔɔ hanle kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛhɔ Nyamenle adidileka ne
yɛhɔva ye azɛlɛ ne bie yɛyɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ” la.
13O me Nyamenle, maa bɛyɛ kɛ munlutu mɔɔ anwoma ɛlɛbɔ nu la,
bɛyɛ kɛ abonle mɔɔ luolua anwoma nu la.
14Maa bɛyɛ kɛ kpɔkɛ mɔɔ senle la nu la,
bɛyɛ kɛ awoka mɔɔ senle ɛdɔ zolɛ la.
