na ɔpepɛ nlenkɛ nzi mbulalɛ nu nwiɔ nwiɔ.
17Bie mɔ ɛtane bɔle bɛ anwonyane,
na bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ manle bɛnwunle nyane dɔɔnwo;
18bɛkpole aleɛ ngakyile biala,
na bɛbikyele ewule anlenkɛ nloa.
19Bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu,
na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile bɛ nyanenwunlɛ nu.
20Ɔhanle edwɛkɛ ne, na bɛ nwo zale,
na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile ewule nu.
21Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo
wɔ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati,
wɔ ye nwanwane gyima mɔɔ ɔlile
ɔmanle menli ne la ati.
22Bɛbɔ ye moyɛlɛ azu,
na bɛdo anyelielɛ edwɛne bɛha ye nyɛleɛ ne mɔ.
23Bie mɔ vale meli hɔle nyevile zo,
bɛhɔlile gua wɔ azule mgbole zo.
24Bɛnwunle Ɛdɛnkɛma nyɛleɛ ne mɔ,
nee ye nwanwane gyima ne mɔ wɔ buma ne anu.
25Ɔluakɛ ɔdendɛle, na ahumu dwazole
manle nyevile azɛlɛkye bule mgbole.
26Azɛlɛkye ne manle meli ne mɔ zo,
finle bɛ buma ne mɔ anu;
bɛ anwosesebɛ minlinle
manle bɛ nzuzuguazo bɔle bɛ.
27Bɛtotɔle kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛbo nza,
na bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ muala wiele.
28Bɛzunle bɛvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ nu,
na ɔliele bɛ ɔvile bɛ nyanenwunlɛ nu;
29ɔmanle ahumu ne guale,
na azɛlɛkye ne mɔ guale diinyi.
30Bɛlile fɛlɛko, ɔboalekɛ maanle nu ɛgua,
na ɔ nee bɛ hɔdwule ahonle ne mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ zo la azo.
31Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo wɔ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati,
wɔ ye nwanwane gyima mɔɔ ɔdi ɔmaa menli la ati.
32Bɛhanvo ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menli ne kɛyia la,
na bɛye ye ayɛlɛ wɔ mgbanyima ayia ne anu.
33Ɔmaa azule kakyi ɛsɛlɛ,
nzubula kakyi azɛlɛ resee;
34azɛlɛ mɔɔ kye aleɛ la kakyi ngyenle azɛlɛ,
wɔ menli ne ɛtane ne mɔ ati.
35Ɔmaa nzule bu ɛsɛlɛ zo,
azɛlɛ resee kakyi nzubula;
36ɔmaa menli mɔɔ ɛhɔne ku bɛ la tɛnla zolɛ,
na bɛkyekye suakpole bɛtɛnla zolɛ.
37Bɛso ɛya bɛdua aleɛ, bɛyɛ vanye egyinli,
na bɛnyia bɛyɔba dɔɔnwo.
38Ɔyila bɛ, ɔmaa bɛ nwo so dɔɔnwo;
ɔmmaa bɛ nlankɛ anwo ɛnyɛ ekyi.
39Saa bɛdi bɛ nwo zo konim na bɛ nwo yɛ ekyi,
bɛsisi bɛ, bɛnwu amaneɛ, na bɛdi nyane a,
40ɔmaa arelemgbunli mɔɔ sie bɛ la nwu kɛ ɔ nye ɛnlie nwo,
na ɔmaa bɛkpɔsɛkpɔsa ɛsɛlɛ zo.
41Ɔye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyia la nyane nu,
na ɔmaa bɛ nwo so kɛ nyɛmoa.
42Pɛlepɛlema nwu ye na bɛdi fɛlɛko;
na amumuyɛma mua bɛ nloa.
43Mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ la ɛdwenle ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ anwo;
bɛmaa menli ɛdwenle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne anwo.

english_text:
(A song and a psalm by David.)
With God on Our Side
1Our God, I am faithful to you
with all my heart,
and you can trust me.
I will sing
and play music for you
with all that I am.
2I will start playing my harps
before the sun rises.
3I will praise you, Lord,
for everyone to hear;
I will sing hymns to you
in every nation.
4Your love reaches higher
than the heavens,
and your loyalty extends
beyond the clouds.
5Our God, may you be honored
above the heavens;
may your glory be seen
everywhere on earth.
6Answer my prayers
and use your powerful arm
to give us victory.
Then the people you love
will be safe.
7Our God, from your holy place
you made this promise:
“I will gladly divide up
the city of Shechem
and give away Succoth Valley
piece by piece.
8The lands of Gilead
and Manasseh are mine.
Ephraim is my war helmet,
and Judah is my symbol
of royal power.
9Moab is merely my washbasin,
and Edom belongs to me.
I shout with victory
over the Philistines.”
10Our God, who will bring me
to the fortress
or lead me to Edom?
11Have you rejected us?
You don't lead our armies.
12Help us defeat our enemies!
No one else can rescue us.
13Only you give us victory
and crush our enemies.
translation_text:
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ wɔ kpɔvolɛ asa anu
1O Nyamenle, me ahonle gyi kpundii,
me ahonle gyi kpundii!
Mebado edwɛne meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ!
Me ɛkɛla, dwazo!
2Bɛdwazo, getaa mgbole nee ngyikyi!
Mebamaa mangyee ye anu akpudwu!
3O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebayɛ wɔ mo,
wɔ menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti avinli,
mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ wɔ maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti avinli.
4Ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne le kpole tɛla anwuma,
wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne dwu amungu ne mɔ anu lɔ.
5O Nyamenle, maa wɔ kpoleyɛlɛ ne zo anwuma lɔ!
Maa wɔ anyunlunyia ɛda ewiade amuala!
6Amaa wɔalie menli mɔɔ ɛkulo bɛ la ngoane;
bua me, na dua wɔ tumi ne azo boa yɛ.
7Nyamenle ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ wɔ ye ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne,
ɔse, “Mebahyɛ Hyikɛm anu konimlilɛ nu,
na meahyɛ Sɛko Bɔnza meamaa me menli ne.
8Geleade le me ɛdeɛ; Manasɛ le me ɛdeɛ;
Yifelaem le me bulalɛ kyɛlɛ; Dwuda le me tumi kpɔma;
9Mowabe le me kyɛnze bonkuma;
mefuandi me mgbɔlaboa megua Yidɔm anwo zo;
metea nu konimlilɛ nu wɔ Filisitiama anwo zo.”
10Nwane a kɛva me kɛhɔ suakpole ne
mɔɔ bɛhye nwo la azo a?
Nwane a kɛva me kɛhɔ Yidɔm a?
11O Nyamenle, asoo ɛtɛkpole yɛ ɛ?
O Nyamenle, ɛ nee yɛ ɛlɔnema ne ɛngɔ.
12O boa yɛ maa yɛho yɛtia kpɔvolɛ ne,
ɔluakɛ sonla moalɛ le mgbane.
13Nyamenle wɔ yɛ afoa a yɛbaho yɛadɔ zo;
yemɔ yɛɛ ɔbaha kpɔvolɛma ne yeagua a.

english_text:
(A psalm by David for the music leader.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1I praise you, God!
Don't keep silent.
2Destructive and deceitful lies
are told about me,
3and hateful things are said
for no reason.
4I had pity and prayed
for my enemies,
but their words to me
were harsh and cruel.
5For being friendly and kind,
they paid me back
with meanness and hatred.
6My enemies said,
“Find some worthless fools
to accuse him of a crime.
7Try him and find him guilty!
Consider his prayers a lie.
8 Cut his life short
and let someone else
have his job.
9Make orphans of his children
and a widow of his wife;
10make his children beg for food
and live in the slums.
11“Let the people he owes
take everything he owns.
Give it all to strangers.
12Don't let anyone be kind to him
or have pity on the children
he leaves behind.
13Bring an end to his family,
and from now on let him be
a forgotten man.
14“Don't let the Lord forgive
the sins of his parents
and his ancestors.
15Don't let the Lord forget
the sins of his family,
or let anyone remember
his family ever lived.
16He was so cruel to the poor,
homeless, and discouraged
that they died young.
17“He cursed others.
Now place a curse on him!
He never wished others well.
Wish only trouble for him!
18He cursed others more often
than he dressed himself.
Let his curses strike him deep,
just as water and olive oil
soak through to our bones.
19Let his curses surround him,
just like the belt and clothes
he wears each day.”
20Those are the cruel things
my enemies wish for me.
Let it all happen to them!
21Be true to your name, Lord God!
Show your great kindness
and rescue me.
22I am poor and helpless,
and I have lost all hope.
23I am fading away
like an evening shadow;
I am tossed aside
like a crawling insect.
24I have gone without eating,
until my knees are weak,
and my body is bony.
25 When my enemies see me,
they say cruel things
and shake their heads.
26Please help me, Lord God!
Come and save me
because of your love.
27Let others know that you alone
have saved me.
28I don't care if they curse me,
as long as you bless me.
You will make my enemies fail
when they attack,
and you will make me glad
to be your servant.
29You will cover them with shame,
just as their bodies
are covered with clothes.
30I will sing your praises
and thank you, Lord,
when your people meet.
31You help everyone in need,
and you save them from death.
translation_text:
Amaneɛnwunlɛnli edwɛkɛ
1O me ayɛlɛyelɛ Nyamenle, mmayɛ koonwu!
2Ɔluakɛ amumuyɛma nee adalɛma ɛdwazo me nwo zo,
bɛlɛkeha adalɛ bɛatia me.
3Bɛfa ɛkpɔlɛ edwɛkɛ bɛyia me adenle,
na mgbane gyɛne ne ala bɛteta me.
4Mekulo bɛ, noko bɛmɛ bɛto me ɛzonle,
kanza meyɛ nzɛlɛlɛ memaa bɛ bɔbɔ a,
5bɛfa ɛtane bɛtua me kpalɛyɛlɛ kakɛ,
yɛɛ bɛfa ɛkpɔlɛ bɛtua me ɛhulolɛ kakɛ.
6Ye amumuyɛnli bie maa ɔho ɔtia me kpɔvolɛ ne,
maa awie ɛdo ye ɛzonle ɛva ye ɛhɔ edwɛkɛlilɛ.
7Saa bɛdi ye edwɛkɛ a, maa ɔli fɔlɛ,
na bɛva ye modolɛ ne kɛ ɛtaneyɛlɛ!
8 Maa ye mekɛ ɛyɛ ezinraa;
maa awie ɛza ye ɛlie ɔ nwo ninyɛne.
9Maa ɔ mra ɛyɛ nrisa,
na ɔ ye ɛyɛ kunlanvolɛ.
10Maa ɔ mra ɛluolua nu ɛzɛlɛzɛlɛ,
na bɛvoa bɛ bɛvi bɛ sua bubulera ne anu.
11Maa menli mɔɔ ɔtua bɛ kakɛ la
ɛlie ɔ nwo ninyɛne muala,
na nyɛvolɛ ɛwua ye debie biala.
12Mmamaa awie biala se ye anwunvɔne,
anzɛɛ nwu ɔ mra nrisa ne mɔ anwunvɔne.
13Maa ɔ bo zo ɛbɔ,
na ye duma ɛminli awolɛndoazo nwiɔ ne anu.
14Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye ɔ ze mɔ ninyɛndane ne mɔ,
yɛɛ mmafa ɔ nli ɛtane ne mɔ ɛkyɛ ye.
15Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye ye ɛtane ne mɔ dahuu;
na maa ewiade amra arɛle ɛvi ye bɔkɔɔ.
16Ɔluakɛ yeangakye kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔse anwunvɔne;
ɔyɛle menli mɔɔ ɛhyia nee ɛhyianvolɛma kpɔdekpɔde,
na ɔtinlinle mɔɔ ɛnwu ɔ nyunlu la edwɛkɛ nu
ɔhunle ye.
17Ɔhulole amowa; maa amowa ɛbu ɛzia ye!
Yeangulo nyilalɛ; maa nyilalɛ ɛbɔ ye!
18Ɔvale amowa ɔyɛle ɛdanlɛ ɔhedale,
maa ye amowa ne ɛloa ye tɔfɔɔ kɛ nzule,
na ɔyɛ kɛ nwole ɔdwu ye mbowule nu.
19Maa ɔyɛ kɛ adɛladeɛ mɔɔ ɔwula,
na ɔyɛ kɛ akyeso mɔɔ dahuu ɔkye la!
20Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa ɛhye ɛyɛ me kpɔvolɛma ahatualɛ,
ɔyɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtendɛ ɛtane bɛtia me la
ahatualɛ.
21Na wɔmɔ, Awulae me Nyamenle,
wɔ duma ne ati, die me ti,
ɔboalekɛ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne le kpalɛ, die me!
22Ɔluakɛ mele ehyianli, yɛɛ mehyia,
nyane ɛha me kpole.
23Mewie kɔ kɛ nɔsolɛ nu ɛlawolɛ,
bɛkpɔla me bɛto kɛ abɛbɛ.
24Ɛhɔnehyelɛ ɛmaa me gyakɛ anzi ɛtuto,
me nwonane ɛwie kɔ bɔkɔɔ.
25 Me kpɔvolɛma nwu me a bɛgolo me nwo;
bɛnwu me a bɛkpusu bɛ ti.
26O Ɛdɛnkɛma me Nyamenle, boa me!
Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, die me!
27Maa bɛnwu ye kɛ wɔ tumi zo ɔ;
na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ wɔyɛ a.
28Maa bɛwa me amonle, na wɔmɔ yila me,
maa me kpɔvolɛma anyunlu ɛgua aze,
na wɔ sonvolɛma ɛli fɛlɛko.
29Maa nyiane ɛhu me kpɔvolɛma,
na maa bɛ anyiemgba ɛbɔ bɛ ti.
30Mebava me nloa meayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo kpole kpalɛ;
mebaye ye ayɛlɛ wɔ menli ɛwolaa ne anu.
31Ɔluakɛ ɔdie anwunvɔnenli ne ati,
ɔdie ye ɔfi menli mɔɔ kulo kɛ bɛku ye la asa anu.

english_text:
(A psalm by David.)
The Lord Gives Victory
1 The Lord said to my Lord,
“Sit at my right side,
until I make your enemies
into a footstool for you.”
2The Lord will let your power
reach out from Zion,
and you will rule
over your enemies.
3Your glorious power
will be seen on the day
you begin to rule.
You will wear the sacred robes
and shine like the morning sun
in all of your strength.
4 The Lord has made a promise
that will never be broken:
“You will be a priest forever,
just like Melchizedek.”
5The Lord is at your right side,
and when he gets angry
he will crush
the other kings.
6He will judge the nations
and crack their skulls,
leaving piles of dead bodies
all over the earth.
7He will drink from any stream
that he chooses, while winning
victory after victory.
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye belemgbunli ne mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye ye la
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me Awulae kɛ,
“Tɛnla me sa fema zo,
kɔkpula kɛ menwɔva wɔ kpɔvolɛma amuala
menwɔwula ɛ gyakɛ abo.” 1 Kɔl 15.25; Ɛfɛ 1.20-22; Kɔlɔ 3.1
2Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa wɔ belemgbunli kpɔma kpole ne
vi Zayɔn ara. Ɔse,
“Di wɔ kpɔvolɛma anwo zo belemgbunli.”
3Wɔ menli ne mɔ bava bɛ nwo amaa wɔ,
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛze kɛ ɛdi wɔ ɛlɔnema ati
wɔ boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo la.
Wɔ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ bara ɛ nwo nwonlomɔ mangyee ne,
kɛ nwonlomɔ ɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛtɔ la.
4 Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha ndane,
yɛɛ ɔnrɛhakyi ye adwenle ɛlɛ.
Ɔse, “Ɛle sɛlɛvolɛ dahuu,
kɛmɔ Mɛlekezidɛke yɛle la.”
5Awulae gyi wɔ fema zo,
ɔfa ɛya a ɔbabubu arelemgbunli.
6Ɔbadea maanle maanle ne mɔ,
na yeamaa avunli ayiyi bɛ ahonleɛ;
ɔbahu bɛ arelemgbunli
mɔɔ wɔ ewiade amuala la.
7Ɔbanlo adehane nzule ne bie;
yemɔti ɔbakpogya ɔ ti zo.

english_text:
Praise the Lord for All He Has Done
1Shout praises to the Lord!
With all my heart
I will thank the Lord
when his people meet.
2The Lord has done
many wonderful things!
Everyone who is pleased
with God's marvelous deeds
will keep them in mind.
3Everything the Lord does
is glorious and majestic,
and his power to bring justice
will never end.
4The Lord God is famous
for his wonderful deeds,
and he is kind and merciful.
5He gives food to his worshipers
and always keeps his agreement
with them.
6He has shown his mighty power
to his people
and has given them the lands
of other nations.
7God is always honest and fair,
and his laws can be trusted.
8They are true and right
and will stand forever.
9God rescued his people,
and he will never break
his agreement with them.
He is fearsome and holy.
10 Respect and obey the Lord!
This is the first step
to wisdom and good sense.
God will always be respected.
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛyelɛ
1Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Mebayeye me ahonle nu meayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo,
wɔ fɔɔnwoma avinli, wɔ ayia kpole ne anu.
2Ɛdɛnkɛma gyima ne mɔ le mgbole,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ nye die nwolɛ la sukoa.
3Tumi nee enililɛ wɔ ye gyima nu,
yɛɛ ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.
4Ɛdɛnkɛma le dovolɛ nee anwunvɔnezelɛnli,
yemaa bɛhakye ye nwanwane gyima ne mɔ.
5Ɔmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo ye la aleɛ;
ɔkakye ye ngyekyeleɛ ne dahuu.
6Yeva maanle maanle ne mɔ agyadeɛ yemaa ye menli
yehile ye menli ne tumi mɔɔ wɔ ye gyimayɛlɛ nu.
7Ɔyɛ ye debie biala nɔhalɛ nu, ɔle fɔɔnwo;
sonla fa ɔ rɛle wula mɔɔ ɔkɛha la anu a ɔyɛ boɛ.
8Bɛwɔ ɛkɛ ne mekɛ biala,
kɛ bɛyɛ bɛ gyima tenlene nee nɔhalɛ nu.
9Ɛdɛnkɛma liele ye menli ne,
na ɔ nee bɛ yɛle ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ a.
Ye duma ne le kpole, ɔle nwuanzanwuanza.
10 Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzulolɛ le nrɛlɛbɛ bo ɛbɔlɛ;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ ndelebɛbo kpalɛ la
a le bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ tieyɛ la.
Ye ayɛlɛyelɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.

english_text:
God Blesses His Worshipers
1Shout praises to the Lord!
The Lord blesses everyone
who worships him and gladly
obeys his teachings.
2Their descendants will have
great power in the land,
because the Lord blesses
all who do right.
3They will get rich and prosper
and will always be remembered
for their fairness.
4They will be so kind
and merciful and good,
that they will be a light
in the dark for others
who do the right thing.
5Life will go well for those
who freely lend
and are honest in business.
6They won't ever be troubled,
and the kind things they do
will never be forgotten.
7Bad news won't bother them;
they have decided
to trust the Lord.
8They are dependable
and not afraid,
and they will live to see
their enemies defeated.
9 They will always be remembered
and greatly praised,
because they were kind
and freely gave to the poor.
10When evil people see this,
they angrily bite their tongues
and disappear.
They will never get
what they really want.
translation_text:
Sonlakpalɛ anyelielɛ
1Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma,
na ɔ nye die ye mɛla ne mɔ anwo la.
2Ɔ bo zo amra bayɛ katakyiema wɔ maanle ne anu;
bɛbayila fɔɔnwonli ne abo zo amra.
3Ezukoa nee anwonyia wɔ ye sua nu;
ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.
4Wienyi kpa menli mɔɔ di boɛ la awozinli,
Ɛdɛnkɛma le dovolɛ, anwunvɔnezelɛnli nee tenlenenli.
5Ɔyɛ boɛ ɔmaa sonla mɔɔ buke ɔ sa nu bɔ bosea,
na ɔyɛ debie biala nɔhalɛ nu la.
6Ɔluakɛ pɛlepɛlenli ne abo zo ɛnrɛminli ɛlɛ;
bɛbahakye ye dahuu.
7Tenlenenli ɛnzulo amaneɛ ɛtane,
ɔgyinla kpundii na ɔfa ɔ rɛle ɔwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu.
8Ye ahonle gyi pi, ɔnzulo,
kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛli ye kpɔvolɛma anwo zo konim.
9 Yebuke ɔ sa nu wɔ ɛhyianvolɛma anwo zo;
ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu;
bɛbava enililɛ bɛakpogya ye tumi ne zo.
10Amumuyɛnli nwu ye na ɔfa ɛya;
ɔdedɛ ɔ nwo bonrane nu na ɔminliminli,
amumuyɛnli adwenle yɛ mgbane.

english_text:
The Lord Helps People in Need
1Shout praises to the Lord!
Everyone who serves him,
come and praise his name.
2Let the name of the Lord
be praised now and forever.
3From dawn until sunset
the name of the Lord
deserves to be praised.
4The Lord is far above
all of the nations;
he is more glorious
than the heavens.
5No one can compare
with the Lord our God.
His throne is high above,
6and he looks down to see
the heavens and the earth.
7God lifts the poor and needy
from dust and ashes,
8and he lets them take part
in ruling his people.
9When a wife has no children,
he blesses her with some,
and she is happy.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma kpalɛyɛlɛ ne ayɛlɛyelɛ
1Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
O Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ,
bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne ayɛlɛ.
2Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne,
ɛnɛ nee dahuu!
3Ɔvi sɛnzɛne ne aduduleɛ kɔdwu ye adɔleɛ,
bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne ayɛlɛ!
4Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole bo maanle maanle ne mɔ azo,
ye anyunlunyia wɔ anwuma tɛla anwumaneamra.
5Nwane a le kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne,
mɔɔ de ye ebia nu wɔ anwuma lɔ,
6na ɔto ɔ nye aze
ɔnea anwumaneamra nee ewiade a?
7Ɔye ehyianli ɔfi ndɛtɛlɛ nu,
na ɔkpogya mɔɔ ɛhyia la zo ɔfi nzonle nu,
8ɔmaa bɛ nee arelemgbunli tɛnla,
ɔdaye ye menli ne arelemgbunli.
9Ɔmaa mɔɔ anwo ralɛ la nyia awuke,
ɔyɛ ngakula dɔɔnwo bɛ nli anyelielɛ nu.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_text:
The Lord Works Wonders
1 God brought his people
out of Egypt, that land
with a strange language.
2He made Judah his holy place
and ruled over Israel.
3 When the sea looked at God,
it ran away,
and the Jordan River
flowed upstream.
4The mountains and the hills
skipped around like goats.
5Ask the sea why it ran away
or ask the Jordan
why it flowed upstream.
6Ask the mountains and the hills
why they skipped like goats!
7Earth, you will tremble,
when the Lord God of Jacob
comes near,
8 because he turns solid rock
into flowing streams
and pools of water.
translation_text:
Akpabɛnwo Ɛvoyia edwɛne
1 Mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma vile Yigyibiti,
Gyekɔbo abo zo amra vile nyɛvolɛ avinli la,
2Dwuda maanzinli ne yɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza,
Yizilayɛ yɛle ye maanle.
3 Nyevile Kɔkɔlɛ ne nleanle na ɔnriandile;
Dwɔdan ne hwenle ziale.
4Awoka wuluwulule kɛ mboane nyinli,
awoka ngyikyi wuluwulule kɛ mboane mralɛ.
5O Nyevile, duzu a yɛle wɔ mɔɔ ɛnriandile a?
O Dwɔdan, duzu ati a ɛhwenle ɛziale a?
6O awoka, duzu ati a bɛwuluwulule kɛ mboane nyinli a?
O awoka ngyikyi, duzu ati a bɛwuluwulule kɛ mboane mralɛ a?
7O azɛlɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma ye ɔ nyunlu a, kpusu,
saa Gyekɔbo Nyamenle ne ye ɔ nyunlu a, kpusu.
8 Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔmaa bodane yɛ azule tandane,
na ɛtwɛlɛboɔ yɛ nzubula a.

english_text:
The Lord Deserves To Be Praised
1We don't deserve praise!
The Lord alone deserves
all of the praise,
because of his love
and faithfulness.
2 Why should the nations ask,
“Where is your God?”
3Our God is in the heavens,
doing as he chooses.
4 The idols of the nations
are made of silver and gold.
5They have a mouth and eyes,
but they can't speak or see.
6Their ears can't hear,
and their noses can't smell.
7Their hands have no feeling,
their legs don't move,
and they can't make a sound.
8Everyone who made the idols
and all who trust them
are just as helpless
as those useless gods.
9People of Israel,
you must trust the Lord
to help and protect you.
10Family of Aaron the priest,
you must trust the Lord
to help and protect you.
11All of you worship the Lord,
so you must trust him
to help and protect you.
12The Lord will not forget
to give us his blessing;
he will bless all of Israel
and the family of Aaron.
13 All who worship the Lord,
no matter who they are,
will receive his blessing.
14I pray that the Lord
will let your family
and your descendants
always grow strong.
15May the Lord who created
the heavens and the earth
give you his blessing.
16The Lord has kept the heavens
for himself,
but he has given the earth
to us humans.
17The dead are silent
and cannot praise the Lord,
18but we will praise him
now and forevermore.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Nɔhalɛ Nyamenle ko ne
1Tɛ yɛmɛ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, tɛ yɛmɛ,
na wɔmɔ yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ anyunlunyia ka wɔ,
wɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛlilɛ ne ati a.
2Duzu ati a maanle maanle ne mɔ kɛbiza kɛ,
“Bɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ nienwu” a?
3Yɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ anwuma;
ɔyɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la.
4 Bɛ mmonle ne mɔ le dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke,
bɛle menli asa anloa gyima.
5Bɛlɛ ɛnloanlɛ, noko bɛndendɛ;
bɛlɛ ɛnyelɛ, noko bɛnnwu debie.
6Bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ, noko bɛnde edwɛkɛ;
bɛlɛ ɛbonyilɛ, noko bɛnde nvoanle.
7Bɛlɛ ɛsalɛ, noko bɛnva bɛnvua debie;
bɛlɛ egyakɛ, noko bɛndia;
yɛɛ bɛnlɛ ɛnelɛ bɛnva bɛnyɛ alɛra.
8Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ mmonle la le kɛ mmonle ne mɔ
ala la,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle wɔ bɛ nu la de a.
9O Yizilayɛma, bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu!
Ɔle bɛ boavolɛ nee bɛ enyinlike.
10O Aalɔn sua nu amra,
bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anu!
Ɔle bɛ boavolɛ nee bɛ enyinlike.
11Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma,
bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula ye nu!
Ɔle bɛ boavolɛ nee bɛ enyinlike.
12Ɛdɛnkɛma dwenle yɛ nwo, ɔbayila yɛ;
ɔbayila Yizilayɛma amuala;
ɔbayila Aalɔn sua nu amra;
13 ɔbayila bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la,
mgbolema nee koahweabanema amuala.
14Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa bɛwo dɔɔnwo,
bɛdabɛ nee bɛ bo zo amra amuala.
15Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila bɛ,
yemɔ mɔɔ ɔbɔle anwuma nee aze.
16Anwuma lɔ le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ,
yɛɛ yeva azɛlɛ ye yemaa menli.
17Mɔwuamra ɛnye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ mɔɔ kɛhɔ monvonle la de a.
18Na yɛmɛ, yɛbaye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ,
ɛnɛ nee dahuu.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_text:
When the Lord Saves You from Death
1I love you, Lord!
You answered my prayers.
2You paid attention to me,
and so I will pray to you
as long as I live.
3Death attacked from all sides,
and I was captured
by its painful chains.
But when I was really hurting,
4I prayed and said, “Lord,
please don't let me die!”
5You are kind, Lord,
so good and merciful.
6You protect ordinary people,
and when I was helpless,
you saved me
7and treated me so kindly
that I don't need
to worry anymore.
8You, Lord, have saved
my life from death,
my eyes from tears,
my feet from stumbling.
9Now I will walk at your side
in this land of the living.
10 I was faithful to you
when I was suffering,
11though in my confusion I said,
“I can't trust anyone!”
12What must I give you, Lord,
for being so good to me?
13I will pour out an offering
of wine to you,
and I will pray in your name
because you
have saved me.
14I will keep my promise to you
when your people meet.
15You are deeply concerned
when one of your loyal people
faces death.
16I worship you, Lord,
just as my mother did,
and you have rescued me
from the chains of death.
17I will offer you a sacrifice
to show how grateful I am,
and I will pray.
18I will keep my promise to you
when your people
19gather at your temple
in Jerusalem.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Sonla mɔɔ bɛlie ye bɛvi ewule nu la ye Nyamenle ayɛlɛ
1Mekulo Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔboalekɛ yede me ne
nee me modolɛ nzɛlɛlɛ.
2Kɛmɔ ɔyɛle ɛnzonlɛ ɔdiele me la ati,
mebavɛlɛ ye wɔ mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ mede ngoane nu la.
3Ewule ngane lile me bɔyia;
Ɛbolɔ mbowule sosɔle me;
menwunle nyane nee abodelɛ.
4Na menvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma kɛ,
“O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebodo wɔ, die me!”
5Ɛdɛnkɛma le dovolɛ, ɔle pɛlepɛlenli;
yɛ Nyamenle ne se anwunvɔne.
6Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la anwo bane,
bɛholole me nwo zo la, ɔliele me.
7O me ɛkɛla, sia balie wɔ ɛnwomenle,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ wɔ boɛ.
8Kɛmɔ wɔlie me ɛkɛla wɔvi ewule nu,
wɔkyikyi me nye anwo monle,
na meandu koti la ati,
9medua Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu,
wɔ teasema azɛlɛ zo.
10 Menzɔle me diedi nu boɛ, bɔbɔ mɔɔ menganle kɛ,
“Menwu amaneɛ kpole” la;
11menvale ewugyemu menganle kɛ,
“Anyelazo wɔ menli kɔsɔɔti anu le mgbane”
12Duzu yɛɛ menva memaa Ɛdɛnkɛma,
wɔ ye ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɛwolaa ye anwo a?
13Mebamaa ngoanelielɛ kɔpo ne zo,
na meabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma meazonle ye.
14Mebaye me ɛwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ mebɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma la,
wɔ ye menli ne kɔsɔɔti anyunlu.
15Nyamenle menli ne ewule le debie kɛnlɛma
wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye zo.
16O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mele wɔ sonvolɛ;
mele wɔ sonvolɛ, wɔ sonvolɛ raalɛ ara nrenya.
Wɔzianyi me nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ ne.
17Mebabɔ moyɛlɛ azu meamaa wɔ,
na meabɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma meazonle ye.
18Mebaye me ɛwɔkɛ biala mɔɔ mebɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma la,
wɔ ye menli ne kɔsɔɔti anyunlu.
19Mebaye ɛwɔkɛ ne wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne
mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la anu.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!

english_text:
Come Praise the Lord
1 All of you nations,
come praise the Lord!
Let everyone praise him.
2God's love for us is wonderful;
his faithfulness never ends.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛyelɛ
1 Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti, bɛyeyɛ ye!
2Ɔluakɛ ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne
mɔɔ ɔlɛ ye yɛ nwo la le kpole;
yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma nɔhalɛlilɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ.

english_text:
The Lord Is Always Merciful
1 Tell the Lord
how thankful you are,
because he is kind
and always merciful.
2Let Israel shout,
“God is always merciful!”
3Let the family of Aaron
the priest shout,
“God is always merciful!”
4Let every true worshiper
of the Lord shout,
“God is always merciful!”
5When I was really hurting,
I prayed to the Lord.
He answered my prayer,
and took my worries away.
6 The Lord is on my side,
and I am not afraid
of what others can do to me.
7With the Lord on my side,
I will defeat
my hateful enemies.
8It is better to trust the Lord
for protection
than to trust anyone else,
9including strong leaders.
10Nations surrounded me,
but I got rid of them
by the power of the Lord.
11They attacked from all sides,
but I got rid of them
by the power of the Lord.
12They swarmed around like bees,
but by the power of the Lord,
I got rid of them
and their fiery sting.
13Their attacks were so fierce
that I nearly fell,
but the Lord helped me.
14 My power and my strength
come from the Lord,
and he has saved me.
15From the tents of God's people
come shouts of victory:
“The Lord is powerful!
16With his mighty arm
the Lord wins victories!
The Lord is powerful!”
17And so my life is safe,
and I will live to tell
what the Lord has done.
18He punished me terribly,
but he did not let death
lay its hands on me.
19Open the gates of justice!
I will enter and tell the Lord
how thankful I am.
20Here is the gate of the Lord!
Everyone who does right
may enter this gate.
21I praise the Lord
for answering my prayers
and saving me.
22 The stone that the builders
tossed aside
has now become
the most important stone.
23The Lord has done this,
and it is amazing to us.
24This day belongs to the Lord!
Let's celebrate
and be glad today.
25 We'll ask the Lord to save us!
We'll sincerely ask the Lord
to let us win.
26 God bless the one who comes
in the name of the Lord!
We praise you from here
in the house of the Lord.
27The Lord is our God,
and he has given us light!
Start the celebration!
March with palm branches
all the way to the altar.
28The Lord is my God!
I will praise him and tell him
how thankful I am.
29Tell the Lord
how thankful you are,
because he is kind
and always merciful.
translation_text:
Konimlilɛ nwo moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ
1 O bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ;
ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu. 136.1; Gyɛ 33.11
2Bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ɛha kɛ,
“Ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.”
3Bɛmaa Aalɔn abo zo amra ɛha kɛ,
“Ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.”
4Bɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la ɛha kɛ,
“Ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.”
5Menvɛlɛle Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ me nyanenwunlɛ nu;
Ɛdɛnkɛma buale me na ɔyele me kɔme kpomgbolo.
6 Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ me afoa, menzulo.
Duzu a sonla kɛhola kɛyɛ me a?
7Ɛdɛnkɛma gyi me nzi kɛ ɔboa me,
mebali bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpɔ me la anwo zo konim.
8Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛvea Ɛdɛnkɛma akɛnra anu,
tɛla kɛ ɔkɛva ɔ rɛle ɔkɛwula dasanli nu.
9Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ sonla kɛvea Ɛdɛnkɛma akɛnra anu,
tɛla kɛ ɔkɛva ɔ rɛle ɔkɛwula arelemgbunli nu.
10Maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti bɔle yiale me;
Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu, menganle bɛ menguale.
11Bɛbɔle bɛyiale me, bɛbɔle bɛyiale me wɔ adenle biala anu;
Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu, menganle bɛ menguale.
12Bɛvɔle me kɛ wolɛ,
na bɛyelale kɛ senle yela mbowule la;
Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu, menganle bɛ menguale.
13Bɛtiale me kpole kpalɛ, asɛɛ mendɔle aze,
noko Ɛdɛnkɛma boale me.
14 Ɛdɛnkɛma le me anwosesebɛ, me konimlilɛ edwɛne,
yelie me ngoane.
15Bɛdie, bɛlɛto konimlilɛ edwɛne fɛlɛkolilɛ nu
wɔ tenlenema ndanlɛ sua ne anu:
“Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi kpole ne ɛli gyima ne,
16Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi kpole ne ɛli konim,
Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi kpole ne ɛli gyima ne!”
17Menrɛwu, mebadɛnla ngoane nu,
na meabɔ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ la nolo.
18Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhwi me nyunlu kpole kpalɛ,
noko ɔtɛyele me ɔtɛmanle ewule.
19Bɛbuke tenleneyɛlɛ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ bɛmaa me,
amaa mealua nuhua meawolo,
na meayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo.
20Ɛdɛnkɛma anlenkɛ kpole ne ɛne;
tenlenema balua nu awolo.
21Meyɛ wɔ mo kɛ wɔbua me,
na wɔlie me ngoane a.
22 Bolɛ ne mɔɔ suasivoma ne kpole la
ɛyɛ mgbɛnezo bolɛ mɔɔ anwo hyia a.
23Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ ɛyɛ ɛhye a;
yɛnea a ɔyɛ nwanwane.
24Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne mɔɔ ɛhyehyɛ la ɛne;
bɛmaa yɛlie yɛ nye na yɛli fɛlɛko.
25 O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛbodo wɔ, die yɛ!
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛbodo wɔ, maa yɛli konim.
26 Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ dua Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu wolo la!
Yɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua nu nyilalɛ yɛyila wɔ.
27Ɛdɛnkɛma le Nyamenle,
yɛɛ yemaa yɛ wienyi.
Bɛva mbaka ngane bɛdo ɛlɔnwɔne bɛbɔ ɛvoyialilɛ ne abo,
na bɛbɔ azukponle ne mgbɔlɔka.
28Ɛle me Nyamenle, mebayɛ wɔ mo;
ɛle me Nyamenle, mebayeyɛ wɔ.
29O bɛyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ;
ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu.

english_text:
In Praise of the Law of the Lord
1Our Lord, you bless everyone
who lives right
and obeys your Law.
2You bless all those
who follow your commands
from deep in their hearts
3and who never do wrong
or turn from you.
4You have ordered us always
to obey your teachings;
5I don't ever want to stray
from your laws.
6Thinking about your commands
will keep me from doing
some foolish thing.
7I will do right and praise you
by learning to respect
your perfect laws.
8I will obey all of them!
Don't turn your back on me.
9Young people can live
a clean life
by obeying your word.
10I worship you
with all my heart.
Don't let me walk away
from your commands.
11I treasure your word
above all else;
it keeps me from sinning
against you.
12I praise you, Lord!
Teach me your laws.
13With my own mouth,
I tell others the laws
that you have spoken.
14Obeying your instructions
brings as much happiness
as being rich.
15I will study your teachings
and follow your footsteps.
16I will take pleasure
in your laws
and remember your words.
17Treat me with kindness, Lord,
so that I may live
and do what you say.
18Open my mind
and let me discover
the wonders of your Law.
19I live here as a stranger.
Don't keep me from knowing
your commands.
20What I want most
and at all times
is to honor your laws.
21You punish those boastful,
worthless nobodies who turn
from your commands.
22Don't let them sneer
and insult me
for following you.
23I keep thinking about
your teachings, Lord,
even if rulers plot
against me.
24Your laws are my greatest joy!
I follow their advice.
25I am at the point of death.
Let your teachings
breathe new life into me.
26When I told you my troubles,
you answered my prayers.
Now teach me your laws.
27Help me to understand
your teachings,
and I will think about
your marvelous deeds.
28I am overcome with sorrow.
Encourage me,
as you have promised to do.
29Keep me from being deceitful,
and be kind enough
to teach me your Law.
30I am determined to be faithful
and to respect your laws.
31I follow your rules, Lord.
Don't let me be ashamed.
32I am eager to learn all
that you want me to do;
help me to understand more.
33Point out your rules, Lord,
and I won't disobey
even one of them.
34Help me to understand your Law;
I promise to obey it
with all my heart.
35Direct me by your commands!
I love to do what you say.
36Make me want to obey you,
rather than to be rich.
37Take away my foolish desires,
and let me find life
by walking with you.
38I am your servant!
Do for me what you promised
to those who worship you.
39Your wonderful teachings
protect me from the insults
that I hate so much.
40I long for your teachings.
Be true to yourself
and let me live.
41Show me your love
and save me, Lord,
as you have promised.
42Then I will have an answer
for everyone who insults me
for trusting your word.
43I rely on your laws!
Don't take away my chance
to speak your truth.
44I will keep obeying your Law
forever and ever.
45I have gained perfect freedom
by following your teachings,
46and I trust them so much
that I tell them to kings.
47I love your commands!
They bring me happiness.
48I love and respect them
and will keep them in mind.
49Don't forget your promise
to me, your servant.
I depend on it.
50When I am hurting,
I find comfort in your promise
that leads to life.
51Conceited people sneer at me,
but I obey your Law.
52I find true comfort, Lord,
because your laws have stood
the test of time.
53I get furious when evil people
turn against your Law.
54No matter where I am,
your teachings
fill me with songs.
55Even in the night
I think about you, Lord,
and I obey your Law.
56You have blessed me
because I have always followed
your teachings.
57You, Lord, are my choice,
and I will obey you.
58With all my heart
I beg you to be kind to me,
just as you have promised.
59I pay careful attention
as you lead me,
and I follow closely.
60As soon as you command,
I do what you say.
61Evil people may set a trap,
but I obey your Law.
62Your laws are so fair
that I wake up and praise you
in the middle of the night.
63I choose as my friends
everyone who worships you
and follows your teachings.
64Our Lord, your love is seen
all over the world.
Teach me your laws.
65I am your servant, Lord,
and you have kept your promise
to treat me with kindness.
66Give me wisdom and good sense.
I trust your commands.
67Once you corrected me
for not obeying you,
but now I do obey.
68You are kindhearted,
and you do good things,
so teach me your laws.
69My reputation is being ruined
by conceited liars,
but with all my heart
I follow your teachings.
70Those liars have no sense,
but I find happiness
in your Law.
71When you corrected me,
it did me good
because it taught me
to study your laws.
72I would rather obey you
than to have a thousand pieces
of silver and gold.
73You created me
and put me together.
Make me wise enough to learn
what you have commanded.
74Your worshipers will see me,
and they will be glad
that I trust your word.
75Your decisions are correct,
and you were right
to punish me.
76I serve you, Lord.
Comfort me with your love,
just as you have promised.
77I love to obey your Law!
Have mercy and let me live.
78Put down those proud people
who hurt me with their lies,
because I have chosen
to study your teachings.
79Let your worshipers come to me,
so they will learn
to obey your rules.
80Let me truly respect your laws,
so I won't be ashamed.
81I long for you to rescue me!
Your word is my only hope.
82I am worn out from waiting
for you to keep your word.
When will you have mercy?
83My life is wasting away
like a dried-up wineskin,
but I have not forgotten
your teachings.
84I am your servant!
How long must I suffer?
When will you punish
those troublemakers?
85Those proud people reject
your teachings,
and they dig pits
for me to fall in.
86Your laws can be trusted!
Protect me from cruel liars.
87They have almost killed me,
but I have been faithful
to your teachings.
88Show that you love me
and let me live,
so that I may obey
your commands.
89Our Lord, you are eternal!
Your word will last as long
as the heavens.
90You remain faithful
in every generation,
and the earth you created
will keep standing firm.
91All things are your servants,
and the laws you made
are still in effect today.
92If I had not found happiness
in obeying your Law,
I would have died in misery.
93I won't ever forget
your teachings,
because you give me new life
when I follow them.
94I belong to you,
and I have respected your laws,
so keep me safe.
95Brutal enemies are waiting
to ambush and destroy me,
but I obey your rules.
96Nothing is completely perfect,
except your teachings.
97I deeply love your Law!
I think about it all day.
98Your laws never leave my mind,
and they make me much wiser
than my enemies.
99Thinking about your teachings
gives me better understanding
than my teachers,
100and obeying your laws
makes me wiser than those
who have lived a long time.
101I obey your word
instead of following a way
that leads to trouble.
102You have been my teacher,
and I won't reject
your instructions.
103Your teachings are sweeter
than honey.
104They give me understanding
and make me hate all lies.
105Your word is a lamp
that gives light
wherever I walk.
106Your laws are fair,
and I have given my word
to respect them all.
107I am in terrible pain!
Save me, Lord,
as you have promised.
108Accept my offerings of praise
and teach me your laws.
109I never forget your teachings,
although my life is always
in danger.
110Some merciless people
are trying to trap me,
but I never turn my back
on your teachings.
111They will always be
my most prized possession
and my source of joy.
112I have made up my mind
to obey your laws forever,
no matter what.
113I hate anyone
whose loyalty is divided,
but I love your Law.
114You are my place of safety
and my shield.
Your word is my only hope.
115All you worthless people,
get away from me!
I am determined to obey
the commands of my God.
116Be true to your word, Lord.
Keep me alive and strong;
don't let me be ashamed
because of my hope.
117Keep me safe and secure,
so that I will always
respect your laws.
118You reject all deceitful liars
because they refuse
your teachings.
119As far as you are concerned,
evil people are garbage,
and so I follow your rules.
120I tremble all over
when I think of you
and the way you judge.
121I did what was fair and right!
Don't hand me over to those
who want to mistreat me.
122Take good care of me,
your servant,
and don't let me be harmed
by those conceited people.
123My eyes are weary from waiting
to see you keep your promise
to come and save me.
124Show your love for me,
your servant,
and teach me your laws.
125I serve you,
so let me understand
your teachings.
126Do something, Lord!
They have broken your Law.
127Your laws mean more to me
than the finest gold.
128I follow all your commands,
but I hate anyone
who leads me astray.
129Your teachings are wonderful,
and I respect them all.
130Understanding your word
brings light to the minds
of ordinary people.
131I honestly want to know
everything you teach.
132Think about me and be kind,
just as you are to everyone
who loves your name.
133Keep your promise
and don't let me stumble
or let sin control my life.
134Protect me from abuse,
so I can obey your laws.
135Smile on me, your servant,
and teach me your laws.
136When anyone disobeys you,
my eyes overflow with tears.
137Our Lord, you always do right,
and your decisions are fair.
138All your teachings are true
and trustworthy.
139It upsets me greatly
when my enemies neglect
your teachings.
140Your word to me, your servant,
is like pure gold;
I treasure what you say.
141Everyone calls me a nobody,
but I remember your laws.
142You will always do right,
and your teachings are true.
143I am in deep distress,
but I love your teachings.
144Your rules are always fair.
Help me to understand them
and live.
145I pray to you, Lord!
Please answer me.
I promise to obey your laws.
146I beg you to save me,
so I can follow your rules.
147Even before sunrise,
I pray for your help,
and I put my hope
in what you have said.
148I lie awake at night,
thinking of your promises.
149Show that you love me, Lord,
and answer my prayer.
Please do the right thing
and save my life.
150People who disobey your Law
have made evil plans
and want to hurt me,
151but you are with me,
and all your commands
can be trusted.
152From studying your laws,
I found out long ago
you made them to last forever.
153I have not forgotten your Law!
Look at the trouble I am in,
and rescue me.
154Be my defender and protector!
Remember your promise
and save my life.
155Evil people won't obey you,
and so they have no hope
of being saved.
156You are merciful, Lord!
Please do the right thing
and save my life.
157I have a lot of brutal enemies,
but still I never turn
from your laws.
158Those unfaithful people
who refuse to obey you
are disgusting to me.
159Remember how I love your laws,
and show your love for me
by keeping me safe.
160All you say can be trusted;
your teachings are true
and will last forever.
161Rulers are cruel to me
for no reason.
But with all my heart
I respect your words,
162because they bring happiness
like treasures taken in war.
163I can't stand liars,
but I love your Law.
164I praise you seven times a day
because your laws are fair.
165You give peace of mind
to all who love your Law.
Nothing can make them fall.
166You are my only hope
for being saved, Lord,
and I do all you command.
167I love and obey your laws
with all my heart.
168You know everything I do.
You know I respect every law
you have given.
169Please, Lord, hear my prayer
and give me the understanding
that comes from your word.
170Listen to my concerns
and keep me safe,
just as you have promised.
171If you will teach me your laws,
I will praise you 172and sing
about your promise,
because all your teachings
are what they ought to be.
173Be ready to protect me
because I have chosen
to obey your laws.
174I am waiting for you
to save me, Lord.
Your Law makes me happy.
175Keep me alive,
so I can praise you,
and let me find help
in your teachings.
176I am your servant,
but I have wandered away
like a lost sheep.
Please come after me,
because I have not forgotten
your teachings.
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne
1Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ndenle nu ɛnlɛ ngehanleɛ,
na bɛbɔ bɛ ɛbɛla kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne de la.
2Nyilalɛ ɛha bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi ye ngyehyɛlɛ zo,
na bɛfa bɛ ahonle muala bɛkpondɛ ɔ bo zo,
3bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnyɛ ɛtane biala,
na bɛdua ye ndenle ne mɔ anu la.
4Wɔva wɔ mɛla ne mɔ wɔmaa yɛ
kɛ yɛli zolɛ kpalɛ.
5O anrɛɛ me ndenle adenrɛ fɔɔnwo
wɔ me Nyamenle ne mɛlalilɛ zo.
6Akee me nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze ko,
kɛmɔ me nye wɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo la.
7Mebava ahonle mɔɔ nuhua te la meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔzukoa wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ mɛla ne mɔ la.
8Mebali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo;
O mmakpo me bɔkɔɔ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anwo tieyɛ
9Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na kpavolɛ adenle nu ayɛ bɔkɔbɔkɔ ɛ?
Kyesɛ ɔdua wɔ edwɛkɛ zo ɔsinza ɔ nwo.
10Mebuke me ahonle nu mekpondɛ wɔ;
mmamaa metwe me nwo mefi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
11Meva wɔ edwɛkɛ ne mezie me ahonle nu,
amaa meanyɛ ɛtane meantia wɔ.
12O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha wɔ;
kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
13Mebabɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔhyehyɛ la nolo.
14Me nye die wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ anwo
kɛmɔ me nye die anwonyia nwo la.
15Mebadwenledwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo,
na meamaa me nye agyinla wɔ ndenle ne mɔ anwo.
16Me nye balie wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo;
me rɛle ɛnrɛvi wɔ edwɛkɛ ne.
Nyamenle mɛla ne anwo fɛlɛkolilɛ
17Ɛ nee wɔ sonvolɛ ɛli ye kɛnlɛma,
amaa meanyia ngoane, na meali wɔ edwɛkɛ zo.
18Buke me nye, amaa meanwu
nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ wɔ mɛla ne anu la.
19Mele ɛyɛvolɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo;
mmafa wɔ mɛla ne mɔ ɛfea me.
20Me ɛkɛla anwo dɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ mekɛ biala.
21Ɛtea mgbanyizonlema, munzuvoma ne
mɔɔ twe bɛ nwo fi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo la.
22Ye bɛ ndeanlɛ ne fi me nwo zo,
ɔluakɛ meli wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo.
23Arelemgbunli kɔ me nwo akpamo bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ,
noko wɔ sonvolɛ badwenledwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
24Wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ a le me anyelielɛ a,
bɛmɛ a bɛtu me folɛ a.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne tieyɛ nwo pi ɛzilɛ
25Medɔ aze; asɛɛ mewu,
kɛmɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne se la, maa me anwosesebɛ.
26Menganle me edwɛkɛ la, ɛbuale me;
kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ!
27Maa mende wɔ mɛla ne mɔ abo,
na mebadwenledwenle wɔ nwanwane gyima ne mɔ anwo.
28Nyane ngome maa me ɛkɛla minli me nwo,
wɔ edwɛkɛ ne ati, maa me anwosesebɛ!
29Ye me fi ndenle ɛtane ɛtane nu,
na ɛlolɛ nu ala kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne.
30Meva nɔhalɛ adenle ne,
meva wɔ mɛla ne mɔ mezie me nyunlu.
31O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mehisa wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ kyengye;
mmamaa me nyunlu gua aze ɛlɛ.
32Mebanriandi meava wɔ mɛla ne mɔ adenle zo,
saa ɛmaa me ndelebɛbo yɛ kpole a.
Ndelebɛbo nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
33O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ ndenle,
na mebalua nu meahɔ awieleɛ.
34Maa me ndelebɛbo, amaa meava wɔ mɛla ne meazie,
na meava me ahonle muala meali zo.
35Fa me dua wɔ mɛla adenle ne anu,
ɔluakɛ me nye die nwolɛ.
36Maa me ahonle ɛbikye wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ
ɛdɛla kɛ menwɔnyia me nwo.
37Ye me nye fi ninyɛne mgbane mgbane nwo,
na maa me ngoane wɔ wɔ ndenle ne mɔ anu.
38Wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔbɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo wɔ la,
moa zolɛ maa wɔ sonvolɛ.
39Ye me fi ndeanlɛ ne mɔɔ mesulo ye la anu,
ɔluakɛ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le kpalɛ.
40Nea, me nwo ɛlɛdɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ;
maa me ngoane wɔ wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ ne ati.
Fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anu
41O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛdwu me nwo zo,
maa wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne ɛrɛla, kɛmɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne se la,
42amaa meahola meabua bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtwi me nyunlu la,
ɔluakɛ me rɛle wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.
43Mmaye nɔhalɛ edwɛkɛ ɛfi me nloa,
ɔluakɛ melɛ anyelazo wɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anu.
44Mebali wɔ mɛla ne azo dahuu,
wɔ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ,
45na me nwo badɔ me wɔ me ɛlualɛ nu,
ɔluakɛ meli wɔ mɛla ne azo.
46Mebabɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ nolo meahile arelemgbunli,
menrɛze nwolɛ nyiane,
47ɔluakɛ me nye die wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo;
mekulo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
48Medi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ eni, mekulo bɛ;
mebadwenledwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
Fa ɛ rɛle wula Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anu
49Kakye wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔbɔ wɔ sonvolɛ,
mɔɔ ɔlua zo wɔmaa menyia anyelazo la.
50Ɛhye le me arɛlekyekyelɛ wɔ me amaneɛnwunlɛ nu,
ɔluakɛ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne maa me ngoane.
51Menli mɔɔ ɛnze Nyamenle la si me amgbu kpole,
noko mendwe me nwo menvi wɔ mɛla ne anwo ɛlɛ.
52Saa medwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔɔ vi tete la anwo a,
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛnee me rɛle ɛkyekye.
53Ɛya ku me kpole kpalɛ,
wɔ amumuyɛma mɔɔ kpo wɔ mɛla ne la ati.
54Meva wɔ mɛla ne mɔ meyɛ me edwɛne
wɔ me ɛbɛlabɔlɛ adendulɛ nu.
55O Ɛdɛnkɛma, aledwolɛ nu mekakye wɔ duma,
na medi wɔ mɛla ne azo.
56Nyilalɛ ɛhye ɛyɛ me ɛdeɛ,
ɔluakɛ meli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
Tu ɛ nwo maa Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne
57Ɛdɛnkɛma le me kyɛfoa;
mebɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ mebali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
58Meyeye me ahonle nu mebiza wɔ moalɛ;
wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne ati, nwu me anwunvɔne.
59Saa medwenle wɔ ndenle ne mɔ anwo a,
mekakyi me nye meba wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
60Meka me nwo, mensisi aze
kɛ menwɔli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
61Amumuyɛma nyɛma ɛkyekye me bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ,
me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne.
62Medwazo alevinli mu nwiɔ avinli meye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
wɔ wɔ mɛla tenlene ne mɔ ati.
63Me nee menli mɔɔ sulo wɔ la a tu a;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdi wɔ mɛla zo la a me nee bɛ tu a.
64O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛyi azɛlɛ ye tɛkɛɛ;
kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
Bolɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne sonle la
65O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛ nee wɔ sonvolɛ ɛli ye boɛ,
kɛmɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne se la.
66Maa me nrɛlɛbɛ nee adwenlenubukelɛ,
ɔluakɛ medie wɔ mɛla ne mɔ medi.
67Menvonle adenle la yɛɛ menwunle me nyunlu a,
na kɛkala medi wɔ edwɛkɛ zo.
68Ɛle kpalɛ yɛɛ ɛyɛ kpalɛ;
kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
69Adubɛnwoma bɔ me nwo nzekue,
na mame, mefa me ahonle muala medi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
70Bɛ ahonle ɛlafe tuanwu kɛ nane ɛnlome,
na mame, me nye die wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
71Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ menwunle me nyunlu a,
amaa meazukoa wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
72Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le kpalɛ maa me
tɛla ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule apenle apenle.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne pɛlepɛlelilɛ
73Ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔbɔ me na wɔziezie me a;
maa me ndelebɛbo, amaa meazukoa wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
74Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo wɔ la banwu me na bɛ nye alie,
ɔboalekɛ menyia anyelazo wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.
75O Ɛdɛnkɛma, meze kɛ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo,
na wɔdea me nɔhalɛ nu.
76Maa wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛkyekye me rɛle,
kɛmɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ wɔbɔ wɔ sonvolɛ ne la de la.
77Nwu me anwunvɔne, amaa meanyia ngoane,
ɔluakɛ me nye die wɔ mɛla ne anwo.
78Maa adubɛnwoma anyunlu ɛgua aze,
ɔboalekɛ bɛva adalɛ bɛli me ɛwɔne;
na mame, mebadwenledwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
79Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo wɔ la ɛrɛla me ɛkɛ,
amaa bɛanwu wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
80Mmamaa medi fɔlɛ wɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo,
amaa me nyunlu angua aze.
Ngoanelielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
81Me ɛkɛla anwo dɔ wɔ ngoanelielɛ;
melɛ anyelazo wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.
82Mehendɛ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne toonwo akee me nye ɛbu,
mebiza kɛ, “Kenlenzu yɛɛ ɛkɛkyekye me rɛle a?”
83Ɔluakɛ meyɛ kɛ nwanye nwoma kodoku mɔɔ la senle nu,
noko me rɛle ɛtɛfile wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
84Wɔ sonvolɛ, mengendɛ mengɔndwu kenlenzu?
Kenlenzu a ɛkɛdea menli mɔɔ yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la a?
85Adubɛnwoma ɛpɛ me nwo kuma,
menli mɔɔ ɛnli wɔ mɛla zo la.
86Wɔ mɛla ne amuala gyi kpundii;
bɛfa adalɛ bɛyɛ me kpɔdekpɔde; boa me!
87Asɛɛ bɛhu me ala ɛne,
noko metɛkpole wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
88Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, die me ngoane,
amaa meali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne azo ɛlilɛ
89O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ edwɛkɛ ne gyi kpundii
wɔ anwuma lɔ dahuu.
90Wɔ nɔhalɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ maa awolɛndoazo muala;
ɛdawɔ a wɔbɔ ewiade ye a, yɛɛ ɔgyi kpundii.
91Kɛ ɛzile ɛhyehyɛle bɛ la yɛɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti tɛde ɛnɛ a,
ɔluakɛ ninyɛne kɔsɔɔti le wɔ sonvolɛma.
92Saa me nye anlie wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo a,
anrɛɛ menwule wɔ me anwubɛnyunlu nu.
93Me rɛle ɛnrɛvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ,
ɔluakɛ ɔlua bɛ nwo zo wɔmaa me ngoane.
94Mele wɔ ɛdeɛ, die me;
ɔluakɛ mebɔ mɔdenle kɛ medi wɔ mɛla ne azo.
95Amumuyɛma ɛhɔ nzia kɛ bɛku me,
na mame, medwenle wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
96Menwu ɛleka mɔɔ kpalɛ biala ɔwɔ kɛ dwu la,
noko wɔ mɛla ne mɔ tɛlɛ bo zolɛ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne ɛhulolɛ
97O, mekulo wɔ mɛla ne somaa!
Medwenledwenle nwolɛ alehyenlɛ biala.
98Wɔ mɛla ne maa menwu nrɛlɛbɛ metɛla me kpɔvolɛma,
ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ me nu dahuu.
99Melɛ ndelebɛbo metɛla me kilehilevolɛma amuala,
ɔluakɛ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ ala a medwenledwenle nwolɛ a.
100Melɛ ndelebɛbo metɛla mgbanyinli,
ɔluakɛ medi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
101Metwe me nwo mefi munzule adenle biala anu,
amaa meahola meali wɔ edwɛkɛ zo.
102Mendwe me nwo menvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo,
ɔluakɛ ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔhilehile me a.
103Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne yɛ me fɛ somaa,
ɔyɛ fɛ ɔtɛla wolɛ.
104Medua wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo menyia ndelebɛbo,
yemɔti mekyi adalɛ adenle biala.
Wienyi mɔɔ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anu
105Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne le kɛnlaneɛ maa me,
ɔle wienyi wɔ me adenle nu.
106Meha ndane na memoa zolɛ
kɛ menwɔli wɔ pɛlepɛle mɛla ne mɔ azo.
107Menwu amaneɛ kpole;
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa me ngoane, kɛmɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ se la.
108O Ɛdɛnkɛma, die me moyɛlɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ,
na kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
109Me ahonle la me sa nu dahuu,
noko me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
110Amumuyɛma ɛzua me ɛhane,
noko mendwe me nwo menvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
111Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le me agyadeɛ dahuu;
ɛhɛe, me ahonle la nwo.
112Meyeye me ahonle nu kɛ meyɛ mɔɔ wɔ mɛla ne se la,
wɔ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne bɔ sonla nwo bane
113Mekyi menli mɔɔ bɛ adwenle le nwiɔ nwiɔ la,
na mekulo wɔ mɛla ne.
114Ɛle me ɛvealeka nee me enyinlike;
melɛ anyelazo wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.
115Bɛmɛ ɛtaneyɛlɛma, bɛhwe bɛ nwo bɛvi me nwo ɛke,
amaa meali me Nyamenle ne mɛla ne mɔ azo.
116Maa me anwosesebɛ, kɛmɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne se la,
amaa meanyia ngoane;
mmamaa me anyelazo wie anyiemgba nu.
117Sɔ me nu, amaa me nwo ayɛ kɔlɔnwo,
na meali wɔ mɛla ne azo dahuu.
118Ɛkyi awie biala mɔɔ kpo wɔ mɛla ne la;
ɛhɛe, bɛ nrɛlɛbɛ adwenle biala le mgbane.
119Ɛbu ewiade ye amumuyɛma kɛ ewula,
yemɔti mekulo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
120Wɔ ɛzulolɛ ti me nwo wozo me,
yɛɛ mesulo wɔ ndɛnebualɛ ne mɔ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anwo tieyɛ
121Meyɛ mɔɔ le pɛlepɛle na ɔtenrɛ la,
mmagyakyi me ɛmaa menli mɔɔ sisi me la.
122Die wɔ sonvolɛ ati dahuu;
mmamaa adubɛnwoma sisi me.
123Mehendɛ wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne
nee wɔ tenlene ɛwɔkɛ ne toonwo me nye ɛbu.
124Ɛ nee wɔ sonvolɛ ɛli kɛmɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ
kpundii ne de la,
na kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
125Mele wɔ sonvolɛ; maa me ndelebɛbo,
amaa meanwu wɔ mɛla ne mɔ!
126Mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma keha ɔ nwo a,
ɔluakɛ bɛtietia wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
127Yemɔti mekulo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ metɛla ezukoa nvutuke,
metɛla nvutuke kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛdu nu la.
128Kɛmɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo la ati,
mekyi adalɛ adenle biala.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anwo tieyɛ nwo ɛhulolɛ
129Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ yɛ nwanwane;
yemɔti mefa me ahonle muala medi zolɛ.
130Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu ngilehilelɛ maa wienyi;
ɔmaa mɔɔ ɛnze nwolɛ bie la nyia ndelebɛbo.
131Kɛmɔ me nwo dɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ somaa la ati,
me ɛnwomenle bɔbɔ ɛndɔ me kunlu.
132Kakyi ɛ nye me nwo na nwu me anwunvɔne,
kɛmɔ ɛyɛ ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ la.
133Wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne ati, mmamaa mekpo aze,
yɛɛ mmamaa ɛtane di me nwo zo konim.
134Die me fi menli mɔɔ sisi me la asa anu,
amaa meali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
135Maa ɛ nyunlu ɛda wɔ sonvolɛ anwo zo,
na kilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
136Me nye monle twi bobobobo,
ɔboalekɛ menli ɛnli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo. b
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne pɛlepɛlelilɛ
137O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle tenlenenli,
yɛɛ wɔ ndɛnebualɛ le fɔɔnwo.
138Wɔhyehyɛ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ tenlene
nee nɔhalɛ adenle zo.
139Me nwo yelɛyela me kɛ senle,
ɔboalekɛ me kpɔvolɛma arɛle fi wɔ edwɛkɛ ne.
140Mezɔ wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne menlea ye kpalɛ,
na wɔ sonvolɛ mekulo ye somaa.
141Mele ekyi, menli ɛmbu me,
noko me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
142Wɔ tenleneyɛlɛ le fɔɔnwo dahuu,
yɛɛ wɔ mɛla ne le nɔhalɛ.
143Melɛnwu amaneɛ nee nyane ɛdeɛ,
noko me nye die wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo.
144Wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo dahuu;
maa me ndelebɛbo, amaa meanyia ngoane.
Ngoanelielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
145Mefa me ahonle muala mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ;
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, bua me!
Mebali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
146Mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ; die me,
amaa meali wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
147Medwazo aleɛbahye na mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ kɛ ɛboa me;
me anyelazo wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anu.
148Aledwolɛ muala me nye gyi zo,
amaa meadwenledwenle wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne anwo.
149Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, tie me ne;
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, dua wɔ pɛlepɛleyɛlɛ ne azo die me ngoane.
150Menli mɔɔ fa adwenle ɛtane yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde la ɛbikye;
bɛnze wɔ mɛla ne fee.
151Na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛbikye me,
yɛɛ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ le nɔhalɛ.
152Menwu wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anu dɛbadɛba,
kɛ wɔhyehyɛ wɔdo ɛkɛ melɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
Moalɛ nwo modolɛ
153Nea me anwubɛnyunlu na die me,
ɔluakɛ me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne.
154Die me ti na kpɔne me;
wɔ ɛwɔkɛ ne ati, maa me ngoane.
155Amumuyɛma ɛnrɛnyia ngoanelielɛ,
ɔluakɛ bɛmkpo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ abo zo.
156O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ anwunvɔnezelɛ le kpole;
wɔ pɛlepɛlelilɛ ti, maa me ngoane.
157Me kpɔvolɛma nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ me
kpɔdekpɔde la zonle,
noko menvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ anwo memkpɔkye me nwo.
158Menea bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnlɛ diedi la a me nwo yelɛyela me,
ɔboalekɛ bɛnli wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo.
159Nea kɛ mesi mekulo wɔ mɛla ne mɔ la!
Wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ati, bɔ me ngoane nwo bane.
160Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti le kpɔkɛ ko, yemɔ a le
nɔhalɛ;
yɛɛ wɔ tenlene mɛla ne mɔ wɔ ɛkɛ ne dahuu.
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɛla ne anwo tunwomaa
161Mgbane gyɛne ala arelemgbunli yɛ me kpɔdekpɔde,
noko me ahonle tu wɔ wɔ edwɛkɛ ne ati.
162Wɔ edwɛkɛ ne maa me nye die
kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛnyia anwonyia la.
163Mekyi yɛɛ mengulo adalɛ,
na mekulo wɔ mɛla ne.
164Meye wɔ ayɛlɛ fane nsuu kenle ko
wɔ wɔ tenlene mɛla ne mɔ ati.
165Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ mɛla ne la lɛ anzonudwolɛ kpole;
debie biala ɛngola ɛmmaa bɛndu koti.
166O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nye la wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne azo,
na meyɛ mɔɔ wɔ mɛla ne mɔ se la.
167Medi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ azo;
mekulo bɛ somaa!
168Medi wɔ mɛla nee wɔ ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo,
ɔluakɛ me ndenle muala la ɛ nyunlu.
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
169O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa me ɛzunlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu;
ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ ti, maa me ndelebɛbo.
170Maa me modolɛ ɛzunlɛ ɛdwu ɛ nyunlu;
ɛ nloa edwɛkɛ ti, die me.
171Mebaye wɔ ayɛlɛ
kɛ ɛkilehile me wɔ mɛla ne mɔ a.
172Mebado wɔ edwɛkɛ ne anwo edwɛne,
ɔluakɛ wɔ mɛla ne amuala le fɔɔnwo.
173Fa wɔ tumi ne boa me,
ɔluakɛ menlea nu meva wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.
174O Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nwo dɔ wɔ ngoanelielɛ ne,
me anyelielɛ a le wɔ mɛla ne.
175Maa me ngoane, amaa meaye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
na maa wɔ mɛla ne mɔ ɛboa me.
176Meminli kɛ boane; kpondɛ wɔ sonvolɛ abo zo,
ɔluakɛ me rɛle ɛnvi wɔ mɛla ne mɔ.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
1When I am in trouble, I pray,
2“Come and save me, Lord,
from deceitful liars!”
3What punishment is fitting
for you deceitful liars?
4Your reward should be
sharp and flaming arrows!
5But I must live as a foreigner
among the people of Meshech
and in the tents of Kedar.
6I have spent too much time
living among people
who hate peace.
7I am in favor of peace,
but when I speak of it,
all they want is war.
translation_text:
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1Me anwongyelelɛ nu mesu mefɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma,
amaa yeabua me;
2O Ɛdɛnkɛma, die me
fi adalɛma nee mɛlɛbɛlama asa anu.
3Duzu yɛɛ bɛva bɛmaa wɔ a?
Yɛɛ duzu bieko yɛɛ bɛyɛ wɔ a,
wɔmɔ nabalabanli?
4Kyesɛ ɛlɔnenli ɛda mbaka nlane,
nee baka ɛsesebɛ emunlike mɔɔ ɛdɔlɔ woonwu la.
5Abule ɛbu me kɛ mekɔ Mihyɛke,
na metɛnla Kidaa ndanlɛ sua nu a!
6Medɛnla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi anzonudwolɛ la
sua nu mehyɛ somaa.
7Mekulo anzonudwolɛ,
noko meka anzonudwolɛ nwo edwɛkɛ a,
ɛnee yeyɛ konle.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Will Protect His People
1I look to the hills!
Where will I find help?
2It will come from the Lord,
who created heaven and earth.
3The Lord is your protector,
and he won't go to sleep
or let you stumble.
4The protector of Israel
doesn't doze
or ever get drowsy.
5The Lord is your protector,
there at your right side
to shade you from the sun.
6You won't be harmed
by the sun during the day
or by the moon at night.
7The Lord will protect you
and keep you safe
from all dangers.
8The Lord will protect you
now and always
wherever you go.
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma wowa yɛ
1Memaa me nye zo menea awoka ne mɔ.
Nienwu yɛɛ me moalɛ vi ba a?
2Me moalɛ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma,
mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze la.
3Ɔnrɛmaa ɛ gyakɛ ɛnrɛhoati,
mɔɔ sinza wɔ la ɛnrɛbɔ ngɔsɔkɛ.
4Bɛnlea, mɔɔ sinza Yizilayɛ la
ɛnrɛbɔ ngɔsɔkɛ yɛɛ ɔnrɛlafe.
5Ɛdɛnkɛma le wɔ sinzavolɛ;
Ɛdɛnkɛma keda ɛ nwo zo,
na ɔmaa wɔ anwosesebɛ.
6Sɛnzɛne ne ɛnrɛyela wɔ alehyenlɛ nu,
yɛɛ siane ne ɛnrɛyela wɔ aledwolɛ nu.
7Ɛdɛnkɛma bazinza wɔ wɔ munzule muala anu;
ɔbamaa ɛ nwo ayɛ kɔlɔnwo.
8Ɛdɛnkɛma bazinza wɔ
wɔ wɔ ɛhɔlɛ nee wɔ ɛralɛ nu
ɔvi ɛnɛ nee mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
A Song of Praise
1It made me glad when they said,
“Let's go to the house
of the Lord!”
2Jerusalem, we are standing
inside your gates.
3Jerusalem, what a strong
and beautiful city you are!
4Every tribe of the Lord
obeys him and comes to you
to praise his name.
5David's royal throne is here
where justice rules.
6Jerusalem, we pray
that you will have peace,
and that all will go well
for those who love you.
7May there be peace
inside your city walls
and in your palaces.
8Because of my friends
and my relatives,
I will pray for peace.
9And because of the house
of the Lord our God,
I will work for your good.
translation_text:
Gyɛlusalɛm ɛhanvolɛ
1Ɔyɛle me fɛ, mekɛ mɔɔ bɛhanle bɛhilele me kɛ,
“Maa yɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua nu!”
2O Gyɛlusalɛm, yɛra!
Yɛgyi wɔ nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anloa.
3Gyɛlusalɛm mɔɔ bɛkyekye ye suakpole
na ɔle kpondekponde.
4Ɛkɛ ne a mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ,
Ɛdɛnkɛma mbusua ekpunli ne mɔ kɔ,
kɛ bɛkayɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mo,
kɛmɔ bɛhyehyɛ bɛmaa Yizilayɛma la.
5Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛzieziele arelemgbunli ndɛnebualɛ mbia ne mɔ a,
Devidi abusua ɛlɔnwɔne arelemgbunli mbia ne mɔ.
6Bɛzɛlɛ anzonudwolɛ bɛmaa Gyɛlusalɛm!
“Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkulo wɔ la ɛkpazi!
7Anzonudwolɛ ɛyi wɔ tɛkɛɛ,
na anwondɔlɛ ɛyi wɔ tawa ne mɔ.”
8Me mediema nee me gɔnwo mɔ ati,
mebaha kɛ, “Anzonudwolɛ ɛyi wɔ tɛkɛɛ!”
9Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne sua ne ati,
mebazuzu wɔ boɛ.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Mercy
1Our Lord and our God,
I turn my eyes to you,
on your throne in heaven.
2Servants look to their master,
but we will look to you,
until you have mercy on us.
3Please have mercy, Lord!
We have been insulted
more than we can stand,
4and we can't take more abuse
from those proud,
conceited people.
translation_text:
Anwunvɔnezelɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1O wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛde wɔ belemgbunli ebia nu wɔ anwuma,
wɔmɔ yɛɛ memaa me nye zo menea wɔ a.
2Kɛmɔ sonvolɛma anye gyi bɛ menle asa anu,
yɛɛ kɛmɔ sonvolɛ raalɛ anye la ɔ menle anwo zo la,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ yɛ nye la Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ Nyamenle ne anwo zo,
kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛnwu yɛ anwunvɔne la.
3Nwu yɛ anwunvɔne, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu yɛ anwunvɔne,
ɔluakɛ yɛnwu akpule yɛhyɛ.
4Yɛ ɛkɛla ɛli nyane ɛhyɛ
wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde boɛ la amgbuzilɛ,
nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛmemaa bɛ nwo zo la akpule ti.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Thanking the Lord for Victory
1The Lord was on our side!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“The Lord was on our side!
Otherwise, the enemy attack
3would have killed us all,
because it was furious.
4We would have been swept away
in a violent flood
5of high and roaring waves.”
6Let's praise the Lord!
He protected us from enemies
who were like wild animals,
7and we escaped like birds
from a hunter's torn net.
8The Lord made heaven and earth,
and he is the one
who sends us help.
translation_text:
Nyamenle bɔ ye menli ne anwo bane
1Saa tɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ ɛnee gyi yɛ nzi la a,
bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ɛha!
2Saa tɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ ɛnee gyi yɛ nzi la a,
anrɛɛ mɔɔ menli dwazole yɛ nwo zo,
3na bɛvale yɛ nwo ɛya la,
anrɛɛ bɛziele yɛ anyewɔzo.
4Anrɛɛ azuyilɛ ne pianle yɛ hɔle,
anrɛɛ azule ne monlanle yɛ,
5anrɛɛ azule ne ɛzenlɛ kpole ne
hedale yɛ nwo zo.
6Ayɛlɛyelɛ ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma
mɔɔ anye yɛ ammaa yɛ kpɔvolɛma angu yɛ la.
7Yɛvi ɛsalɛ kɛ anloma mɔɔ ɛvi ɛhane nu;
ɛhane ne ɛbubu, yɛvi ɛsalɛ!
8Yɛ moalɛ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma
mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee aze la.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord's People Are Safe
1Everyone who trusts the Lord
is like Mount Zion
that cannot be shaken
and will stand forever.
2Just as Jerusalem is protected
by mountains on every side,
the Lord protects his people
by holding them in his arms
now and forever.
3He won't let the wicked
rule his people
or lead them to do wrong.
4Let's ask the Lord to be kind
to everyone who is good
and completely obeys him.
5When the Lord punishes
the wicked,
he will punish everyone else
who lives an evil life.
Pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
Nyamenle menli ne anwo banebɔlɛ
1Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu la
le kɛ Boka Zayɔn mɔɔ ɛnkpusu
na ɔgyi kpundii dahuu la.
2Kɛmɔ awoka ne mɔ bɛnra yia Gyɛlusalɛm la,
zɔhane ala yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye bɛnra yia ye menli ne anwo,
ɔvi ɛnɛ kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
3Amumuyɛma ɛnrɛli belemgbunli
wɔ tenlenema azɛlɛ zo dahuu;
anrɛɛ tenlenema kɛdwazo kɛli ɛtane.
4O Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛ kpalɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛle kpalɛ,
nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛ ahonle nu te la.
5Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkakyi bɛ nwo bɛyɛ ninyɛndane la
Ɛdɛnkɛma badea bɛ nee amumuyɛma amuala.
Anzonudwolɛ ɛha Yizilayɛma.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Celebrating the Harvest
1It seemed like a dream
when the Lord brought us back
to the city of Zion.
2We celebrated with laughter
and joyful songs.
In foreign nations it was said,
“The Lord has worked miracles
for his people.”
3And so we celebrated
because the Lord had indeed
worked miracles for us.
4Our Lord, we ask you to bless
our people again,
and let us be like streams
in the Southern Desert.
5We cried as we went out
to plant our seeds.
Now let us celebrate
as we bring in the crops.
6We cried on the way
to plant our seeds,
but we will celebrate and shout
as we bring in the crops.
translation_text:
Ngoanelielɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma manle Zayɔn kpazile bieko la,
yɛyɛle kɛ menli mɔɔ ɛlɛka ɛlalɛ la.
2Akee yɛ nloa anwo yɛle ɛzelekɛ ngome,
na yɛdeɛdeanle nu anyelielɛ nu;
na maanle maanle ne mɔ hanle kɛ,
“Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ ninyɛne mgbole ɛmaa bɛ.”
3Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ ninyɛne mgbole ɛmaa yɛ;
ɔyɛ yɛ fɛ kpole.
4O Ɛdɛnkɛma, maa yɛkpazi bieko,
kɛ azudenle ne mɔ mɔɔ gua nyiakɛ la!
5Maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa monle bɛdua la,
ɛva anyelielɛ ɛdeɛdea nu ɛbu!
6Sonla ne mɔɔ fa ɛzunlɛ
soa ye ma kɛ ɔkalua la,
bava anyelielɛ adeɛdea nu,
ava ye bɛyɔba ne ara sua nu.

english_text:
(A song by Solomon for worship.)
Only the Lord Can Bless a Home
1Without the help of the Lord
it is useless to build a home
or to guard a city.
2It is useless to get up early
and stay up late
in order to earn a living.
God takes care of his own,
even while they sleep.
3Children are a blessing
and a gift from the Lord.
4Having a lot of children
to take care of you
in your old age
is like a warrior
with a lot of arrows.
5The more you have,
the better off you will be,
because they will protect you
when your enemies
attack you in court.
translation_text:
Nyamenle kpalɛyɛlɛ ne ɛyeyɛlɛ (Sɔlɔmɔn edwɛne)
1Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye yeanzi sua ne a,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsi la fɛ mgbane.
Saa Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye yeanzinza suakpole ne a,
sinzavolɛma solo nafelɛ mgbane.
2Ɔnle debie mgbane kɛ ɛkɛdwazo ndɛ na ɛnrɛla ndɛ,
ɛkɛva ɛ nwo amuala ɛkɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ;
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ maa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɔkulo bɛ la,
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlafe la.
3Nea, mralɛ mrenya le agyadeɛ
mɔɔ vi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ a;
awolɛ le nyilalɛ.
4Mgbavolɛ nu mralɛ mrenya ɛnyialɛ
le kɛ ɛda mbaka wɔ ɛlɔnenli asa anu.
5Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ ye ɛda mbaka boa ne ɛyi la.
Saa ɔ nee ye kpɔvolɛma nyia ɛdendɛlɛ
wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa a,
ɔ nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze ɛlɛ.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Rewards His Faithful People
1The Lord will bless you
if you respect him
and obey his laws.
2Your fields will produce,
and you will be happy—
all will go well.
3Your wife will be as fruitful
as a grapevine,
and just as an olive tree
is rich with olives,
your home will be rich
with healthy children.
4This is how the Lord will bless
everyone who respects him.
5I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion
and let Jerusalem prosper
as long as you live.
6May you live long enough
to see your grandchildren.
Let's pray for peace in Israel!
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma ane ɛdielɛ nwo ahatualɛ
1Nyilalɛ ɛha awie biala mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma,
na ɔdua ye ndenle ne mɔ anu la!
2Ɛbali ɛ sa anloa gyima aleɛ;
ɔbayɛ boɛ yeamaa wɔ na ɛ nye alie.
3Ɛ ye bayɛ kɛ vanye baka mɔɔ so la
wɔ wɔ sua nu;
ɛ mra bayɛ kɛ ɔlivi mbaka mɔɔ ɛwɔlɔwɔlɔ la
abɔ ayia wɔ ɛkponle nwo.
4Nea, zɛhae nyilalɛ yɛɛ
sonla mɔɔ sulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la banyia a.
5Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ ɛvi Zayɔn!
Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ɛnwu Gyɛlusalɛm ɛkpazilɛ ne,
wɔ wɔ ngoane mekɛ muala anu!
6Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa ɛnwu ɛ mra amra.
Anzonudwolɛ ɛha Yizilayɛ!

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
A Prayer for Protection
1Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
Let everyone in Israel say:
2“Since the time I was young,
enemies have often attacked!
But they have not defeated me,
3though my back is like a field
that has just been plowed.”
4The Lord always does right,
and he has set me free
from the ropes
of those cruel people.
5I pray that all who hate
the city of Zion
will be made ashamed
and forced to turn and run.
6May they be like grass
on the flat roof of a house,
grass that dries up
as soon as it sprouts.
7Don't let them be like wheat
gathered in bundles.
8And don't let anyone
who passes by say to them,
“The Lord bless you!
I give you my blessing
in the name of the Lord.”
translation_text:
Nzɛlɛlɛ mɔɔ tia Yizilayɛ kpɔvolɛma
1“Ɔvi me ngakula nu, bɛhile me nyane kpalɛ,”
bɛmaa Yizilayɛma ɛha.
2“Ɔvi me ngakula nu, bɛhile me nyane kpalɛ,
noko bɛtɛkolale me nwo zo konim di.
3Bɛrelerelele me nzi kuma nu,
bɛpɛle ye ahuma kɛ ɛyazonlɛnli fa alua aleɛ.
4Ɛdɛnkɛma le tenlenenli;
yepepɛ amumuyɛma nyɛma ne mɔ anu.”
5Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkyi Zayɔn la
anyunlu ɛgua aze na bɛzia bɛ nzi.
6Maa bɛyɛ kɛ sua ti zo ndile,
mɔɔ fifi a ɔngyɛ na yeanwoso la.
7Mɔɔ bu bɛyɔba la ɛmbu,
anzɛɛ mɔɔ kyekye bɛ avile la ɛnkyekye bie
ɛnlɛ ye ɔ kɛnra azo ɛngɔ.
8Mmamaa menli mɔɔ se ɛkɛ ne la ka kɛ,
“Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila wɔ!
Yɛyila wɔ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma duma nu!”

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Trusting the Lord in Times of Trouble
1From a sea of troubles
I cry out to you, Lord.
2Won't you please listen
as I beg for mercy?
3If you kept record of our sins,
no one could last long.
4But you forgive us,
and so we will worship you.
5With all my heart,
I am waiting, Lord, for you!
I trust your promises.
6I wait for you more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
Yes, I wait more eagerly
than a soldier on guard duty
waits for the dawn.
7Israel, trust the Lord!
God is always merciful
and has the power to save you.
8 Israel, the Lord will save you
from all your sins.
translation_text:
Moalɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mela buma ye anu
mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ!
2O Awulae, tie me ne!
Gyele ɛ nzo tie me modolɛ ɛzunlɛ!
3O Ɛdɛnkɛma, saa ɛse ɛdi ɛtane nzi a,
Awulae, anrɛɛ nwane a kɛhola kɛgyinla a?
4Na wɔmɔ, ɛlɛ fakyɛ,
amaa bɛazulo wɔ.
5Mekendɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, me ɛkɛla kendɛ,
yɛɛ me nye la ye edwɛkɛ ne azo;
6me ɛkɛla kendɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma
tɛla sinzavolɛma mɔɔ kendɛ alehyenlɛ la,
tɛla sinzavolɛma mɔɔ kendɛ alehyenlɛ la.
7O Yizilayɛma, bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma anwo zo!
Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ ɛhulolɛ kpundii,
na ɔlɛ ngoanelielɛ dɔɔnwo.
8 Ɔbalie Yizilayɛma
yeavi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anu.

english_text:
(A song by David for worship.)
Trust the Lord!
1I am not conceited, Lord,
and I don't waste my time
on impossible schemes.
2But I have learned to feel safe
and satisfied,
like a young child
in its mother's arms.
3People of Israel,
you must trust the Lord
now and forever.
translation_text:
Diedi nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, metɛmemanle me nwo zo,
me nye ɛtɛtɛlale me ndo;
menva ninyɛne mɔɔ le mgbole
nee mɔɔ yɛ nwanwane ɔmaa me la membɔ me ɛbolɛ.
2Na medo me rɛle azule nu, meyɛ koonwu
kɛ kakula mɔɔ la ɔ nli akɛnra nu la;
me ɛkɛla ɛyɛ koonwu kɛ kakula la.
3O Yizilayɛ, nyia anyelazo wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu,
ɔvi ɛnɛ kɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
The Lord Is Always with His People
1Our Lord, don't forget David
and how he suffered.
2Mighty God of Jacob,
remember how he promised:
3“I won't go home
or crawl into bed
4or close my eyelids,
5until I find a home for you,
the mighty Lord God of Jacob.”
6 When we were in Ephrath,
we heard that the sacred chest
was somewhere near Jaar.
7Then we said, “Let's go
to the throne of the Lord
and worship at his feet.”
8Come to your new home, Lord,
you and the sacred chest
with all its power.
9Let victory be like robes
for the priests;
let your faithful people
celebrate and shout.
10David is your chosen one,
so don't reject him.
11 You made a solemn promise
to David, when you said,
“I, the Lord, promise
that someone in your family
will always be king.
12If they keep our agreement
and follow my teachings,
then someone in your family
will rule forever.”
13You have gladly chosen Zion
as your home, our Lord.
14You said, “This is my home!
I will live here forever.
15I will bless Zion with food,
and even the poor will eat
until they are full.
16Victory will be like robes
for the priests,
and its faithful people
will celebrate and shout.
17 I will give mighty power
to the kingdom of David.
Each of my chosen kings
will shine like a lamp
18and wear a sparkling crown.
But I will disgrace
their enemies.”
translation_text:
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛhanvolɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye Devidi
nee amaneɛ kpole mɔɔ ɔnwunle ye;
2ye ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle wɔmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma
nee amonle mɔɔ ɔlile ɔhilele Gyekɔbo Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne
3kɛ, “Menrɛhɔ me sua ne anu,
anzɛɛ menrɛla me ɛkpa ne azo;
4menrɛmuomua me nye menrɛlafe,
anzɛɛ menrɛbɔ ngɔsɔkɛ na me nye ahɔ dɔɔnwo,
5kɔkpula kɛ menwɔnyia ɛleka menwɔmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma,
ɛleka mɔɔ Gyekɔbo Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne badɛnla la.”
6 Nea, yɛdele Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne nganeɛ wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm,
yɛnwunle ye wɔ Keleate Gyialem ɛya nu.
7Yɛhanle kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua nu;
bɛmaa yɛbutu ɔ gyakɛ abo yɛzonle ye!”
8O Ɛdɛnkɛma, dwazo kɔ wɔ sua ne anu,
ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔ Ngyekyeleɛ Ɛlɛka ne mɔɔ kile wɔ
tumi la.
9Maa wɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ɛbɔ ɛbɛla mɔɔ tenrɛ,
na maa wɔ menli ne ɛva anyelielɛ ɛdea nu.
10Wɔ sonvolɛ Devidi ati,
mmakakyi ɛ nzi ɛsi mɔɔ wɔkpokpa ye nwole la.
11 Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔle Devidi ɛwɔkɛ,
na ɔnrɛhakyi ɔ nloa ɛlɛ.
Ɔse, “Ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔwo bɛ la anu ko
yɛɛ mebava meazie wɔ ebia ne azo a.
12Saa ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ di me mɛla zo,
bɛdi me ngilehilelɛ mɔɔ mebahilehile bɛ la azo a,
bɛdabɛ noko bɛ mra mrenya
badɛnla wɔ ebia ne azo mekɛ biala.”
13Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnlea nu ɛye Zayɔn;
yehulo kɛ ɛkɛ ne a ɔtɛnla a:
14Ɔse, “Ɛke le me ɛnwomenlelielɛ ɛleka dahuu;
ɛke a mebadɛnla a, ɔluakɛ mehulo ɛke.
15Mebamaa yeanyia ninyɛne dɔɔnwo;
mebamaa ye ehyianvolɛma anyia aleɛ.
16Mebamaa ye sɛlɛvolɛma anyia ngoanelielɛ,
na meamaa me menli ne mɔɔ wɔ zo la
ava anyelielɛ adeɛdea nu.
17 Ɛke a mebamaa Devidi abo zo amra ne mɔ ko
adwazo ayɛ belemgbunli kpole a,
na mebazinza mɔɔ mekpa nu meye ye belemgbunli la.
18Mebamaa ye kpɔvolɛma abɔ anyiemgba,
na meamaa ye belemgbunlililɛ ayɛ kpole.”

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Living Together in Peace
1It is truly wonderful
when the people of God
live together in peace.
2It is as beautiful as olive oil
poured on Aaron's head
and running down his beard
and the collar of his robe.
3It is like the dew
from Mount Hermon,
falling on Zion's mountains,
where the Lord has promised
to bless his people
with life forevermore.
translation_text:
Mediema ɛhulolɛ ɛyeyɛlɛ
1Bɛnlea kɛ ɔsi ɔle kɛnlɛma nee kpalɛ,
kɛ mediema kɛbɔ nu kɛdɛnla koyɛlɛ nu!
2Ɔle kɛ nwole mɔɔ sonle bolɛ
mɔɔ bɛwola bɛgua sonla ti zo,
na ɔsonyi ɔgua ɔ kɛsa anu,
bɔbɔ kɛ Aalɔn akɛsa anu ɛdeɛ ne,
mɔɔ zonyinle guale tɛladeɛ ne akɔme ne anu la.
3Ɔle kɛ Hɛmɔn Boka zo ɛbɔlɛ,
mɔɔ tɔ gua Zayɔn awoka ne mɔ azo la!
Gyɛlusalɛm yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbayila bɛ,
yeamaa bɛ ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ a.

english_text:
(A song for worship.)
Praising the Lord at Night
1Everyone who serves the Lord,
come and offer praises.
Everyone who has gathered
in his temple tonight,
2lift your hands in prayer
toward his holy place
and praise the Lord.
3The Lord is the Creator
of heaven and earth,
and I pray that the Lord
will bless you from Zion.
translation_text:
Nyamenle ayɛlɛyelɛ
1Bɛrɛla, bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma,
bɛmɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma,
mɔɔ aledwolɛ nu bɛgyinla bɛsinza Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua ne la!
2Bɛmaa bɛ sa zo wɔ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne,
na bɛyeyɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma!
3Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyila bɛ ɛvi Zayɔn,
yemɔ mɔɔ ɔbɔle anwuma nee aze la!

english_text:
In Praise of the Lord's Kindness
1Shout praises to the Lord!
You are his servants,
so praise his name.
2All who serve in the temple
of the Lord our God,
3come and shout praises.
Praise the name of the Lord!
He is kind and good.
4He chose the family of Jacob
and the people of Israel
for his very own.
5The Lord is much greater
than any other god.
6He does as he chooses
in heaven and on earth
and deep in the sea.
7The Lord makes the clouds rise
from far across the earth,
and he makes lightning
to go with the rain.
Then from his secret place
he sends out the wind.
8The Lord killed the first-born
of people and animals
in the land of Egypt.
9God used miracles and wonders
to fight the king of Egypt
and all of his officials.
10He destroyed many nations
and killed powerful kings,
11including King Sihon
of the Amorites
and King Og of Bashan.
He conquered every kingdom
in the land of Canaan
12and gave their property
to his people Israel.
13The name of the Lord
will be remembered forever,
and he will be famous
for all time to come.
14The Lord will bring justice
and show mercy to all
who serve him.
15 Idols of silver and gold
are made and worshiped
in other nations.
16They have a mouth and eyes,
but they can't speak or see.
17They are completely deaf,
and they can't breathe.
18Everyone who makes idols
and all who trust them
will end up as helpless
as their idols.
19Everyone in Israel,
come praise the Lord!
All the family of Aaron
20and all the tribe of Levi,
come praise the Lord!
All of his worshipers,
come praise the Lord.
21Praise the Lord from Zion!
He lives here in Jerusalem.
Shout praises to the Lord!
translation_text:
Ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne
1Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma duma ne ayɛlɛ,
O Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ,
2bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛgyinla bɛsinza Ɛdɛnkɛma Sua ne,
wɔ yɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne
alie nwo ɛkɛ ne la, bɛyeyɛ ye!
3Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ ɔle kpalɛ;
bɛdo edwɛne bɛmaa ye, ɔluakɛ ɔle dovolɛ!
4Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa nu ɛye Gyekɔbo ɛmaa ɔ nwo,
yeva Yizilayɛ yeyɛ ye ɛdeɛ.
5Meze kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma le kpole,
yɛɛ yɛ Awulae bo nyamenle muala anwo zo.
6Debie biala mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo la yɛɛ ɔyɛ a,
wɔ anwuma nee aze, nyevile nu nee buma kɔsɔɔti anu.
7Yemɔ a ɔmaa amungu dwazo ewiade ati lɔ a;
ɔmaa ɛsɛnlɛmanye kpakye ezule nu,
na ɔtukue anwoma anlenkɛ ɔmaa ɔtu a.
8Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔhunle Yigyibiti belamunli mralɛ,
menli nee nane mɔɔ bɛlumuale bɛwole bɛ la.
9Yemɔ yɛɛ Yigyibitima avinli,
ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne nee sɛkɛlɛneɛ
ɔtiale Falo ne nee ye sonvolɛma a.
10Yemɔ yɛɛ ɔzɛkyele maanle maanle
na ɔhunle arelemgbunli katakyiema a:
11Amɔle Belemgbunli Saehɔn,
yɛɛ Beehyan Belemgbunli Ɔɔgo,
na ɔzɛkyele Keena arelemgbunli maanle ne mɔ a.
12Ɔvale bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ ɔmanle bɛyɛle bɛ agyadeɛ,
ye menli Yizilayɛma agyadeɛ.
13O Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ duma ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu,
O Ɛdɛnkɛma, awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti bade wɔ nganeɛ.
14Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma balie ye menli ne ati,
na yeanwu ye sonvolɛma anwunvɔne.
15Maanle maanle mmonle ne mɔ,
le dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke;
bɛle menli asa anloa gyima.
16Bɛlɛ ɛnloanlɛ, noko bɛndendɛ,
bɛlɛ ɛnyelɛ, noko bɛnnwu debie,
17bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ, noko bɛnde edwɛkɛ,
yɛɛ ɛnwomenle biala ɛnle bɛ nu.
18Maa menli mɔɔ yɛ mmonle la,
ɛhɛe, awie biala mɔɔ fa ɔ rɛle wula mmonle nu la,
ɛyɛ kɛ mmonle la.
19O Yizilayɛma, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
O Aalɔn awuke nu amra, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
20O Livaema, bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ!
Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsulo Ɛdɛnkɛma la, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ.
21Ayɛlɛyelɛ vi Zayɔn ɛha Ɛdɛnkɛma,
yemɔ mɔɔ ɔde Gyɛlusalɛm la.
Bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma ayɛlɛ.

english_text:
God's Love Never Fails
1 Praise the Lord! He is good.
God's love never fails.
2Praise the God of all gods.
God's love never fails.
3Praise the Lord of lords.
God's love never fails.
4Only God works great miracles.
God's love never fails.
5 With wisdom he made the sky.
God's love never fails.
6 The Lord stretched the earth
over the ocean.
God's love never fails.
7 He made the bright lights
in the sky.
God's love never fails.
8He lets the sun rule each day.
God's love never fails.
9He lets the moon and the stars
rule each night.
God's love never fails.
10 God struck down the first-born
in every Egyptian family.
God's love never fails.
11 He rescued Israel from Egypt.
God's love never fails.
12God used his great strength
and his powerful arm.
God's love never fails.
13 He split the Red Sea apart.
God's love never fails.
14The Lord brought Israel safely
through the sea.
God's love never fails.
15He destroyed the Egyptian king
and his army there.
God's love never fails.
16The Lord led his people
through the desert.
God's love never fails.
17Our God defeated mighty kings.
God's love never fails.
18And he killed famous kings.
God's love never fails.
19 One of them was Sihon,
king of the Amorites.
God's love never fails.
20 Another was King Og of Bashan.
God's love never fails.
21God took away their land.
God's love never fails.
22He gave their land to Israel,
the people who serve him.
God's love never fails.
23God saw the trouble we were in.
God's love never fails.
24He rescued us from our enemies.
God's love never fails.
25He gives food to all who live.
God's love never fails.
26Praise God in heaven!
God's love never fails.

A Prayer for Revenge
1Beside the rivers of Babylon
we thought about Jerusalem,
and we sat down and cried.
2We hung our small harps
on the willow trees.
3Our enemies had brought us here
as their prisoners;
now they wanted us to sing
and entertain them.
They insulted us and shouted,
“Sing about Zion!”
4Here in a foreign land,
how can we sing
about the Lord?
5Jerusalem, if I forget you,
let my right hand go limp.
6Let my tongue stick
to the roof of my mouth,
if I don't think about you
above all else.
7Our Lord, punish the Edomites!
On the day Jerusalem fell,
they shouted,
“Completely destroy the city!
Tear down every building!”
8 Babylon, you are doomed!
I pray the Lord's blessings
on anyone who punishes you
for what you did to us.
9May the Lord bless everyone
who beats your children
against the rocks!
translation_text:
Yizilayɛma mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la awolɛyelɛ
1Wɔ Babelɔn azule ne mɔ anloa,
yɛdɛnlanle aze yɛzunle,
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ yɛhakyele Zayɔn la.
2Azule ne anloa mbaka ne mɔ azo,
yɛhendɛhendanle yɛ getaa ne mɔ.
3Ɔluakɛ ɛkɛ ne a menli mɔɔ hyele yɛ la
zele yɛ kɛ yɛdo edwɛne a.
Bɛhilele yɛ nyane na bɛzele yɛ kɛ,
“Bɛdo Zayɔn edwɛne ne mɔ bie bɛhile yɛ.”
4Kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ yɛto Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛne wɔ
maanɔne ɛ?
5O Gyɛlusalɛm, saa me rɛle fi wɔ a,
maa me sa fema ɛnwenwe.
6Saa me rɛle fi wɔ,
na meammaa Gyɛlusalɛm angyia me
andɛla me anyelielɛ biala a,
maa mendɔ mumule!
7O Ɛdɛnkɛma, kakye mɔɔ Yidɔmma yɛle
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Gyɛlusalɛm bɔle la.
Bɛzele kɛ, “Bɛbɔ ye, bɛbɔ ye tɔɔ!
Bɛgologolo ye bɛgua aze!”
8 O Babelɔn, wɔmɔ sɛkyeravolɛ!
Ahenle mɔɔ bali wɔ nzenralɛ
wɔ mɔɔ wɔva wɔyɛ yɛ la anwo la
anye balie kpole!
9Ɔ nye balie na yealielie bɛ mra ngakula
yeava bɛ ti yeakpulokpula bodane yeahu bɛ.

english_text:
(By David.)
Praise the Lord with All Your Heart
1With all my heart
I praise you, Lord.
In the presence of angels
I sing your praises.
2I worship at your holy temple
and praise you for your love
and your faithfulness.
You were true to your word
and made yourself more famous
than ever before.
3When I asked for your help,
you answered my prayer
and gave me courage.
4All kings on this earth
have heard your promises, Lord,
and they will praise you.
5You are so famous
that they will sing about
the things you have done.
6Though you are above us all,
you care for humble people,
and you keep a close watch
on everyone who is proud.
7I am surrounded by trouble,
but you protect me
against my angry enemies.
With your own powerful arm
you keep me safe.
8You, Lord, will always
treat me with kindness.
Your love never fails.
You have made us what we are.
Don't give up on us now!
translation_text:
Moyɛlɛ nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, mefa me ahonle muala meyɛ wɔ mo;
meto wɔ ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne wɔ awozonle nyunlu;
2mekakyi me nye wɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua nwo lɔ,
mebutu meyɛ wɔ mo,
wɔ wɔ ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne nee wɔ nɔhalɛ ti,
ɔluakɛ wɔkpogya wɔ duma nee wɔ edwɛkɛ zo
wɔdɛla debie biala.
3Kenle mɔɔ menvɛlɛle wɔ la, ɛliele me zo,
na ɛmanle me anwosesebɛ.
4O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ewiade arelemgbunli kɔsɔɔti baye wɔ ayɛlɛ,
ɔluakɛ bɛde ɛ nloa anu edwɛkɛ.
5Bɛbado Ɛdɛnkɛma ndenle ne mɔ anwo edwɛne,
