na bɛnrɛnwu bɛ.
Menli mɔɔ zo konle doa bɛ la
ɛnrɛhola ɛhwee yɛ.
13Ɔluakɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle,
melɛ bɛ sa fema ne anu.
Medame yɛɛ melɛka meahile bɛ a:
Bɛmmasulo na mebaboa bɛ.”
14Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, Yizilayɛma,
mɔɔ bɛ anwosesebɛ le kɛ sone a, bɛmmasulo!
Mebaboa bɛ,
bɛ Kpɔnevolɛ a le Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne.
15Bɛnlea, mebamaa bɛayɛ kɛ ma ɛwozolɛ taboa
mɔɔ le fofolɛ, na ɔlɛ mbulalɛ egyele mɔɔ yɛ nla;
bɛbava bɛahili awoka mgbole ne mɔ bɛagua,
na bɛapia awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ kɛ ma abonle.
16Bɛbakpogya bɛ na anwoma ne abɔ bɛ ahɔ,
na ahumu abɔ bɛ asande.
Ɛdɛnkɛma ati, bɛ nye balie,
na bɛaye Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne ayɛlɛ.
17“Saa ehyianli nee mɔɔ ɛhyia la kpondɛ nzule,
na bie ɛnle ɛkɛ,
na nzuhɔne maa bɛ kɔmenzia we resee a,
medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebadie bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ;
medame Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, menrɛkpo bɛ.
18Mebamaa azule aze awoka ne mɔ azo,
na nzule feanvea adenrɛ mbɔnza ne mɔ anu.
Mebamaa nzule agyinlegyinla ɛsɛlɛ zo,
na meamaa nzubula agyinlegyinla azɛlɛ resee zo.
19Mebamaa sida mbaka afifi fienemgbole nu,
akasea, mɛtɛle nee ɔlivi mbaka kɔsɔɔti;
mebamaa sepelɛse mbaka afifi ɛsɛlɛ zo,
dwunipa nee bolonyia mbaka kɔsɔɔti,
20amaa menli anwu ye na bɛanwu ye,
bɛadwenle nwolɛ na bɛade ɔ bo kɛ,
Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛɛ ɛyɛ ɛhye a;
Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne a bɔle bɛ a.”
Awozonle nee Ɛdɛnkɛma dwudwu
21Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli ne se,
“Bɛha bɛ edwɛkɛ ne, bɛhile nɔhalɛ mɔɔ wɔ nu la.
22Bɛrɛla bɛraha mɔɔ bazi la,
bɛha mɔɔ ɛzi dɛba la bɛhile yɛ,
amaa yeadwenle nwolɛ,
amaa yɛanwu kɛ bɛ awieleɛ zile wiele la;
anzɛɛ bɛha mɔɔ bara la bɛhile yɛ.
23Bɛha mɔɔ bara ɛhye mɔ anzi la bɛhile yɛ,
amaa yɛanwu kɛ bɛle nyamenle;
bɛyɛ kpalɛ, anzɛɛ bɛyɛ amumuyɛ,
amaa yɛ ahonle adu na yɛazulo.
24Bɛnlea, bɛnle ɛhwee,
yɛɛ bɛ gyima le mgbane;
mɔɔ kɛva bɛ la ɛbɔ munzule.
25“Meye awie vi aduduleɛ lɔ memaa yera,
ɔvi aduduleɛ lɔ ɔbarazonle me;
ɔbatietia arelemgbunli nwo zo
kɛ buakɛnwovolɛ ɛlɛtietia ndɛtɛlɛ zo la.
26Nwane a alumua ne ɔhanle a, amaa yɛanwu ye,
yɛɛ ɔhanle ye dɛba, amaa yeaha kɛ, ‘Ɔle nɔhalɛ’ a?
Awie anga, yɛɛ awie ambɔ ye nolo,
awie ande bɛ edwɛkɛ ne.
27Mame, melumua meha mehile Zayɔn,
yɛɛ memaa Gyɛlusalɛm ɛde amaneɛ fɛlɛko.
28Na meneanle la, awie ko bɔbɔ ɛnle ɛkɛ;
awie ɛnle bɛ avinli mɔɔ tu folɛ,
mɔɔ saa mebiza a ɔye ɔ nloa a.
29Bɛnlea, bɛ muala bɛle mgbane,
bɛ gyima ne mɔ ɛnle ɛhwee;
bɛ ananze ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛgua la le kɛ anwoma.”

english_text:
The Lord's Servant
1 Here is my servant!
I have made him strong.
He is my chosen one;
I am pleased with him.
I have given him my Spirit,
and he will bring justice
to the nations.
2He won't shout or yell
or call out in the streets.
3He won't break off a bent reed
or put out a dying flame,
but he will make sure
that justice is done.
4He won't quit or give up
until he brings justice
everywhere on earth,
and people in foreign nations
long for his teaching.
5 I am the Lord God.
I created the heavens
like an open tent above.
I made the earth and everything
that grows on it.
I am the source of life
for all who live on this earth,
so listen to what I say.
6 I chose you to bring justice,
and I am here at your side.
I selected you and sent you
to bring light
and my promise of hope
to the nations.
7You will give sight
to the blind;
you will set prisoners free
from dark dungeons.
8My name is the Lord!
I won't let idols or humans
share my glory and praise.
9Everything has happened
just as I said it would;
now I will announce
what will happen next.
Sing Praises to the Lord
10Tell the whole world to sing
a new song to the Lord!
Tell those who sail the ocean
and those who live far away
to join in the praise.
11Tell the tribes of the desert
and everyone in the mountains
to celebrate and sing.
12Let them announce
his praises everywhere.
13The Lord is marching out
like an angry soldier,
shouting with all his might
while attacking his enemies.
The Lord Will Help His People
14For a long time, I, the Lord,
have held my temper;
now I will cry out and groan
like a woman giving birth.
15I will destroy the mountains
and what grows on them;
I will dry up rivers and ponds.
16I will lead the blind on roads
they have never known;
I will guide them on paths
they have never traveled.
Their road is dark and rough,
but I will give light
to keep them from stumbling.
This is my solemn promise.
17Everyone who worships idols
as though they were gods
will be terribly ashamed.
God's People Won't Obey
18You people are deaf and blind,
but the Lord commands you
to listen and to see.
19No one is as blind or deaf
as his messenger,
his chosen servant,
20who sees and hears so much,
but pays no attention.
21The Lord always does right,
and so he wanted his Law
to be greatly praised.
22But his people were trapped
and imprisoned in holes
with no one to rescue them.
All they owned had been taken,
and no one was willing
to give it back.
23Why won't his people
ever learn to listen?
24Israel sinned and refused
to obey the Lord
or follow his instructions.
So the Lord let us be robbed
of everything we owned.
25He was furious with us
and punished our nation
with the fires of war.
Still we paid no attention.
We didn't even care
when we were surrounded
and scorched by flames.
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Bɛnlea me sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ sɔ me nye la,
yemɔ a mekpa nu meye ye a;
me nye die ɔ nwo.
Meva me Sunsum ne mewula ye,
ɔbava pɛlepɛlelilɛ yeara maanle maanle ne mɔ anu.
2Ɔnrɛmaa ɔ ne zo ɔnrɛdea nu,
anzɛɛ ɔnrɛmaa bɛnrɛde ɔ ne wɔ gua ne mɔ azo.
3Ɔnrɛpɛ ndɔ mɔɔ bɛkposo ye la,
yɛɛ ɔnrɛnlua senle mɔɔ asɛɛ ɛnlu la;
ɔbamaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ ali gyima nɔhalɛ nu.
4Ɔnrɛkpo aze anzɛɛ ye ahonle ɛnrɛdu,
kɔkpula kɛ ɔkɛmaa pɛlepɛlelilɛ kɛra ewiade.
Ɛnweanloa amra ɛlɛkendɛ ye mɛla ne.”
5 Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma
na ɔdɛlɛle ye,
mɔɔ bɔle azɛlɛ ye nee zolɛ debie biala,
na ɔmaa menli mɔɔ de azɛlɛ ye azo la
ɛnwomenle nee sunsum la se,
6“Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a,
tenleneyɛlɛ ti a mevɛlɛ wɔ a;
mezɔ ɛ sa meva wɔ mezie gyɛlɛɛnye.
Meva wɔ meyɛ kɛ ngyekyeleɛ memaa menli ne,
ɛbayɛ kɛnlaneɛ wɔamaa maanle maanle ne mɔ.
7Ɛbadukuedukue mɔɔ anye ɛzi la anye,
na wɔaye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ
bɛgua efiade anu awozinli nu la.
8“Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, me duma ɛne!
Menva me anyunlunyia memmaa awie,
yɛɛ menva me ayɛlɛyelɛ memmaa ananze mɔɔ bɛgua.
9Bɛnlea, ninyɛne dɛba ne
mɔɔ menganle nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la ɛyɛ zɔ;
kɛkala, melɛka ninyɛne fofolɛ nwo edwɛkɛ;
melɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ meahile bɛ
kolaa na bɛasisi.”
Ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne
10Bɛdo edwɛne fofolɛ bɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma;
ewiade amra amuala, bɛdo ye ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne!
Nyevile zo amra, bɛye ye ayɛlɛ,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde ɛnweanloa la, bɛdo edwɛne.
11Bɛmaa ɛsɛlɛ nee zolɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ ɛye ye ayɛlɛ.
Kidaa namunamu ne mɔ azo amra ɛye ye ayɛlɛ;
bɛmaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde Sila la ɛva anyelielɛ ɛdo edwɛne,
bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdeɛdea nu wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo.
12Bɛmaa bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia,
na bɛbɔ ye ayɛlɛyelɛ ne nolo bɛhile ɛnweanloa
amra.
13Ɛdɛnkɛma tudu ɔ gyakɛ kɛ ɔle katakyie,
ɔle kɛ ɛlɔnenli mɔɔ ɛva ɛya;
ɔtea nu, ɔtea nu ɛsesebɛ,
ɔkile ye katakyie tumi ne wɔ ye kpɔvolɛma anwo zo.
Nyamenle bɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔboa ye menli ne
14Nyamenle se,
“Mekɛ tendenle mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la meyɛ koonwu,
meyɛ koonwu, mehomo me nwo zo;
na kɛkala mebadea kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛvo awolɛ zo,
mebalie ɛnwomenle mgbole kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛvɛ la.
15Mebadwulu awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi,
na meamaa mbaka mɔɔ wɔ zo la anwoso;
mebamaa azule ne mɔ apepɛ bula bula,
na bula ne mɔ asesa ayɛ resee.
16“Mebahile anyenzinliravolɛma adenle,
wɔ adenle mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛnze la anu,
adenle mɔɔ bɛtɛfale zolɛ ɛlɛ la azo
yɛɛ mebava bɛ mealua a.
Mebamaa awozinli ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nyunlu la ayɛ
wienyi,
na ɛleka ahuhunduu ne mɔ ayɛ azɛlɛ sɛsɛ.
Ninyɛne mɔɔ mebayɛ la ɛne,
yɛɛ menrɛkpo bɛ.
17Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛ rɛle bɛwula ananze mmonle nu,
na bɛka bɛkile bɛ ananze mmonle ne mɔ kɛ,
‘Bɛle yɛ nyamenle’ la
bakpo aze na bɛ nyunlu agua aze.”
Yizilayɛma kpo kɛ bɛnrɛzukoa
18Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Bɛmɛ anzondiliravolɛma, bɛdie!
Bɛmɛ anyenzinliravolɛma, bɛnlea, amaa bɛanwu debie!
19Nwane a anye ɛzi kɛ me sonvolɛ ne,
anzɛɛ anzo ɛdi kɛ me soanvolɛ ne la a?
Nwane a anye ɛzi kɛ me ra ne mɔɔ ɛdu ɔ nwo ɛmaa me,
anzɛɛ anye ɛzi kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma soanvolɛ ne la a?
20Ɔnwu ninyɛne dɔɔnwo, noko ɔnvede ɔ nye ɔnnea,
yebuke ɔ nzo, noko ɔnde edwɛkɛ.”
21Ye tenleneyɛlɛ ti, Ɛdɛnkɛma lile fɛlɛko,
kɛ yekpogya Nyamenle mɛla ne zo yemaa bɛli ye eni.
22Noko bɛwua ye menli ne bɛve bɛ nwo ninyɛne,
bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ bɛgua bɛ azɛlɛ bo efiade.
Bɛdɔ agye, bɛnlɛ awie mɔɔ die bɛ a,
bɛyɛ afedeɛ mɔɔ awie ɛnga kɛ, “Bɛgyakyi!”
23Nwane a wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ kɛdie ɛhye a,
mɔɔ kɛgyinla kɛdie mekɛ ne mɔɔ bara la a?
24Nwane a vale Gyekɔbo abo zo amra manle sɛkyevolɛ ne,
yele Yizilayɛma manle nwule a?
Asoo tɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ yɛyɛ ɛtane yɛtia ye,
mɔɔ bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛlua ye ndenle nu,
na bɛse bɛnrɛli ye mɛla zo la ɔ?
25Yemɔti ɔwolale ye ɛya wuluwulu ne ɔguale yɛ nwo zo,
na yɛnwunle kɛ konle si yɛ ɛzulolɛ la;
ɔmanle ye ɛya senle ne zɔle bɔle yiale Yizilayɛ,
noko yeande ɔ bo;
ɔyelale ye, noko yeandwenle nwolɛ bɔbɔ.

english_text:
The Lord Has Rescued His People
1Descendants of Jacob,
I, the Lord, created you
and formed your nation.
Israel, don't be afraid.
I have rescued you.
I have called you by name;
now you belong to me.
2When you cross deep rivers,
I will be with you,
and you won't drown.
When you walk through fire,
you won't be burned
or scorched by the flames.
3I am the Lord, your God,
the Holy One of Israel,
the God who saves you.
I gave up Egypt, Ethiopia,
and the region of Seba
in exchange for you.
4To me, you are very dear,
and I love you.
That's why I gave up nations
and people to rescue you.
5Don't be afraid! I am with you.
From both east and west
I will bring you together.
6I will say to the north
and to the south,
“Free my sons and daughters!
Let them return
from distant lands.
7They are my people—
I created each of them
to bring honor to me.”
The Lord Alone Is God
The Lord said:
8Bring my people together.
They have eyes and ears,
but they can't see or hear.
9Tell everyone of every nation
to gather around.
None of them can honestly say,
“We told you so!”
If someone heard them say this,
then tell us about it now.
10My people, you are my witnesses
and my chosen servant.
I want you to know me,
to trust me, and understand
that I alone am God.
I have always been God;
there can be no others.
11I alone am the Lord;
only I can rescue you.
12I promised to save you,
and I kept my promise.
You are my witnesses
that no other god did this.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
13I am God now and forever.
No one can snatch you from me
or stand in my way.
The Lord Will Prepare the Way
14I, the Lord, will rescue you!
I am Israel's holy God,
and this is my promise:
For your sake, I will send
an army against Babylon
to drag its people away,
crying as they go.
15I am the Lord, your holy God,
Israel's Creator and King.
16I am the one who cut a path
through the mighty ocean.
17I sent an army to chase you
with chariots and horses;
now they lie dead,
unable to move.
They are like an oil lamp
with the flame snuffed out.
Forget the Past
The Lord said:
18Forget what happened long ago!
Don't think about the past.
19I am creating something new.
There it is! Do you see it?
I have put roads in deserts,
streams in thirsty lands.
20Every wild animal honors me,
even jackals and owls.
I provide water in deserts—
streams in thirsty lands
for my chosen people.
21I made them my own nation,
so they would praise me.
22I, the Lord, said to Israel:
You have become weary of me,
but not from worshiping me.
23You have not honored me
by sacrificing sheep
or other animals.
And I have not burdened you
with demands for sacrifices
or sweet-smelling incense.
24You have not brought
delicious spices for me
or given me the best part
of your sacrificed animals.
Instead, you burden me down
with your terrible sins.
25But I wipe away your sins
because of who I am.
And so, I will forget
the wrongs you have done.
26Meet me in court!
State your case and prove
that you are right.
27Your earliest ancestor
and all your leaders
rebelled against me.
28That's why I don't allow
your priests to serve me;
I let Israel be destroyed
and your people disgraced.
translation_text:
Nyamenle bɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbalie ye menli ne
1O Yizilayɛma, Gyekɔbo abo zo amra,
Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ bɔle bɛ yɛle bɛ muala la se,
“Bɛmmasulo, ɔluakɛ mekpɔne bɛ;
meva bɛ duma mevɛlɛ bɛ, bɛle me ɛdeɛ.
2Saa bɛlua nzule buma nu a, me nee bɛ balua;
bɛlua azule ne mɔ anu a, bɛnrɛmonla bɛ;
saa bɛlua senle nu a, senle ne ɛnrɛyela bɛ,
yɛɛ ye ɛzɔlɛ gbolamgbolam ne ɛnrɛyela bɛ.
3Ɔluakɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne,
Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne, bɛ Dievolɛ ne a.
Mefa Yigyibiti meyɛ bɛ ɛkpɔnedeɛ,
mefa Sudan nee Siba memaa na medie bɛ.
4Kɛmɔ bɛsonle bolɛ wɔ me nye zo,
medi bɛ eni, na mekulo bɛ la ati,
mefa menli memaa na medie bɛmɛ bɛ ngoane.
5Bɛmmasulo, ɔluakɛ me nee bɛ lua.
“Mebava bɛ bo zo amra meavi aduduleɛ,
meaboɔboa bɛ nloa meavi adɔleɛ meara.
6Mebaha meahile sɔlɔ amra kɛ, ‘Bɛgyakyi bɛ,’
na meaze nyiakɛ amra kɛ, ‘Bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka bɛ;’
me mra mrenya ne mɔ vi moa moa,
yɛɛ me mra mraalɛ ne mɔ vi ewiade ɛleka biala bara.
7Awie biala mɔɔ bɛfa me duma bɛfɛlɛ ye,
mɔɔ me anyunlunyia ti membɔle ye,
na mengyehyɛle menyɛle la bara.”
Yizilayɛma le Ɛdɛnkɛma alasevolɛ
8Nyamenle se,
“Bɛva menli ne mɔɔ lɛ ɛnyelɛ, noko bɛ nye ɛzi,
bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ, noko bɛ nzo ɛdi la bɛrɛla.
9Bɛmaa maanle maanle ne mɔ ɛboɔboa bɛ nloa,
na bɛmaa menli ngakyile kɔsɔɔti ɛboɔboa bɛ nloa.
Nwane a wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ kɛhola kɛha ɛhye kɛdo gua,
na ɔkɛhile yɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la a?
Bɛmaa bɛva bɛ alasevolɛ bɛrɛla bɛmaa bɛrali
bɛmaa bɛ,
anzɛɛ bɛdie na bɛha kɛ, ‘Ɔle nɔhalɛ.’ ”
10Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛle me alasevolɛ
nee me sonvolɛma mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ,
amaa bɛanwu ye na bɛalie me bɛali,
na bɛade ɔ bo kɛ medame a mele Nyamenle a.
Ɛye me a, nyamenle biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ li me nyunlu,
yɛɛ bie vi me nzi ɛnrɛra.
11“Medame, medame ala a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a,
ɛye me a dievolɛ bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.
12Medame a menganle mɔɔ bazi la mendole gua a,
medame a menliele bɛ ngoane a,
wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee nyamenle gyɛne biala
ɛnle bɛ avinli la;
bɛdabɛ a bɛle me alasevolɛ a.
13Medame a mele Nyamenle a,
yɛɛ ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la medame a mele Nyamenle a;
awie ɛngola ɛnlie debie mɔɔ melɛ ye me sa nu la;
yɛɛ melɛyɛ debie a awie ɛngola ɛnzi me aze.”
Bɛnriandi bɛavi Babelɔn
14Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Kpɔnevolɛ ne,
Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne se,
“Bɛdabɛ bɛ ti, mebazoa meamaa bɛahɔ Babelɔn anwo zo,
meamaa bɛahɔbubu suakpole ne nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ,
na meamaa Babeloniama anyelielɛ ɛdeɛdeanlɛ ne ahakyi awolɛyelɛ.
15Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne,
Yizilayɛma Bɔvolɛ, bɛ Belemgbunli ne a.”
16Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ pɛ adenle to nyevile nu,
na ɔye adenle ɔto azule mgbole nu,
17yemɔ mɔɔ ɔka konle ehwili nee mgbɔnwɔ ɔgua,
ɔbɛlɛ ɛlɔnema nee ɛlɔne nu katakyiema aze;
ɔka bɛ ɔgua mɔɔ bɛngola dwazo bieko,
ɔnua bɛ kɛ senle, ɔminli bɛ bo zo la se,
18“Bɛmmakakye ninyɛne dɛba ne mɔ,
yɛɛ bɛmmadwenle mɔmoane ninyɛne ne mɔ anwo.
19Bɛnlea, melɛyɛ debie fofolɛ;
kɛ ɔlɛba ɛ, asoo bɛnnwu ye?
Mebakpakye adenle meado fienemgbole nu,
na meaye azule meagua ɛsɛlɛ zo.
20-21Nanemgbole bali me eni,
ɛzonlɛ nee soholo ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti,
ɔluakɛ memaa nzule finde fienemgbole nu,
yɛɛ memaa azule da ɛsɛlɛ zo,
amaa me menli ne mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ,
me menli ne mɔɔ mebɔ bɛ memaa me nwo la,
anyia bie anlo na bɛaye me ayɛlɛ.”
Yizilayɛma ɛtane ne
22Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
Noko “Bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛanzonle me,
me nwo ɛvonle bɛ, O Yizilayɛma!
23Bɛtɛfale bɛ mboane bɛtɛbayɛle ɛyelalɛ
azubɔdeɛ bɛtɛmanle me,
yɛɛ bɛtɛfale azubɔlɛ bɛtɛdile me eni.
Metɛfale azubɔlɛ metɛyɛle kpomgbolo metɛkpolole bɛ,
yɛɛ metɛgyegyele bɛ wɔ ɛyɛlɛ evuanlɛ nwo.
24Bɛtɛfale bɛ ezukoa bɛtɛtɔle baka evuanlɛ
bɛtɛmanle me,
yɛɛ bɛtɛfale bɛ nane mɔɔ ɛlɔ la
bɛtɛbɔle azu bɛtɛmanle me.
Na bɛmɛ, bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛbo me nwo zo,
bɛva bɛ amumuyɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ bɛgyegye me.
25Medame, medame a mele Nyamenle,
mɔɔ medame me ti, mefa bɛ ɛtane mekyɛ bɛ a.
Menrɛhakye bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bieko.
26“Bɛhakye me adwenle; bɛrɛla bɛmaa yɛvedevede nu,
bɛha bɛ tendile ne bɛhile kɛ bɛdi benle.
27Bɛ ze ne mɔɔ lumua la yɛle ɛtane,
yɛɛ bɛ mɛla kilehilevolɛma ne yɛle ɛtane tiale me.
28Yemɔti menguale bɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne mgbanyima
anyunlu aze;
menyele Yizilayɛma memanle bɛzɛkyele bɛ,
na memanle bɛgolole me menli ne anwo.”

english_text:
The Lord's Promise to Israel
1People of Israel,
I have chosen you
as my servant.
2I am your Creator.
You were in my care
even before you were born.
Israel, don't be terrified!
You are my chosen servant,
my very favorite.
3I will bless the thirsty land
by sending streams of water;
I will bless your descendants
by giving them my Spirit.
4They will spring up like grass
or like willow trees
near flowing streams.
5They will worship me
and become my people.
They will write my name
on the back of their hands.
6 I am the Lord All-Powerful,
the first and the last,
the one and only God.
Israel, I have rescued you!
I am your King.
7Can anyone compare with me?
If so, let them speak up
and tell me now.
Let them say what has happened
since I made my nation
long ago,
and let them tell
what is going to happen.
8Don't tremble with fear!
Didn't I tell you long ago?
Didn't you hear me?
I alone am God—
no one else is a mighty rock.
Idols Can't Do a Thing
The Lord said:
9Those people who make idols
are nothing themselves,
and the idols they treasure
are just as worthless.
Worshipers of idols are blind,
stupid, and foolish.
10Why make an idol or an image
that can't do a thing?
11Everyone who makes idols
and all who worship them
are mere humans,
who will end up
sadly disappointed.
Let them face me in court
and be terrified.
Idols and Firewood
12A metalworker shapes an idol
by using a hammer
and heat from the fire.
In his powerful hand
he holds a hammer,
as he pounds the metal
into the proper shape.
But he gets hungry and thirsty
and loses his strength.
13Some woodcarver measures
a piece of wood,
then draws an outline.
The idol is carefully carved
with each detail exact.
At last it looks like a person
and is placed in a temple.
14Either cedar, cypress, oak,
or any tree from the forest
may be chosen.
Or even a pine tree planted
by the woodcarver
and watered by the rain.
15 Some of the wood is used
to make a fire for heating
or for cooking.
One piece is made into an idol,
then the woodcarver bows down
and worships it.
16He enjoys the warm fire
and the meat that was roasted
over the burning coals.
17Afterwards, he bows down
to worship the wooden idol.
“Protect me!” he says.
“You are my god.”
18Those who worship idols are stupid and blind! 19They don't have enough sense to say to themselves, “I made a fire with half of the wood and cooked my bread and meat on it. Then I made something worthless with the other half. Why worship a block of wood?”
20How can anyone be stupid enough to trust something that can be burned to ashes? No one can save themselves like that. Don't they realize that the idols they hold in their hands are not really gods?
The Lord Won't Forget His People
21People of Israel,
you are my servant,
so remember all of this.
Israel, I created you,
and you are my servant.
I won't forget you.
22Turn back to me!
I have rescued you
and swept away your sins
as though they were clouds.
Sing Praises to the Lord
23Tell the heavens and the earth
to start singing!
Tell the mountains
and every tree in the forest
to join in the song!
The Lord has rescued his people;
now they will worship him.
The Lord Created Everything
24Israel, I am your Lord,
the source of your life,
and I have rescued you.
I created everything
from the sky above
to the earth below.
25 I make liars of false prophets
and fools of fortunetellers.
I take human wisdom
and turn it into nonsense.
26I will make the message
of my prophets come true.
They are saying, “Jerusalem
will be filled with people,
and the Lord will rebuild
the towns of Judah.”
27I am the one who commands
the sea and its streams
to run dry.
28 I am also the one who says,
“Cyrus will lead my people
and obey my orders.
Jerusalem and the temple
will be rebuilt.”
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma ala a le Nyamenle a
1Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Yizilayɛma, me sonvolɛma, bɛdie,
Gyekɔbo abo zo amra mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ a!
2Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ membɔle bɛ,
mengyehyɛle bɛ bɛ nli mɔ akunlu la
mese: Mebaboa bɛ; bɛmmasulo,
me sonvolɛ Gyekɔbo abo zo amra;
bɛmɛ a bɛle menli mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ a.
3“Mebamaa ezule adɔ azɛlɛ resee zo,
na azudenle aze azɛlɛ mɔɔ nzule ɛnle zo la azo.
Mebawola me Sunsum ne meagua bɛ bo zo amra anwo zo,
na meayila bɛ mra.
4Bɛbamaa bɛ nwo zo kɛ ndile mɔɔ fifi nzule nu la;
bɛbayɛ kɛ mbaka mɔɔ fifi azule nloa la.
5“Ɛhye baha kɛ, ‘Mele Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ;’
ko bava Gyekɔbo duma ado ɔ nwo zo,
yɛɛ ko noko bahɛlɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛdeɛ ɔ’ yeagua ɔ sa anwo,
na yeava Yizilayɛ duma yeazɔ ye duma ne azo.”
6 Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli
nee Kpɔnevolɛ, Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Medame a mele mɔlebɛbo ne, yɛɛ medame a mele awieleɛ ne;
ɛye me a nyamenle bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.
7Nwane a le kɛ medame a? Bɛmaa ɔha ɔdo gua,
bɛmaa ɔha ɔdo gua na ɔva ɔzi me nyunlu.
Nwane a mɔmoane ɔholale ɔhanle mɔɔ bazi la a?
Bɛmaa ɔha mɔɔ kenlebie bazi la ɔhile yɛ.
8Bɛmmasulo yɛɛ bɛmmamaa ɛzulolɛ ka bɛ;
meha mehile bɛ dɛba yɛɛ meva medo gua.
Bɛmɛ a bɛle me alasevolɛ a!
Asoo ɛye me a nyamenle bieko wɔ ɛkɛ ɔ?
Pepɛdievolɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ kɛ medame;
menze bie memboka me nwo.”
Bɛgolo amonlezɔlɛ nwo
9Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛyɛ mmonle la ɛnle ɛhwee, yɛɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛyɛ la azo ɛnlɛ nvasoɛ ɛmmaa bɛ; bɛ alasevolɛ ne mɔ ɛnze, yɛɛ bɛnnwu kɛ bɛ nyunlu bagua aze. 10Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgua ananze bɛyɛ mmonle la ɛnnyia nvasoɛ biala wɔ zolɛ. 11Bɛnlea, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsonle ye la amuala anyunlu bagua aze, yɛɛ dwinvolɛma mɔɔ yɛ la le menli ala; maa bɛ muala bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa bɛragyinla ɛke, na ɛkɛnwu kɛ bɛ ahonle badu, bɛ nyunlu agua aze.
12Mbulalɛ dwinvolɛ ne wula bulalɛ senle nu na ɔyɛ nwolɛ gyima, ɔfa ɔ sa ɛnlomboɛ ne ɔsɔ hamenle nu ɔbolo ye ɔsiezie ye. Ye ɛyɛlɛ nu, nzuhɔne ku dwinvolɛ ne, ɛhɔne ku ye maa ɔ nwo bɛlɛ ye.
13Saa kapenta noko a, ɔfa ye ɛzuzudeɛ ne ɔto nwolɛ, ɔfa ye pɛnsele ne ɔkɛlɛhɛlɛ taboa ne azo, na akee ɔfa bulalɛ ɔtwɛlɛhwɛlɛ nwolɛ, ɔsiezie ye ɔmaa ɔyɛ kɛ sonla, na ɔyɛ ɔmaa ɔsɔho sonla, na bɛfa bɛsie sua nu. 14Sonla pɛ sida baka to; anzɛɛ yɛ baka ɛsesebɛ bie anyenle, ɔgyakyi ye ɔmaa ɔnyi ɔyɛ baka kpole ɛsesebɛ wɔ kpɔkɛ ne anu. Ɔdua sida baka na ɔgyakyi ye ɔmaa ezule tɔ gua zolɛ, ɔyɛ baka ɛsesebɛ. 15Akee ɔfa bie ɔyɛ ɛyɛne ɔwuda ɔmaa ɔbɔ ɔ nwo wuluwulu, ɔfa bie ɔwuda senle ɔto kpanwo ɔdi, na eza yeava bie yeayɛ ye nyamenle yeazonle ye. Ɔfa baka ne ɔyɛ ananze na yeabɔ ɔ ti aze yeamaa ye. 16Sonla pɛ baka ne bie wuda senle, ɔfa ɔtondo fɛlɛ anzɛɛ nane ɔdi ɔ ko yi, na ɔnyia anwosesebɛ a yeaha kɛ, “Ɛhɛe, me nwo ɛyɛ wuluwulu, senle le debie kpalɛ.” 17Na baka ne mɔɔ kɛha la yeava yeaze ananze, yeayɛ amonle, yeava yeayɛ ye nyamenle; ɔtu ɔtɔ ɔ nyunlu ɔsonle ye na yeazɛlɛ ye yeaha kɛ, “Die me ngoane, ɔluakɛ ɛle me nyamenle!”
18Menli zɛhae mɔ ɛnnwu mɔɔ bɛyɛ la, yɛɛ bɛnde ɔ bo, ɔluakɛ bɛ nye ɛzi, yemɔti bɛnnwu ɛhwee, yɛɛ bɛdo bɛ adwenle nu, yemɔti bɛnde debie biala abo. 19Biala ɛndwenle, yɛɛ bɛnlɛ adwenle anzɛɛ bɛnnwu nrɛlɛbɛ bɛnga kɛ, “Baka ye foa ko a meyela ye senle nu, meva medo kpanwo, medondo fɛlɛ anzɛɛ nane meli la; na duzu ati a akee menwɔva sinli ne mɔɔ ɛha la menwɔyɛ bɛkyi debie ɛ? Asoo membɔ me ti aze memaa baka sinli?”
20Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɔkɛli nzonle bɔbɔ; adwenle ɛtane ɛminli ye, yemɔti ɔngola ɔnlie ɔ nwo anzɛɛ ɔnga kɛ amonle ne mɔɔ ɔlɛ la ɛnle nyamenle fee.
Ɛdɛnkɛma, Bɔvolɛ nee Dievolɛ
21O Gyekɔbo abo zo amra,
bɛhakye ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ;
Yizilayɛma, bɛle me sonvolɛma.
Medame a membɔle bɛ a,
bɛle me sonvolɛma.
Me rɛle ɛnrɛvi bɛ ɛlɛ.
22Mepia bɛ mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ amuala kɛ amungu mehɔ,
yɛɛ mepia bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kɛ ɛbɔlɛ megua;
bɛzia bɛrɛla, ɔluakɛ mekpɔne bɛ.
23O anwumaneamra, bɛdo edwɛne,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a ɛyɛ a;
O azɛlɛ buma ne mɔ, bɛdea nu;
O awoka, bɛdo edwɛne,
O kpɔkɛ, nee nuhua mbaka kɔsɔɔti, bɛdo edwɛne!
Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpɔne Gyekɔbo abo zo amra,
na bɛbawula ye anyunlunyia wɔ Yizilayɛ.
24Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Kpɔnevolɛ ne
mɔɔ bɔle bɛ guale bɛ wɔ bɛ nli mɔ akunlu la se,
“Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ bɔle ninyɛne
kɔsɔɔti la,
me ngome a membɔle anwuma a.
Mɔɔ mebɔ azɛlɛ ye la, nwane a gyi me foa a?
25 Medame a mesɛkye adalɛma
mɔɔ bɔ menli munzule la sɛkɛlɛneɛ ne mɔ,
memaa menli mɔɔ tendɛ nwomenle nloa zo la yɛ ahoasea,
memaa nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma nrɛlɛbɛ ka bɛ ti anu,
na memaa bɛ adwenlenubukelɛ yɛ mgbane.
26Medame a memaa me sonvolɛma edwɛkɛ di munli,
na meyɛ mɔɔ me soanvolɛma kɛha la.
Meka ye Gyɛlusalɛm anwo kɛ,
‘Menli baradɛnla zolɛ,’
na meka mekile Dwuda azuamgbole kɛ,
‘Bɛbakyekye bɛ fofolɛ,
na mebakyekye bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ ɛzɛkye la.’
27Medame a meka mekile buma kɛ ‘We resee,
mebamaa wɔ azule ne mɔ asesa.’
28 Medame a meka mekile Saelɛse kɛ,
‘Ɔle me mboaneneavolɛ,
yɛɛ ɔbayɛ debie biala mɔɔ mekpondɛ la;’
meka mekile Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ,
‘Bɛbakyekye ye bieko,’
na meka wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo kɛ,
‘Bɛbawula wɔ adiabo ne aze.’ ”

english_text:
Cyrus Obeys the Lord's Commands
1The Lord said to Cyrus, his chosen one:
I have taken hold
of your right hand
to help you capture nations
and remove kings from power.
City gates will open for you;
not one will stay closed.
2As I lead you,
I will level mountains
and break the iron bars
on bronze gates of cities.
3I will give you treasures
hidden in dark
and secret places.
Then you will know that I,
the Lord God of Israel,
have called you by name.
4Cyrus, you don't even know me!
But I have called you by name
and highly honored you
because of Israel,
my chosen servant.
5Only I am the Lord!
There are no other gods.
I have made you strong,
though you don't know me.
6Now everyone from east to west
will learn that I am the Lord.
No other gods are real.
7I create light and darkness,
happiness and sorrow.
I, the Lord, do all this.
8Tell the heavens
to send down justice
like showers of rain.
Prepare the earth
for my saving power
to sprout and produce justice
that I, the Lord, create.
The Lord's Mighty Power
The Lord said:
9 Israel, you have no right
to argue with your Creator.
You are merely a clay pot
shaped by a potter.
The clay doesn't ask,
“Why did you make me this way?
Where are the handles?”
10Children don't have the right
to demand of their parents,
“What have you done
to make us what we are?”
11I am the Lord, the Creator,
the holy God of Israel.
Do you dare question me
about my own nation
or about what I have done?
12I created the world
and covered it with people;
I stretched out the sky
and filled it with stars.
13I have done the right thing
by placing Cyrus in power,
and I will make the roads easy
for him to follow.
I am the Lord All-Powerful!
Cyrus will rebuild my city
and set my people free
without being paid a thing.
I, the Lord, have spoken.
The Lord Alone Can Save
14My people, I, the Lord, promise
that the riches of Egypt
and the treasures of Ethiopia
will belong to you.
You will force into slavery
those tall people of Seba.
They will bow down and say,
“The only true God is with you;
there are no other gods.”
15People of Israel,
your God is a mystery,
though he alone can save.
16Anyone who makes idols
will be confused
and terribly disgraced.
17But Israel, I, the Lord,
will always keep you safe
and free from shame.
Everyone Is Invited
18The Lord alone is God!
He created the heavens
and made a world
where people can live,
instead of creating
an empty desert.
The Lord alone is God;
there are no others.
19The Lord did not speak
in a dark secret place
or command Jacob's descendants
to search for him in vain.
The Lord speaks the truth,
and this is what he says
20to every survivor
from every nation:
“Gather around me!
Learn how senseless it is
to worship wooden idols
or pray to helpless gods.
21“Why don't you get together
and meet me in court?
Didn't I tell you long ago
what would happen?
I am the only God!
There are no others.
I bring about justice,
and have the power to save.
22“I invite the whole world
to turn to me and be saved.
I alone am God!
No others are real.
23 I have made a solemn promise,
one that won't be broken:
Everyone will bow down
and worship me.
24They will admit that I alone
can bring about justice.
Everyone who is angry with me
will be terribly ashamed
and will turn to me.
25I, the Lord, will give
victory and great honor
to the people of Israel.”
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma nea nu aye Saelɛse
1Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa nu ɛye Saelɛse,
yemaa ye tumi kpole kɛ
ɔli maanle maanle nwo zo konim,
na ɔlie arelemgbunli tumi ɔvi bɛ sa nu;
ɔbukebuke nlenkɛ mɔɔ wɔ ɔ nyunlu la,
amaa bɛando nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anu,
na ɔzele ye kɛ:
2“Mebalumua ɛ nyunlu,
meahɔha awoka ne mɔ aze meamaa wɔ.
Mebabubu bɛ kɔbele nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ,
na meapepɛ bɛ nlenkɛ mgbole nzi mbulalɛ ne mɔ anu.
3Mebava anwonyia mɔɔ vea awozinli nu la meamaa wɔ,
meava anwoneɛ biala mɔɔ vea la meamaa wɔ,
amaa wɔanwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma,
Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne, mefa wɔ duma mefɛlɛ wɔ.
4Me sonvolɛ Gyekɔbo ati,
nee Yizilayɛma mɔɔ mekpa nu meye bɛ la ati,
mefa wɔ duma mefɛlɛ wɔ,
yɛɛ ɛnze me bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ, noko me duma la ɛ nwo zo.
5“Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ,
ɛye me a Nyamenle bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ;
memaa wɔ anwosesebɛ, noko ɛnze me,
6amaa ɔvi aduduleɛ kɔdwu adɔleɛ,
menli kɔsɔɔti anwu kɛ
ɛye me a, bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.
Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a,
bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.
7Medame a mebɔ wienyi nee awozinli a,
medame a memaa sonla kpazi na memaa munzule to ye a,
medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ yɛ ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ
kɔsɔɔti a.
8O anwomanyunlu, tɔ tenleneyɛlɛ kɛ ezule
fi anwuma gua azɛlɛ ye azo,
maa azɛlɛ ye ɛmeme, amaa zolɛ afifi ngoanelielɛ,
na tenleneyɛlɛ noko afifi zolɛ;
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a memaa ɛhye si a.”
Ewiadebɔlɛ nee tetedwɛkɛ Awulae
9 Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ nee ye Bɔvolɛ dwudwu la,
ɔle kɛ buakɛ wɔ mɔɔ nwonle ye la asa anu.
Asoo ndɛtɛlɛ bahola aha ahile mɔɔ ɛlɛfa ye anwo debie la kɛ,
‘Duzu a ɛlɛnwo la?’
anzɛɛ ‘Wɔ dwora ne ɛnlɛ ɔ sa?’
10Munzule ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kɛha kɛhile ɔ ze kɛ,
‘Duzu a ɛlɛwo bɛ la?’
anzɛɛ ɔ nli mɔɔ ako ɛha ye la kɛ,
‘Duzu a ɛlɛmaa wɔade awolɛ nyane la?’ ”
11Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne,
Yizilayɛ Bɔvolɛ ne se,
“Ɛbiza me kpuyia mɔɔ fane me menli ne anwo la,
anzɛɛ ɛkile me mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ mesi meyɛ me gyima la ɔ?
12Medame a membɔle ewiade a,
yɛɛ membɔle sonla mendole nu;
menvale me tumi a membɔle anwuma a,
yɛɛ medame a membɔle anwumaneamra a.
13Memaa mɔɔ Saelɛse ɛyɛ la ɛyɛ tenlene,
yɛɛ mebamaa ye ndenle ne mɔ ayɛ fɔɔnwo;
ɔbakyekye me suakpole ne,
na yeamaa bɛagyakyi me menli ne
mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu la,
ɔnrɛlie bɛ ti ɛkpɔnedeɛ anzɛɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ,
medame Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
14Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Yigyibiti nee Sudan anwonyia ne amuala
bapɛ ali bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma bɛ ɛkɛ,
yɛɛ Sibama, menli kakanyinlima ne,
barazonle bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma,
bɛbagua bɛ anga bɛara, na bɛarahoto bɛ.
Bɛbabodo bɛazɛlɛ bɛ bɛaha kɛ,
‘Nyamenle nee bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma angome a lua a,
nyamenle bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ kɛ ɔ ngome ala.
15O Yizilayɛ Nyamenle, Ngoanedievolɛ ne,
Nɔhalɛ, ɛle Nyamenle mɔɔ ɛfea ɛ nwo a.
16Bɛ muala bɛ nyunlu ɛgua aze, bɛbɔ anyiemgba,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛnwo mmonle la, bɛbɔ anyiemgba.
17Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛlie Yizilayɛma ngoane,
yemaa bɛ ngoanelielɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ,
bɛ nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze anzɛɛ bɛnrɛbɔ anyiemgba ɛlɛ.’ ”
18Ɛdɛnkɛma mɔɔ bɔle anwuma la,
yemɔ a ɔle Nyamenle a!
Yemɔ mɔɔ ɔhyehyɛle na ɔbɔle azɛlɛ ye la,
ɔbɔle ɔmanle ɔlile munli,
yeambɔ ye sesakaa biala yeanzie ɛkɛ;
ɔbɔle ewiade, amaa sonla adɛnla nu.
Ɔse, “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a, bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.
19Meanga ye fealera nu,
wɔ awozinli azɛlɛ bie azo;
meanga meangile Gyekɔbo abo zo amra kɛ,
‘Bɛva basabasayɛlɛ bɛkpondɛ me bo zo.’
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, meka nɔhalɛ ne,
meka mɔɔ le nɔhalɛ la meto gua.”
Ewiade Awulae nee Babelɔn mmonle ne mɔ
20Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛango bɛandɔ,
mɔɔ bɛwɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu la,
bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa na bɛrɛla,
bɛ muala bɛhwe bɛbikye.
Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛsoa mbaka mmonle bɛkpɔsa,
na dahuu bɛsonle nyamenle
mɔɔ ɛngola ɛnlie ngoane la
ɛnlɛ adwenle!
21Bɛha bɛ tendile ne bɛdo gua;
bɛ muala bɛva adwenle!
Nwane a dɛbadɛba ne hanle ɛhye a?
Nwane a vale dole gua wɔ mɔmoane a?
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a menganle a,
yɛɛ ɛye me a nyamenle bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.
Mele Nyamenle tenlene yɛɛ medie ngoane,
ɛye me a bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.
22“Bɛzia bɛ nzi bɛrɛla na bɛnyia ngoane,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ ewiade amuala la!
Ɔluakɛ medame a mele Nyamenle a, bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.
23 Meha medame me ngome me nwo mebɔ ɛwɔkɛ,
me nloa ɛvula edwɛkɛ mɔɔ le tenlene,
menrɛhwe menrɛzia:
Awie biala bahoto me,
awie biala babɔ ɛwɔkɛ wɔ me nyunlu.
24“Bɛbaha wɔ me nwo kɛ,
Ɛdɛnkɛma anu yɛɛ yɛnwu tenleneyɛlɛ nee tumi a.
Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛva ɔ nwo ɛya la
bara ye ɛkɛ na bɛ nyunlu agua aze.
25Ɛdɛnkɛma ati Yizilayɛma abo zo amra bali konim
na bɛ nyunlu ara anyia dahuu.

english_text:
Babylonia's Gods Are Helpless
The Lord said:
1The gods Bel and Nebo
are down on their knees,
as wooden images of them
are carried away
on weary animals.
2They are down on their knees
to rescue the heavy load,
but the images are still taken
to a foreign country.
3You survivors in Israel,
listen to me, the Lord.
Since the day you were born,
I have carried you along.
4I will still be the same
when you are old and gray,
and I will take care of you.
I created you. I will carry you
and always keep you safe.
5Can anyone compare with me?
Is anyone my equal?
6Some people hire a goldsmith
and give silver and gold
to be formed into an idol
for them to worship.
7They carry the idol
on their shoulders,
then put it on a stand,
but it cannot move.
They call out to the idol
when they are in trouble,
but it doesn't answer,
and it cannot help.
8Now keep this in mind,
you sinful people.
And don't ever forget it.
The Lord Alone Is God
9I alone am God!
There are no other gods;
no one is like me.
Think about what happened
many years ago.
10From the very beginning,
I told what would happen
long before it took place.
I kept my word 11and brought
someone from a distant land
to do what I wanted.
He attacked from the east,
like a hawk swooping down.
Now I will keep my promise
and do what I planned.
12You people are stubborn
and far from being safe,
so listen to me.
13I will soon come to save you.
I am not far away
and will waste no time;
I take pride in Israel
and will save Jerusalem.
translation_text:
1“Babelɔn awozonle Bɛle nee Nibo ɛwie ala ɛne,
nane nee nlankɛ a soa bɛ mmonle ne mɔ a;
ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ bɛsoa bɛkpɔsa la
le adesoa maa nane ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛwie fɛ la.
2Bɛbɔ nu bɛkoto, bɛbɔ bɛ ti aze,
bɛngola bɛnlie bɛ nwo,
bɛhye bɛdabɛ mumua ne nuokɛ!
3“O Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛdie me,
O Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la, bɛdie me!
Ɔvi bɛ awolɛ nu
menlea bɛ boɛ toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a.
4Kɛkala bɔbɔ mɔɔ bɛwie nyi la, medame ala
yɛɛ mebazɔ bɛ toonwo bɛabɔ egyɛne a.
Medame a mebɔ bɛ a, mebanlea bɛ nwo zo kpalɛ;
mebaboa bɛ na mealie bɛ ngoane.
5“Nwane a bɛkɛva ye bɛkɛdo me nwo,
mɔɔ le kɛ medame na ɔ nee me sɛ a?
6Menli ye ezukoa nvutuke wɔ bɛ ahodoku nu;
bɛsuzu bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule ne mɔ;
bɛbɔ ezukoa dwinvolɛ ɛkpa;
ɔfa bɛ ezukoa ne ɔyɛ nyamenle,
na bɛtu bɛgua ɔ nyunlu bɛsonle ye!
7Bɛkpogya ye zo bɛto bɛ kɔme zo,
bɛsoa ye bɛkɔsie ye ɛleka ko, ɛnee ɔgyi ɛkɛ,
ɔngola ɔndu ɔ bo ɔnvi ɛleka mɔɔ ɔgyi la.
Saa awie su fɛlɛ ye a ɔmbua ye
anzɛɛ ɔnlie ye ɔnvi ye amaneɛnwunlɛ nu.
8“Bɛmɛ mɛlatovoma, bɛhakye ɛhye,
bɛdwenle nwolɛ na bɛhakye.
9Bɛhakye alumua ninyɛne mɔɔ zile dɛba ne la;
ɔluakɛ medame a mele Nyamenle a, bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.
Medame a mele Nyamenle a,
bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ le kɛ medame.
10Medame a mɔlebɛbo ne menganle awieleɛ edwɛkɛ ne
na mɔmoane menganle mɔɔ basisi la anwo bie
menzele kɛ, ‘Mɔɔ meha la bagyinla ɛkɛ,
yɛɛ mebayɛ mɔɔ mehyehyɛ la.’
11Mevɛlɛ awie vi aduduleɛ maanle bie anu moa moa,
ɔbara kɛ anloma mɔɔ kyehye nyɛmoa di la.
Meha, na mebamaa yeayɛ zɔ;
mehyehyɛ medo ɛkɛ, yɛɛ mebayɛ.
12“Bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛsolo
na bɛ ngoanelielɛ wɔ moa a, bɛdie me!
13Memaa bɛ ngoanelielɛ kenle ne ɛbikye,
ɔnle moa fee,
yɛɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ na me ngoanelielɛ ne ara.
Mebalie Gyɛlusalɛm
na meava anyunlunyia meamaa Yizilayɛ.”

english_text:
Babylon Will Fall
The Lord said:
1 City of Babylon,
You are delicate
and untouched,
but that will change.
Surrender your royal power
and sit in the dirt.
2Start grinding grain!
Take off your veil.
Strip off your fancy clothes
and wade across rivers.
3You will suffer the shame
of going naked,
because I will take revenge,
and no one can escape.
4I am the Lord All-Powerful,
the holy God of Israel.
I am their Savior.
5Babylon, be silent!
Sit in the dark.
No longer will nations
accept you as their queen.
6I was angry with my people.
So I let you take their land
and bring disgrace on them.
You showed them no mercy,
but were especially cruel
to those who were old.
7You thought that you
would be queen forever.
You didn't care what you did;
it never entered your mind
that you might get caught.
8 You think that you alone
are all-powerful,
that you won't be a widow
or lose your children.
All you care about is pleasure,
but listen to what I say.
9Your magic powers and charms
will suddenly fail,
then you will be a widow
and lose your children.
10You hid behind evil
like a shield and said,
“No one can see me!”
You were fooled by your wisdom
and your knowledge;
you felt sure that you alone
were in full control.
11But without warning,
disaster will strike—
and your magic charms
won't help at all.
12Keep using your magic powers
and your charms
as you have always done.
Maybe—just maybe—
you will frighten somebody!
13You have worn yourself out,
asking for advice
from those who study the stars
and tell the future
month after month.
Go ask them how to be saved
from what will happen.
14People who trust the stars
are as helpless as straw
in a flaming fire.
No one can even keep warm,
sitting by a fire
that feeds only on straw.
15These are the fortunetellers
you have done business with
all of your life.
But they don't know
where they are going,
and they can't save you.
translation_text:
Babelɔn ndeanlɛ
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Babelɔn, dwu aze badɛnla ndɛtɛlɛ nu.
Kalediama suakpole mɔɔ ɛnli kotɔ,
ɛvi wɔ belemgbunli ebia ne azo dwu aze,
ɔluakɛ ɛ nwo ɛngyia bieko.
2Fa ɛdibolɛ ne na ti ɛdɔkɛ ne,
ye ɛ ti zo aguzo ne;
kpa gua maa ɛ gyakɛ anwo ɛla ɛkɛ,
na wudwu azule ne mɔ.
3Ɛ nwo bala zo,
menli banwu kɛ wɔbɔ anyiemgba.
Mebali nzenralɛ,
yɛɛ menrɛvavi awie biala.”
4Yɛ Kpɔnevolɛ ne, ye duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma.
Yemɔ a ɔle Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne a.
5Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Babelɔn, tɛnla koonwu maa awozinli ɛva wɔ,
ɔluakɛ ɛnɛ bɛnrɛvɛlɛ wɔ
maanle maanle belemgbunli raalɛ.
6Menvale me menli ne anwo ɛya,
menguale me agyadeɛ nwo evinli;
menyele bɛ menwulale ɛ sa nu,
wɔannwu bɛ anwunvɔne,
na ɛmanle mrelera yɛle gyima ɛsesebɛ.
7Ɛzele me kɛ, ‘Medi belemgbunli meahyɛ.’
Yemɔti wɔandwenle mɔɔ ɛlɛyɛ la anwo
anzɛɛ kɛ bɛ awieleɛ bazi awie la.
8 “Wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛkulo anyelielɛ,
wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛdwenle kɛ ɛde, ɛ nwo tɔ wɔ,
na ɛka ye ɛ ti anu kɛ,
‘Medame ɛne, awie ɛndɛla me;
menrɛdɛnla kɛ kunlanvolɛ
anzɛɛ menrɛli abawuo’ la, tie ɛhye:
9Ninyɛne nwiɔ ɛhye bazi ɛ nwo zo,
bɛbazi ɛ nwo zo arɛlevilɛ nu, kenle kokye;
wɔ ninsinlima baye ngonyia,
bɛbahye sili, na ɔnrɛyɛ boɛ;
bɛ ayɛne tumi kpole ne amuala anzi
ɛbali kunlane, wɔaminli ɛ mra ne mɔ amuala.
10“Ɛdwenle kɛ wɔ amumuyɛ ne maa ɛ nwo tɔ wɔ,
wɔ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, ‘Awie ɛnnwu me’;
wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ ne nee wɔ adwenle ne ɛmaa wɔminli.
Eza wɔha ye ɛ ti anu kɛ,
‘Medame ɛne, awie biala nee me ɛnzɛ.’
11Noko munzule bado wɔ
mɔɔ ɛnrɛhola ɔ nloa gyinla a;
edwɛkɛ kpole bado wɔ
mɔɔ ɛnrɛhola nwolɛ mgbɔdalɛ di a;
ɛbabɔ atondo arɛlevilɛ nu
mɔɔ ɛ nye ɛnla a.
12Gyinla kpundii wɔ wɔ ngonyiayelɛ
nee wɔ nyidane ɛdudulɛ ne mɔ,
mɔɔ sumunli wɔ mgbavolɛ nu wɔyɛ la anu;
wɔannea a ɔbamaa wɔakpazi,
wɔannea a ɛ nwo baha ɛzulolɛ.
13Menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ tu wɔ folɛ la anwo ɛvonle wɔ,
maa bɛgyinla bɛlie wɔ ngoane ɛ,
bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛkola bɛkyɛ anwumaneamra anu,
bɛnea bɛsukoa nwɔlɔra ne mɔ,
bɛmɛ mɔɔ siane fofolɛ biala
bɛkola bɛka mɔɔ bazi ɛ nwo zo la bɛkile wɔ la.
14“Bɛnlea, bɛle kɛ abɛlɛ gyakɛ,
senle yela bɛ wee;
bɛngola bɛnlie bɛ nwo
bɛnvi senle ne asa anu.
Ɛhye ɛnle samɛnlankɛ ɔmbɔ bɛ nwo wuluwulu,
ɔnle senle bɛndɛnla nwo bɛnde!
15Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛ nee bɛ ɛvɛ,
na bɛ nee wɔ ɛli gua vi wɔ mgbavolɛ nu la,
kɛ bɛ muala bɛle la ɛne;
ko biala ɔdaye ɔlua ye ɛlualɛ,
awie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ kɛlie wɔ a.”

english_text:
The Lord Corrects His People
1People of Israel,
you come from Jacob's family
and the tribe of Judah.
You claim to worship me,
the Lord God of Israel,
but you are lying.
2You call Jerusalem your home
and say you depend on me,
the Lord All-Powerful,
the God of Israel.
3Long ago I announced
what was going to be,
then without warning,
I made it happen.
4I knew you were stubborn
and hardheaded.
5And I told you these things,
so that when they happened
you would not say,
“The idols we worship did this.”
6You heard what I said,
and you have seen it happen.
Now admit it's true!
I will show you secrets
you have never known.
7Today I am doing something new,
something you cannot say
you have heard before.
8You have never been willing
to listen to what I say;
from the moment of your birth,
I knew you would rebel.
The Lord Warns Israel
9I, the Lord, am true to myself;
I will be praised for not punishing
and destroying you.
10I tested you in hard times
just as silver is refined
in a heated furnace.
11I did this because of who I am.
I refuse to be dishonored
or share my praise
with any other god.
12 Israel, my chosen people,
listen to me.
I alone am the Lord,
the first and the last.
13With my own hand
I created the earth
and stretched out the sky.
They obey my every command.
The Lord Speaks to the Nations
14Gather around me, all of you!
Listen to what I say.
Did any of your idols
predict this would happen?
Did they say that my friend
would do what I want done
to Babylonia?
15I was the one who chose him.
I have brought him this far,
and he will be successful.
16Come closer and listen!
I have never kept secret
the things I have said,
and I was here
before time began.
It Is Best To Obey the Lord
By the power of his Spirit
the Lord God has sent me
17with this message:
People of Israel,
I am the holy Lord God,
the one who rescues you.
For your own good,
I teach you, and I lead you
along the right path.
18How I wish that you
had obeyed my commands!
Your success and good fortune
would then have overflowed
like a flooding river.
19Your nation would be blessed
with more people
than there are grains of sand
along the seashore.
And I would never have let
your country be destroyed.
20 Now leave Babylon!
Celebrate as you go.
Be happy and shout
for everyone to hear,
“The Lord has rescued
his servant Israel!
21He led us through the desert
and made water flow from a rock
to satisfy our thirst.
22 But the Lord has promised
that none who are evil
will live in peace.”
translation_text:
Nyamenle le kenlebie Awulae
1O Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛdie ɛhye,
bɛfa Yizilayɛ duma bɛfɛlɛ bɛ,
yɛɛ bɛle Dwuda mogya ne bie;
bɛfa Ɛdɛnkɛma duma bɛka ndane,
na bɛbɔ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne duma,
noko bɛmbɔ ye nɔhalɛ nu nee fɔɔnwo zo.
2Bɛfa suakpole nwuanzanwuanza ne duma bɛfɛlɛ bɛ
nwo,
na bɛfa bɛ ti bɛsɔ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne;
ye duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma.
3Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Ɔvi tete, menganle mɔɔ kenle bie bazi la,
ɔvi me nloa anu ɔvindele na memanle bɛdele ɔ bo,
akee arɛlevilɛ nu menyɛle
na memanle ɔyɛle nɔhalɛ.
4Kɛmɔ meze kɛ bɛnli edwɛkɛ nwo bie,
na bɛ kɔme ɛyɛ kahelee kɛ bulalɛ,
bɛ nwoma azo ta kɛ ayera la ati,
5yɛɛ dɛba dɛba ne menvale mendole gua a,
menganle kolaa na bɛayɛ zɔ;
anrɛɛ bɛkɛha kɛ, ‘Me bozonle ne a yɛle a,
me ananze mɔɔ megua nee mɔɔ meze la
yɛɛ hanle manle ɔyɛle zɔhane a.’
6Bɛde, akee kɛkala, bɛnlea ɛhye mɔ,
na bɛlie bɛdo nu kɛ mele nɔhalɛ.
Ɔvi ɛnɛ mɔɔ kɔ la bɛbade ninyɛne fofolɛ,
ninyɛne mɔɔ vea mɔɔ bɛtɛnwunle bɛ la anwo
edwɛkɛ.
7Bɛnle ɛkɛ dɛba, kɛkala a mebɔ bɛ a;
bɛtɛtele nwolɛ edwɛkɛ ɛlɛ kɛ ɛnɛ,
anrɛɛ bɛkɛha kɛ, ‘Yɛdayɛ yɛze bɛ dɛba.’
8Bɛtɛtele ye ɛlɛ, bɛnze ye ɛlɛ,
ɔvi tete, bɛtɛbukele bɛ nzo.
Ɔluakɛ meze kɛ bɛbayɛ ngunzi,
yɛɛ ɔvi bɛ awolɛ nu, bɛfɛlɛ bɛ atuadelɛma.
9“Me duma ne ati, megyakyi me ɛya ne,
me ayɛlɛyelɛ ti, menrɛva menrɛgua bɛ nwo zo,
amaa meambɔ bɛ bo zo.
10Bɛnlea, mede bɛ nwo, noko bɛ nee dwɛtɛ fufule ɛnzɛ;
meva nyanenwunlɛ mokyea medu bɛ nuhua.
11Medame mumua ne me ti yɛɛ meyɛ a,
ɔluakɛ ɔnle kɛ bɛgua me duma ne anwo evinli.
Menrɛva me anyunlunyia menrɛmaa awie gyɛne.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpa nu ɛye Saelɛse kɛ ɔle kpanyinli
12 Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“O Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛdie me!
Yizilayɛma mɔɔ medame mevɛlɛ bɛ, bɛdie me!
Medame a mele Nyamenle a,
medame a mele mɔlebɛbo ne nee awieleɛ ne a.
13Medame a menwulale azɛlɛ ye adiabo ne aze a,
menvale me tumi a membɔle anwuma a;
saa mefɛlɛ bɛ a, bɛfinde me nyunlu.
14“Bɛ muala bɛrayia, na bɛdie!
Nwane a wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ ɛva ɛhye mɔ ɛdo gua a?
Ɛdɛnkɛma kulo mɔɔ yekpa nu yeye ye la;
ɔbali Babelɔn anwo gyima;
ye tumi ne batia Babeloniama
15Medame, ɛhɛe, medame yɛɛ mevɛlɛ ye a,
meva ye mera, na ɔbakpazi adenle biala anu.
16“Bɛhwe bɛbikye me na bɛdie ɛhye,
ɔvi tete, metɛfeale metɛkanle edwɛkɛ.
Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkara la, ɛnee mewɔ ɛkɛ.”
(Na kɛkala, Awulae Nyamenle ne ɛzoa me na yemaa me ye
Sunsum ne bie.)
Ɛdɛnkɛma yɛ ye menli ne anwo ngyehyɛlɛ
17Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Kpɔnevolɛ,
Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne se,
“Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne,
mɔɔ kilehile bɛ maa bɛyɛ kpalɛ,
na ɔdi bɛ nyunlu ɔkilehile bɛ adenle mɔɔ ɔwɔ
kɛ bɛdua nu la.
18“O anrɛɛ bɛdiele me mɛla ne mɔ!
Anrɛɛ bɛ anzonudwolɛ kɛyɛ kɛ azule,
na bɛ tenleneyɛlɛ ayɛ kɛ nyevile azɛlɛkye;
19anrɛɛ bɛ bo zo amra kɛzo kɛ ɛnwea,
na bɛ mra azo kɛ abɛlɛ ma;
bɛ duma ɛnrɛminli ɛlɛ,
anzɛɛ ɛnrɛzɛkye wɔ me nyunlu ɛlɛ.”
20 Bɛvi Babelɔn bɛye bɛ nwo, bɛnriandi bɛvi Babelonia.
Bɛbɔ ye nolo, bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdeɛdea nu bɛha,
bɛmaa ɔdwu azɛlɛ ye azo amuala;
bɛha kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpɔne ye sonvolɛ
Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne!”
21Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ lua ɛsɛlɛ ne azo la,
nzuhɔne angu bɛ ɛlɛ;
ɔmanle nzule vi bodane nu vindele zenle manle bɛ,
ɔkpukele bolɛ ne na nzule vi nu vindele.
22 Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Amumuyɛma ɛnrɛnyia anzonudwolɛ.”

english_text:
The Work of the Lord's Servant
1 Everyone, listen,
even you foreign nations
across the sea.
The Lord chose me
and gave me a name
before I was born.
2 He made my words pierce
like a sharp sword
or a pointed arrow;
he kept me safely hidden
in the palm of his hand.
3The Lord said to me,
“Israel, you are my servant;
and because of you
I will be highly honored.”
4I said to myself,
“I'm completely worn out;
my time has been wasted.
But I did it for the Lord God,
and he will reward me.”
5Even before I was born,
the Lord God chose me
to serve him and to lead back
the people of Israel.
So the Lord has honored me
and made me strong.
6 Now the Lord says to me,
“It isn't enough for you
to be merely my servant.
You must do more than lead back
survivors from the tribes
of Israel.
I have placed you here as a light
for other nations;
you must take my saving power
to everyone on earth.”
The Lord Will Rescue His People
7Israel, I am the holy Lord God,
the one who rescues you.
You are slaves of rulers
and of a nation
who despises you.
Now this is what I promise:
Kings and rulers will honor you
by kneeling at your feet.
You can trust me! I am your Lord,
the holy God of Israel,
and you are my chosen ones.
The Lord Will Lead His People Home
8 This is what the Lord says:
I will answer your prayers
because I have set a time
when I will help
by coming to save you.
I have chosen you
to take my promise of hope
to other nations.
You will rebuild the country
from its ruins,
then people will come
and settle there.
9You will set prisoners free
from dark dungeons
to see the light of day.
On their way home,
they will find plenty to eat,
even on barren hills.
10 They won't go hungry
or get thirsty;
they won't be bothered
by the scorching sun
or hot desert winds.
I will be merciful
while leading them along
to streams of water.
11I will level the mountains
and make roads.
12Then my people will return
from distant lands
in the north and the west
and from the city of Syene.
The Lord's Mercy
13Tell the heavens and the earth
to celebrate and sing;
command every mountain
to join in the song.
The Lord's people have suffered,
but he has shown mercy
and given them comfort.
14The people of Zion said,
“The Lord has turned away
and forgotten us.”
15The Lord answered,
“Could a mother forget a child
who nurses at her breast?
Could she fail to love an infant
who came from her own body?
Even if a mother could forget,
I will never forget you.
16A picture of your city
is drawn on my hand.
You are always in my thoughts!
17“Your city will be built faster
than it was destroyed—
those who attacked it
will retreat and leave.
18Look around! You will see
your people coming home.
As surely as I live,
I, the Lord, promise
that your city with its people
will be as lovely as a bride
wearing her jewelry.”
Jerusalem's Bright Future
19Jerusalem is now in ruins!
Nothing is left of the city.
But it will be rebuilt
and soon overcrowded;
its cruel enemies
will be gone far away.
20Jerusalem is a woman
whose children were born
while she was in deep sorrow
over the loss of her husband.
Now those children
will come and seek room
in the crowded city,
21and Jerusalem will ask,
“Am I really their mother?
How could I have given birth
when I was still mourning
in a foreign land?
Who raised these children?
Where have they come from?”
22 The Lord God says:
“I will soon give a signal
for the nations
to return your sons
and your daughters
to the arms of Jerusalem.
23The kings and queens
of those nations
where they were raised
will come and bow down.
They will take care of you
just like a slave
taking care of a child.
Then you will know
that I am the Lord.
You won't be disappointed
if you trust me.”
The Lord Is on Our Side
24Is it possible to rescue victims
from someone strong
and cruel?
25But the Lord has promised
to fight on our side
and to rescue our children
from those strong
and violent enemies.
26He will make those cruel people
dine on their own flesh
and get drunk from drinking
their own blood.
Then everyone will know
that the Lord is our Savior;
the powerful God of Israel
has rescued his people.
translation_text:
Yizilayɛ le maanle maanle ne mɔ kɛnlaneɛ
1 Maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ moa moa, bɛdie me,
bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛde moa moa maanle nu, bɛdie.
Mela ɛkolɛ nu la yɛɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma vɛlɛle me a,
mɔɔ mela ɔmɔ akunlu la yɛɛ ɔdonle me duma a.
2 Ɔmanle me nloa edwɛkɛ yɛle nla kɛ konle dadeɛ,
ɔvale me ɔveale ye tumi bo;
ɔmanle menyɛle kɛ ɛda baka,
ɔvale me ɔveale ye boa nu.
3Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Ɛle me sonvolɛ,
Yizilayɛ, wɔmɔ ɛ ti, menli baye me ayɛlɛ.”
4Na menganle kɛ, “Medame, mevɛ mgbane,
mezɛkye me anwosesebɛ mgbane,
mɔɔ nvasoɛ biala ɛnle zolɛ a.”
Noko me anwosesebɛ wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ,
yɛɛ me ahatualɛ wɔ me Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ.
5Na kɛkala, Ɛdɛnkɛma
mɔɔ bɔle me wɔ ɔmɔ akunlu kɛ menyɛ ye sonvolɛ,
menva Yizilayɛma menzia membɛlɛ ye,
ɔluakɛ mezɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anye,
yɛɛ me Nyamenle ne mɔɔ le me anwosesebɛ la se:
6 “Ɔnyɛ se kɛ ɛkɛyɛ me sonvolɛ,
na ɛkɛva Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la
ɛkɛzie bɛ gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne.
Mebamaa wɔayɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ kɛnlaneɛ,
amaa me ngoanelielɛ ne adwu ewiade ɛleka biala.”
7Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Kpɔnevolɛ ne,
Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne
ɛlɛka ahile sonla ne mɔɔ le arelemgbunli sonvolɛ,
mɔɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ ɛkpo ye,
na bɛkyi ye kpole kpalɛ la kɛ,
“Arelemgbunli banwu wɔ na bɛadwazo;
arelemgbunli amra mrenya badu agua ɛ nyunlu,
ɔboalekɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne,
mɔɔ ɛkpa nu ɛye wɔ la di nɔhalɛ.”
Gyɛlusalɛm boɛyɛlɛ
8 Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Mekɛ dwule mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ menwu bɛ anwunvɔne la,
membuale bɛ,
mekɛ ne mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ medie bɛ ngoane la, memboale bɛ;
mezinza bɛ, na mebɔ bɛ nwo bane,
melua bɛ nwo zo me nee menli ne ɛyɛ ngyehyɛlɛ,
kɛ bɛbadɛnla azɛlɛ ne azo,
na bɛahyɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdɔ mgbane la;
9mebaha meahile pilizama kɛ, ‘Bɛraze bɛhɔ’
mebaze menli mɔɔ de awozinli nu la kɛ,
‘Bɛrɛla wienyi nu.’
Bɛbadidi adehane ne mɔ,
yɛɛ awoka ne mɔ azo bayɛ bɛ adidileka.
10 Ɛhɔne anzɛɛ nzuhɔne ɛnrɛhu bɛ,
sɛnzɛne anzɛɛ anwoma wuluwulu ɛnrɛbɔ bɛ,
ɔluakɛ ahenle mɔɔ nwu bɛ anwunvɔne la bali bɛ ti,
yɛɛ ɔbava bɛ yeahɔ nzubula nwo.
11“Mebakpakye adenle meado awoka ne mɔ anu,
na meadu ademgbole meamaa bɛ.
12Bɛnlea, ɛhye mɔ vi moa bara,
bɛvi sɔlɔ nee adɔleɛ afoa nu,
yɛɛ bɛvi Asewan azɛlɛ zo bɛbara.”
13Anwuma amra, bɛva anyelielɛ bɛdo edwɛne,
O azɛlɛ ye azo amra, bɛli wulupe;
O awoka, bɛdo edwɛne!
Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkyekye ye menli ne arɛle,
na ɔbanwu ye menli ne mɔɔ ɛlɛdi nyane la anwunvɔne.
14Noko Gyɛlusalɛmma se,
“Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpo yɛ,
yɛ Awulae arɛle ɛvi yɛ.”
15Yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Asoo ɛrɛladane arɛle bavi ɔ ra mɔɔ no nyɛfonlɛ,
asoo ɔnrɛnwu ɔ ra nrenya mɔɔ yewo ye la anwunvɔne?
Ɔyɛ a bɛ rɛle kɛvi bɔbɔ ɛdeɛ,
noko mame, me rɛle ɛnrɛvi bɛ.
16Bɛnlea, mehɛlɛ bɛ aluma wɔ me sa akunlu;
me nye wɔ bɛ suakpole ne bane ne mɔ anwo.
17“Bɛ suazilɛma ɛbo suabɔlɛma ne anwo zo,
menli mɔɔ razɛkyele bɛ la bahɔ.
18Bɛva bɛ nye bɛbɔ bɛ nwo mgbɔlɔka bɛnlea,
bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa, bɛlɛba bɛ nwo ɛkɛ.
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese:
Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Nyamenle la,
bɛ nye balie bɛ menli ne anwo kɛ anwoneɛ,
na bɛava bɛaziezie bɛ nwo kɛ atɔfolɛ.
19“Nɔhalɛ, bɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛzɛkyele ye,
bɛ maanle ne mɔɔ bɛdole ye mgbane la
bayɛ ekyi amaa bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbadɛnla nu la;
na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛzɛkyele bɛmɛ la badu ahɔ moa moa.
20Bɛ anwubɛnyunlu mekɛ nu ngakula mɔɔ bɛwole bɛ la
baha amaa bɛade bie kɛ:
‘Azɛlɛ ne le ekyi maa yɛ;
bɛdɛlɛ nu bɛmaa yɛnyia ɛleka yɛdɛnla.’
21Akee bɛbaha ye bɛ ti akunlu kɛ,
‘Nwane a wole ngakula ɛhye mɔ manle yɛ a?
Yɛ mra ne mɔ wule, yɛpɛle awolɛ,
bɛhyele yɛ nuokɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu;
na nwane a wole menli ɛhye mɔ a?
Bɛnlea, ɔhale me ngomekye ala;
nienwu a akee ɛhye mɔ vi ɛra a.’ ”
22Awulae Nyamenle ne se,
“Bɛnlea, mebamaa me sa zo meahile maanle maanle.
mebanwɔha ye meado bɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ,
na bɛbava bɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ bɛarɛlɛ bɛ,
bɛbazoa bɛ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ bɛ bati bɛara.
23Arelemgbunli bayɛ bɛ dɔmagyama,
na arelemgbunli mraalɛ ayɛ bɛ baviavolɛma.
Bɛbazi bɛ ti aze, bɛabu ndwɛlɛ wɔ bɛ nyunlu,
na bɛatafe bɛ gyakɛ anwo munlutu.
Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkendɛ me moalɛ la anyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze.”
24Asoo katakyie sɔ awie nu a bɛkola ye die?
Asoo atisesebɛnli kye awie nuokɛ a bɛkola ye die?
25Nɔhalɛ, kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se la ɛne,
“Sonla mɔɔ katakyie ɛhye ye nuokɛ la, bɛbalie ye,
yɛɛ bɛbalie mɔɔ atisesebɛnli ne ɛhye ye la.
Ɔluakɛ me nee menli mɔɔ nee bɛ ko la baho,
yɛɛ mebalie bɛ mra ne mɔ ngoane.
26Mebamaa menli mɔɔ ɛlɛsisi bɛ la
ali bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwonane,
na bɛanlo bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ mogya
bɛabo kɛ bɛnlo nwanye.
Akee menli kɔsɔɔti banwu kɛ
medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Dievolɛ ne,
bɛ Kpɔnevolɛ ne, Yizilayɛ Katakyie Ko ne a.”

english_text:
The Lord's Power To Punish
1 The Lord says, “Children,
I didn't divorce your mother
or sell you to pay debts;
I divorced her and sold you
because of your sins.
2I came and called out,
but you didn't answer.
Have I lost my power
to rescue and save?
At my command oceans and rivers
turn into deserts;
fish rot and stink
for lack of water.
3I make the sky turn dark
like the sackcloth
you wear at funerals.”
God's Servant Must Suffer
4The Lord God gives me
the right words
to encourage the weary.
Each morning he awakens me
eager to learn his teaching;
5he made me willing to listen
and not rebel or run away.
6 I let them beat my back
and pull out my beard.
I didn't turn aside
when they insulted me
and spit in my face.
7But the Lord God keeps me
from being disgraced.
So I refuse to give up,
because I know
God will never let me down.
8 My protector is nearby;
no one can stand here
to accuse me of wrong.
9The Lord God will help me
and prove I am innocent.
My accusers will wear out
like moth-eaten clothes.
10None of you respect the Lord
or obey his servant.
You walk in the dark
instead of the light;
you don't trust the name
of the Lord your God.
11Go ahead and walk in the light
of the fires you have set.
But with his own hand,
the Lord will punish you
and make you suffer.
translation_text:
1Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Bɛ nli kɛlata ne mɔɔ mengɛlɛle membɔle ye ewole,
menvoanle ye la wɔ nienwu?
Anzɛɛ nwane a metua ye kakɛ,
mɔɔ ɔlua zo medɔne bɛ memaa ye a?
Bɛnlea, ɔlua bɛdabɛ bɛ ɛtane nee bɛ mɛladonlɛ ti
yɛɛ bɛdɔne bɛ na bɛvoa bɛ nli a.
2“Kɛmɔti ɛ, membale la ɛnee awie ɛnle ɛkɛ ɔ?
Menvɛlɛle la, ɛnee awie ɛnle ɛkɛ mɔɔ die zo ɔ?
Asoo me sa ɛyɛ ezinraa
mɔɔ yemɔti mengola memkpɔne bɛ a?
Anzɛɛ menlɛ tumi mɔɔ mefa medie bɛ ngoane ɔ?
Bɛnlea, metendɛ a nyevile sesa;
memaa azule ne mɔ kakyi ɛsɛlɛ,
fɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ nu la ɛnnyia nzule,
nzuhɔne maa bɛwu na bɛbɔ.
3Memaa awozinli fa anwumaneamra,
na memaa bɛkeda ɛrele.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛ ne tieyɛ
4Awulae Nyamenle ɛmaa me ɛnloanlɛ,
amaa meahilehile,
na meanwu edwɛkɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ meka a
ɔkɛmaa mɔɔ anwo ɛbɛlɛ ye la anwosesebɛ a.
Nwonlomɔ biala ɔtunwue me, ɔbuke me nzo,
amaa meade mɔɔ ɔkilehile me la.
5Awulae Nyamenle ɛbuke me nzo,
yɛɛ meande ɔ nwo atua,
meangakyi me nzi meanzi ye.
6 Mengakyile me nzi memanle menli mɔɔ bo me la,
menvale me kɛsa memanle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdudule me kɛsa la;
mɔɔ bɛtoto me nyunlu nyɛlɛ, bɛgua me nyunlu aze la,
meanva me nyunlu meanvea.
7Ɔluakɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne boa me,
yemɔti me rɛle ɛtɛbɔle.
Zɔhane ati meyɛ me nyunlu kɛ ɛtwɛlɛboɔ;
meze kɛ me nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze;
8 mɔɔ di me edwɛkɛ maa me la bikye me.
Nwane a kɛhola me a?
Ɔdwazo ɔrɛla ɔmaa yɛbɔ ye zo.
Nwane a le me kpɔvolɛ a?
Ɔdwazo ɔrɛla ɛke.
9Bɛnlea, Awulae Nyamenle ne boa me;
nwane a kɛbua me fɔlɛ a?
Bɛnlea, bɛ muala bɛbatete kɛ ɛdanlɛ,
ɛlɛtɛba bali bɛ atete bɛ.
10Nwane a wɔ bɛ avinli mɔɔ sulo Nyamenle,
na ɔyɛ tieyɛ ɔmaa ye sonvolɛ ne,
mɔɔ lua awozinli nu na ɔnlɛ kɛnlaneɛ,
noko ɔ rɛle wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anu,
na ɔfa ɔ nwo ɔmaa ye Nyamenle ne la?
11Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwuda menli nzi senle,
na bɛsɔ menli nwo tɛkɛ la, bɛnlea!
Bɛlua bɛ senle ne mɔɔ bɛwuda,
nee bɛ tɛkɛ ne mɔ wienyi ne anwo bɛhɔ!
Debie mɔɔ bɛbanyia ye bɛavi me ɛkɛ ne la ɛne:
nyane ala a baha bɛ a.

english_text:
The Lord Will Bring Comfort
1 If you want to do right
and obey the Lord,
follow Abraham's example.
He was the rock from which
you were chipped.
2God chose Abraham and Sarah
to be your ancestors.
The Lord blessed Abraham,
and from that one man
came many descendants.
3Though Zion is in ruins,
the Lord will bring comfort,
and the city will be as lovely
as the garden of Eden
that he provided.
Then Zion will celebrate;
it will be thankful
and sing joyful songs.
The Lord's Victory Will Last
4The Lord says:
You are my people and nation!
So pay attention to me.
My teaching will cause justice
to shine like a light
for every nation.
5Those who live across the sea
are eagerly waiting
for me to rescue them.
I am strong and ready;
soon I will come to save
and to rule all nations.
6Look closely at the sky!
Stare at the earth.
The sky will vanish like smoke;
the earth will wear out
like clothes.
Everyone on this earth
will die like flies.
But my victory will last;
my saving power never ends.
7If you want to do right
and obey my teaching
with all your heart,
then pay close attention.
Don't be discouraged
when others insult you
and say hurtful things.
8They will be eaten away
like a moth-eaten coat.
But my victory will last;
my saving power
will never end.
A Prayer for the Lord's Help
9Wake up! Do something, Lord.
Be strong and ready.
Wake up! Do what you did
for our people long ago.
Didn't you chop up
Rahab the monster?
10Didn't you dry up the deep sea
and make a road for your people
to follow safely across?
11Now those you have rescued
will return to Jerusalem,
singing on their way.
They will be crowned
with great happiness,
never again to be burdened
with sadness and sorrow.
The Lord Gives Hope
12I am the Lord, the one
who encourages you.
Why are you afraid
of mere humans?
They dry up and die like grass.
13I spread out the heavens
and laid foundations
for the earth.
But you have forgotten me,
your Lord and Creator.
All day long you were afraid
of those who were angry
and hoped to oppress you.
Where are they now?
14Everyone crying out in pain
will be quickly set free;
they will be rescued
from the power of death
and never go hungry.
15I will help them
because I am your God,
the Lord All-Powerful,
who makes the ocean roar.
16I have told you what to say,
and I will keep you safe
in the palm of my hand.
I spread out the heavens
and laid foundations
for the earth.
Now I say, “Jerusalem,
your people are mine.”
A Warning to Jerusalem
17 Jerusalem, wake up! Stand up!
You've drunk too much
from the cup filled
with the Lord's anger.
You have swallowed every drop,
and you can't walk straight.
18Not one of your many children
is there to guide you
or to offer a helping hand.
19You have been destroyed
by war and by famine;
I cannot comfort you.
20The Lord your God is angry,
and on every street corner
your children lie helpless,
like deer trapped in nets.
21You are in trouble and drunk,
but not from wine.
So pay close attention
22to the Lord your God,
who defends you and says,
“I have taken from your hands
the cup filled with my anger
that made you drunk.
You will never be forced
to drink it again.
23Instead I will give it
to your brutal enemies,
who treated you like dirt
and walked all over you.”
translation_text:
Arɛlekyekyelɛ edwɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛka bɛahile Gyɛlusalɛmma
1Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ ngoane,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma moalɛ la, bɛdie!
Bɛnlea bodane ne mɔɔ bɛkpukele bɛyele bɛ nu,
awolɛdulɛ kuma ne mɔɔ bɛdule bɛ nu la.
2Bɛnlea bɛ nlenya Ebileham,
nee bɛ nla Sɛla mɔɔ zole bɛ;
ɔluakɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Ebileham ɛtɛwole ralɛ la,
yɛɛ menvɛlɛle ye a.
Na menyilale ye memanle ɔ bo zo amra yɛle dɔɔnwo.
3“Ɛdɛnkɛma bakyekye Gyɛlusalɛmma arɛle,
ɔbakyekye bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azuadu nu la arɛle;
ɔbamaa Gyɛlusalɛm fienemgbole ahakyi kɛ Yidɛn tola,
yeamaa ɛsɛlɛ ne ayɛ kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma tola nu.
Fɛlɛko nee anyelielɛ bara ɛkɛ,
na bɛado ayɛlɛyelɛ edwɛne bɛayɛ me mo.
4“Bɛdie me, me menli,
me maanlema, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie me,
ɔluakɛ mebali mɛla,
na me pɛlepɛlelilɛ bayɛ kɛnlaneɛ amaa maanle
maanle ne mɔ.
5Me ngoanelielɛ ne ɛbikye kpalɛ,
me ngoanelielɛ ne ɛdwu bɛ nwo zo dɛbadɛba,
na medame mumua ne mebazie maanle maanle ne mɔ.
Maanle maanle mɔɔ wɔ moa la ɛlɛkendɛ me,
bɛ nye la kɛ menwɔlie bɛ.
6Bɛdo bɛ nye anwuma bɛnlea,
na bɛdo bɛ nye bɛnlea azɛlɛ ye,
ɔluakɛ anwuma baminliminli kɛ esike;
azɛlɛ ye batete kɛ ɛdanlɛ,
na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde zolɛ la bawu kɛ ngokowule.
Me ngoanelielɛ ne wɔ ɛkɛ dahuu,
na me konimlilɛ ɛnrɛwie ɛlɛ.
7“Bɛmɛ tenlenema, bɛdie me,
bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛdi me mɛla zo,
bɛmmasulo menli ngehanleɛ,
yɛɛ bɛmmamaa bɛ ahonle tu bɛ ɛnwunlonwunlanlɛ nwo.
8Ɔluakɛ ɛlɛtɛba bali bɛ kɛ bɛdi ɛdanlɛ,
yɛɛ sone bali bɛ kɛ bɛdi boane enrinli la;
na me konimlilɛ ne badɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu,
me ngoanelielɛ ne badwu awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti anwo zo.”
9Dwazo, O Ɛdɛnkɛma,
fa wɔ anwosesebɛ nee wɔ tumi ne dwazo boa yɛ.
Dwazo, kɛmɔ mɔmoane ɛyɛle
na ɛboale awolɛndoazo mɔɔ ɛze ɛhɔ la.
Asoo tɛ wɔmɔ a ɛpepɛle nyevizonle Releehabe anu azinli azinli,
na ɛwɔle nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ne mɔɔ le kɛ ɛlɛnrɛne la atwɛ la?
10Asoo tɛ wɔmɔ a ɛmanle nyevile ne sesanle,
ye buma ne nzule muala wele,
na ɛmanle nyevile buma ne yɛle ademgbole,
ɛmanle wɔ menli ne mɔɔ wɔkpɔne bɛ la luale nu la?
11Menli mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkpɔne bɛ la bazia ara,
bɛbava edwɛndolɛ bɛara Gyɛlusalɛm.
Bɛ nye balie dahuu;
bɛbali fɛlɛko na bɛ nye alie,
na bɛnrɛnwu nyane, yɛɛ alɔbɔlɛ ɛnrɛhu bɛ bieko.
12Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Medame a mele Nyamenle mɔɔ kyekye bɛ rɛle a.
Duzu ati a bɛsulo sonla mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na yeawu,
mɔɔ ye ngoane le kɛ ndile la ɛ?
13Kɛmɔ bɛ kpɔvolɛ ne ɛwie ɛya fa,
na yeva yezie ɔ nyunlu kɛ ɔsɛkye bɛ la ati,
dahuu bɛwɔ ɛzulolɛ nu.
na bɛ rɛle ɛvi Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Bɔvolɛ ne
mɔɔ bɔle anwuma,
na ɔwulale azɛlɛ ye adiabo ne mɔ aze la,
Na kpɔvolɛ ne ɛyavalɛ ne dwu nienwu?
14Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na mɔɔ bɛholo ɔ kɔme zo la anwo adɔ ye;
ɔnrɛwu yɛɛ ɔnrɛnwu Ewule Kuma ne,
yɛɛ ɔ nloa anu aleɛ ɛnrɛbɔ ye.
15“Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne,
mɔɔ maa nyevile azɛlɛkye kulu.
Me duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma.
16Meva me edwɛkɛ mewula ɛ nloa,
yɛɛ meva wɔ mevea me ndɛba abo.
Medame a membɔle anwuma,
na menwulale azɛlɛ ye adiabo aze,
na menzele Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ, ‘Bɛle me menli’ a.”
Gyɛlusalɛmma amaneɛnwunlɛ ne awieleɛ
17 O Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛdwazo,
bɛheha bɛ nwo, bɛheha bɛ nwo!
Bɛmɛ, bɛnlo Ɛdɛnkɛma ndeanlɛ kɔpo ne anu,
ye ɛya kɔpo ne ɛra bɛ nwo zo ɛlɛ;
bɛmɛ, bɛnlonle ye ɛya kɔpo ne anu bɛmanle ɔdɔle mgbane,
na ɔmanle bɛyɛle sesɛsesɛ.
18Mralɛ mrenya bebelebe ne mɔɔ bɛwo bɛ la,
bɛnnyia nuhua ko bɔbɔ ɛnli bɛ ti.
Mralɛ mrenya bebelebe ne mɔɔ bɛtete bɛ la,
bɛnnyia nuhua ko ɛnzɔ bɛ avinli.
19Edwɛkɛ mgbole nwiɔ ɛhye mɔ ɛsisi bɛ nwo zo:
Konle ɛzɛkye bɛ maanle ne,
ɛhɔne nee ewule ɛhu menli ne;
awie ɛnyɛ bɛ gyakɔ ɛnkyekye bɛ rɛle.
20Bɛ mra mrenya anye zo ɛbulu,
bɛgua ye takagyaa wɔ guabile ne mɔ azo
kɛ kɛtɛboɛ mɔɔ ɛdo ɛhane,
Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne wɔ bɛ nwo zo kpole,
bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛdea bɛ.
21Yemɔti bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛdi nyane a,
bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛanno nwanye na bɛbo a, bɛdie ɛhye:
22Ɛdɛnkɛma, bɛ Awulae, bɛ Nyamenle ne
mɔɔ die ye menli ne ati la se,
“Bɛnlea, melie kɔpo ne mɔɔ maa bɛyɛ sesɛsesɛ,
me ɛya kɔpo ne mɔɔ maa bɛte nyane la mevi bɛ sa nu,
bɛnrɛnlo nuhua bieko;
23Mebava meawula menli mɔɔ ɛlɛsisi bɛ,
mɔɔ ɛha ɛhile bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma kɛ,
‘Bɛbutu bɛmaa yɛtietia bɛ nwo zo,’
na bɛva bɛ nzi bɛyɛ ndɛtɛlɛ bɛtietia zo la,
na bɛ nzi ɛyɛ guabile mɔɔ bɛdua zolɛ la asa anu.”

english_text:
Jerusalem Can Celebrate
1 Jerusalem, wake up!
Stand up and be strong.
Holy city of Zion,
dress in your best clothes.
Those foreigners who ruined
your sacred city
won't bother you again.
2Zion, rise from the dirt!
Free yourself from the rope
around your neck.
Suffering Will End
3The Lord says:
My people, you were sold,
but not for money;
now you will be set free,
but not for a payment.
4Long ago you went to Egypt
where you lived
as foreigners.
Then Assyria was cruel to you,
5 and now another nation
has taken you prisoner
for no reason at all.
Your leaders groan with pain,
and day after day
my own name is cursed.
6My people, you will learn
who I am and who is speaking
because I am here.
A Message of Hope for Jerusalem
7 What a beautiful sight!
On the mountains a messenger
announces to Jerusalem,
“Good news! You're saved.
There will be peace.
Your God is now King.”
8Everyone on guard duty,
sing and celebrate!
Look! You can see the Lord
returning to Zion.
9Jerusalem, rise from the ruins!
Join in the singing.
The Lord has given comfort
to his people;
he comes to your rescue.
10The Lord has shown all nations
his mighty strength;
now everyone will see
the saving power of our God.
A Command To Leave Babylon
11 Leave the city of Babylon!
Don't touch anything filthy.
Wash yourselves. Be ready
to carry back everything sacred
that belongs to the Lord.
12You won't need to run.
No one is chasing you.
The Lord God of Israel
will lead and protect you
from enemy attacks.
The Suffering Servant
13The Lord says:
My servant will succeed!
He will be given great praise
and the highest honors.
14Many were horrified
at what happened to him.
But everyone who saw him
was even more horrified
because he suffered until
he no longer looked human.
15 My servant will make
nations worthy to worship me;
kings will be silent
as they bow in wonder.
They will see and think about
things they have never seen
or thought about before.
translation_text:
Nyamenle balie Gyɛlusalɛm
1 Gyɛlusalɛmma, bɛdwazo!
Bɛdwazo, bɛmaa bɛ nwo ɛyɛ se,
bɛva bɛ adɛladeɛ ngɛnlɛma ne mɔ bɛwula,
O Gyɛlusalɛm, suakpole nwuanzanwuanza azo amra,
ɔluakɛ awie biala mɔɔ anwo ɛnde na ɔnzonle Nyamenle la
ɛnrɛra suakpole ne azo ɛlɛ.
2O Gyɛlusalɛmma mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ,
bɛdwazo bɛvi ndɛtɛlɛ ne anu;
bɛye bɛ kɔme nwɔnzɔnwɔnzɔ ne mɔ,
O Zayɔnoma mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ nuokɛ a.
3Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛandɔne bɛ bɛanlie debie, yemɔti bɛnrɛdua bɛ ti ezukoa biala wɔ bɛ ɛkpɔnelɛ nu. 4Ɔluakɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Me menli ne hɔle Yigyibiti alumua ne kɛ bɛkakpɔsa lɔ ala, na Aseleama sisile bɛ mgbane gyɛne ne ala. 5 Na kɛkala medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, duzu a menwu ye ɛke a? Mɔɔ menwu ye la a le kɛ bɛhye me menli ne bɛhɔ mgbane. Bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ su, yɛɛ dahuu bɛgua me duma ne anwo evinli. 6Yemɔti me menli ne banwu me duma. Mekɛ ne anu bɛbanwu kɛ medame a melɛtendɛ la; medame ɛne.”
7 Ahenle ne mɔɔ lua awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ,
mɔɔ lɛ nrɛlaleɛ kpalɛ ɛlɛba la ɛralɛ nu le kɛnlɛma,
ɔbɔ anzonudwolɛ nolo, na ɔlɛ nrɛlaleɛ kɛnlɛma kpalɛ,
ɔbɔ ngoanelielɛ nolo,
na ɔka ɔkile Zayɔn kɛ, “Wɔ Nyamenle ne di
belemgbunli.”
8Bɛdie, bɛ sinzavolɛma ɛlɛtea nu,
bɛbɔ nu bɛto edwɛne anyelielɛ nu,
ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ bɛnwu ye bɛ nye amunwiɔ
kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛzia ɛlɛba Zayɔn.
9Bɛ muala bɛbɔ nu bɛdo edwɛne,
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛdede Gyɛlusalɛm awuke mɔɔ ɛbɔ la anu la,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnwu ye menli ne anwunvɔne,
yekyekye ye menli ne arɛle.
10Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ye tumi nwuanzanwuanza ne
ɛwa maanle maanle ne mɔ anye,
na ewiade amra amuala
bɛanwu yɛ Nyamenle ne ngoanelielɛ ne.
11 Bɛhɔ, bɛhɔ, bɛvi Babelonia bɛdwazo bɛhɔ,
bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka debie biala mɔɔ evinli ɛha ye la.
Bɛhɔ na bɛhɔnlua bɛ nwo,
bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛsoa Ɛdɛnkɛma dwora ne mɔ la.
12Bɛnrɛhɔ ye ndɛndɛ ndɛndɛ,
yɛɛ bɛnrɛnriandi,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ɔbali bɛ nyunlu,
Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne bali bɛ nzi.
Sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ la
13Bɛnlea, me sonvolɛ ne bakpazi,
bɛbali ye eni na bɛamaa ye zo.
Ɔbayɛ sonlakpole kpalɛ.
14Ɔyɛle bɛdabɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛnwunle ye la azibɛnwo,
ɔhakyile bɔkɔɔ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔnzɔho sonla a,
yeanzɔho sonla bɔbɔ.
15 Zɔhane ala yɛɛ maanle maanle dɔɔnwo banwu ye na bɛabɔ mgbatike,
yemɔ ɔ ti arelemgbunli baha bɛ nloa ado nu,
ɔluakɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛkanle bɛtɛkilele bɛ la, bɛbanwu ye,
yɛɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛtele ye ɛlɛ la, bɛbade ɔ bo.

english_text:
What God's Servant Did for Us
1 Has anyone believed us
or seen the mighty power
of the Lord in action?
2Like a young plant or a root
that sprouts in dry ground,
the servant grew up
obeying the Lord.
He wasn't some handsome king.
Nothing about the way he looked
made him attractive to us.
3He was hated and rejected;
his life was filled with sorrow
and terrible suffering.
No one wanted to look at him.
We despised him and said,
“He is a nobody!”
4He suffered and endured
great pain for us,
but we thought his suffering
was punishment from God.
5 He was wounded and crushed
because of our sins;
by taking our punishment,
he made us completely well.
6 All of us were like sheep
that had wandered off.
We had each gone our own way,
but the Lord gave him
the punishment we deserved.
7 He was painfully abused,
but he did not complain.
He was silent like a lamb
being led to the butcher,
as quiet as a sheep
having its wool cut off.
8He was condemned to death
without a fair trial.
Who could have imagined
what would happen to him?
His life was taken away
because of the sinful things
my people had done.
9 He wasn't dishonest or violent,
but he was buried in a tomb
among cruel, rich people.
10The Lord decided his servant
would suffer as a sacrifice
to take away the sin
and guilt of others.
Now the servant will live
to see his own descendants.
He did everything
the Lord had planned.
11By suffering, the servant
will learn the true meaning
of obeying the Lord.
Although he is innocent,
he will take the punishment
for the sins of others,
so that many of them
will no longer be guilty.
12 The Lord will reward him
with honor and power
for sacrificing his life.
Others thought he was a sinner,
but he suffered for our sins
and asked God to forgive us.
translation_text:
1 Nwane a ɛlie mɔɔ yɛde la ɛli a?
Nwane a bɛye Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi ne bɛhile ye a?
2Ɔluakɛ ɔfifile kɛ baka ekyi bie
mɔɔ zɔle ndinli wɔ azɛlɛ resee zo;
ɔnle kɛnlɛma anzɛɛ ɔnzɔho debie na yɛanlea,
yɛɛ ɔnzɔ ɛnyelɛ na yɛ nye abolo ye.
3Menli kpole ye yɛɛ bɛambu ye;
ɔnwunle amaneɛ na ɔdele nyane;
ɔyɛle sonla mɔɔ menli nwu ye a bɛye bɛ nye bɛto ɛbɔ nu,
bɛkpole ye yɛɛ yɛambu ye bie.
4 Nɔhalɛ, yezoa yɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ kɔsɔɔti,
yɛɛ yezoa yɛ nyanenwunlɛ kɔsɔɔti;
noko yɛ adwenle a le kɛ,
ye amaneɛnwunlɛ ne le Nyamenle ndeanlɛ.
5 Noko yɛ mɛladonlɛ ne mɔ ati bɛbodɛbodale ye,
bɛbodɛbodale ye wɔ yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati;
bɛvale yɛ nwo ndeanlɛ bɛguale ɔ nwo zo,
ye empele mɔɔ bɛbilale ye la ɛyɛ yɛ ayile.
6 Yɛ muala yɛminli kɛ mboane la;
yɛ nuhua biala ɔdaye yeva ye adenle ɛdeɛ zo;
Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ amuala ɛgua ɔ nwo zo.
7 Bɛsisile ye, na bɛhilele ye nyane,
noko yeambuke ɔ nloa;
ɔle kɛ boane ralɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee ye ɛlɛkɔ ahunleɛ,
yɛɛ ɔle kɛ boane mɔɔ bɛhye ye bɛlɛpepɛ ɔ nwo
enrinli la.
Ɔdɔle mumule, yeambuke ɔ nloa.
8Nzisilɛ nu, bɛbuale ye ewule fɔlɛ na bɛ nee ye hɔle;
awolɛndoazo zɔhane amra, biala andwenle nwo
kɛ bɛlɛye ye bɛavi anyewɔzoma azɛlɛ zo,
bɛhunle ye wɔ me menli ne mɛladonlɛ ti.
9 Bɛbɔle ye nla bɛbokale amumuyɛma anwo,
bɛziele ye wɔ sukoavolɛma avinli.
Yeanyɛ ɛtane biala,
yɛɛ yeambɔ adalɛ ɛlɛ.
10Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Noko ɔle me ɛhulolɛ kɛ bɛkɛbodɛboda ye,
na ɔkɛnwu amaneɛ dɔɔnwo;
na ɔkɛva ɔ nwo ɔkɛbɔ azu ɔkɛmaa ɛtane.
Ɔbanyi yeahyɛ na yeanwu ɔ bo zo amra,
na ɔlua ɔ nwo zo
Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛhulolɛ ne ali munli.
11Ɔbanwu ye amaneɛnwunlɛ ne abo aleɛ na ɔ nye alie,
na ɔlua me sonvolɛ tenlene ko ne anwo zo,
bɛbava menli dɔɔnwo kɛ bɛle tenlenema;
na ɔbazoa bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo ndeanlɛ.
12 Yemɔti mebamaa ye ɛleka wɔ mgbolema avinli,
na ɔ nee anwosesebɛma ahyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛnyianle bɛ wɔ konle nu la,
ɔboalekɛ ɔvale ɔ nwo ɔmanle kɛ bɛhu ye,
na bɛdianle ye bɛbokale mɛladonlɛma anwo.
Ɔvale menli dɔɔnwo ɛtane ɔdole ɔ nwo zo,
na ɔkpale mɛladonlɛma ati kyɛlɛ.”

english_text:
A Promise of the Lord's Protection
1 Sing and shout,
even though you have never
had children!
The Lord has promised that you
will have more children
than someone married
for a long time.
2Make your tents larger!
Spread out the tent pegs;
fasten them firmly.
3You and your descendants
will take over the land
of other nations.
You will settle in towns
that are now in ruins.
4Don't be afraid or ashamed
and don't be discouraged.
You won't be disappointed.
Forget how sinful you were
when you were young;
stop feeling ashamed
for being left a widow.
5The Lord All-Powerful,
the Holy God of Israel,
rules all the earth.
He is your Creator and husband,
and he will rescue you.
6You were like a young wife,
brokenhearted and crying
because her husband
had divorced her.
But the Lord your God says,
“I am taking you back!
7I rejected you for a while,
but with love and tenderness
I will embrace you again.
8For a while, I turned away
in furious anger.
Now I will have mercy
and love you forever!
I, your protector and Lord,
make this promise.”
The Lord Promises Lasting Peace
9 I once promised Noah that I
would never again destroy
the earth by a flood.
Now I have promised that I
will never again get angry
and punish you.
10 Every mountain and hill
may disappear.
But I will always be kind
and merciful to you;
I won't break my agreement
to give your nation peace.
The New Jerusalem
11 Jerusalem, you are sad
and discouraged,
tossed around in a storm.
But I, the Lord,
will rebuild your city
with precious stones;
for your foundation
I will use blue sapphires.
12Your fortresses
will be built of rubies,
your gates of jewels,
and your walls of gems.
13 I will teach your children
and make them successful.
14You will be built on fairness
with no fears of injustice;
every one of your worries
will be taken far from you.
15I will never send anyone
to attack your city,
and you will make prisoners
of those who do attack.
16Don't forget that I created
metalworkers who make weapons
over burning coals.
I also created armies
that can bring destruction.
17Weapons made to attack you
won't be successful;
words spoken against you
won't hurt at all.
My servants, Jerusalem is yours!
I, the Lord, promise
to bless you with victory.
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ Yizilayɛma anwo ɛhulolɛ
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“O motanli mɔɔ anwo ralɛ a, to edwɛne;
to edwɛne na maa ɛ ne ɛhɔ anwuma,
wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛtɛtele awolɛ nyane ɛlɛ a!
Ɔluakɛ raalɛ ne mɔɔ bɛkpo ye la
amra bazo dɔɔnwo adɛla raalɛ ne
mɔɔ de agyalɛ ne abo la.
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.
2Buke wɔ ndanlɛ sua ne anu,
na tɛlɛ wɔ mgbɛnu ndanlɛ ne mɔ anu,
mmagyakyi, maa ndanlɛ sua nyɛma ne mɔ ɛyɛ ndendenle,
na maa adakola ne mɔ anu ɛyɛ se.
3Ɔluakɛ ɛbadɛlɛ wɔahɔ fema zo nee bɛne zo,
na ɛ bo zo amra bava maanle ne amuala,
na menli ayi azuamgbole mɔɔ ɛyɛ azuadu la.
4Mmasulo, ɔluakɛ ɛ nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze;
mmamaa wɔ ahonle tu, na awie ɛnrɛgua ɛ nyunlu aze,
ɔluakɛ ɛ rɛle bavi wɔ mbɛlɛra nu anyiemgba ne,
yɛɛ ɛnrɛhakye wɔ kunlanehyilɛ nyanenwunlɛ ne
bieko.
5Ɔluakɛ ɛ hu a le wɔ Bɔvolɛ ne,
ye duma a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma;
Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne a le wɔ Kpɔnevolɛ ne,
bɛfɛlɛ ye ewiade amuala Nyamenle.
6“Ɔluakɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mevɛlɛ wɔ
kɛ yelɛ mɔɔ bɛkpo ye na ɔlɛdi nyane,
kɛ yelɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛvoa ye ye mbɛlɛra nu la,
medame wɔ Nyamenle a mese a.
7Ɔluakɛ mekɛ ekyi bie memkpole wɔ,
noko mebava anwunvɔnezelɛ kpole kpalɛ meazia meava wɔ.
8Menvale ɛya kpole mendwenle me nwo mekɛ ekyi,
mendole me nye ɛbɔ nu,
noko mebava ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ ɛnwie ɛlɛ la
meanwu wɔ anwunvɔne,
medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, wɔ Kpɔnevolɛ ne a mese a.
9 “Ɔluakɛ ɛhye kakye me Nowa mekɛ zo,
mɔɔ menganle ndane kɛ menrɛmaa nzule
mɔɔ le kɛ Nowa mekɛ zo ɛdeɛ ne la
ɛnrɛyi ɛnrɛva azɛlɛ ye bieko la.
Yemɔti meha ndane kɛ menrɛva ɛ nwo ɛya bieko,
yɛɛ menrɛhwi ɛ nyunlu bieko.
10Awoka mgbole badudu ahɔ,
awoka ngyikyi bavi bɛ bo zo ne mɔ,
na me ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne ɛnrɛvi ɛ nwo ɛlɛ,
yɛɛ me anzonudwolɛ ngyekyeleɛ ne ɛnrɛkpa nwo ɛlɛ,
medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ menwu wɔ anwunvɔne la a mese a.”
Kɛ kenlebie Gyɛlusalɛm bazi ayɛ la
11 Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“O wɔmɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛdi nyane,
wɔ adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu,
na awie ɛnkyekye ɛ rɛle a,
nea, mebayɛ wɔ awolɛ ne mɔ memeamemea,
na meava awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la meawula wɔ adiabo ne.
12Mebava ezukoa bolɛ meazi wɔ tawa ne mɔ,
meava awolɛ mɔɔ sɔ memeamemea la meaduodua wɔ
nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ ɛbonle,
na meava ezukoa awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la mealie wɔ bane ne mɔ.
13 “Ɛdɛnkɛma bahilehile ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ,
na ɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ bakpazi kpole kpalɛ.
14Ɛbalua tenleneyɛlɛ zo wɔamaa ɛ nwo ayɛ se,
awie ɛnrɛsisi wɔ, yɛɛ ɛnrɛzulo;
yɛɛ ɛzulolɛ biala ɛnrɛbikye wɔ.
15Saa awie fa konle ba a,
ɛnee tɛ me ɔ;
awie mɔɔ kɛva ye konle kɛdoa wɔ la,
ɛdawɔ ti, ɔbali akoatɔ.
16“Bɛnlea, mebɔ dwinvolɛ
mɔɔ wuda emunlike bɔ akodeɛ;
eza mebɔ ɛlɔnenli
mɔɔ ko sɛkye ninyɛne,
17noko akodeɛ biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ bɛatia wɔ la
ɛnrɛyɛ kpalɛ ɛlɛ;
yɛɛ awie biala mɔɔ kɛva edwɛkɛ kɛdo ɛ nwo zo la,
ɛbaha wɔado ɔ nwo zo.
Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma agyadeɛ,
nee bɛ ti mɔɔ medie la a le ɛhye.
Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”

english_text:
The Lord's Invitation
1 If you are thirsty,
come and drink water!
If you don't have any money,
come, eat what you want!
Drink wine and milk
without paying a cent.
2 Why waste your money
on what really isn't food?
Why work hard for something
that doesn't satisfy?
Listen carefully to me,
and you will enjoy
the very best foods.
3 Pay close attention!
Come to me and live.
I will promise you
the eternal love and loyalty
that I promised David.
4I made him the leader and ruler
of the nations;
he was my witness to them.
5You will call out to nations
you have never known.
And they have never known you,
but they will come running
because I am the Lord,
the holy God of Israel,
and I have honored you.
God's Words Are Powerful
6Turn to the Lord!
He can still be found.
Call out to God! He is near.
7Give up your evil ways
and your evil thoughts.
Return to the Lord our God.
He will be merciful
and forgive your sins.
8The Lord says:
“My thoughts and my ways
are not like yours.
9Just as the heavens
are higher than the earth,
my thoughts and my ways
are higher than yours.
10 “Rain and snow fall from the sky.
But they don't return
without watering the earth
that produces seeds to plant
and grain to eat.
11That's how it is with my words.
They don't return to me
without doing everything
I send them to do.”
God's People Will Celebrate
12When you are set free,
you will celebrate
and travel home in peace.
Mountains and hills will sing
as you pass by,
and trees will clap.
13Cypress and myrtle trees
will grow in fields
once covered by thorns.
And then those trees will stand
as a lasting witness
to the glory of the Lord.
translation_text:
Nyamenle anwunvɔnezelɛ nwo ɛwɔkɛ
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Awie biala mɔɔ nzuhɔne ɛlɛku ye la
ɛrɛla ɛranlo nzule;
yɛɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ezukoa la
ɛrɛla ɛradɔ aleɛ ɛli.
Bɛrɛla, bɛradɔ nwanye nee meleke,
bɛnlɛ bolɛ yɛɛ bɛnva ezukoa bɛndɔ.
2Duzu ati a bɛsɛkye bɛ ezukoa
wɔ mɔɔ ɛnle aleɛ la anwo,
na bɛsɛkye bɛ anwosesebɛ
wɔ mɔɔ ɛmmaa ahunlundwolɛ la anwo ɛ?
Bɛdie me kpalɛ, bɛli mɔɔ le kpalɛ la,
na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie aleɛ sosɔɔ nwo
na bɛyɛ mbelane.
3 “Bɛrɛla, bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ bɛdie me;
bɛdie, amaa bɛanyia ngoane,
na me nee bɛ bakyekye ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ ɛntulu ɛlɛ,
na bɛanyia me ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne
mɔɔ menvale mengulole Belemgbunli Devidi la.
4Bɛnlea, menyɛle ye maanle maanle ne mɔ dasevolɛ,
maanle maanle ne mɔ safohyenlema kpanyinli mɔɔ li bɛ ti.
5Akee ɛbavɛlɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnze bɛ la,
yɛɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛnze wɔ la banriandi ara ɛ nwo,
wɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma wɔ Nyamenle ne,
Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne ati,
