on every public street.
Our time was up;
our doom was near.
19They swooped down faster
than eagles from the sky.
They hunted for us in the hills
and set traps to catch us
out in the desert.
20The Lord's chosen leader
was our hope for survival!
We thought he would keep us safe
somewhere among the nations,
but even he was caught
in one of their traps.
21You people of Edom
can celebrate now!
But your time will come
to suffer and stagger
around naked.
22The people of Zion
have paid for their sins,
and the Lord will soon
let them return home.
But, people of Edom,
you will be punished,
and your sins exposed.
translation_text:
Gyɛlusalɛm ɛbɔlɛ ne anzi
1Ezukoa nvutuke ne ɛlu,
ezukoa nvutuke kpalɛ anye ɛhakyi.
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne awolɛ ne mɔ
ɛkponde suakpole ye awɔdenle ne mɔ azo.
2Zayɔn mgbavolɛ mɔɔ di munli,
mɔɔ sonle bolɛ kɛ ezukoa nvutuke la
ɛnɛ ɛzɔho mbuakɛ
mɔɔ nwovolɛ ɛnwo bɛ ɔ sa nu la.
3Ɛzonlɛ bɔbɔ noa bɛ mra nyɛfonlɛ,
na me menli ne ɛdeɛ, bɛ ti ɛyɛ se,
bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ ɛsɛlɛ zo soholo.
4Bɛmaa ɛhɔne nee nzuhɔne ku bɛ nlɔma,
ngakula ne mɔ su kɛ bɛdie aleɛ,
noko awie ɛnnea bɛ nyunlu.
5Menli mɔɔ anrɛɛ di aleɛ kpalɛ la,
ɛnɛ ɛhɔne ku bɛ gua guabile zo;
bɛdabɛ mɔɔ anrɛɛ bɛde arelemgbunli azua nu la
ɛnɛ gua fovolɛ zo.
6 Me menli ne ndeanlɛ ɛyɛ kpole
ɛdɛla Sodɔm ɛdeɛ ne;
yemɔ, bɛzɛkyele ye arɛlevilɛ nu,
tɛ sonla a zɛkyele ye a.
7Ɛnee yɛ arelemgbunli anwo te
tɛla ezukɔtweaba nee nyɛfonzule,
bɛnyi ngɛnlɛma, bɛ nwo yɛ se;
bɛ ngɛnlɛma le kɛ ezukoa bolɛ safaya.
8Akee bɛ nyunlu ɛlu kisii ɛdɛla sisikpunlike,
bɛnnwu bɛ menli holɛ;
bɛnwa bɛhakyi mbowule,
bɛhete kɛ ɛyɛne.
9Menli mɔɔ dɔle konle nu la anwo dwole
dɛlale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔne hunle bɛ la;
ɛhɔne manle bɛhetele,
ɛbɔ nu nzoleɛ bɔbɔ, bɛannyia bie.
10 Mraalɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ se anwunvɔne la
ɛdo bɛ kunlu mralɛ ɛli.
Me menli ne ɛzɛkyelɛ
manle bɛvale bɛ bɛhakyile aleɛ.
11Ɛdɛnkɛma hilele ye ɛya kpole ne,
na ɔwolale ye ɛya wuluwulu ne ɔguale;
ɔdole senle wɔ Zayɔn,
na ɔzɔle ɔyelale suakpole ne adiabo ne mɔ.
12Ewiade arelemgbunli anlie anli,
azɛlɛ ye azo sonla biala anlie anli,
kɛ kpɔvolɛma kɛhola kɛwolo
Gyɛlusalɛm nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ anu.
13Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛtane ne mɔ,
nee sɛlɛvolɛma ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛle,
kɛ bɛhanle tenlenema mogya bɛguale la ati
yɛɛ ɛhye mɔ zile a.
14Bɛhakyile anyenzinlirama bɛluoluale gua ne mɔ azo;
mogya ɛbia bɛ takaa
mɔɔ awie ɛngola ɛnzɔ bɛ ndanlɛ nu a.
15Menli deanle zele kɛ,
“Bɛvi ɛkɛ ne! Bɛ nwo ɛnde!
Awie mmamaa ɔ nwo ka bɛ.”
Yemɔti bɛvoanle bɛ bɛmanle bɛluoluale nu.
Maanle maanle zele kɛ,
“Yɛ nee bɛ ɛnrɛdɛnla bieko.”
16Ɛdɛnkɛma mumua ne a ɛkponde bɛ a;
ɔnrɛbu bɛ bieko; yeambu sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ,
yeanze mgbanyima ne mɔ anwunvɔne.
17Yɛ nye hale adenle zo,
yɛhendɛle moalɛ mgbane;
yɛzinzale yɛhendɛle
maanle mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔnlɛ gyinlagyakɛ la.
18Menli vunvuanle yɛ gyakɛ abo zo
mɔɔ ɛnee yɛngola finde a,
yɛ awieleɛ bikyele, yɛ mekɛ dwule,
ɔluakɛ yɛ awieleɛ ɛra.
19Menli mɔɔ voanle yɛ la anwo yɛ ndɛ
tɛla anloma ɛkpɔtɛ;
bɛvoanle yɛ awoka zo lɔ;
bɛhɔle yɛ nwo nzia wɔ fienemgbole nu.
20Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ye ɛmaa yɛ,
na ɔle yɛ ɛnwomenle la, bɛhye ye bɛ ɛhane nu.
Yemɔ a yɛhanle ɔ nwo edwɛkɛ kɛ,
“Saa yɛwɔ ɔ bo a, yɛnzulo maanle maanle ne mɔ” a.
21Bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie na bɛli fɛlɛko, O Yidɔmma
mɔɔ de Ɛɛze azɛlɛ zo,
na bɛ nyane kɔpo ɛdeɛ ne bara bɛ nwo zo;
bɛbanlo, bɛabo, na bɛayeye bɛ nwo bɛagua zo.
22Zayɔnoma, bɛwie bɛ tea wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati;
ɔbaye bɛ yeavi nlɔnu;
na bɛmɛ Yidɔmma, bɛbadea bɛ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati,
ɔbaza bɛ ninyɛndane ne mɔ yeagua zo.

english_text:
A Prayer for Mercy
The People of Jerusalem Pray:
1Our Lord, don't forget
how we have suffered
and been disgraced.
2Foreigners and strangers
have taken our land
and our homes.
3We are like children
whose mothers are widows.
4The water we drink
and the wood we burn
cost far too much.
5We are terribly mistreated;
we are worn out
and can find no rest.
6We had to surrender
to Egypt and Assyria
because we were hungry.
7Our ancestors sinned,
but they are dead,
and we are left to pay
for their sins.
8Slaves are now our rulers,
and there is no one
to set us free.
9We are in danger
from brutal desert tribes;
we must risk our lives
just to bring in our crops.
10Our skin is scorched
from fever and hunger.
11On Zion and everywhere in Judah
our wives and daughters
are being raped.
12Our rulers are strung up
by their arms,
and our nation's advisors
are treated shamefully.
13Young men are forced
to do the work of slaves;
boys must carry
heavy loads of wood.
14Our leaders are not allowed
to decide cases in court,
and young people
no longer play music.
15Our hearts are sad;
instead of dancing,
we mourn.
16Zion's glory has disappeared!
And we are doomed
because of our sins.
17We feel sick all over
and can't even see straight;
18our city is in ruins,
overrun by wild dogs.
19You will rule forever, Lord!
You are King for all time.
20Why have you forgotten us
for so long?
21Bring us back to you!
Give us a fresh start.
22Or do you despise us so much
that you don't want us?
translation_text:
Anwunvɔnezelɛ nwo nzɛlɛlɛ
1O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nea mɔɔ ɛdo yɛ a;
nea anyiemgba mɔɔ yɛbɔ a.
2Yɛ gyadeɛ ɛpɛ ɛli nyɛvolɛ asa anu,
nyɛvolɛ ɛva yɛ azua.
3Yɛyɛ nrisa, yɛnlɛ selɛ;
yɛ nli mɔ ɛhakyi ahunlanvolɛ.
4Yɛtua nzule mɔɔ yɛno la kakɛ,
yɛtɔ ɛyɛne na yɛawuda.
5Gyɛnvayile gua yɛ kɔme zo, yɛyɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ;
bɛmmaa yɛnlie yɛ ɛnwomenle,
yɛwie fɛ bɔkɔɔ.
6Amaa yɛanyia aleɛ yɛali la,
yɛsonle Yigyibiti nee Aselea.
7Egya mɔ yɛle ɛtane, na bɛwu bɛhɔ;
nwolɛ ɛzonle ɛzoa yɛmɛ.
8Ahanra a sie yɛ a;
yɛnnyia awie ɛnlie yɛ ɛnvi bɛ sa nu.
9Yɛfa yɛ ngoane yɛtɔ aleɛ,
ɔluakɛ ahɔdiawu ɛva ɛbɔ nu.
10Yɛ nwo ɛlɔ kɛ fonlomo,
ɛhɔne ngome ɛwie yɛ yela.
11Bɛkye yɛ mraalɛ bɛfa bɛ wɔ Zayɔn;
bɛyɛ mbɛlɛra mɔɔ ɛnze mrenya la zɔhane wɔ Dwuda.
12Bɛkyekye yɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ asa bɛkenda bɛ,
bɛmbu yɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ bie.
13Bɛmaa mgbavolɛ ne mɔ kyiba abɛlɛ melahyinli,
yɛɛ ngakula mrenya soa ɛyɛne avile mgbole,
na bɛ gyakɛ anzi wozo bɛ.
14Mgbanyinli ne mɔ ɛvi suakpole ne anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa,
mgbavolɛ ne mɔ ɛdua edwɛne ɛdolɛ.
15Yɛ fɛlɛkolilɛ ɛwie;
yɛ agolezilɛ ɛhakyi yɛ nyanelilɛ.
16Yɛ nyunlu ɛdɔ aze ɛbɔ;
abule ɛbu yɛ, ɔboalekɛ yɛyɛ ɛtane!
17Ɛhye ati nyane ɛwie yɛ ku,
ɛhye ati monle ɛmmaa yɛnnwu aze,
18ɔluakɛ Zayɔn Boka ɛdɔ mgbane,
ɛzonlɛ a duolua ɛkɛ ne didi a.
19Na wɔmɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛle belemgbunli dahuu;
wɔ belemgbunlililɛ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
20Duzu ati a wɔkpo yɛ bɔkɔɔ ɛ?
Duzu ati a ɛ rɛle ɛvi yɛ bɔkɔɔ ɛ?
21O Ɛdɛnkɛma, fa yɛ bɔ wɔ ɛbolɛ.
Maa yɛnyia gyinlagyakɛ kɛ dɛba ne la.
22Anzɛɛ wɔkpo yɛ bɔkɔɔ ɔ?
Wɔva yɛ nwo ɛya bɔkɔɔ ɔ?

english_text:
Ezekiel Sees the Lord's Glory
1-3 I am Ezekiel—a priest and the son of Buzi.
Five years after King Jehoiachin of Judah had been led away as a prisoner to Babylonia, I was living near the Chebar River among those who had been taken there with him. Then on the fifth day of the fourth month of the thirtieth year, the heavens suddenly opened. The Lord placed his hand upon me and showed me some visions.
4I saw a windstorm blowing in from the north. Lightning flashed from a huge cloud and lit up the whole sky with a dazzling brightness. The fiery center of the cloud was as shiny as polished metal, 5 and in that center I saw what looked like four living creatures. They were somewhat like humans, 6except that each one had four faces and four wings. 7Their legs were straight, but their feet looked like the hoofs of calves and sparkled like bronze. 8Under each of their wings, these creatures had a human hand. 9The four creatures were standing back to back with the tips of their wings touching. They moved together in every direction, without turning their bodies.
10 Each creature had the face of a human in front, the face of a lion on the right side, the face of a bull on the left, and the face of an eagle in back. 11Two wings of each creature were spread out and touched the wings of the creatures on either side. The other two wings of each creature were folded against its body.
12The four living creatures went wherever the Spirit led them, and they moved together without turning their bodies, because each creature faced straight ahead. 13 The creatures were glowing like hot coals, and I saw something like a flaming torch moving back and forth among them. Lightning flashed from the torch every time its flame blazed up. 14The creatures themselves moved as quickly as sparks jumping from a fire.
15 I then noticed that on the ground beside each of the four living creatures was a wheel, 16shining like chrysolite. Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it, 17so that they could move in any direction without turning. 18 The rims of the wheels were large and frightening, and they had eyes all the way around them. 19-21The creatures controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the four creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels were beside them.
22-23 Above the living creatures, I saw something that was sparkling like ice, and it reminded me of a dome. Each creature had two of its wings stretched out toward the creatures on either side, with the other two wings folded against its body. 24 Whenever the creatures flew, their wings roared like an ocean or a large army or even the voice of God All-Powerful. And whenever the creatures stopped, they folded their wings against their bodies.
25When the creatures stopped flapping their wings, I heard a sound coming from above the dome. 26 I then saw what looked like a throne made of sapphire, and sitting on the throne was a figure in the shape of a human. 27 From the waist up, it was glowing like metal in a hot furnace, and from the waist down it looked like the flames of a fire. The figure was surrounded by a bright light, 28as colorful as a rainbow that appears after a storm.
I realized I was seeing the brightness of the Lord's glory! So I bowed with my face to the ground, and just then I heard a voice speaking to me.
translation_text:
YIZIKEƐLE ƐNYELƐZODEƐNWUNLƐ MƆƆ LUMUA
(1.1—7.27)
Nyamenle Belemgbunli Ebia ne
1Wɔ ɛvolɛ abulasa ne anu, siane nna ne, ye kenle nnu ne azo, ɛnee medame, sɛlɛvolɛ Yizikeɛle, mɔɔ me ze a le Buzi la mewɔ Dwuuma mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ, bɛ nee bɛ ɛhɔ nlɔnu la avinli wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa. Na menwunle kɛ anwuma ɛbuke, na Nyamenle yele ɔ nwo hilele me. 2 (Kenle ko ne, ɛnee bɛhyele Dwuda Belemgbunli Gyɛhɔyaken bɛhɔle nlɔnu wɔ Babelɔn la yeli ɛvolɛ nnu.) 3Na Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa wɔ Babelonia azɛlɛ zo; eza mendele Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi ne wɔ me nu.
4Memanle me nye zo la, menwunle kɛ ahumu vi ɛbɔ nu afoa nu ɛlɛba. Ɛnee amungu ne le kpole kpalɛ na wienyi kpole bie ɛbɛnra ɛyia ye. Senle vi amungu ne anu ɛlɛtudu, na debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ kɔbele mɔɔ ɛlɛta la wɔ senle ne anu. 5 Akee menwunle debie bie mɔɔ zɔho tease abɔdeɛ la nna. Na kɛ bɛde la ɛne: bɛle kɛ menli la, 6noko ko biala anyunlu nna, yɛɛ ɔlɛ ndɛbalɛ nna. 7Bɛ gyakɛ tenletenle, yɛɛ bɛ gyakɛ taboa ne mɔ le kɛ ɛnlankɛ nyinli ndwɛlɛ la, na bɛta kɛ kɔbele mɔɔ bɛbolo nwolɛ la. 8Wɔ bɛ ndɛba nna nna ne mɔ mɔɔ duodua bɛ la abo, ko biala lɛ sonla ɛsalɛ nna. Ɛsalɛ ko wɔ ndɛbalɛ ko abo. Kɛ bɛ nyunlu nee bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ de la ɛne: 9Bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ kpulokpula zolɛ, yɛɛ bɛmaa bɛ nwo zo na bɛlɛkɔ a, bɛkɔ fɔɔnwo; biala ɛmpɛne ɔ nwo anzɛɛ ɛngakyi ɔ nwo.
10 Bɛ nyunlu ne mɔ kɛ de la ɛne: ko biala anyunlu nna; ɔ nyunlu ko le sonla nyunlu, ye fema zo le awenade nyunlu, ye bɛne zo le ɛnlankɛ nyinli nyunlu, yɛɛ ɔ nzi le kɔleɛ nyunlu. 11Bɛmemanle bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ nwiɔ nwiɔ zo mɔɔ ko biala ɛdeɛ ko ati kpula ɔ gɔnwo mɔɔ bikye ye la ɛdeɛ ne ati, yɛɛ ndɛbalɛ nwiɔ nwiɔ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛha la betɛbeta bɛ nwo. 12Ko biala tu ɔ bo a ɔkɔ ɔ nyunlu fɔɔnwo; ɛleka biala mɔɔ sunsum ne kɛva bɛ kɛdu kɛdenrɛ la, biala ɛmpɛne ɔ nwo.
13Wɔ tease abɔdeɛ nna ne mɔ avinli, debie bie mɔɔ ɛdɔlɔ guaanye kɛ senle samɛnlankɛ, na ɔle kɛ tɛkɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛsɔ la wɔ ɛkɛ, na ɔsɔ ɔkpɔsa tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ anu. Ye senle ne ta kpole kpalɛ, yɛɛ ɛsɛnlɛmanye kpakye fi nuhua finde. 14Tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ noko tudu agyakɛ kɔ ba kɛ ɛsɛnlɛmanye mɔɔ kɛkpakye la.
15Mɔɔ meneanle tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ la, menwunle kɛ ehwili nna gyigyi bɛ nwo ɛkɛ, ko biala ehwili ko. 16Ehwili nna ne amuala zɔho bɛ nwo, na bɛyɛ bɛ kɛ asɛɛ ehwili vea ehwili nu, yɛɛ bɛ nwo ta kɛ ezukoa bolɛ. 17Saa bɛtu bɛ bo bɛlɛkɔ a, bɛtia bɛ gyakɛ nna ne mɔ azo bɛkɔ bɛ tɛbanu ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛmpɛne bɛ nwo a. 18 Ehwili nna ne mɔ amuala dedɛ bɛ gyakɛ ahutukpunli mɔɔ mbaka anzɛɛ mbulalɛ beɛbea nuhua, yɛɛ egyakɛ kutukpunli ko biala anwo le ɛnyelɛ dɔɔnwo. 19Saa tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ tu bɛ bo a, ɛnee ehwili ne mɔ ɛdu bɛ bo, saa bɛmaa bɛ nwo zo a, ɛnee ehwili ne mɔ noko ɛmaa bɛ nwo zo. 20Ɛleka biala mɔɔ sunsum ne vale bɛ dule denrɛle la, bɛhɔle, yɛɛ ehwili ne mɔ hɔle bie, ɔluakɛ tease abɔdeɛ nna ne mɔ sunsum ne wɔ ehwili ne mɔ anu. 21Yemɔti saa tease abɔdeɛ nna ne mɔ tu bɛ bo, anzɛɛ gyinla, anzɛɛ maa bɛ nwo zo a, ehwili ne mɔ yɛ zɔhane ala. Ɔluakɛ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ sunsum ne wɔ ehwili ne mɔ anu.
22 Tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ ati zo anwuma, ninyɛne ahutukpunli bie mɔɔ ta hyɛɛnye kɛ ezukoa bolɛ la hendɛhenda ɛkɛ. 23Tease abɔdeɛ nna ne mɔ ɛdɛlɛdɛlɛ bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ nwiɔ nwiɔ anu mɔɔ ko kpula ɔ gɔnwo ɛdeɛ ne, yɛɛ bɛva nwiɔ bɛhedɛheda bɛ nwo na bɛgyigyi ninyɛne ahutukpunli ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛlɛta la abo. 24 Mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ la, mendele kɛ ɛnee bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ anu ɛlɛsu kɛ azule mɔɔ lua awolɛ nu, ɔle kɛ Tumivolɛ Nyamenle ne ɛlɛkulu la, na ɔle kɛ ɛlɔne kpole bie ɛlɛyɛ alɛra la. Mɔɔ bɛkɛgyinla la, ɛnee bɛgua bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ aze. 25Saa bɛgyinla na bɛgua bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ aze a, ɛnelɛ vi ninyɛne ahutukpunli ne mɔ mɔɔ hendɛhenda bɛ ti zo la azo ba.
26Wɔ ninyɛne ahutukpunli ne mɔ mɔɔ hendɛhenda bɛ ti zo anwuma la azo, debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ belemgbunli ebia, mɔɔ bɛva ezukoa bolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye safaya la a bɛyɛle la gyi zolɛ, na debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla la de nuhua. 27Deɛ ne mɔɔ de ebia ne anu la anwuma toonwo mɔɔ badwu ɔ nze zo la ta kɛ kɔbele mɔɔ ɛlɛta la, na yeyɛ kɛ asɛɛ debie mɔɔ senle ɛbɔ ɛyia ye la; akee menwunle kɛ ɔvi ɔ nze zo toonwo mɔɔ badwu ye aze la le kɛ senle na wienyi kpole kpalɛ ɛbɔ ɛyia ye. 28Wienyi ne le kɛ ezule mɔɔ ɛmunla la nyangondonle ne mɔɔ kɛdo la. Kɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne sɔhovolɛ de la ɛne.
Nyamenle fɛlɛ Yizikeɛle ayɛ ye kpɔmanvolɛ
Mɔɔ menwunle ɛhye la, membutule me nye aze, na mendele awie ane kɛ ɔlɛtendɛ.

english_text:
The Lord Chooses Ezekiel
1The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, I want you to stand up and listen.” 2After he said this, his Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
3Ezekiel, I am sending you to the people of Israel. They are just like their ancestors who rebelled against me and refused to stop. 4They are stubborn and hardheaded. But I, the Lord God, have chosen you to tell them what I say. 5Those rebels may not even listen, but at least they will know that a prophet has come to them.
6Don't be afraid of them or of anything they say. You may think you're in the middle of a thorn patch or a bunch of scorpions. But be brave 7and preach my message to them, whether they choose to listen or not. 8Ezekiel, don't rebel against me, as they have done. Instead, listen to everything I tell you.
And now, Ezekiel, open your mouth and eat what I am going to give you.
9 Just then, I saw a hand stretched out toward me. And in it was a scroll. 10The hand opened the scroll, and both sides of it were filled with words of sadness, mourning, and grief.
translation_text:
1Ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, dwazo gyinla ɛ gyakɛ anu, na me nee wɔ tendɛ.” 2Mɔɔ ɔdendɛle ɔhilele me la, Nyamenle Sunsum ne wolole me na ɔmanle mendwazole mengyinlanle, na mendele kɛ ɔlɛtendɛ yeahile me. 3Ɔse, “Sonla ra, mesoa wɔ wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo ɛkɛ. Bɛle maanle mɔɔ te atua a, na bɛde me nwo atua. Bɛ nee bɛ ze mɔ bɛtietia me mɛla zo toonwo a yeradwu ɛnɛ a. 4Eza bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛzua anyetele, yɛɛ bɛmbu me. Mesoa wɔ wɔ bɛ nwo ɛkɛ na wɔahɔze bɛ kɛ, ‘Kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle mese la ɛne.’ 5Na saa bɛtie wɔ anzɛɛ bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdie wɔ a, bɛbanwu kɛ amuanrɛɛ bɛlɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ wɔ bɛ avinli, ɔluakɛ bɛdabɛ mumua ne bɛle atuadelɛma.
6“Na wɔmɔ, sonla ra, mmasulo bɛ, yɛɛ mmasulo mɔɔ bɛkeha la. Ɔbayɛ kɛ ɛla mbowule nu anzɛɛ ɛde nyamenleakɛlɛ avinli. Noko mmasulo bɛ ngehanleɛ yɛɛ mmamaa bɛ anyehoanlɛ ne mɔ tu wɔ ahonle, ɔluakɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛde atua a. 7Saa bɛtie wɔ anzɛɛ bɛkpo kɛ bɛnrɛdie wɔ bɔbɔ a, ka me edwɛkɛ ne kile bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛde atua a.
8“Sonla ra, tie mɔɔ melɛka meahile wɔ la. Mmate atua kɛ menli ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ la. Buke ɛ nloa na di mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa wɔ la.” 9 Na menwunle kɛ bɛdende ɛsalɛ bie me nwo na ɔlɛ nwoma mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ nu la. 10Ɔdɛlɛle nwoma ne anu wɔ me nyunlu ɛkɛ, na ɛnee bɛhɛlɛ ɔ kunlu nee ɔ nzi amuala. Mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛle la le awolɛyelɛ, nyanelilɛ nee munzule edwɛkɛ ngome.

english_text:
1 The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, after you eat this scroll, go speak to the people of Israel.”
2-3He handed me the scroll and said, “Eat this and fill up on it.” So I ate the scroll, and it tasted sweet as honey.
4The Lord said:
Ezekiel, I am sending you to your own people. 5-6They are Israelites, not some strangers who speak a foreign language you can't understand. If I were to send you to foreign nations, they would listen to you. 7But the people of Israel will refuse to listen, because they have refused to listen to me. All of them are stubborn and hardheaded, 8so I will make you as stubborn as they are. 9You will be so determined to speak my message that nothing will stop you. I will make you hard like a diamond, and you'll have no reason to be afraid of those arrogant rebels.
10Listen carefully to everything I say and then think about it. 11Then go to the people who were brought here to Babylonia with you and tell them you have a message from me, the Lord God. Do this, whether they listen to you or not.
12The Spirit lifted me up, and as the glory of the Lord started to leave, I heard a loud, thundering noise behind me. 13It was the sound made by the creatures' wings as they brushed against each other, and by the rumble of the wheels beside them. 14Then the Spirit carried me away.
The Lord's power had taken complete control of me, and I was both annoyed and angry.
15When I was back with the others living at Abib Hill near the Chebar River, I sat among them for seven days, shocked at what had happened to me.
The Lord Appoints Ezekiel To Stand Watch
(Ezekiel 33.1-9)
16Seven days after I had seen the brightness of the Lord's glory, the Lord said:
17Ezekiel, son of man, I have appointed you to stand watch for the people of Israel. So listen to what I say, then warn them for me. 18When I tell wicked people they will die because of their sins, you must warn them to turn from their sinful ways so they won't be punished. If you refuse, you are responsible for their death. 19However, if you do warn them, and they keep on sinning, they will die because of their sins, and you will be innocent.
20Now suppose faithful people start sinning, and I decide to put stumbling blocks in their paths to make them fall. They deserve to die because of their sins. So if you refuse to warn them, I will forget about the times they were faithful, and I will hold you responsible for their death. 21But if you do warn them, and they listen to you and stop sinning, I will let them live. And you will be innocent.
Ezekiel Cannot Talk
22The Lord took control of me and said, “Stand up! Go into the valley, and I will talk with you there.”
23I immediately went to the valley, where I saw the brightness of the Lord's glory, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River, and I bowed with my face to the ground. 24His Spirit took control of me and lifted me to my feet. Then the Lord said:
Go back and lock yourself in your house! 25You will be tied up to keep you inside, 26and I will make you unable to talk or to warn those who have rebelled against me. 27But the time will come, when I will tell you what to say, and you will again be able to speak my message. Some of them will listen; others will be stubborn and refuse to listen.
translation_text:
1 Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, di mɔɔ meva memaa wɔ la. Di nwoma ne na kɔ, kɔdendɛ kile Yizilayɛma amuala.”
2Yemɔti membukele me nloa, na ɔvale nwoma ne ɔmanle me kɛ menli. 3Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, di nwoma ɛhye mɔɔ melɛfa meamaa wɔ la maa ɛ ko ɛyi.” Menlile, na ɔyɛle me nloa anu menlemenle kɛ wolɛ.
4Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, kɔ Yizilayɛma ɛkɛ na ka me nloa edwɛkɛ ne kile bɛ. 5Menzoa wɔ wɔ menli mɔɔ ka ɛdendɛlɛ gyɛne na bɛ aneɛ ne yɛ se la anu. Melɛsoa wɔ wɔ Yizilayɛma ɛkɛ. Menzoa wɔ wɔ menli ngakyile mɔɔ asolo bɛ ɛdendɛlɛ na bɛ aneɛ ne yɛ se, mɔɔ ɛnrɛde ɔ bo la ɛkɛ. 6Saa mesoa wɔ wɔ menli zɛhae bie mɔ ɛkɛ ne a, bɛbadie wɔ. 7Noko Yizilayɛma ɛdeɛ, bɛnrɛdie wɔ, ɔluakɛ bɛngulo kɛ bɛtie me ne, ɔboalekɛ Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti ati anu le bile, yɛɛ bɛ ahonle ɛsolo. 8Kɛkala, mebamaa ɛdawɔ noko wɔayɛ se na meamaa wɔasolo kɛ bɛdabɛ la. 9Memaa ɛ ti ayɛ se kpole kpalɛ adɛla ɛtwɛlɛboɔ. Yemɔti mmasulo bɛ, yɛɛ mmamaa bɛ anyehoanlɛ ne mɔ tu ɛ kunlu, ɔluakɛ bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛde atua a.”
10Nyamenle zɔle zolɛ hanle kɛ, “Sonla ra, tie mɔɔ melɛka meahile wɔ la boɛ na kakye debie biala mɔɔ mebaha meahile wɔ la. 11Kɔ wɔ menli ne mɔɔ wɔ nlɔnu la ɛkɛ ne, na saa bɛtie wɔ o, bɛandie wɔ o, ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Kɛ medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese la ɛne.’ ”
12Akee Nyamenle Sunsum ne manle me zo, na mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne ɛlɛkpogya ɔ nwo zo avi ɔ bo zo ne la, mendele azɛlɛkpusulɛ ɛnelɛ kpole bie wɔ me nzi nehane. 13Tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ andɛba ne mɔ mɔɔ keha bɛ nwo, yɛɛ ehwili ne mɔ anwo alɛra ne a le kɛ azɛlɛkpusulɛ la. 14Nyamenle Sunsum ne wolole me na ɔmanle me zo ɔhɔle. Ɛnee ɛya ɛhu me kpole. Na ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne tumi ne wɔ me nwo zo kpole. 15Membale bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ nlɔnu la ɛkɛ wɔ Tɛle Abebe, wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ nlɔnu la wɔ la. Me nee bɛ dɛnlanle kenle nsuu, na mɔɔ mendele nee mɔɔ menwunle ye la zinle me nwo.
Ɛdɛnkɛma maa Yizikeɛle ayɛ sinzavolɛ
(Yiz 33.1-9)
16Kenle nsuu ne anzi, Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 17Ɔse, “Sonla ra, meyɛ wɔ Yizilayɛma sinzavolɛ. Kenle biala mɔɔ ɛkɛde edwɛkɛ ɛkɛvi me nloa anu la, ɛbaha wɔahile bɛ wɔabɔ bɛ kɔkɔ wɔamaa me. 18Saa mese amumuyɛnli bie kɛ ɔbawu, na wɔanga wɔangile ye wɔamaa yeangakyi ye subane, yeanlie ye ɛkɛla ngoane a, ɔbawu kɛ ɔle ɛtanenli, na mebabiza wɔ ye ewule nwo edwɛkɛ. 19Na saa ɛbɔ amumuyɛnli ne kɔkɔ, na yeangakyi ye subane a, ɔbawu, na wɔmɔ, ɛlɛ wɔ ngoane, ɛnli ɛzonle.
20“Saa tenlenenli bɔ ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi ɛtane, ɔyɛ amumuyɛ a, mebamaa yeadu koti. Kɛmɔ ɛtɛbɔle ye kɔkɔ la ati, ɔbawu wɔ ye ɛtane ti, yɛɛ ye debie kpalɛ biala mɔɔ ɔyɛle la, menrɛhakye ye bieko; na ye ewule ne ɛdeɛ, mebabiza wɔ nwolɛ edwɛkɛ. 21Noko akee, saa ɛbɔ tenlenenli zɔhane kɔkɔ kɛ ɔmmayɛ ɛtane ne na ɔgyakyi, yeannyia yeanyɛ ɛtane ne a, ɔbanyia ngoane kɛ ɔdiele wɔ kɔkɔbɔlɛ ne a, yɛɛ ɛdawɔ noko wɔlie wɔ ngoane.”
Yizikeɛle ɛnrɛhola tendɛ
22Na Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi ne dwule me nwo zo kpole kpalɛ, na ɔzele me kɛ, “Dwazo kɔ azɛlɛ sɛsɛ wienyi ne azo lɔ. Ɛkɛ ne a mebadendɛ meahile wɔ a.”
23Yemɔti mendwazole mengɔle azɛlɛ sɛsɛ wienyi ne azo lɔ, na menwunle Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne wɔ ɛkɛ, ɔle kɛ anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ menwunle ye wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa la, na membutule mutule nu. 24Na Nyamenle Sunsum ne wolole me na mendwazole mengyinlanle me gyakɛ anu, na ɔdendɛle ɔzele me kɛ, “Kɔ kɔdo ɛ nwo anlenkɛ nu wɔ ɛdawɔ wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ. 25Na wɔmɔ, sonla ra, bɛbava nyɛma bɛakyekye wɔ mɔɔ ɛnrɛhola menli nu finde a. 26Mebamaa ɛ tafinlima abutu na wɔadɔ mumule mɔɔ ɛnrɛhola tendɛ na wɔabɔ bɛ kɔkɔ a, ɔboalekɛ bɛle atuadelɛma. 27Na saa me nee wɔ tendɛ a, mebazianyi ɛ tafinlima na wɔaze bɛ kɛ, ‘Kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne.’ Mɔɔ kɛdie la, maa ɔdie, mɔɔ kɛkpo noko kɛ ɔnrɛdie la, gyakyi ye, ɔluakɛ bɛle atuadelɛma.”

english_text:
Ezekiel Acts Out an Attack on Jerusalem
The Lord said:
1Ezekiel, son of man, find a brick and sketch a picture of Jerusalem on it. 2Then prepare to attack the brick as if it were a real city. Build a dirt mound and a ramp up to the top and surround the brick with enemy camps. On every side put large wooden poles as though you were going to break down the gate to the city. 3Set up an iron pan like a wall between you and the brick. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
4-5After that, lie down on your left side and stay there for 390 days as a sign of Israel's punishment—one day for each year of its suffering. 6Then turn over and lie on your right side 40 more days. That will be a sign of Judah's punishment—one day for each year of its suffering.
7The brick stands for Jerusalem, so attack it! Stare at it and shout angry warnings. 8I will tie you up, so you can't leave until your attack has ended.
9Get a large bowl. Then mix together wheat, barley, beans, lentils, and millet, and make some bread. This is what you will eat for the 390 days you are lying down. 10Eat only a small loaf of bread each day 11and drink only two large cups of water. 12Use dried human waste to start a fire, then bake the bread on the coals where everyone can watch you. 13When I scatter the people of Israel among the nations, they will also have to eat food that is unclean, just as you must do.
14I said, “Lord God, please don't make me do that! Never in my life have I eaten food that would make me unacceptable to you. I've never eaten anything that died a natural death or was killed by a wild animal or that you said was unclean.”
15The Lord replied, “Instead of human waste, I will let you bake your bread on a fire made from cow manure. 16Ezekiel, the people of Jerusalem will starve. They will have so little food and water that they will be afraid and hopeless. 17Everyone will be shocked at what is happening, and, because of their sins, they will die a slow death.”
translation_text:
Yizikeɛle yɛ debie ahile kɛ bɛbazi bɛabɛnra bɛayia Gyɛlusalɛm la
1Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Wɔmɔ, sonla ra, fa belekese ko to ɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ, na koɔhoa zolɛ maa ɔgyinla ɛkɛ ɔmaa suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm. 2Akee yɛ debie mɔɔ kile kɛ ɛlɔnema ɛbɛnra ɛyia ye la. Fu kuma wɔ nwolɛ bɛnra yia, kuohua ɛnwea nwolɛ, yɛ azokoɛleɛ na siezie konle ninyɛne bɛnra yia ye. 3Fa kyɛnze tɛtɛlɛ yɛ bane wa ɛdawɔ nee suakpole ne bɛ avinli. Akee yɛ kɛ ɛ nee suakpole ne ɛlɛko. Bɛva suakpole ne aze ala ɛne, na wɔmɔ yɛɛ wɔva suakpole ne aze a. Ɛhye le sɛkɛlɛneɛ maa Yizilayɛma.
4-5“Akee da ɛhyɛne zo wɔ wɔ bɛne zo, na mebava Yizilayɛma amuala ɛtane nwo ndeanlɛ meagua ɛ nwo zo. Ɛbala ɛkɛ ne kenle ɛya nsa abulahɔnla wɔanwu amaneɛ wɔ bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ati. Wɔ amaneɛnwunlɛ kenle ko biala gyi ɛkɛ maa ɛvolɛ ko biala ndeanlɛ. 6Saa ɛwie ɛhye a, ɛbahakyi ɛ nwo wɔala ɛhyɛne zo wɔ wɔ fema zo, na wɔanwu amaneɛ kenle abulanla wɔ Dwudama ati, kenle ko biala le wɔ ɛvolɛ ko amaneɛnwunlɛ.
7“Akee maa ɛ nye ɛgyinla Gyɛlusalɛm mɔɔ ɛlɔnema ɛbɛnra ɛyia ye la anwo. Sua botokuma na ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne tia ye. 8Nea, mebava nyɛma meakyekye wɔ kpalɛ mɔɔ ɛnrɛhola ɛ nwo kakyi kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛwie suakpole ne fa la.
9“Akee fa hwiiti, baale, aluba akpatala nee alubandenra (somgbotekɛ), yɛɛ atoko; fa bɛ muala gua kyɛnze nu fete yɛ kpanwo. Aleɛ mɔɔ ɛbali, wɔ kenle ɛya nsa abulahɔnla ne anu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛla ɛhyɛne zo la ɛne. 10Kenle ko biala ɛbali aleɛ ko ala, yɛɛ aleɛ ne mɔɔ ɛbali la ɛnlomboɛ ɔwɔ kɛ to tone nu gelamo ɛya nwiɔ abulasa. 11Eza ɛbanlo nzule ekyi bie, kɛyɛ kɔpo nwiɔ kenle ko. 12Ɛbava sonla ebinli welera wɔawuda senle wɔadondo wɔ kpanwo ne wɔ bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ wɔali.”
13Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Zɛhae adenle zo yɛɛ Yizilayɛma bali bɛ aleɛ mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde la, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔbɔ bɛ asande menwɔhɔgua maanle gyɛne gyɛne zo la a.”
14Na membuale kɛ, “Kyɛkyɛ, Awulae Nyamenle! Nɔhalɛ, ɔvi me ngakula nu toonwo mɔɔ yeradwu ɛnɛ la metɛdile debie mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔ ngome yewu anzɛɛ nane kpole bie ɛtete ye nu la, yɛɛ debie nvoanle biala ɛtɛkpulale me nloa na evinli aha me.”
15Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Ɔle kpalɛ. Ɛnee mebamaa wɔava ɛnlankɛ ebinli na wɔagyakyi sonla ebinli ne, na wɔadondo wɔ kpanwo ne zolɛ.”
16Na ɔvale ɔzɔle zolɛ kɛ, “Sonla ra, memaa ɛhɔne azi Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛbava sulosulo bɛazuzu bɛ aleɛ na bɛali na bɛava arɛlebɔlɛ bɛazuzu bɛ nzule na bɛanlo. 17Mebayɛ ɛhye meamaa bɛ nzule asesa na bɛ aleɛ awie, bɛbava arɛlebɔlɛ bɛanleɛnlea bɛ nyunlu, na bɛ ndeanlɛ ne bamaa bɛanwa.”

english_text:
Jerusalem's Coming Destruction
The Lord said:
1Ezekiel, son of man, get a sharp sword and use it to cut off your hair and beard. Weigh the hair and divide it into three equal piles. 2After you attack the brick that stands for Jerusalem, burn one pile of your hair on the brick. Chop up the second pile and let the small pieces of hair fall around the brick. Throw the third pile into the wind, and I will strike it with my own sword.
3Keep a few of the hairs and wrap them in the hem of your clothes. 4Then pull out a few of those hairs and throw them in the fire, so they will also burn. This fire will spread, destroying everyone in Israel.
5I am the Lord God, and I have made Jerusalem the most important place in the world, and all other nations admire it. 6But the people of Jerusalem rebelled and refuse to obey me. They ignored my laws and have become even more sinful than the nations around them.
7So tell the people of Jerusalem:
I am the Lord God! You have refused to obey my laws and teachings, and instead you have obeyed the laws of the surrounding nations. You have become more rebellious than any of them! 8Now all those nations will watch as I turn against you and punish you 9for your sins. Your punishment will be more horrible than anything I've ever done or will ever do again. 10 Parents will be so desperate for food that they will eat their own children, and children will eat their parents. Those who survive this horror will be scattered in every direction.
11Your sins have disgusted me and made my temple unfit as a place to worship me. So I swear by my own life that I will cut you down and show you no pity. 12A third of you will die here in Jerusalem from disease or starvation. Another third will be killed in war. And I will scatter the last third of you in every direction, then track you down and kill you.
13You will feel my fierce anger until I have finished taking revenge. Then you will know that I, the Lord, was furious because of your disobedience. 14Every passerby will laugh at your destruction. Foreign nations 15will insult you and make fun of you, but they will also be shocked and terrified at what I did in my anger. 16I will destroy your crops until you starve to death, and disasters will strike you like arrows. 17 Starvation and wild animals will kill your children. I'll punish you with horrible diseases, and your enemies will strike you down with their swords. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_text:
Yizikeɛle pepɛ ɔ ti enrinli
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Na wɔmɔ, o sonla ra, fa dadeɛ mɔɔ yɛ nla kpalɛ la kakyi dadeɛ dɛma, na fa kpa ɛ ti enrinli nee ɛ kɛsa amuala. Suzu enrinli ne mɔɔ ɛkɛkpa la wɔ tone zo na akee kyɛ nu nsa. 2Gua ko senle nu yela ye wɔ suakpole ne avinli, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛkɛva suakpole ne ɛkɛwie la; fa ko pepɛ nu ngyikyi ngyikyi kponde suakpole ne anwo yia, na kponde ko ne mɔɔ ɛha la anwoma ne anu, na medame, akee mebava me dadeɛ ne meazi mealɔ bɛ nu. 3Fa ɛkpɔ ɛhye mɔ biala anu ekyi kyekye ye wɔ wɔ tɛladeɛ ne anloa. 4Ɛbava ɛhye wɔagua senle nu wɔamaa yeazɔ. Ɛbanwu kɛ senle vi nuhua bazɔ ahɔ Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu amuala.”
5Kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne: “Gyɛlusalɛm ɛne. Meva ye mezie ewiade avinli, memaa maanle maanle ɛbɔ ɛyia ye. 6Noko yede atua amumuyɛ nu ala kɛ ɔnrɛli me mɛla ne mɔ nee me ngyehyɛlɛ zo, bɔbɔ yedɛla maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia ye la amuala. 7Yemɔti kɛ medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese la ɛne: Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ ɛ nzo yɛ se tɛla maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia wɔ, na wɔanli me ngyehyɛlɛ nee me mɛla ne mɔ azo, na wɔva ɛ nwo wɔtolo maanle maanle zɔhane mɔ la, 8medame Awulae Nyamenle, kɛ mese la ɛne: Nea, medame, ɛhɛe, medame mumua ne, meyɛ wɔ kpɔvolɛ. Mebadea wɔ meamaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwu ye. 9Ɔlua bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ ati, mɔɔ mebava meahile bɛ la, metɛfale bie metɛkilele awie ɛlɛ, yɛɛ menrɛyɛ ye bieko ɛlɛ. 10 Ye zɔhane ati, selɛma bahu bɛ mra mrenya ali na mralɛ mrenya ahu bɛ ze mɔ ali. Mebadea bɛ kpalɛ, na bɛ nuhua mɔɔ kɛha la, mebabɔ bɛ asande meahɔgua ɛleka muala.
11“Zɔhane ati medame tease Awulae Nyamenle, mese, suzuamgba ala mɔɔ bɛva bɛ ninyɛmunli nee bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛgua me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne evinli la, mebabɔ bɛ bo zo. Menrɛvavi bie yɛɛ menrɛze anwunvɔne. 12Ɛhɔne nee ewulenzane bahyɛ bɛ nuhua nsa ahu ko; nwiɔ ne mɔɔ baha la, ko bawu konle nu; na meabɔ ko ne mɔɔ baha la asande na meava konle meazi bɛ zo.
13“Zɛhae yɛɛ bɛbanwu me ɛyavalɛ ne a; mebakpokpo ye kɔsɔɔti meagua bɛ ti zo na me kunlu adwo, na bɛanwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, meva ɛya kpole a melɛtendɛ meahile bɛ a. 14Eza mebayɛ suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm suadu mɔɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia ye nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛse ɛke la, biala nwu ye a ɔsi ye amgbu a.
15“Saa me ɛya ne fo me na me sa sɔ wɔ nu kɛ metea wɔ a, maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia wɔ la bazi wɔ amgbu, na yeayɛ kɔkɔbɔlɛ yeamaa bɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a! 16Mebamaa sane nee ɛhɔne ara bɛ nwo zo na bɛade ye nyane kɛ ɛda mɔɔ ɛlɛwowɔ bɛ azɛkye bɛ la. 17 Mebamaa ɛhɔne nee nanemgbole arahu bɛ mra, na meamaa ewulenzane, konle nee kpolera adɔ bɛ avinli ahu bɛ. Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a!”

english_text:
Israel Is Doomed
1The Lord God said:
2Ezekiel, son of man, face the hills of Israel and tell them:
3Listen, you mountains and hills, and every valley and gorge! I, the Lord, am about to turn against you and crush all the places where foreign gods are worshiped. 4Every altar will be smashed, and in front of the idols I will put to death the people who worship them. 5Dead bodies and bones will be lying around the idols and the altars. 6Every town in Israel will be destroyed to make sure that each shrine, idol, and altar is smashed—everything the Israelites made will be a pile of ruins. 7All over the country, your people will die. And those who survive will know that I, the Lord, did these things. 8I will let some of the people live through this punishment, but I will scatter them among the nations, 9where they will be prisoners. And when they think of me, they will realize that they disgraced me by rebelling and by worshiping idols. They will hate themselves for the evil things they did, 10and they will know that I am the Lord and that my warnings must be taken seriously.
11The Lord God then said:
Ezekiel, beat your fists together and stomp your feet in despair! Moan in sorrow, because the people of Israel have done disgusting things and now will be killed by enemy troops, or they will die from starvation and disease. 12Those who live far away will be struck with deadly diseases. Those who live nearby will be killed in war. And the ones who are left will starve to death. I will let loose my anger on them! 13These people used to offer incense to idols at altars built on hills and mountaintops and in the shade of large oak trees. But when they see dead bodies lying around those altars, they will know that I am the Lord. 14I will make their country a barren wasteland, from the Southern Desert to the town of Diblah in the north. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma kyi awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2Ɔse, “Sonla ra, fa ɛ nye su Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ na fa me nrɛlaleɛ kɔmaa bɛ. 3Ka kile bɛ kɛ: Bɛmɛ Yizilayɛ awoka, bɛdie Awulae Nyamenle ne edwɛkɛ ne. Awulae Nyamenle ne se, bɛmɛ awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi, mbɔnza nee ahuma, bɛnlea na medame, ɛhɛe, medame, mebava konle meadoa bɛ, na meazɛkye bɛ ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsonle la. 4Mebabubu bɛ azukponle ne mɔ nee bɛ ɛyɛlɛ azukponle ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti, na meava bɛ avunli mearagua bɛ mmonle ne mɔ anyunlu. 5Mebava Yizilayɛma avunli meagua bɛ mmonle ne mɔ anyunlu, na meazande bɛ mbowule wɔ bɛ azukponle ne mɔ anwo. 6Mebamaa bɛ azuamgbole kɔsɔɔti adɔ mgbane, na meabubu bɛ mmonle nee bɛ azukponle ne mɔ amuala, meazɛkye bɛ ɛyɛlɛ azukponle ne mɔ, na meaminli bɛ sa anloa gyima bo zo. 7Bɛbahuhu menli sesakaa wɔ bɛ avinli na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
8“Noko mebamaa bɛ bie mɔ avi ɛsalɛ na bɛade bɛakponde maanle maanle zo, amaa saa bɛte bɛkponde maanle maanle ne mɔ azo a, 9bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛvi ɛsalɛ la ahakye me wɔ maanle maanle zɔhane mɔ mɔɔ hyele bɛ nuokɛ hɔle la avinli. Mebaha bɛ ahonle ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ manle bɛdele me nwo atua la aze na meazi bɛ nye ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛfa bɛkpondɛ awozonle bɛsonle bɛ la; na bɛ nwo bayɛ nyiane kpole wɔ bɛ ngome bɛ nye zo wɔ amumuyɛ nee bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la ati. 10Na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma, na edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ menganle kɛ mebamaa munzule ɛhye ado bɛ la, meanga ye mgbane.”
11Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Bɔ ɛ sa nu! Si ɛ gyakɛ aze! Ka kɛ, ‘Egya e!’ wɔ Yizilayɛma munzule nyɛleɛ ne mɔ ati. Ɔluakɛ bɛbawuwu wɔ konle nee ewule mɔɔ bazi la anu. 12Bɛ nuhua mɔɔ wɔ moa la ewulenzane bahu bɛ, bɛ nuhua mɔɔ wɔ sua nu la badɔ dadeɛ nloa wɔ konle nu; yɛɛ bɛ nuhua mɔɔ baha la, ɛhɔne nee sane bahu bɛ. Ɛhye yɛɛ bɛbava bɛanwu kɛ me ɛyavalɛ ne ɛnlomboɛ si de la a. 13Bɛ avunli bayɛ bɛ awozonle ne mɔ avunli, bɛ azukponle ne mɔ azo, awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, bɛ egyane ne mɔ abo, bɛ oku mbaka bubuzuu ne mɔ abo, yɛɛ bɛ ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛzonlenle la totɔɔ, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 14Mebadenrɛ me sa na meazɛkye bɛ maanle ne. Mebamaa ɛleka biala mɔɔ Yizilayɛma de la adɔ mgbane, ɔvi nyiakɛ fienemgbole ne anloa, yeahɔdwu sɔlɔ lɔ suakpole ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Relebela la azo, na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_text:
Disaster Is Near
1The Lord God said:
2Ezekiel, son of man, tell the people of Israel that I am saying:
Israel will soon come to an end! Your whole country is about to be destroyed 3as punishment for your disgusting sins. I, the Lord, am so angry 4that I will show no pity. I will punish you for the evil you've done, and you will know that I am the Lord.
5There's never been anything like the coming disaster. 6And when it comes, your life will be over. 7You people of Israel are doomed! Soon there will be panic on the mountaintops instead of celebration. 8I will let loose my anger and punish you for the evil things you've done. You'll get what you deserve. 9Your sins are so terrible, that you'll get no mercy from me. Then you will know that I, the Lord, have punished you.
10Disaster is near! Injustice and arrogance are everywhere, 11and violent criminals run free. None of you will survive the disaster, and everything you own and value will be shattered. 12The time is coming when everyone will be ruined. Buying and selling will stop, 13and people who sell property will never get it back, because all of you must be punished for your sins. And I won't change my mind!
14A signal has been blown on the trumpet, and weapons are prepared for battle. But no one goes to war, because in my anger I will strike down everyone in Israel.
Israel Is Surrounded
The Lord said to the people of Israel:
15War, disease, and starvation are everywhere! People who live in the countryside will be killed in battle, and those who live in towns will die from starvation or deadly diseases. 16Anyone who survives will escape into the hills, like doves who leave the valleys to find safety.
All of you will moan because of your sins. 17Your hands will tremble, and your knees go limp. 18You will put on sackcloth to show your sorrow, but terror will overpower you. Shame will be written all over your faces, and you will shave your heads in despair. 19Your silver and gold will be thrown into the streets like garbage, because those are the two things that led you into sin, and now they cannot save you from my anger. They are not even worth enough to buy food. 20You took great pride in using your beautiful jewelry to make disgusting idols of foreign gods. So I will make your jewelry worthless.
21Wicked foreigners will rob and disgrace you. 22They will break into my temple and leave it unfit as a place to worship me, but I will look away and let it happen.
23Your whole country is in confusion! Murder and violence are everywhere in Israel, 24so I will tell the most wicked nations to come and take over your homes. They will put an end to the pride you have in your strong army, and they will make your places of worship unfit to use. 25You will be terrified and will desperately look for peace—but there will be no peace. 26One tragedy will follow another, and you'll hear only bad news. People will beg prophets to give them a message from me. Priests will stop teaching my Law, and wise leaders won't be able to give advice. 27Even your king and his officials will lose hope and cry in despair. Your hands will tremble with fear.
I will punish you for your sins and treat you the same way you have treated others. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_text:
Yizilayɛma awieleɛ ɛbikye
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2Ɔse, “Wɔmɔ, o sonla ra, mɔɔ medame Awulae Nyamenle melɛ ye meka meahile Yizilayɛma la ɛne: Yewie! Azɛlɛ ye muleɛ nna ne amuala ɛzɛkyelɛ ala ɛne!
3“Yizilayɛma, bɛ awieleɛ ne ala ɛne. Mebakpokpo me ɛya ne meagua bɛ nwo zo, na meabua bɛ ndɛne, kɛmɔ bɛ ndenle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛlua nu la si de la. Mebadea bɛ wɔ bɛ bɛkyi nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anwo. 4Menrɛvavi bie, yɛɛ menrɛze anwunvɔne. Mebadea bɛ, kɛmɔ bɛ ndenle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛlua nu la si de, na bɛtɛbɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ɛbɛla ne mɔ la, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”
5Kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne, “Munzule ɛdoa munzule ɛrɛla bɛ nwo zo! 6Bɛnlea, kɛ ɔlɛba ɛ! Yewie! Awieleɛ ne ɛra. Ye kɔsɔɔti gua bɛ nwo zo. 7O Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ye azo amra, munzule ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ. Mekɛ ne ɛdwu. Bɛ anyezota mekɛ ne ɛbikye; bɛ anyelielɛ wɔ awoka ne mɔ azo ɛwie.
8“Ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meawola me ɛya ne amuala meagua bɛ nwo zo, na meabua bɛ ndɛne, kɛmɔ bɛ ndenle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛlua nu la si de la. Mebadea bɛ wɔ bɛ bɛkyi nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anwo. 9Menrɛvavi bie, yɛɛ menrɛze anwunvɔne. Mebadea bɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtɛyɛ bɛ bɛkyi ninyɛne ne mɔ la, na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma, mɔɔ mekola meku bɛ a.
10“Bɛnlea, kenle ne ɛdwu! Bɛnlea, ɔlɛba! Bɛ anwubɛnyunlu mekɛ ɛdwu. Nzisi ɛbɔ ndotolo, adubɛnwo ɛwula nya. 11Basabasayɛlɛ ɛwie nyi ɛhakyi amumuyɛ baka. Bɛ nuhua biala ɛnrɛha. Bɛ anyiabɛnwo nee bɛ anwonyia baminli, yɛɛ biala ɛnrɛnyia ɔ nyunlu.
12“Mekɛ ne ɛlɛba; asɛɛ yedwu bɔbɔ. Bɛmmamaa mɔɔ tɔ la anye die, yɛɛ mɔɔ tɔne la mmadi nyane, ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛya ne wɔ bɛ kɔsɔɔti bɛ nwo zo. 13Ɔluakɛ mɔɔ tɔne la ɛnrɛzia ɛnrɛhɔkpondɛ mɔɔ yedɔne la abo zo, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔde ngoane nu la. Ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ɛya ne wɔ bɛ muala bɛ nwo zo, yɛɛ bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ ati, biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie ɔ nwo ngoane. 14Bɛbɔ aweɛne tendenle ne anu kɛ awie biala ɛboɔboa ɔ nwo; noko awie biala ɛngɔ konle nloa, ɔluakɛ me ɛya ne wɔ bɛ muala bɛ nwo zo.
Yizilayɛma ɛtane ne mɔ anwo ndeanlɛ
15“Bɛbayia konle wɔ gua zo, yɛɛ ɛhɔne nee ewulenzane bahu bɛ wɔ sua nu. Mɔɔ ɛnriandi ɛhɔ ɛbɔ nu la bawu dadeɛ nloa, yɛɛ ɛhɔne nee ewulenzane bahu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ sua zo la. 16Saa bie mɔ fi ɛsalɛ a, bɛbanriandi bɛahɔ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ, bɛbayɛ kɛ mbɔnza nu abubule, na bɛazu bɛ ɛtane. 17Bɛ sa bayɛ kpokpɔdwɔlɔɔ, na bɛ gyakɛ agbɔkɛ abili kɛ atɛ. 18Bɛbaheda ɛrele, na ɛzulolɛ ava bɛ aze. Bɛ nyunlu bayɛ nyiane nyiane ngome na bɛ ti zo adudu. 19Bɛbado bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule bɛagua mgbata zo, bɛ ezukoa nvutuke nwo ɛnrɛde, yɛɛ bɛ ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie bɛ ɛnrɛvi Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛya ne anu. Bɛnrɛhola bɛ ezukoa ne mɔ di bɛnrɛmaa bɛ ko ɛnrɛyi. Ɔluakɛ yemɔ a ɔle ɛtane mɔɔ manle bɛdule koti a. 20Bɛvale bɛ anwoneɛ ne mɔ bɛdule bɛ nwo, na bɛvale bɛyɛle bɛ munzule ananze ne mɔ bɛbɔle bɛkyi ɛbɛla. Yemɔti mebamaa yeayɛ bɛkyi debie yeamaa bɛ.
21“Mebamaa bɛadɔ agye wɔ nyɛvolɛ sa nu, yɛɛ amumuyɛma barave bɛ nwo ninyɛne na bɛagua nwolɛ evinli. 22Mebado me nye ɛbɔ nu meamaa bɛagua me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo evinli. Nwule bahɔva ɛkɛ ne, bɛagua ɛkɛ ne evinli na bɛayɛ ɛkɛ ne suadu.
23“Kɛmɔ suakpole ne azo ɛyɛ konle ngome na azɛlɛ ne azo ɛyɛ mogya ngome la, 24mebamaa maanle mɔɔ ati yɛ se kpalɛ la arava bɛ azua ne mɔ. Mebamaa bɛ anwosesebɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛtu bɛ nwo la aha aze, na evinli aha bɛ ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ. 25Saa abodelɛ ba a, bɛbakpondɛ anzonudwolɛ, noko bɛnrɛnyia bie. 26Munzule badoa munzule, yɛɛ huhuhuhu badoa huhuhuhu; bɛbakpondɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ bɛavi Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛkɛ, na Nyamenle mɛla ne baminli sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ ati anu, yɛɛ bɛnrɛnyia folɛdulɛ bɛnrɛvi mgbanyima ne mɔ ɛkɛ. 27Belemgbunli ne bali nyane, belemgbunli ara nrenya ne arɛle babɔ, na ɛzulolɛ bamaa menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la asa adwɔlɔdwɔlɔ. Mebadua bɛ kakɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo, na adenle mɔɔ bɛluale nu bɛbuale awie mɔ ndɛne la anu yɛɛ mebalua meabua bɛdabɛ noko bɛ ndɛne a. Na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_text:
Ezekiel Sees the Terrible Sins of Jerusalem
1Six years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, the leaders of Judah were meeting with me in my house. On the fifth day of the sixth month, the Lord God suddenly took control of me, 2 and I saw something in the shape of a human. This figure was like fire from the waist down, and it was bright as polished metal from the waist up. 3It reached out what seemed to be a hand and grabbed my hair. Then in my vision the Lord's Spirit lifted me into the sky and carried me to Jerusalem.
The Spirit took me to the north gate of the temple's inner courtyard, where there was an idol that disgusted the Lord and made him furious. 4 Then I saw the brightness of the glory of the God of Israel, just as I had seen it near the Chebar River.
5God said to me, “Ezekiel, son of man, look north.” And when I did, I saw that repulsive idol by the altar near the gate.
6God then said, “Do you see the terrible sins of the people of Israel? Their sins are making my holy temple unfit as a place to worship me. Yet you will see even worse things than this.”
7Next, I was taken to the entrance of the courtyard, where I saw a hole in the wall.
8God said, “Make this hole bigger.” And when I did, I realized it was a doorway. 9“Go in,” God said, “and see what horrible and evil things the people are doing.”
10Inside, I saw that the walls were covered with pictures of reptiles and disgusting, unclean animals, as well as with idols that the Israelites were worshiping. 11Seventy Israelite leaders were standing there, including Jaazaniah son of Shaphan. Each of these leaders was holding an incense burner, and the smell of incense filled the room.
12God said, “Ezekiel, do you see what horrible things Israel's leaders are doing in secret? They have filled their rooms with idols. And they say I can't see them, because they think I have already deserted Israel. 13But I will show you something even worse than this.”
14He took me to the north gate of the temple, where I saw women mourning for the god Tammuz. 15God asked me, “Can you believe what these women are doing? But now I want to show you something even worse.”
16I was then led into the temple's inner courtyard, where I saw about 25 men standing near the entrance, between the porch and the altar. Their backs were to the Lord's temple, and they were bowing down to the rising sun.
17God said, “Ezekiel, it's bad enough that the people of Judah are doing these disgusting things. But they have also spread violence and injustice everywhere in Israel and have made me very angry. They have disgraced and insulted me in the worst possible way. 18So in my fierce anger, I will punish them without mercy and refuse to help them when they cry out to me.”
translation_text:
YIZIKEƐLE ƐNYELƐZODEƐNWUNLƐ MƆƆ TƆ ZO NWIƆ
(8.1—10.22)
Awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm
1Bɛ nee yɛ hɔle nlɔnu la, ye ɛvolɛ nsia, siane nsia ne anu, ye kenle nnu ne azo, ɛnee me nee Dwuda mgbanyima ne mɔ wɔ sua nu ɛkɛ ne, na Awulae Nyamenle ne tumi ne rawolole me. 2 Memkpogyale me ti zo, na menwunle debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla anwo ɛzulolɛ bie la kɛ ɔgyi ɛkɛ. Ɔvi ɔ nze zo mɔɔ pe ye aze la le senle, yɛɛ ɔvi ɔ nze zo mɔɔ kɔ ye anwuma la ta kɛ kɔbele mɔɔ bɛhwi nwolɛ la. 3Ɔdenrɛle debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ ɛsalɛ la ɔzɔle me ti enrinli; na Nyamenle Sunsum ne manle me zo anwomanyunlu na ɔvale me wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu ɔrale Gyɛlusalɛm, wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu anlenkɛ ne mɔɔ di kɔ ɛbɔ nu la anloa, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛzie amonle bie, mɔɔ ka Nyamenle ɛya la.
4 Ɛkɛ ne, menwunle wienyi kpole ne mɔɔ kile kɛ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ ɛkɛ ne la bieko, kɛmɔ menwunle ye wɔ azɛlɛ wienyi ne azo la. 5Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, maa ɛ nye zo nea ɛbɔ nu afoa nu.” Na nea, menwunle kɛ amonle ne gyi azukponle ne tɛbanu wɔ ɛbɔ nu afoa nu.
6Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, wɔnwu mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la, bɛkyi ɛbɛla mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ɛlɛbɔ adu me wɔ me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne la ɔ? Na ɛbanwu bɛkyi ninyɛne mgbole kpalɛ bɔbɔ mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye mɔ la.”
7Akee Nyamenle vale me vindele hɔle findezo alie nwo anuhɔlɛ ne, na meneanle la ɛnee tokule bie wɔ bane ne anu. 8Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, fu bane ne anu.” Menvunle bane ne anu la menwunle kɛ anlenkɛ wɔ ɛkɛ. 9Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Wolo kɔ nuhua na kɔnlea ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ ye ɛke la.” 10Yemɔti menwolole mengɔle nu mengɔneanle. Na menwunle kɛ bɛdolɔdolɔ ninyɛne mɔɔ twenle bɛ kɛnra aze, nane anwo ɛzulolɛ ɛzulolɛ nee Yizilayɛma mmonle ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti wɔ bane ne anwo. 11Yizilayɛ mgbanyima abulasuu gyigyi ɛkɛ ne, na Hyeefan ara Gyeeyazanaya boka bɛ. Ko biala lɛ ɛyɛlɛ siase ɔ sa nu, na ɛyɛlɛ ne esike ne ɛlɛkpu ahɔ anwuma. 12Na Nyamenle bizale me kɛ, “Sonla ra, wɔnwu mɔɔ Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ɛlɛyɛ ye feabo la ɔ? Sonla ko biala nee ye ekpumgbunli mɔɔ ɔsonle ye nvoninli wɔ nu la. Ɔluakɛ bɛse, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛnnwu yɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma arɛle ɛvi maanle ne.’ ”
13Eza ɔzele me kɛ, “Ɛbanwu bɛkyi ninyɛne mgbole kpalɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye mɔ la.” 14Akee ɔvale me ɔrale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne mɔɔ di kɔ ɛbɔ nu afoa nu la anwo, na menwunle kɛ mraalɛ bie gua ɛkɛ ɛlɛsu Tamɛze.
15Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, asoo wɔnwu ɛhye. Ɛbanwu bɛkyi ninyɛne mgbole mɔɔ tɛla ɛhye mɔ la.” 16Akee ɔvale me ɔhɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie ne mɔɔ wɔ ɔ kunlu lɔ la anwo. Na menwunle kɛ menli abulanwiɔ nee nnu gyigyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anlenkɛ ne anyunlu wɔ azukponle ne nee alie nwo nwolodo ne avinli, bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne, bɛ nye kɔ aduduleɛ na bɛlɛsonle sɛnzɛne ne.
17Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, wɔnwu ɛhye ɔ? Asoo ɔle kpalɛ kɛ Dwudama kɛbɔ munzule kpole ɛhye mɔɔ bɛbɔ ye ɛke la, na bɛkɛva kɔdiawu ɛbɛla bɛkɛkponde azɛlɛ ne azo amuala, na bɛkɛha me ɛya ɔ? Nea, bɛdabɛ bɛva baka bɛzinla bɛ bonyi. 18Yemɔti mebava ɛya me nee bɛ ali. Menrɛvavi bie yɛɛ menrɛze anwunvɔne, bɛbazu ɛzunlɛ kpole bɔbɔ bɛavɛlɛ me, noko menrɛde bɛ ne.”

english_text:
The Lord Gives the Command To Punish Jerusalem
1After that, I heard the Lord shout, “Come to Jerusalem, you men chosen to destroy the city. And bring your weapons!”
2I saw six men come through the north gate of the temple, each one holding a deadly weapon. A seventh man dressed in a linen robe was with them, and he was carrying things to write with. The men went into the temple and stood by the bronze altar.
3The brightness of God's glory then left its place above the statues of the winged creatures inside the temple and moved to the entrance. The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, 4 “Walk through the city of Jerusalem and mark the forehead of anyone who is truly upset and sad about the terrible things that are being done here.”
5-6He turned to the other six men and said, “Follow him and put to death everyone who doesn't have a mark on their forehead. Show no mercy or pity! Kill men and women, parents and children. Begin here at my temple, but be sure not to harm those who are marked.”
The men immediately killed the leaders who were standing there.
7Then the Lord said, “Pollute the temple by piling the dead bodies in the courtyards. Now get busy!” They left and started killing the people of Jerusalem.
8I was then alone, so I bowed down and cried out to the Lord, “Why are you doing this? Are you so angry with the people of Jerusalem that everyone must die?”
9The Lord answered, “The people of Israel and Judah have done horrible things. Their country is filled with murderers, and Jerusalem itself is filled with violence. They think that I have deserted them, and that I can't see what they are doing. 10And so I will not have pity on them or forgive them. They will be punished for what they have done.”
11Just then, the man in the linen robe returned and said, “I have done what you commanded.”
translation_text:
Bɛdea Gyɛlusalɛm
1Akee mendele kɛ Nyamenle deanle nu kɛ, “Bɛdabɛ suakpole ye sinzavolɛma, bɛrɛla ɛke. Biala ɛva ye konle ninyɛne ne mɔ.” 2Na menli nsia vi anwuma lɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anwo rale, ko biala lɛ ye konle ninyɛne mɔɔ ɔbava yeahu menli ne la ɔ sa nu. Nrenya bie mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ la nee bɛ a lua a, na ngɛlata kodoku zia ye foa ko. Na bɛwolole Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bɛhɔgyinlanle kɔbele azukponle ne anwo.
3Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia ne vi tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ dede Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la anu ɛhɔ. Ɔvɛlɛle nrenya ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne na ngɛlata kodoku ne zia ye foa ko la. 4 Na Ɛdɛnkɛma zele ye kɛ, “Kɔ Gyɛlusalɛm suakpole ne azo amuala na fa sɛkɛlɛneɛ to awie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛdi nyane wɔ munzule ɛbɛla mɔɔ bɛbɔ wɔ zolɛ la anwo la anwoma azo.”
5Na mendele kɛ ɔlɛka yeahile menli ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛli ɔ nzi bɛhɔ suakpole ne azo amuala, bɛhɔhu bɛ. Bɛmmafavi bie, yɛɛ bɛmmase anwunvɔne. 6Bɛhu mrenya mgbanyinli, mgbavolɛ nee mbɛlɛra, ngakula nee mraalɛ kɔsɔɔti, noko bɛmmafa bɛ sa bɛka awie biala mɔɔ lɛ nzonlɛ ne wɔ ɔ nwoma azo la. Bɛbɔ ɔ bo wɔ me ɛleka nwuanzanwuanza ne.” Yemɔti bɛbɔle ɔ bo wɔ mgbanyima ne mɔ mɔɔ gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu la anwo zo.
7Na Nyamenle zele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛhɔ! Bɛhɔsesa avunli ne mɔ bɛragua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ye anu bɛgua nwolɛ evinli.” Yemɔti bɛhɔle suakpole ne azo na bɛhunle menli ne mɔ.
8Mɔɔ bɛlɛku menli ne mɔ na ɔhale me ngome la, mendule mendɔle mutule nu na mendeanle nu kɛ, “O, Awulae Nyamenle! Ɛfa Gyɛlusalɛm anwo ɛya wɔahu Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ɛha la ɔ?”
9Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Yizilayɛma nee Dwudama ɛtane ne akee ɛbo zolɛ. Mogya ɛva azɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ nzisi ɛva suakpole ye, ɔluakɛ bɛ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, ‘Ɛdɛnkɛma arɛle ɛvi maanle ne, yɛɛ ɔnnwu ɛhwee.’ 10Mame medame, menrɛvavi yɛɛ menrɛze anwunvɔne. Mɔɔ bɛyɛ la, memaa yeabɔ bɛ ti tɔ.”
11Na nrenya ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne, na ngɛlata kodoku ne zia ye foa ko la rale na ɔrahanle kɛ, “Meyɛ debie biala kɛmɔ ɛzele me la.”

english_text:
The Lord's Glory Leaves the Temple
1 I saw the dome that was above the four winged creatures, and on it was the sapphire throne. 2 The Lord said to the man in the linen robe, “Walk among the four wheels beside the creatures and pick up as many hot coals as you can carry. Then scatter them over the city of Jerusalem.” I watched him as he followed the Lord's instructions.
3The winged creatures were standing south of the temple when the man walked among them. A cloud filled the inner courtyard, 4and the brightness of the Lord's glory moved from above the creatures and stopped at the entrance of the temple. The entire temple was filled with his glory, and the courtyard was dazzling bright. 5The sound of the creatures' wings was as loud as the voice of God All-Powerful and could even be heard in the outer courtyard.
6The man in the robe was now standing beside a wheel. 7One of the four creatures reached its hand into the fire among them and gave him some of the hot coals. The man took the coals and left.
8I noticed again that each of the four winged creatures had what looked like human hands under their wings, 9 and I saw the four wheels near the creatures. These wheels were shining like chrysolite. 10Each wheel was exactly the same and had a second wheel that cut through the middle of it, 11so that they could move in any direction without turning. The wheels moved together whenever the creatures moved. 12 I also noticed that the wheels and the creatures' bodies, including their backs, their hands, and their wings, were covered with eyes. 13And I heard a voice calling these “the wheels that spin.”
14 Each of the winged creatures had four faces: the face of a bull, the face of a human, the face of a lion, and the face of an eagle. 15-17These were the same creatures I had seen near the Chebar River. They controlled when and where the wheels moved—the wheels went wherever the creatures went and stopped whenever they stopped. Even when the creatures flew in the air, the wheels stayed beside them.
18Then I watched the brightness of the Lord's glory move from the entrance of the temple and stop above the winged creatures. 19They spread their wings and flew into the air with the wheels at their side. They stopped at the east gate of the temple, and the Lord's glory was above them.
20I knew for sure that these were the same creatures I had seen beneath the Lord's glory near the Chebar River. 21-22They had four wings with hands beneath them, and they had the same four faces as those near the River. Each creature moved straight ahead without turning.
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne fi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu
1 Akee memanle me nye zo, na menwunle kɛ, wɔ deɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdo ɛbɛnra abɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la ati ne mɔ anwo la azo, debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ belemgbunli ebia, mɔɔ bɛva sanyia bolɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye safaya la bɛyɛ la gyi zolɛ anwuma. 2 Nyamenle zele nrenya ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne la kɛ, “Kɔwolo ehwili ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ abo la avinli na fula samɛnlankɛ ne bie kɔzande ye wɔ suakpole ne azo.”
Ɔkɔ la me nye gyi ɔ nwo. 3Mekɛ mɔɔ nrenya ne kawolo ehwili ne anu la ɛnee tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ gyigyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nyiakɛ, na amungu ne rayile Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu alie nwo ɛkɛ. 4Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne vi tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ ati zo hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. Amungu ne rayile sua ne, na Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne yile alie nwo ɛkɛ ne manle ɔyɛle wienyi. 5Saa awie wɔ findezo alie nwo nehane na ɔte abɔdeɛ ne mɔ andɛba mɔɔ bɛlɛbɔ nu la ane a, ɔle kɛ Nyamenle Bedevinli ne ɛlɛtendɛ la.
6Nyamenle zele nrenya ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne la kɛ ɔhɔvula senle wɔ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ ehwili ne mɔ avinli na ɔhɔle la, ɔhɔgyinlanle ehwili ko anwo. 7Na tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ ko vale ɔ sa bɔle senle ne mɔɔ wɔ tease abɔdeɛ nna ne mɔ avinli la anu vulale bie guale nrenya ne asa anu. Nrenya ne liele na ɔhɔle.
8Tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ lɛ debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla sa la wɔ bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ abo. 9 Meneanle la eza menwunle kɛ ehwili nna gyigyi abɔdeɛ ne mɔ anwo ɛkɛ, abɔdeɛ ko biala ehwili ko. Ehwili ne mɔ ta kɛ ezukoa bolɛ. 10Bɛ muala bɛzɔho bɛ nwo kɛ asɛɛ ehwili ko de ko noko anu. 11Saa bɛtu bɛ bo kɛ bɛlɛkɔ a, bɛkola bɛkɔ bɛ tɛbanu nna ne mɔ anu biala mɔɔ bɛngakyi anzɛɛ bɛmpɛne bɛ nwo a. 12 Ɛnyelɛ duodua ehwili kɛba ne mɔ nee nuhua mbulalɛ meɛbeanu ne mɔ amuala anwo, yɛɛ ehwili nna ne mɔɔ bɛlɛ la, biala anwo le ɛnyelɛ ngome. 13Na mendele kɛ bɛfɛlɛ ehwili ne mɔ “Akyima Ehwili.”
14 Tease abɔdeɛ ko biala anyunlu nna. Mɔɔ lumua la zɔho ɛnlankɛ nyinli, mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nwiɔ la le sonla, mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nsa la le awenade, yɛɛ mɔɔ tɔ zolɛ nna la le kɔleɛ. 15(Bɛdabɛ ko ne ala a menwunle bɛ wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa la.) Saa tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ maa bɛ nwo zo 16kɛ bɛlɛkɔ a, ehwili ne mɔ sianle bɛ, yɛɛ saa bɛbɔ bɛ ndɛba anu bɛtu a, ehwili ne mɔ ɛnga aze. 17Saa bɛgyinla a, ɛnee ehwili ne mɔ ɛgyinla, yɛɛ saa bɛtu bɛ bo a, ɛnee ehwili ne mɔ ɛdu bɛ bo. Ɔluakɛ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ sunsum ne wɔ ehwili ne mɔ anu.
18Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne vi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne yele ɔ nwo hɔzinzele tease abɔdeɛ nna ne ati zo anwuma. 19Na menwunle kɛ tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ dɛlɛle bɛ ndɛba anu na bɛdule, ehwili ne mɔ boka bɛ. Bɛhɔgyinlanle Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne aduduleɛ anlenkɛ ne anloa, na Yizilayɛ Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne ɛheda bɛ nwo zo. 20Bɛdabɛ ko ne ala a bɛle tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ menwunle bɛ Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne abo wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa la.
21Ko biala lɛ ɔ nyunlu nna, ɔ ndɛba nna, yɛɛ debie bie mɔɔ le kɛ sonla ɛsalɛ la wɔ bɛ ndɛba ne mɔ abo. 22Bɛ nyunlu kile kɛ bɛdabɛ ko ne ala a menwunle bɛ wɔ Azule Kibaa ne anloa la. Ko biala maa ɔ nwo zo a, ɔkɔ ɔ nyunlu fɔɔnwo.

english_text:
Ezekiel Condemns Jerusalem's Wicked Leaders
1The Lord's Spirit lifted me up and took me to the east gate of the temple, where I saw 25 men, including the two leaders, Jaazaniah son of Azzur and Pelatiah son of Benaiah. 2The Lord said, “Ezekiel, son of man, these men are making evil plans and giving dangerous advice to the people of Jerusalem. 3They say things like, ‘Let's build more houses. This city is like a cooking pot over a fire, and we are the meat, but at least the pot keeps us from being burned in the fire.’ 4So, Ezekiel, condemn them!”
5The Lord's Spirit took control of me and told me to tell these leaders:
I, the Lord God, know what you leaders are saying. 6You have murdered so many people that the city is filled with dead bodies! 7This city is indeed a cooking pot, but the bodies of those you killed are the meat. And so I will force you to leave Jerusalem, 8and I'll send armies to attack you, just as you fear. 9Then you will be captured and punished by foreign enemies. 10You will be killed in your own country, but not before you realize that I, the Lord, have done these things.
11You leaders claim to be meat in a cooking pot, but you won't be protected by this city. No, you will die at the border of Israel. 12You will realize that while you were following the laws of nearby nations, you were disobeying my laws and teachings. And I am the Lord!
13Before I finished speaking, Pelatiah dropped dead. I bowed down and cried out, “Please, Lord God, don't kill everyone left in Israel.”
A Promise of Hope
14The Lord replied:
15Ezekiel, son of man, the people living in Jerusalem claim that you and the other Israelites who were taken to Babylonia are too far away to worship me. They also claim that the land of Israel now belongs only to them. 16But here is what I want you to tell the Israelites in Babylonia:
It's true that I, the Lord God, have forced you out of your own country and made you live among foreign nations. But for now, I will be with you wherever you are, so that you can worship me. 17And someday, I will gather you from the nations where you are scattered and let you live in Israel again. 18When that happens, I want you to clear the land of all those idols I hate so much. 19 Then I will take away your stubbornness and make you eager to be completely faithful to me. You will want to obey me 20and all my laws and teachings. You will be my people, and I will be your God. 21But those who worship idols will be punished and get what they deserve. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
The Lord's Glory Leaves Jerusalem
22 After the Lord had finished speaking, the winged creatures spread their wings and flew into the air, and the wheels were beside them. The brightness of the Lord's glory above them 23left Jerusalem and stopped at a hill east of the city.
24Then in my vision, the Lord's Spirit lifted me up and carried me back to the other exiles in Babylonia. The vision faded away, 25and I told them everything the Lord had shown me.
translation_text:
Bɛbua Gyɛlusalɛm fɔlɛ kɛ ɔbabɔ
1Nyamenle Sunsum ne manle membale Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne aduduleɛ anlenkɛ ne anloa. Na menwunle menli abulanwiɔ nee nnu wɔ anuhɔlɛ ne, Ezɛ ara Gyeeyazanaya nee Bɛnaya ara Pɛlataya, mɔɔ le maanle ne anu mgbanyinli la boka nwolɛ.
2Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, menli ɛhye mɔ a bɔ maamɔvo kpɔkɛ na bɛtu suakpole ne azo amra folɛ ɛtane la. 3Bɛ edwɛkɛ se kɛ, ‘Ɔtɛdwule mekɛ mɔɔ yɛsisi azua a; suakpole ɛhye le kɛ danesɛne kpole bie, yɛɛ yɛmɛ yɛle fɛlɛ yɛwɔ nu.’ 4Yemɔti ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne tia bɛ, o sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne.”
5Ɛdɛnkɛma Sunsum ne wolole me na ɔzele me kɛ menga kɛ, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se, O, Yizilayɛma, kɛ bɛ adwenle yɛ bɛ la ɛhye ɔ? Meze debie biala mɔɔ wɔ bɛ adwenle nu la. 6Bɛhu menli dɔɔnwo kpalɛ wɔ suakpole ye azo, na ye kpalɛ ne mɔ amuala azo ɛyɛ avunli ngome.
7“Yemɔti kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle ne mese la ɛne: Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhu bɛ bɛgua kpalɛ ne mɔ azo la, bɛ avunli a le fɛlɛ ne, yɛɛ suakpole ye a le danesɛne kpole ne, na bɛmɛ, bɛbaye bɛ bɛavi suakpole ye azo bɛavinde. 8Bɛzulo dadeɛ nloa ewule; na kɛkala, mebamaa bɛawu dadeɛ nloa. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a. 9Mebaye bɛ kɔsɔɔti meavinde na meaye bɛ meamaa nyɛvolɛ adea bɛ. 10Bɛbadɔ amolɛ nu wɔ konle nu; mebadea bɛ toonwo meahɔdwu Yizilayɛ ɛweɛne zo, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 11Suakpole ɛhye ɛnrɛyɛ bɛ danesɛne kpole, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ noko bɛnrɛyɛ nuhua fɛlɛ. Mebadea bɛ toonwo meahɔdwu Yizilayɛ ɛweɛne zo, 12na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. Ɔluakɛ bɛanli me mɛla ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ bɛanli me ngyehyɛlɛ zo, na bɛli maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la maamɛla zo.”
13Mɔɔ me nloa wɔ zolɛ melɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne la, Pɛlataya mɔɔ ɔ ze a le Bɛnaya la wule. Ɛkɛ ne ala, membutule mutule nu, na mendeanle nuhua kpole kɛ, “O, Awulae Nyamenle, ɛbɔ Yizilayɛma ekyi mɔɔ ɛha la abo zo ɔ?”
Nyamenle ɛwɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔbɔle bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la
14Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 15Ɔse, “Sonla ra, menli mɔɔ wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la ɛlɛka ɛdawɔ nee ɛ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ wɔ nlɔnu la anwo edwɛkɛ kɛ, ‘Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu la wɔ moa; bɛ nee Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ avinli ɛde; kɛkala, azɛlɛ ye ɛyɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ.’
16“Zɔhane ati ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Medame yɛɛ menvale bɛ mengɔle maanle zo moa moa na membɔle bɛ memkpondenle maanle maanle ne mɔ avinli a; noko me nee bɛ lua maanle biala mɔɔ bɛhɔ nu la anu.’ 17Yemɔti ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Mebaboɔboa bɛ nloa meavi menli ne mɔ anu, na meaye bɛ meavi maanle maanle mɔɔ me nee bɛ hɔle nu la anu, meazia meara, na meava Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ye meamaa bɛ. 18Saa bɛsia bɛba a, bɛbayeye ninyɛne ɛtane ɛtane nee bɛkyi debie biala mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la amuala.
19 “ ‘Mebamaa bɛanyia ahonle fofolɛ na meamaa bɛ sunsum fofolɛ. Mebaye bolɛ ahonle ne wɔ bɛ nuhua na meamaa bɛ tieyɛ ahonle. 20Bɛbazie me mɛla ne nee me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ na bɛali zolɛ; bɛbayɛ me menli na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle. 21Na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛse bɛkɔ zolɛ bɛayɛ ninyɛne ɛtane ɛtane na bɛabɔ bɛkyi ɛbɛla la, mebamaa bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ abɔ bɛ ti tɔ. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle yɛɛ mese a.’ ”
Nyamenle anyunlunyia ne fi Gyɛlusalɛm
22 Tease abɔdeɛ ne mɔ akee bɔle bɛ ndɛba nu dule, ehwili ne mɔ li bɛ foa ko, na Yizilayɛ Nyamenle ne anyunlunyia ne zinzele bɛ nwo zo. 23Na Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia ne vi suakpole ne azo yele ɔ nwo na ɔhɔzinzele boka ne mɔɔ wɔ suakpole ne aduduleɛ la azo. 24Akee Nyamenle Sunsum ne vale me luale ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne anu ziale rale Babelonia wɔ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhye bɛ bɛhɔ nlɔnu la avinli. Akee me nye zo tetele me. 25Na menganle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛye ɛhile me la amuala mengilele nlɔnuma ne.

english_text:
Ezekiel Acts Out Israel's Captivity
1The Lord said:
2 Ezekiel, son of man, you are living among rebellious people. They have eyes, but refuse to see; they have ears, but refuse to listen. 3So before it gets dark, here is what I want you to do. Pack a few things as though you were going to be taken away as a prisoner. Then go outside where everyone can see you and walk around from place to place. Maybe as they watch, they will realize what rebels they are. 4After you have done this, return to your house.
Later that evening leave your house as if you were going into exile. 5Dig through the wall of your house and crawl out, carrying the bag with you. Make sure everyone is watching. 6Lift the bag to your shoulders, and with your face covered, take it into the darkness, so that you cannot see the land you are leaving. All this will be a warning for the people of Israel.
7I did everything the Lord had said. I packed a few things. Then as the sun was going down, and while everyone was watching, I dug a hole through one of the walls of my house. I pulled out my bag, then lifted it to my shoulders and left in the darkness.
8The next morning, the Lord 9reminded me that those rebellious people didn't even ask what I was doing. 10So he sent me back to tell them:
The Lord God has a message for the leader of Jerusalem and everyone living there!
11I have done these things to show them what will happen when they are taken away as prisoners.
12The leader of Jerusalem will lift his own bag to his shoulders at sunset and leave through a hole that the others have dug in the wall of his house. He will cover his face, so he can't see the land he is leaving. 13 The Lord will spread out a net and trap him as he leaves Jerusalem. He will then be led away to the city of Babylon, but will never see that place, even though he will die there. 14His own officials and troops will scatter in every direction, and the Lord will track them down and put them to death.
15The Lord will force the rest of the people in Jerusalem to live in foreign nations, where they will realize that he has done all these things. 16Some of them will survive the war, the starvation, and the deadly diseases. That way, they will be able to tell foreigners how disgusting their sins were, and that it was the Lord who punished them in this way.
A Sign of Fear
17The Lord said:
18Ezekiel, son of man, shake with fear when you eat, and tremble when you drink. 19Tell the people of Israel that I, the Lord, say that someday everyone in Jerusalem will shake when they eat and tremble when they drink. Their country will be destroyed and left empty, because they have been cruel and violent. 20Every town will lie in ruins, and the land will be a barren desert. Then they will know that I am the Lord.
The Words of the Lord Will Come True
21The Lord said:
22Ezekiel, son of man, you've heard people in Israel use the saying, “Time passes, and prophets are proved wrong.” 23Now tell the people that I, the Lord, am going to prove that saying wrong. No one will ever be able to use it again in Israel, because very soon everything I have said will come true! 24The people will hear no more useless warnings and false messages. 25I will give them my message, and what I say will certainly happen. Warn those rebels that the time has come for them to be punished. I, the Lord, make this promise.
26-27Ezekiel, the people of Israel are also saying that your visions and messages are only about things in the future. 28So tell them that my words will soon come true, just as I have warned. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_text:
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne yɛ nriandivolɛ
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2 Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ɛde menli anzosesebɛma mɔɔ ɛngyɛ na ade atua la avinli. Bɛlɛ ɛnyelɛ, noko bɛnnwu debie; bɛlɛ ɛnzonlɛ, noko bɛnde edwɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛle atuadelɛma.
3“Yemɔti, sonla ra, kyekye bɔlɛ na yɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ bɛhye ye bɛ nee ye ɛlɛkɔ nlɔnu la. Tɔ adenle zo alehyenlɛ nu mɔɔ awie biala anye dua wɔ kɛ ɛlɛkɔ nlɔnu la. Yɛ ɛ nwo kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ nlɔnu la na ɛvi ɛleka ko kɔ ɛleka fofolɛ. Bɛ nzo yɛ se, yɛɛ bɛde atua ɛdeɛ, noko wɔannea a bɛbade ɔ bo. 4Alehyenlɛ ne anu, ɛbaboɔboa wɔ ninyɛne ne mɔ anloa wɔ bɛ nye zo, na ye nɔsolɛ nu wɔadɔ adenle zo wɔ bɛ nye zo, kɛmɔ menli mɔɔ kɔ nlɔnu la yɛ la. 5Funvu bane ne anu fiti tɔ ɔ nzi wɔ bɛ nye zo ɛkɛ ne, na dua nuhua finde. 6Bɛ nye zo ɛkɛ ne ala, maa wɔ bɔlɛ ne zo to ɛ kɔme zo na tɔ awozinli ne anu kɔ. Keda ɛ nyunlu, amaa wɔannwu ɛleka mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ la. Ɔluakɛ meva wɔ meyɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ memaa Yizilayɛma.”
7Menyɛle mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me la. Alehyenlɛ ne anu, menkyekyele me bɔlɛ kɛ sonla mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ nlɔnu la; nɔsolɛ nu menvale me sa menvunvunle bane ne anu menfitile mendɔle ɔ nzi, na bɛ nye zo ɛkɛ ne ala, menvale me bɔlɛ mendole me kɔme zo na mendɔle awozinli ne anu mengɔle.
8Aleɛ hyenle la Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 9Ɔse, “Sonla ra, se Yizilayɛ atuadelɛma akee ɛbiza wɔ kɛ, ‘Duzu a ɛlɛyɛ la?’ 10Ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se, nyɛleɛ ɛhye fane kpanyinli ne mɔɔ ɛlɛbu Gyɛlusalɛm maanle ne nee Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala anwo.’ 11Ka kile bɛ kɛ, mɔɔ wɔyɛ la le sɛkɛlɛneɛ maa bɛ. Mɔɔ wɔyɛ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ bɛbava bɛayɛ bɛ a. Bɛbahye bɛ nuokɛ bɛ nee bɛ ahɔ nlɔnu. 12Na belemgbunli ne mɔɔ sie bɛ la bava ye bɔlɛ ado ɔ kɔme zo nɔɔzo, na yeanriandi yeahɔ. Ɔbavunvu bane ne anu yeafiti yeadɔ ɔ nzi, na yealua nu yeahɔ. Ɔbaheda ɔ ti zo, amaa yeannwu azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɔlɛkɔ zolɛ la azo. 13 Na mebagua ye asawu meahye ye me ɛhane nu. Mebava ye meahɔ nlɔnu wɔ suakpole Babelɔn azo, wɔ Babelonia azɛlɛ zo, mɔɔ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔnrɛnwu ye a. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ ɔbawu a. 14Mebabɔ menli mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia ye wɔ ye suakunlu ɛkɛ ne, mɔɔ tu ye folɛ yɛɛ ye ɛlɔnema kɔsɔɔti asande meahɔgua ɛleka kɔsɔɔti, na meamaa menli ahoto ahɔhu bɛ.
15“Saa mebɔ bɛ asande na mekponde bɛ wɔ maanle maanle avinli a, yɛɛ bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 16Noko mebamaa bɛ nuhua ekyi avi ɛsalɛ, mɔɔ bɛnrɛhu bɛ, yɛɛ ewulenzane nee ɛhɔne ɛnrɛmaa bɛnrɛwu, amaa bɛaha bɛ bɛkyi nyɛleɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛle la bɛahile maanle maanle mɔɔ bɛkɛhɔdo bɛ la, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne mɔɔ anwo wozo ye la anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ
17Eza Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 18Ɔse, “Sonla ra, saa ɛdi aleɛ a fa anwowozolɛ di, yɛɛ ɛno nzule a fa anwowozolɛ nee sulosulo no. 19Ka kile maanle ne anu amra kɛ, ‘Edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ka ye wɔ menli mɔɔ de Gyɛlusalɛm nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo la anwo la ɛne: Bɛbava sulosulo bɛali aleɛ, na bɛava arɛlebɔlɛ bɛanlo nzule, ɔboalekɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ne azo la ahɔdiawu ɛbɛla ne ati, bɛ azɛlɛ ne badɔ mgbane. 20Bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ azo ɛyɛ gbudugbudu la amuala bayɛ azuadu, na azɛlɛ ne azo ayɛ nyanyoo, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a!’ ”
Ɛrɛlɛ mɔɔ awie biala ze nee nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ awie biala ɛnze
21Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me bieko. 22Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ɛrɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ Yizilayɛma ta bu la a le duzu? Bɛse, ‘Mekɛ ne ɛzenlɛ ala a se a, noko bɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne ɛnyɛ zɔhane.’ 23Zɔhane ati ka kile bɛ kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Metua zɛhae ɛrɛlɛ ne, na bɛnrɛbu ye bieko ɛlɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo.’ Na ka kile bɛ kɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ biala ɔwɔ kɛ yɛ zɔhane a.
24“Akee ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ mgbane mgbane nee adalɛ abisadeɛ edwɛkɛ biala ɛnrɛvinde Yizilayɛma avinli bieko. 25Medame Awulae Nyamenle, mebadendɛ, na edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ mebaha la bayɛ zɔhane. Aze ɛzilɛ biala ɛnle ɛkɛ. Bɛmɛ atuadelɛma, mebaha me nloa edwɛkɛ, na ɔbayɛ zɔhane, yɛɛ ɔbazi bɛ mekɛ zo. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”
26Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, 27“Sonla ra, nea, Yizilayɛma se, ‘Debie mɔɔ bɛkɛye bɛkɛhile ye wɔ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu kazi la, ɛnee yehyɛ, yɛɛ ye Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ɔfa ɔbɛlɛ ye la, kayɛ zɔhane la, ɛnee yehyɛ.’ 28Yemɔti ka kile bɛ kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se, ‘Me edwɛkɛ ɛnrɛzi aze bieko. Edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ medame menwɔha la bayɛ zɔhane. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.’ ”

english_text:
Lying Prophets
1The Lord said:
2Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the prophets of Israel who say they speak in my name, but who preach messages that come from their own imagination. Tell them it's time to hear my message.
3I, the Lord God, say those lying prophets are doomed! They don't see visions—they make up their own messages! 4Israel's prophets are no better than jackals that hunt for food among the ruins of a city. 5They don't warn the people about coming trouble or tell them how dangerous it is to sin against me. 6Those prophets lie by claiming they speak for me, but I have not even chosen them to be my prophets. And they still think their words will come true. 7They say they're preaching my messages, but they are full of lies—I did not speak to them!
8So I am going to punish those lying prophets for deceiving the people of Israel with false messages. 9I will turn against them and no longer let them belong to my people. They will not be allowed to call themselves Israelites or even to set foot in Israel. Then they will realize that I am the Lord God.
10 Those prophets refuse to be honest. They tell my people there will be peace, even though there's no peace to be found. They are like workers who think they can fix a shaky wall by covering it with paint. 11But when I send rainstorms, hailstones, and strong winds, the wall will surely collapse. 12People will then ask the workers why the paint didn't hold it up.
13That wall is the city of Jerusalem. And I, the Lord God, am so angry that I will send strong winds, rainstorms, and hailstones to destroy it. 14The lying prophets have tried to cover up the evil in Jerusalem, but I will tear down the city, all the way to its foundations. And when it collapses, those prophets will be killed, and everyone will know that I have done these things.
15The city of Jerusalem and its lying prophets will feel my fierce anger. Then I will announce that the city has fallen and that the lying prophets are dead, 16because they promised my people peace, when there was no peace. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
Women Who Wear Magic Charms
The Lord said:
17Ezekiel, son of man, now condemn the women of Israel who preach messages that come from their own imagination. 18Tell them they're doomed! They wear magic charms on their wrists and scarves on their heads, then trick others into believing they can predict the future. They won't get away with telling those lies. 19They charge my people a few handfuls of barley and a couple pieces of bread, and then give messages that are insulting to me. They use lies to sentence the innocent to death and to help the guilty go free. And my people believe them!
20I hate the magic charms they use to trick people into believing their lies. I will rip those charms from their wrists and set free the people they have trapped like birds. 21I will tear the scarves from their heads and rescue my people from their power once and for all. Then they will know that I am the Lord God.
22They do things I would never do. They lie to good people and encourage them to do wrong, and they convince the wicked to ruin their own lives by not turning from sin. 23I will no longer let these women give false messages and use magic, and I will free my people from their control. Then they will know that I, the Lord, have done these things.
translation_text:
Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ tia Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ mrenya adalɛ la
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. Ɔse, 2“Sonla ra, ka nrɛlaleɛ ɛhye kile Yizilayɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma mɔɔ bɔ bɛ ti anu keha mɔɔ bɛdabɛ bɛkulo la. Ka kile bɛ maa bɛdie mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese la.
3“Ka kile bɛ kɛ, Ɛdɛnkɛma se, ‘Munzule ɛha Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ahoasea ne mɔ, mɔɔ ɛnnwu ɛhwee na bɛbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ la. 4Yizilayɛma, bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ɛyɛ kɛ fovolɛ zo ɛzonlɛ. 5Bɛtɛkɔneanle ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛgologolo ɛgua la, yɛɛ bɛtɛdiele Yizilayɛma anwo bane, amaa Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne dwu na konle ba a bɛahola gyinla. 6Bɛbɔ adalɛ, yɛɛ bɛha adalɛ abisadeɛ edwɛkɛ; bɛse, “Ɛdɛnkɛma se,” wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ metɛsoanle bɛ la. Noko bɛ nye la kɛ mebamaa bɛ edwɛkɛ ne mɔɔ bɛha la ayɛ zɔhane. 7Asoo tɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ mgbane mgbane nee adalɛ abisadeɛ edwɛkɛ a bɛka mekɛ biala mɔɔ bɛkɛha kɛ “Ɛdɛnkɛma se,” wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ metɛkanle ɛhwee la?’
8“Yemɔti ka kile bɛ kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se, ‘Kɛmɔ bɛ ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ ne mɔ ɛnle nɔhalɛ na bɛbɔ adalɛ la ati, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mekpo bɛ. 9Mebadea bɛdabɛ bɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛtɛnwunle debie a, ɛnee bɛse bɛnwu debie na bɛbɔ adalɛ la. Bɛnrɛdia bɛ bɛnrɛboka Yizilayɛma anwo, yɛɛ bɛ nee bɛ ɛnrɛdu agyinla bɔbɔ. Bɛnrɛzia bɛnrɛhɔ bɛ maanle nu Yizilayɛ; na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Awulae Nyamenle ne a.
10 “ ‘Kɛmɔ bɛbɛlɛbɛla me menli ne, na ɛleka mɔɔ anzonudwolɛ ɛnle la ɛnee bɛse anzonudwolɛ wɔ ɛkɛ, na menli ne die bane mgbane bie a ɛnee bɛmɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma bɛhwi nwolɛ kalo la; 11ka kile bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛtwi kalo ne la kɛ bane ne bagolo agua. Ezule kpole badɔ, ezuawolɛ mgbole bagua, na ahumu kpole adu, 12na saa bane ne bu gua a, ɛnee bɛ kalo ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛhwile nwolɛ la hale nienwu?’
13“Zɔhane ati kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne: Mebava ɛya na meamaa ahumu kpole adu, ezule badɔ kpole bie, na ezuawolɛ adɔ abubu bane ne. 14Mebabubu bɛ bane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhwi nwolɛ kalo la, na meagolo bɛ meagua, meamaa ye adiabo ne bɔbɔ anwenle zolɛ. Ye ɛbulɛ ne anu, ɔbahu bɛ, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
15-16“Zɛhae yɛɛ mebava meayɛ bane ne nee bɛdabɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛannwu ɛhwee na bɛhanle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ bɛhilele Gyɛlusalɛmma kɛ bɛde anzonudwolɛ nu, na bɛhwile bane ne anwo kalo la. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a!”
Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ tia Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ mraalɛ adalɛ la
17Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Sonla ra, akee nea mraalɛ mɔɔ wɔ wɔ menli ne avinli, na bɛbɔ bɛ ti anu bɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ la.
