Mekɛ biala mɔɔ ɛkɛde me nloa anu edwɛkɛ la, kakye bɛ wɔ nwolɛ. 8Saa meka mekile amumuyɛnli ne kɛ ɔbawu na wɔambɔ amumuyɛnli ne kɔkɔ wɔammaa yeanvi ye ninyɛndane nwo a, amumuyɛnli zɔhane bawu ala ye ɛtane nu, noko mebalie ye mogya ne meavi wɔ ɛkɛ. 9Na saa ɛbɔ amumuyɛnli ne kɔkɔ kɛ ɔvi ye ninyɛndane nwo, na yeangyakyi ɔ sa anloa a, ɔbawu yeala ye ɛtane ne anu, na wɔmɔ, ɛ nwo kɔlɔnwo.”
Sonla ko biala ɛzonlelilɛ
10Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Na wɔmɔ, sonla ra, ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ, mɔɔ wɔha la ɛne: ‘Yɛ mɛladonlɛ nee yɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛbu ɛzia yɛ; na ɛhye ati a yɛmkpazi a. Na kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na yɛanyia ngoane ɛ?’ 11Ka kile bɛ kɛ, suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame Awulae Nyamenle a mele tease Nyamenle ne la, menlɛ anyelielɛ biala wɔ amumuyɛnli ewule nu, kyesɛ amumuyɛnli ne kakyi fi ye ndenle ne mɔ anu na ɔnyia ngoane. Bɛzia bɛ nzi, bɛzia bɛ nzi bɛvi bɛ munzule ndenle ne mɔ anu; Yizilayɛma, duzu ati a bɛkulo kɛ bɛwu a?
12“Na wɔmɔ, sonla ra, ka kile menli ne kɛ, saa tenlenenli yɛ ɛtane a, ye tenleneyɛlɛ ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie ye, yɛɛ saa amumuyɛnli sia fi ye ninyɛndane nwo a, ɔnrɛwu. Saa tenlenenli yɛ ɛtane a, ye tenleneyɛlɛ ne ɛnrɛmaa ɔnrɛnyia ngoane. 13Saa meka mekile tenlenenli kɛ ɔbanyia ngoane, na ɔmaa ɔ ti anu yɛ ye fɛ na ɔyɛ ɛtane a, ye tenlene nyɛleɛ biala mɔɔ yeyɛ la abo zo baminli mɔɔ bɛnrɛhakye ye bieko a, na ɛtane ne mɔɔ yeyɛ la yɛɛ ɔbawu yeala nu a. 14Bieko, saa meka mekile amumuyɛnli kɛ, ‘ɛbawu’, na saa ɔsia ɔfi ye ninyɛndane nwo, ɔyɛ mɔɔ fa mɛla adenle nu na ɔle kpalɛ, 15na amumuyɛnli ne siane mɔɔ bɛvale bɛwulale ye ɛkɛ ne awoba la, ɔfa mɔɔ ɔwuale la ɔmaa ɔ menle mɔ, na ɔdi ngoane mɛla ne mɔ azo, mɔɔ ɔnyɛ ɛtane bieko la a, ɔbanyia ngoane, ɔnrɛwu. 16Bɛnrɛhakye ye ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ yeyɛ la biala. Yeyɛ mɔɔ fa mɛla adenle nu na ɔle kpalɛ la, ɔbanyia ngoane.
17“Noko akee wɔ menli ne se, ‘Awulae adenle ne ɛnle pɛpɛ,’ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛmɛ yɛɛ bɛ adenle ne ɛnle pɛpɛ la. 18Saa tenlenenli sia fi ye tenleneyɛlɛ nwo na ɔyɛ ɛtane a, ye ɛtane ne ati, ɔbawu. 19Na saa amumuyɛnli sia fi ye amumuyɛ mɔɔ yeyɛ la anwo, na ɔyɛ mɔɔ fa mɛla adenle nu la na ɔdi boɛ a, ye boɛlilɛ ne ati, ɔbanyia ngoane. 20Na bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛse ‘Awulae adenle ne ɛnle pɛpɛ.’ Mebabua sonla ko biala ndɛne, kɛmɔ ye ndenle ne mɔ si de la.”
Gyɛlusalɛm ɛbɔlɛ nwo nrɛlaleɛ
21 Bɛhyele yɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la, ye ɛvolɛ bulu nee nwiɔ ne, ye siane bulu ne, ye kenle nnu ne azo, nrenya bie mɔɔ ɛnriandi ɛvi Gyɛlusalɛm la rale me nwo ɛkɛ razele me kɛ, “Suakpole ne ɛbɔ.” 22Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi ne dɔle me nwo zo, ɔvi kenle mɔɔ ye alehyenlɛ nu a ahenle ne mɔɔ vile ɛsalɛ la nriandile rale la nɔsolɛ nu. Kenle ko ne mɔɔ nrenya ne rale la nwonlomɔ ne, ɛnee Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛde me nloa. Yemɔti mendendɛle, meanyɛ mumule bieko.
Menli ne ɛtane ne mɔ
23Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 24Ɔse, “Sonla ra, menli mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛdɔ mgbane la azo la tɛka kɛ, ‘Ebileham ɛnee le sonla kokye, noko ɔholale ɔnyianle azɛlɛ ne, na akee yɛmɛ mɔɔ yɛ nwo zonle la; bɛva azɛlɛ ne bɛmaa yɛ kɛ ɔle yɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ.’
25“Yemɔti ka kile bɛ kɛ, kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se la ɛne: Mɔɔ bɛdi nane mɔɔ ye mogya ne wɔ nu, bɛsonle bɛ mmonle ne mɔ, na bɛka mogya bɛgua la, asoo bɛkɛhola azɛlɛ ne fa yɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ? 26Ɔngyɛ ɛnee bɛhwe dadeɛ, bɛbɔ bɛkyi ɛbɛla na bɛfa bɛ gɔnwo mɔ mraalɛ la, ɛnee kɛ bɛsi bɛfa azɛlɛ ne bɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ ɛ?
27“Ka kile bɛ kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se, ‘Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Nyamenle ne la, bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ mgbane ne azo la badɔ dadeɛ nloa wɔ konle nu. Mɔɔ ɛhɔ ɛbɔ nu la, mebaye ye meamaa nanemgbole ahye ye ali; yɛɛ ewulenzane bahu bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛhɔvea aranemgbole nee awolɛ mbɔne nu la. 28Mebamaa azɛlɛ ne adɔ mgbane, yeahwe, na ye anwosesebɛ ne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛtu bɛ nloa anu la awie. Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ azo badɔ mgbane mɔɔ awie ɛnrɛze zolɛ bieko a. 29Na saa meto azɛlɛ ne mgbane, mɔɔ awie ɛnle zolɛ wɔ bɛ amumuyɛ nee bɛ ninyɛndane ti a, akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.’ ”
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne nrɛlaleɛ ne anzi edwɛkɛ
30Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Na wɔmɔ sonla ra, wɔ menli ne mɔɔ kuohua bɛ nloa wɔ bane bo bane bo nee bɛ nlenkɛ nzi ka ɛ nwo edwɛkɛ la ka kile bɛ nwo ngoko kɛ, ‘Bɛrɛla bɛradie edwɛkɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma nee ye ɛra la.’ 31Bɛba ɛ nwo ɛkɛ, kɛmɔ awie biala ba la, bɛbatɛnla ɛ nwo ɛkɛ kɛ asɛɛ me menli la, na bɛtie mɔɔ ɛka la, noko bɛnrɛyɛ ye ɛlɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛfa bɛ nloa a bɛkile bɛ ɛhulolɛ a, na bɛ ahonle ɛdeɛ, yemɔ ɔgyi bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ kpalɛyɛlɛ zo. 32Na nea, ɛle bɛ nye zo kɛ sonla bie mɔɔ fa ɛnelɛ fɛlɛko to ɛhulolɛ edwɛne na ɔbɔ agole la, ɔluakɛ bɛte mɔɔ ɛka la, noko bɛnrɛyɛ ye ɛlɛ. 33Saa ɛhye ba a, na ɔbara noko, yɛɛ bɛkɛnwu kɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ a ɛnee de bɛ avinli a.”

english_text:
Israel's Leaders Are Worthless Shepherds
1 The Lord God said:
2Ezekiel, son of man, Israel's leaders are like shepherds taking care of my sheep, the people of Israel. But I want you to condemn these leaders and tell them:
I, the Lord God, say you shepherds of Israel are doomed! You take care of yourselves while ignoring my sheep. 3You drink their milk and use their wool to make your clothes. Then you butcher the best ones for food. But you don't take care of the flock! 4You have never protected the weak ones or healed the sick ones or bandaged those that get hurt. You let them wander off and never look for those that get lost. You are cruel and mean to my sheep. 5 They strayed in every direction, and because there was no shepherd to watch them, they were attacked and eaten by wild animals. 6So my sheep were scattered across the earth. They roamed on hills and mountains, without anyone even bothering to look for them.
7-8Now listen to what I, the living Lord God, am saying to you shepherds. My sheep have been attacked and eaten by wild animals, because you refused to watch them. You never went looking for the lost ones, and you fed yourselves without feeding my sheep. 9-10So I, the Lord, will punish you! I will rescue my sheep from you and never let you be their shepherd again or butcher them for food. I, the Lord, have spoken.
The Lord Is the Good Shepherd
11The Lord God then said:
I will look for my sheep and take care of them myself, 12just as a shepherd looks for lost sheep. My sheep have been lost since that dark and miserable day when they were scattered throughout the nations. But I will rescue them 13and bring them back from the foreign nations where they now live. I will be their shepherd and will let them graze on Israel's mountains and in the valleys and fertile fields. 14They will be safe as they feed on grassy meadows and green hills. 15I promise to take care of them and keep them safe, 16to look for those that are lost and bring back the ones that wander off, to bandage those that are hurt and protect the ones that are weak. I will also slaughter those that are fat and strong, because I always do right.
Judgment on the Strong Sheep
17The Lord God said to his sheep, the people of Israel:
I will carefully watch each one of you to decide which ones are the strong sheep and which ones are weak. 18Some of you eat the greenest grass, then trample down what's left when you finish. Others drink clean water, then step in the water to make the rest of it muddy. 19That means my other sheep have nothing fit to eat or drink.
20So I, the Lord God, will separate you strong sheep from the weak. 21You strong ones have used your powerful horns to chase off those that are weak, 22but I will rescue them and no longer let them be mistreated. I will separate the good from the bad.
23 After that, I will give you a shepherd from the family of my servant King David. All of you, both strong and weak, will have the same shepherd, and he will take good care of you. 24 He will be your leader, and I will be your God. I, the Lord, have spoken.
A Bright Future for the Lord's Sheep
The Lord God said:
25The people of Israel are my sheep, and I solemnly promise that they will live in peace. I will chase away every wild animal from the desert and the forest, so my sheep will not be afraid. 26They will live around my holy mountain, and I will bless them by sending more than enough rain 27to make their trees produce fruit and their crops to grow. I will set them free from slavery and let them live safely in their own land. Then they will know that I am the Lord. 28Foreign nations will never again rob them, and wild animals will no longer kill and eat them. They will have nothing to fear. 29I will make their fields produce large amounts of crops, so they will never again go hungry or be laughed at by foreigners. 30Then everyone will know that I protect my people Israel. I, the Lord, make this promise. 31They are my sheep; I am their God, and I take care of them.
translation_text:
Yizilayɛ mboaneneavolɛma
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne kile Yizilayɛ mboaneneavolɛma ne. Ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne kile bɛ kɛ, kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle mese la ɛne: Bɛmɛ Yizilayɛ mboaneneavolɛma mɔɔ yɛne bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo a, bɛwie! Asoo mboaneneavolɛ fa mboane kɔ adidi a, tɛ yemɔ yɛɛ ɔnea mboane ne mɔ ɔmaa bɛdidi a? 3Na bɛmɛ, bɛku mɔɔ ɛlɔ la bɛdi, bɛpepɛ bɛ nwo enrinli bɛnwo ndanlɛ bɛkeda; noko bɛmmaa mboane ne mɔ aleɛ. 4Bɛannea mɔɔ anwo ɛbɛlɛ ye la, bɛanyɛ mɔɔ ɛnde kpɔkɛ la ayile, mɔɔ ɛboda la, bɛambɔ ye bɔlɛ, mɔɔ vonle adenle la, bɛanva ye bɛamba, bɛamkpondɛ mɔɔ ɛminli la, na bɛvale atisesebɛ nee amumuyɛ a bɛnleanle bɛ a. 5 Yemɔti bɛbɔle asande, ɔboalekɛ ɛnee bɛnlɛ mɔɔ nea bɛ a; na bɛyɛle aleɛ bɛmanle ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole. 6Me mboane ne mɔ bɔle asande, bɛluoluale awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi ne mɔ azo; me mboane ne mɔ bɔle asande wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo amuala, na bɛannyia awie amkpondɛ bɛ anzɛɛ amkpo bɛ bo zo.
7“Zɔhane ati, bɛmɛ mboaneneavolɛma, bɛdie mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma melɛka meahile bɛ la: 8Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame Awulae Nyamenle mede aze la, kɛmɔ me mboane ne ɛdɔ agyie, na bɛyɛ aleɛ bɛmaa ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole, na bɛnlɛ mboaneneavolɛ biala, kɛmɔ me mboaneneavolɛma ne amkpo me mboane ne mɔ abo zo, na mboaneneavolɛma ne ɛli bɛdabɛ bɛ ngome bɛ nwo adane, na bɛanyɛne me mboane ne la, 9bɛmɛ mboaneneavolɛma, bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne: 10Kɛ medame, Awulae Nyamenle mese la ɛne: Bɛnlea, mekpo mboaneneavolɛma ne, na mebabiza bɛ mealie me mboane ne mɔ, na meamaa bɛagyakyi me mboane ne ɛyɛnelɛ. Bɛnrɛli bɛ ngome bɛ nwo adane bieko. Mebalie me mboane ne meavi bɛ nloa anu, amaa yeanyɛ aleɛ yeammaa bɛ.
Mboaneneavolɛ kpalɛ ne
11“Ɔluakɛ kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle mese la ɛne: Bɛnlea, medame, medame mumua ne mebakpondɛ me mboane ne toonwo meahɔnwu bɛ. 12Kɛmɔ mboaneneavolɛ mɔɔ ye mboane mɔɔ ɛbɔ asande la si kpondɛ ye mboane ne mɔ la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebakpondɛ me mboane ne mɔ a. Mebalie bɛ meavi ɛleka mɔɔ bɛzande bɛ bɛhɔgua la wɔ amungu nee awozinli kenle ne. 13Mebaye bɛ meavi maanle maanle ne mɔ anu; mebaboɔboa bɛ nloa meavi maanle maanle ne mɔ anu, na meava bɛ meara bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu. Mebayɛne bɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ azo, azudenle ne mɔ anloa, nee maanle ne anu ɛleka biala mɔɔ sonla tɛnla a ɔyɛ boɛ la. 14Mebamaa bɛ adidileka kpalɛ, wɔ Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ azo. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛbadɛnla azɛlɛ kpalɛ mɔɔ aleɛ wɔ zolɛ la azo, na bɛadidi Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ azo adidileka kpalɛ ne a. 15Medame mumua ne mebayɛ me mboane ne neavolɛ na meamaa bɛala bɛalie bɛ ɛnwomenle. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.
16“Mebakpondɛ mɔɔ ɛminli la, na me nee mɔɔ agyakɛ ɛvo adenle la azia ara sua nu; mebabɔ mɔɔ ɛbubu la bɔlɛ, meamaa mɔɔ anwo ɛbɛlɛ ye la anyia anwosesebɛ, na mɔɔ ɛhye nee mɔɔ lɛ anwosesebɛ la, mebavede me nye meanlea bɛ boɛ. Mebamaa biala aleɛ, kɛmɔ ɔfɛta la.
17“Na bɛmɛ, me mboane ekpunli, medame Awulae Nyamenle mese: Bɛnlea, mebabua bɛ ndɛne na meaye kpalɛ ne meavi ɛtane ne mɔ avinli; meaye mbɔnkye ne mɔ meavi mboane ne avinli. 18Bɛdi ndile kpalɛ ne bɛwie a, ɔnle kɛ bɛtietia mɔɔ kɛha la azo; na bɛno nzule kpalɛ anye komikomi bɛwie a, bɛatietia nu bɛakpoto ye. 19Ɛnee bɛkpondɛ bɛaze kɛ me mboane ne ɛli mɔɔ bɛmɛ bɛtietia zolɛ la, na bɛnlo nzule ne mɔɔ bɛkpoto ye la ɔ?
20“Yemɔti, medame Awulae Nyamenle, meka meahile bɛ kɛ: Bɛnlea kɛ akee medame, medame mumua ne, mebabua mboane kyenlera ne mɔ nee mboane nwanlera ne mɔ ndɛne. 21Kɛmɔ bɛfa bɛ nvenle nee bɛ bati bɛsuhuzuhu mboane nwanlera ne mɔ, na bɛfa bɛ mɛne bɛwowɔ bɛ bɛmaa bɛbɔ asande bɛkɔ maanle zo la ati, 22mebalie me mboane ekpunli ne ati. Bɛnrɛdɔ agyie bieko; na mebabua bɛ ndɛne meaye mboane kpalɛ ne meavi ɛtane ne avinli. 23Mebamaa bɛ mboaneneavolɛ ko, me akɛlɛ Devidi, na yeayɛne bɛ. Ɔbayɛne bɛ na yeayɛ bɛ neavolɛ. 24Na medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma, mebayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, na me akɛlɛ Devidi ali bɛ belemgbunli, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a. 25Me nee bɛ bayɛ anzonudwolɛ ngyekyeleɛ na meavoa nanemgbole ne mɔ meavi azɛlɛ ne azo, amaa bɛadɛnla fienemgbole ne anu anwondɔlɛ nu na bɛala kpɔkɛ nu mbaka ne mɔ abo bɛalafe.
26“Mebayila bɛ na meayila ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne la amuala. Mebamaa ezule anyenye wɔ bɛ ɛlobɔ ne mɔ anloa ayɛ nyilalɛ amaa bɛ. 27Ɛbɔ nu mbaka bazo ma amaa bɛ, na azɛlɛ ne amaa bɛ aleɛ ahye, na bɛ nwo adɔ bɛ wɔ bɛ maanle ne anu. Saa meye bɛ kɔme kpomgbolo, na medie bɛ mefi menli mɔɔ ɛva bɛ ɛyɛ bɛ ahanra la asa anu a, bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 28Bɛnrɛdɔ agyie bɛnrɛmaa maanle maanle, yɛɛ azɛlɛ ne azo nanemgbole biala ɛnrɛhye bie ɛnrɛli. Bɛ nwo badɔ bɛ, yɛɛ awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛmaa bɛ ahonle ɛnrɛdu. 29Mebamaa bɛ egyinli ne mɔ ahye, amaa ɛhɔne angu bɛ bieko wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo, na maanle maanle ne mɔ angolo bɛ nwo bieko. 30Bɛbanwu kɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, me nee bɛ lua, na bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛma amuala, bɛle me menli. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.
31“Bɛle me mboane, me adidileka mboane, yɛɛ mele bɛ Nyamenle. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”

english_text:
Edom Will Be a Wasteland
1 The Lord said:
2Ezekiel, son of man, condemn the people of Edom 3and say to them:
I, the Lord God,
am now your enemy!
And I will turn your nation
into an empty wasteland,
4leaving your towns in ruins.
Your land will be a desert,
and then you will know
that I am the Lord.
5People of Edom, not only have you been Israel's longtime enemy, you simply watched when disaster wiped out its people as punishment for their sins. 6And so, as surely as I am the living Lord God, you are guilty of murder and must be put to death. 7I will destroy your nation and kill anyone who travels through it. 8Dead bodies will cover your mountains and fill up your valleys, 9and your land will lie in ruins forever. No one will live in your towns ever again. You will know that I am the Lord.
10You thought the nations of Judah and Israel belonged to you, and that you could take over their territory. But I am their God, 11and as surely as I live, I will punish you for treating my people with anger and hatred. Then they will know that I, the Lord, am punishing you! 12And you will finally realize that I heard you laugh at their destruction and say their land was yours to take. 13You even insulted me, but I heard it all.
14Everyone on earth will celebrate when I destroy you, 15just as you celebrated when Israel was destroyed. Your nation of Edom will be nothing but a wasteland. Then everyone will know that I am the Lord.
translation_text:
Nyamenle ndeanlɛ mɔɔ wɔ Yidɔm anwo zo
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2Ɔse, “Sonla ra, kakyi ɛ nye wɔ Yidɔm maanle ne anwo na ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ tia ye la. 3Ka kile ye kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se:
Nea, bɛmɛ Yidɔm awoka, meyɛ bɛ kpɔvolɛ!
Mebadenrɛ me sa meatia bɛ,
na meamaa bɛadɔ mgbane.
4Mebamaa bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ ayɛ azuadu,
na bɛ azɛlɛ ne adɔ mgbane,
na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
5“Kɛmɔ ɛnee bɛle Yizilayɛma kpɔvolɛ kpalɛ kpalɛ, na bɛyele bɛ bɛmanle bɛhunle bɛ wɔ bɛ anwubɛnyunlu mekɛ nu, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛtea bɛ ndeanlɛ mɔɔ li amozi la ati, 6suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Awulae Nyamenle la, mebaha bɛ mogya meagua, na mogya adu bɛ mgbaliko, ɔboalekɛ bɛdi fɔlɛ kɛ bɛha mogya bɛgua, yemɔti mogya badu bɛ mgbaliko. 7Mebamaa Yidɔm maanle ne adɔ mgbane mɔɔ awie ɛnrɛdɛnla nu a; yɛɛ mebahu menli mɔɔ ba nu kɔ la amuala. 8Bɛ awoka mgbole ne mɔ azo bayɛ avunli ngome, na dɔɔnwo noko adɔ dadeɛ nloa agua bɛ awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, mbɔnza ne mɔ anu, nee bɛ awoka ne mɔ avinli ahuma ne mɔ anu. 9Mebamaa bɛ maanle ne abɔ bɔkɔɔ, yɛɛ awie ɛnrɛdɛnla bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo. Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.
10“Bɛdabɛ, bɛ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, ‘Maanle nwiɔ ɛhye, Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ bayɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ, na yɛbava yɛayɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ bɔkɔɔ,’ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mede bɛ avinli la. 11Zɔhane ati, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Suzuamgba ala mɔɔ medame a mele tease Nyamenle ne la, me nee bɛ bali, kɛmɔ bɛ ɛya nee bɛ anyebolo ne mɔɔ bɛvale bɛkpɔle me menli ne la si de la. Akee mebaye me nwo meahile bɛ wɔ bɛ ndɛnebualɛ nu. 12Na bɛbanwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, mede aholoba mɔɔ bɛvale bɛbɔle Yizilayɛ maanle ne, na bɛhanle kɛ, ‘Maanle ne mɔ ɛdɔ mgbane, bɛva bɛmaa yɛ kɛ yɛzɛkye bɛ’ la. 13Bɛmemanle bɛ nwo zo, bɛhehanle mgbole bɛtietiale me, na bɛhehanle edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo bɛtietiale me. Mendele.
14“Medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Mebamaa bɛadɔ mgbane, amaa ewiade kɔsɔɔti anye alie. 15Kɛ bɛzile bɛ nye liele Yizilayɛma azedɔlɛ nee bɛ mgbane mɔɔ bɛyɛle la anwo la, zɔhane ala yɛɛ mebayɛ bɛdabɛ noko a. Siyɛ awoka ne mɔ azo, Yidɔm maanle ne amuala badɔ mgbane. Na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_text:
A Message for Israel's Mountains
1The Lord said:
Ezekiel, son of man, tell the mountains of Israel 2that I, the Lord God, am saying:
Your enemies sneered and said that you mountains belonged to them. 3They ruined and crushed you from every side, and foreign nations captured and made fun of you. 4So all you mountains and hills, streams and valleys, listen to what I will do. Your towns may now lie in ruins, and nations may laugh and insult you. 5But in my fierce anger, I will turn against those nations, and especially the Edomites, because they laughed at you the loudest and took over your pasturelands. 6You have suffered long enough, and, I, the Lord God, am very angry! Nations have insulted you, 7so I will now insult and disgrace them. That is my solemn promise.
8Trees will grow on you mountains of Israel and produce fruit for my people, because they will soon come home. 9I will take care of you by plowing your soil and planting crops on your fertile slopes. 10The people of Israel will return and rebuild your ruined towns and live in them. 11Children will be born, and animals will give birth to their young. You will no longer be deserted as you are now, but you will be covered with people and treated better than ever. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
12I will bring my people Israel home, and they will live on you mountains, because you belong to them, and your fertile slopes will never again let them starve. 13It's true that you have been accused of not producing enough food and of letting your people starve. 14-15But I, the Lord, promise that you won't hear other nations laugh and sneer at you ever again. From now on, you will always produce plenty of food for your people. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
The Lord Will Be Honored
16The Lord said:
17Ezekiel, son of man, when the people of Israel were living in their own country, they made the land unclean by the way they behaved, just as a woman's monthly period makes her unclean. 18They committed murders and worshiped idols, which made the land even worse. So in my anger, I punished my people 19and scattered them throughout the nations, just as they deserved. 20Wherever they went, my name was disgraced, because foreigners insulted my people by saying I had forced them out of their own land.
21I care what those foreigners think of me, 22so tell the Israelites that I am saying:
You have disgraced my holy name among the nations where you now live. So you don't deserve what I'm going to do for you. I will lead you home to bring honor to my name 23and to show foreign nations that I am holy. Then they will know that I am the Lord God. I have spoken.
24I will gather you from the foreign nations and bring you home. 25I will sprinkle you with clean water, and you will be clean and acceptable to me. I will wash away everything that makes you unclean, and I will remove your disgusting idols. 26 I will take away your stubborn heart and give you a new heart and a desire to be faithful. You will have only pure thoughts, 27because I will put my Spirit in you and make you eager to obey my laws and teachings. 28You will once again live in the land I gave your ancestors; you will be my people, and I will be your God.
29I will protect you from anything that makes you unclean. Your fields will overflow with grain, and no one will starve. 30Your trees will be filled with fruit, and crops will grow in your fields, so that you will never again feel ashamed for not having enough food. 31You will remember your evil ways and hate yourselves for what you've done. 32People of Israel, I'm not doing these things for your sake. You sinned against me, and you must suffer shame and disgrace for what you have done. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
33After I have made you clean, I will let you rebuild your ruined towns and let you live in them. 34Your land will be plowed again, and nobody will be able to see that it was once barren. 35Instead, they will say that it looks as beautiful as the garden of Eden. They won't see towns lying in ruins, but they will see your strong cities filled with people. 36Then the nearby nations that survive will know that I am the one who rebuilt the ruined places and replanted the barren fields. I, the Lord, make this promise.
37I will once again answer your prayers, and I will let your nation grow until you are like a large flock of sheep. 38The towns that now lie in ruins will be filled with people, just as Jerusalem was once filled with sheep to be offered as sacrifices during a festival. Then you will know that I am the Lord.
translation_text:
Nyamenle nyilalɛ mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛma anwo zo
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Na wɔmɔ, sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne kile Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ na se bɛ kɛ, ‘O Yizilayɛ awoka, bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne.’ 2Kɛ medame Awulae Nyamenle mese la ɛne: Kɛmɔ kpɔvolɛ ne zelele bɛ na bɛhanle kɛ, ‘Mɔmoane awoka ne mɔ ɛyɛ yɛ ɛdeɛ’ la ati, 3ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne na se bɛ kɛ, medame Awulae Nyamenle mese: Ɛnee, kɛmɔ bɛmanle bɛdɔle mgbane, na bɛvi ɛleka ngakyile bɛraholole bɛ nwo zo, maanle maanle ne mɔ hyɛle bɛ vale, bɛ nwo donle, na menli vale bɛ lile ɛfenle la ati, 4Yizilayɛ awoka, bɛdie Awulae Nyamenle ne edwɛkɛ. Awulae Nyamenle ne ɛlɛse bɛmɛ awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi, awoka avinli ahuma nee mbɔnza, azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ ɛdɔ mgbane nee azuamgbole mɔɔ ɛyɛ azuadu, mɔɔ ɛdɔ agyie ɛmaa maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la kɛ, 5‘Medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Melɛ ɛya kpole nee anyebolo melɛtendɛ meatia maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛha la, nee Yidɔmma kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ hyɛle me azɛlɛ ne manle bɛ nwo anyelielɛ nu, adubɛnwo nu kɛ bɛfa na bɛave zolɛ ninyɛne bɛali la.’
6“Yemɔti ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ fane Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ne anwo la na se awoka mgbole nee ngyikyi, awoka avinli ahuma nee mbɔnza ne mɔ kɛ, medame Awulae Nyamenle mese: Meva ɛya kpole kpalɛ a melɛtendɛ a, ɔboalekɛ bɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ maanle maanle asa anu. 7Yemɔti, medame Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Meka, meka kɛ, maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la banwu zɔhane amaneɛ ne bie. 8Na bɛmɛ Yizilayɛ awoka, mbaka bafifi zolɛ, na bɛazo ma bɛamaa me menli Yizilayɛma, ɔluakɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na bɛazia bɛara sua nu. 9Ɔluakɛ, bɛnlea, mele bɛ ɛdeɛ. Mebahakyi me nye bɛ nwo zo, na bɛbazo bɛ ɛya bɛalua. 10Mebamaa menli dɔɔnwo aradɛnla ɛkɛ, meka Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti. Menli badɛnla azuamgbole ne mɔ azo na bɛaziezie ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ ɛdɔ mgbane la. 11Mebamaa menli nee nane azo awoka ne mɔ azo; bɛ nwo bazo na bɛawo dɔɔnwo. Mebamaa bɛadɛnla, kɛmɔ alumua ne bɛde la, na meayɛ kpalɛ dɔɔnwo meamaa bɛ, meadɛla mɔɔ mɔmoane menyɛle la. Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 12Ɛhɛe, mebamaa me menli Yizilayɛma aradɛnla awoka ne mɔ azo na bɛava bɛayɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ, na bɛ mra ɛnrɛhye ɛhɔne bieko.
13“Medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ, menli ka kɛ, ‘Ɛdi menli, yɛɛ ɛkye maanle ne anu amra ɛhɔne ɛku bɛ.’ 14Yemɔti ɛnrɛhu menli bieko yɛɛ ɛnrɛhye menli ne ɛhɔne bieko ɛnrɛhu bɛ. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a. 15Menrɛmaa ɛnrɛde maanle maanle ne mɔ aholoba ɛbɔlɛ ne bieko, ɛ nyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anyunlu yɛɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛnrɛdu koti bieko. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”
Yizilayɛma ɛbɛlabɔlɛ fofolɛ
16Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 17Ɔse, “Sonla ra, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Yizilayɛma de bɛ maanle nu la, bɛvale bɛ ɛbɛlabɔlɛ nee ninyɛndane bɛzɛkyele ye. Wɔ me nye zo a, bɛ nyɛleɛ ne ɛtane le kɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛhɔ amozi la. 18Yemɔti menwolale me ɛya ne menguale bɛ ti zo wɔ mogya ne mɔɔ bɛha bɛgua azɛlɛ ne azo, nee bɛ mmonle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛva bɛzɛkye azɛlɛ ne la ati. 19Memkpondenle bɛ wɔ maanle maanle zo na bɛzandele maanle ne mɔ anu. Kɛ bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ nee bɛ subane ne mɔ si de la yɛɛ menluale zolɛ mendeanle bɛ a. 20Noko mɔɔ bɛhɔle maanle ne mɔ anu la, ɛleka biala mɔɔ bɛhɔle la, bɛzɛkyele me duma nwuanzanwuanza ne. Yemɔti menli hanle ye bɛ nwo kɛ, ‘Ɛhye mɔ le Ɛdɛnkɛma ɔdaye ye menli, noko akee ɔwɔ kɛ bɛfi ye azɛlɛ ne azo ala.’ 21Na me duma nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ Yizilayɛma manle bɛguale nwolɛ evinli wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛhɔle nu la anu la ɛnee hyia me.
22“Zɔhane ati, ka kile Yizilayɛma kɛ: Medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Tɛ bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma ati yɛɛ mekeha me nwo a, na me duma nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔɔ bɛzɛkye ye wɔ maanle maanle mɔɔ bɛhɔle nu la ati ɔ. 23Me duma nwuanzanwuanza kpole ne mɔɔ bɛzɛkye ye wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ avinli la, mebakpogya ye zo kpole bie, na maanle maanle ne mɔ banwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a; mebalua bɛdabɛ Yizilayɛma bɛ nwo zo meakpogya me nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne zo wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anye zo. 24Ɔluakɛ mebaye bɛ meavi maanle maanle ne mɔ avinli, meaboɔboa bɛ nloa wɔ maanle ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛwɔ nu la anu, na meava bɛ meara bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu. 25Mebakponde nzule mɔɔ anye te la bɛ nwo, na bɛ nwo bade avi bɛ ɛtane biala nee bɛ mmonle mɔɔ bɛzonlenle la anwo. 26 Mebamaa bɛ ahonle fofolɛ, meava sunsum fofolɛ meawula bɛ nuhua, na meaye bolɛ ahonle ne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nu la na meamaa bɛ ahonle bɛlɛvolɛ. 27Mebava me sunsum ne meawula bɛ nuhua, na meamaa bɛali me mɛla ne mɔ azo, na bɛanlea boɛ bɛali me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ azo. 28Bɛbadɛnla azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ menvale memanle bɛ ze mɔ la azo, bɛbayɛ me menli na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle. 29Mebaye bɛ meavi ninyɛndane biala anwo, na meamaa bɛanyia abɛlɛ dɔɔnwo; menrɛmaa ɛhɔne ɛnrɛhu bɛ. 30Mebamaa bɛ mbaka azo dɔɔnwo na bɛ ɛya nu aleɛ ahye, amaa ɛhɔne angu bɛ angua bɛ nyunlu aze bieko wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anyunlu. 31Na akee bɛbahakye bɛ ninyɛndane nee bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛle la, na bɛavu bɛ nwo kɛ bɛyɛle amumuyɛ nee bɛkyi ninyɛne zɔhane mɔ a. 32Tɛ bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma ati yɛɛ mekeha me nwo a, medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a. Bɛmaa ɔla bɛ ti anu. O Yizilayɛma, bɛmaa bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛyɛ bɛ nyiane ɛmaa bɛ ti ɛzi aze.”
33Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Kenle mɔɔ mebanlua bɛ wɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ne mɔ ati la, mebamaa bɛahɔdɛnla bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo, na bɛakyekye bɛ azua mɔɔ ɛyɛ azuadu la. 34Bɛbazo ɛya wɔ azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ dɔle mgbane la azo, wɔ menli mɔɔ zenle azɛlɛ ne azo la anye zo. 35Na bɛbaha kɛ, ‘Azɛlɛ ɛhye mɔɔ dɔle mgbane la azo ɛyɛ gbudugbudu kɛ Yidɛn Tola ne la, na azuamgbole mɔɔ yɛle azuadu la kɛkala azo ɛyɛ gbudugbudu, na bɛlie nwolɛ bane.’ 36Na akee maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛbɔ ɛyia bɛ la banwu kɛ, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mekyekye azua ne mɔ na memaa ɛleka mɔɔ dɔle mgbane la ɛfifi a. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a, yɛɛ mebayɛ noko.”
37Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Eza mebamaa Yizilayɛma abiza me bɛamaa meayɛ ɛhye meamaa bɛ. Mebamaa bɛ nwo azo kɛ mboane ekpunli. 38Mebamaa bɛ azuamgbole mɔɔ yɛle azuadu la azo ayɛ menli gbudugbudu, kɛmɔ azubɔlɛ mekɛ dwu a Gyɛlusalɛm yɛ mboane ngome la. Na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_text:
Dry Bones Live Again
1Some time later, I felt the Lord's power take control of me, and his Spirit carried me to a valley full of bones. 2The Lord showed me all around, and everywhere I looked I saw bones that were dried out. 3He said, “Ezekiel, son of man, can these bones come back to life?”
I replied, “Lord God, only you can answer that.”
4He then told me to say:
Dry bones, listen to what the Lord is saying to you, 5“I, the Lord God, will put breath in you, and once again you will live. 6I will wrap you with muscles and skin and breathe life into you. Then you will know that I am the Lord.”
7I did what the Lord said, but before I finished speaking, I heard a rattling noise. The bones were coming together! 8I saw muscles and skin cover the bones, but they had no life in them.
9The Lord said:
Ezekiel, now say to the wind, “The Lord God commands you to blow from every direction and to breathe life into these dead bodies, so they can live again.”
10 As soon as I said this, the wind blew among the bodies, and they came back to life! They all stood up, and there were enough to make a large army.
11The Lord said:
Ezekiel, the people of Israel are like dead bones. They complain that they are dried up and that they have no hope for the future. 12So tell them, “I, the Lord God, promise to open your graves and set you free. I will bring you back to Israel, 13and when that happens, you will realize that I am the Lord. 14My Spirit will give you breath, and you will live again. I will bring you home, and you will know that I have kept my promise. I, the Lord, have spoken.”
Judah and Israel Together Again
15The Lord said:
16Ezekiel, son of man, get a stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Judah.” Then get another stick and write on it, “The kingdom of Israel.” 17Hold these two sticks end to end, so they look like one stick. 18And when your people ask you what this means, 19tell them that I, the Lord, will join together the stick of Israel and the stick of Judah. I will hold them in my hand, and they will become one.
20Hold these two sticks where they can be seen by everyone 21and then say:
I, the Lord God, will gather the people of Israel and bring them home from the foreign nations where they now live. 22I will make them into one nation and let them once again live in the land of Israel. Only one king will rule them, and they will never again be divided into two nations. 23They will no longer worship idols and do things that make them unacceptable to me. I will wash away their sin and make them clean, and I will protect them from everything that makes them unclean. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
24-25 Their king will always come from the family of my servant King David and will care for them like a shepherd. The people of Israel will faithfully obey my laws. They and their descendants will live in the land I gave my servant Jacob, just as their ancestors did. 26I solemnly promise to bless the people of Israel with unending peace. I will protect them and let them become a powerful nation. My temple will stand in Israel for all time, 27 and I will live among my people and be their God. 28Every nation on earth will know that my temple is in Israel and that I have chosen the Israelites to be my people.
translation_text:
Mbowule welera bɔnza ne
1Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi ne rahedale me nwo zo, na ye sunsum ne vale me rale bɔnza ne avinli, na menwunle mbowule dɔɔnwo wɔ bɔnza ne anu. 2Na ɔvale me ɔkpɔsale bɛ avinli, na menwunle kɛ ɛnee bɛzonle kpalɛ a bɛwɔ bɔnza ne anu a, na bɛwe bɛyɛ resee zɛhae. 3Na ɔbizale me kɛ, “Sonla ra, asoo mbowule ɛhye mɔ kola nyia ngoane?”
Membuale kɛ, “O Awulae Nyamenle, ɛdawɔ yɛɛ ɛze a.”
4Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne kile mbowule ɛhye mɔ na se bɛ kɛ, O mbowule welera, bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma ane. 5Awulae Nyamenle ne ɛlɛka ahile bɛmɛ mbowule kɛ: Mebamaa ɛnwomenle awolo bɛ nu na bɛbanyia ngoane. 6Mebamaa bɛanyia ndinli, nwonane ara nwolɛ, nwoma arafɔle nwolɛ, na meava ɛnwomenle meawula bɛ nu na bɛanyia ngoane; na bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”
7Yemɔti menganle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne, kɛmɔ bɛzele me la. Mɔɔ melɛka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne la, mendele ɛnelɛ bie kɛ ɔlɛsu kpoladada, na mbowule ne mɔ rasisiale zolɛ. 8Me nye gyi bɛ nwo ala la, bɛnyianle ndinli, nwonane rale nwolɛ, na nwoma rafɔlele nwolɛ noko ɛnee ɛnwomenle ɛnle bɛ nu.
9Na Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne kile anwoma. Sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne na se anwoma ne kɛ, ‘Awulae Nyamenle ne se: O sunsum, ɛvi anwoma nna ne anu bɛla bagu ɛnwomenle gua menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ bɛhunle bɛ la nu maa bɛnyia ngoane.’ ”
10 Yemɔti menganle Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne, kɛmɔ ɔzele me la, na ɛnwomenle rale bɛ nu na bɛnyianle ngoane, bɛdwazole bɛgyinlanle, na ɛnee bɛ nwo zonle kpole kpalɛ.
11Akee Nyamenle zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, mbowule ɛhye mɔ a le Yizilayɛma amuala. Nea, bɛ edwɛkɛ a le kɛ, ‘Yɛ mbowule ɛwe, yɛnlɛ anyelazo biala; bɛpɛ yɛ bɛgua bɔkɔɔ ala ɛne.’ 12Zɔhane ati ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne na se bɛ kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se: O me menli, bɛnlea, mebabukebuke bɛ nla ne mɔ, meadwazo bɛ meavi bɛ nla ne mɔ anu, na me nee bɛ ahɔ sua nu wɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo. 13Na saa mebukebuke bɛ nla ne mɔ na medwazo bɛ meba ngoane nu a, me menli ne akee banwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 14Mebava me Sunsum ne meawula bɛ nuhua, na bɛanyia ngoane, na meava bɛ meahɔgua bɛdabɛ bɛ azɛlɛ ne azo; na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a meha a, yɛɛ meyɛ. Medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, kɛ mese la ɛne.”
Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ yɛ belemgbunli maanle ko
15Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 16Ɔse, “Sonla ra, fa baka na kɛlɛ nwolɛ, ‘Dwuda ɛdeɛ ɔ, na Yizilayɛma amuala nee ye le ko;’ eza fa baka ko noko na kɛlɛ nwolɛ, ‘Dwosefi ɛdeɛ ɔ (ɛhye le Yifelaem baka) na Yizilayɛma amuala nee ye le ko.’ 17Akee fa mbaka nwiɔ ne bɔ nwolɛ yɛ bɛ baka ko wɔ ɛ sa nu. 18Na saa wɔ menli ne biza wɔ kɛ, ‘Ɛnrɛhile yɛ deɛ mɔɔ ɛhye kile la abo?’ a, 19ka kile bɛ kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Bɛnlea, meyɛ kɛ mefa Dwosefi baka ne (mɔɔ Yifelaem lɛ ye ɔ sa nu la) nee Yizilayɛ mbusua ekpunli ekpunli ne mɔ mɔɔ nee ye ɛyɛ ko la, na meava ye nee Dwuda baka ɛdeɛ ne meabɔ bɛ nu meayɛ bɛ baka ko wɔ me sa nu.
20“Mɔɔ akee bɛkɛnwu kɛ ɛlɛ mbaka nwiɔ ne mɔɔ wɔhɛlɛhɛlɛ nwolɛ la ɛ sa nu wɔ bɛ nyunlu ɛkɛ ne la, 21se bɛ kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Mebahɔva Yizilayɛma mɔɔ wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ azo la, meaboɔboa bɛ nloa, na me nee bɛ ara bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu. 22Mebayɛ bɛ maanle ko wɔ Yizilayɛ awoka maanle ne anu. Belemgbunli ko ala a bazie bɛ a. Bɛnrɛyɛ maanle nwiɔ bieko yɛɛ bɛnrɛyɛ arelemgbunli maanle nwiɔ. 23Bɛnrɛzonle mmonle bɛnrɛgua bɛ nwo evinli; bɛnrɛyɛ bɛkyi debie biala, yɛɛ bɛnrɛtietia me mɛla ne mɔ azo. Mebalie bɛ meavi ninyɛne mɔɔ manle bɛyɛle ɛtane la asa anu na meade bɛ nwo. Bɛbayɛ me menli, na medame meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle. 24 Me sonvolɛ Devidi bali bɛ belemgbunli anlea bɛ nwo zo, na bɛ muala bɛanyia mboaneneavolɛ kokye. Bɛbali me ngyehyɛlɛ ne mɔ anzi na bɛanlea bɛali me mɛla ne mɔ azo. 25Bɛbadɛnla azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ bɛ ze mɔ dɛnlanle zolɛ na menvale memanle me sonvolɛ Gyekɔbo la azo. Bɛdabɛ, bɛ mra, yɛɛ bɛ bo zo amra kɔsɔɔti badɛnla ɛkɛ ne dahuu, na me sonvolɛ Devidi ali bɛ belemgbunli dahuu. 26Me nee bɛ bayɛ anzonudwolɛ ngyekyeleɛ; ɔbayɛ me nee bɛ yɛ ngyekyeleɛ mɔɔ bɛntulu ye ɛlɛ a. Mebayila bɛ na meamaa bɛ nwo azo, na meazi me Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bɛ avinli, mɔɔ bɛndu ye bieko ɛlɛ a. 27 Mebadɛnla bɛ avinli, na meayɛ bɛ Nyamenle, na bɛayɛ me menli. 28Na akee maanle maanle ne mɔ banwu kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma a mete Yizilayɛma anwo a, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ me Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza wɔ bɛ avinli dahuu la.”

english_text:
Gog Invades Israel
1The Lord said:
2 Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog, that wicked ruler of the kingdoms of Meshech and Tubal in the land of Magog. Tell him:
3I, the Lord God, am your enemy, 4and I will make you powerless! I will put a hook in your jaw and drag away both you and your large army. You command cavalry troops that wear heavy armor and carry shields and swords. 5Your army includes soldiers from Persia, Ethiopia, and Libya, 6as well as from Gomer and Beth-Togarmah in the north. Your army is enormous!
7So keep your troops prepared to fight, 8because in a few years, I will command you to invade Israel, a country that was ruined by war. It was deserted for a long time, but its people have returned from the foreign nations where they once lived. The Israelites now live in peace in the mountains of their own land. 9But you and your army will attack them like a fierce thunderstorm and surround them like a cloud.
10When that day comes, I know that you will have an evil plan 11to take advantage of Israel, that weak and peaceful country where people live safely inside towns that have no walls or gates or locks. 12You will rob the people in towns that were once a pile of rubble. These people lived as prisoners in foreign nations, but they have returned to Israel, the most important place in the world, and they own livestock and property. 13The people of Sheba and Dedan, along with merchants from villages in southern Spain, will be your allies. They will want some of the silver and gold, as well as the livestock and property that your army takes from Israel.
14I, the Lord God, know that when you see my people Israel living in peace, 15you will lead your powerful cavalry from your kingdom in the north. 16You will attack my people like a storm-cloud that covers their land. I will let you invade my country Israel, so that every nation on earth will know that I, the Lord, am holy.
Judgment on Gog
17The Lord said to Gog:
Long ago, I ordered my prophets to warn the people of Israel that someday I would send an enemy to attack them. You, Gog, are that enemy, and that day is coming. 18When you invade Israel, I will become furious, 19and in my anger I will send a terrible earthquake to shake Israel. 20Every living thing on earth will tremble in fear of me—every fish and bird, every wild animal and reptile, and every human. Mountains will crumble, cliffs will fall, and cities will collapse. 21I, the Lord, will make the mountains of Israel turn against you. Your troops will be so terrified that they will attack each other. 22I will strike you with diseases and punish you with death. You and your army will be pounded with rainstorms, hailstones, and burning sulfur. 23I will do these things to show the world that I, the Lord, am holy.
translation_text:
Gɔɔgo
1Ɛdɛnkɛma dendɛle hilele me. 2 Ɔse, “Sonla ra, kakyi ɛ nye wɔ Meegɔɔgo azɛlɛ zo, wɔ Gɔɔgo mɔɔ sie Mihyɛke nee Tubale la, 3na ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ tia ye la kɛ Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Gɔɔgo, Mihyɛke nee Tubale belemgbunli, nea, mekpo wɔ. 4Mebabɔ wɔ nzɛla na meava koba meabɔ wɔ awudwɔlɛ meava wɔ meara, ɛdawɔ nee wɔ ɛlɔnema amuala, wɔ mgbɔnwɔ nee menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ, mɔɔ bɛ muala bɛwulowula konle adɛladeɛ, bɛ nwo zonle kpalɛ na bɛdedɛ bɛ sa nu enyinlike, bɛkola dadeɛ to; 5bie mɔ mɔɔ vi Pɛhyea, Sudan, yɛɛ Lebeya, na bɛdedɛ bɛ sa nu enyinlike, bɛzozo mbulalɛ ahyɛlɛ la boka bɛ; 6Goma nee ye ɛlɔnema, Bɛte Togama nee ye menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ li ɔ nzi mɔɔ bɛvi sɔlɔ nehane la amuala. 7Bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo na bɛla bɛ nwo zo, ɛdawɔ, wɔ ɛlɔnema, yɛɛ maanle maanle mɔɔ ɛhuohua bɛ nloa ɛ nwo ɛkɛ ne la amuala, na yɛ bɛ sinzavolɛ. 8Mekɛ dɔɔnwo se a, bɛbaheha bɛ nwo; nzinlii bɛbava konle badoa maanle ne mɔɔ bɛlie ye bɛvi konle nu la. Menli dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛboɔboale bɛ nloa bɛ nee bɛ vi maanle maanle zo rale Yizilayɛ awoka maanle ne mɔɔ dɔle mgbane mekɛ dɔɔnwo anu la a wɔ ɛkɛ a; ɛnɛ bɛde ye anwondɔlɛ nu yɛɛ bɛndwenle konle nwo. 9Ɛ nee wɔ ɛlɔnema nee maanle maanle mɔɔ li ɛ nzi la bara bɛ nwo zo kɛ ahumu, na wɔayɛ kɛ amungu wɔaheda maanle ne azo.”
10Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Mekɛ zɔhane anu, ɛbanyia adwenle dɔɔnwo na wɔabɔ adwenle ɛtane wɔaha kɛ, 11‘Mefa konle meahɔdoa azua ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛtɛdiele nwolɛ bane la. Mekɔ menli ne mɔɔ anzo nu ɛdwo bɛ na bɛde anwondɔlɛ nu, na bɛtɛdiele bɛ azua ne mɔ anwo bane, na bɛnlɛ nlenkɛ mgbole mɔɔ mbulalɛ gua bɛ nzi la anwo zo, 12amaa yɛave bɛ ninyɛne, yɛazoa ninyɛne mɔɔ yɛkɛnyia la yɛahɔ, yɛahɔha menli ne mɔɔ ɛyɛ gbudugbudu de azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ dɔle mgbane la azo la senle dwɛɛ. Bɛ nee bɛ vi maanle maanle zo a rale a, na bɛlɛ nlankɛ nee ninyɛne dɔɔnwo, yɛɛ bɛde ewiade ye avinli.’ 13Hyiba nee Didan nee gualilɛma mɔɔ vi Tahyehye nee ye namunamu la babiza wɔ kɛ, ‘Wɔra kɛ ɛbave ninyɛne ɔ? Wɔboɔboa wɔ ɛlɔnema anloa kɛ ɛbazoa dwɛtɛ fufule nee ezukoa nvutuke, nlankɛ nee ninyɛne wɔahɔ ɔ?’
14“Yemɔti, sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne na se Gɔɔgo kɛ, Awulae Nyamenle ne se: Mekɛ ne anu mɔɔ ɛnee me menli ne de anwondɔlɛ nu la, 15ɛbaheha ɛ nwo na ɛvi ɛleka mɔɔ ɛde, wɔ sɔlɔ nehane la, wɔava menli ɛwolaa ne mɔɔ li ɛ nzi, mɔɔ biala de ɛkpɔnwɔ zo, na bɛle ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo anwo ɛzulolɛ la, 16wɔara me menli Yizilayɛma anwo zo kɛ amungu la wɔaraheda maanle ne azo. Mekɛ ne mɔɔ li amozi la anu, mebamaa wɔara me azɛlɛ ne azo, na saa medua ɛdawɔ Gɔɔgo ɛ nwo zo meye me nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne mekile a, maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwu me. 17Medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mebiza wɔ kɛ: Wɔmɔ a ɛle sonla ne mɔɔ menluale me sonvolɛ kpɔmanvolɛma anwo zo menganle ɛ nwo edwɛkɛ mɔmoane mɔmoane ne kɛ mebava wɔ meara Yizilayɛma anwo zo la ɔ?”
Nyamenle ndeanlɛ mɔɔ wɔ Gɔɔgo anwo zo
18Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Mekɛ ne anu, mɔɔ Gɔɔgo bara Yizilayɛma maanle ne anu la, mebava ɛya kpole. 19Ɔluakɛ melɛ anyebolo nee ɛya kpole meka kɛ: Mekɛ ne anu, Yizilayɛ maanle ne anu bakpusu kpole kpalɛ. 20Saa meye me nyunlu a, menli mɔɔ wɔ ewiade la amuala, fɛlɛ mɔɔ wɔ nyevile nu, nloma mɔɔ wɔ anwomanyunlu, nane, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ twenle ɔ kɛnra aze la anwo bawozo ye, awoka badwulu agua, yɛɛ bodane boka senze bɔbɔ bagolo agua aze. 21Mebamaa ɛzulolɛ kpole kpalɛ aha Gɔɔgo, medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a. Awie biala bahwe ɔ gɔnwo anwo dadeɛ. 22Mebava ewulenzane nee mogya ɛhanlɛ a meadea ye a. Mebamaa ezuawolɛ, senle nee sɔlefe adɔ bilididi agua ye nee ye ɛlɔnema nee maanle maanle mɔɔ yehwe bɛ yeli ɔ nzi la anwo zo. 23Zɛhae yɛɛ mebahile me kpoleyɛlɛ nee me nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ na meaye me nwo meahile bɛ wɔ maanle maanle anyunlu a. Na akee bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a.”

english_text:
Gog Is Defeated
The Lord said:
1Ezekiel, son of man, condemn Gog and tell him:
You are the ruler of Meshech and Tubal, but I, the Lord, am your enemy! 2I will turn you around and drag you from the north until you reach the mountains of Israel. 3I will knock the bow out of your left hand and the arrows out of your right hand, 4 and you and your army will die on those mountains. Then birds and wild animals will eat the flesh 5of your dead bodies left lying in open fields. I, the Lord, have spoken.
6I will set fire to the land of Magog and to those nations along the seacoast that think they are so secure, and they will know that I am the Lord.
7My people Israel will know me, and they will no longer disgrace my holy name. Everyone on earth will know that I am the holy Lord God of Israel. 8The day is coming when these things will happen, just as I have promised.
9When that day comes, the people in the towns of Israel will collect the weapons of their dead enemies. They will use these shields, bows and arrows, spears, and clubs as firewood, and there will be enough to last for seven years. 10They will burn these weapons instead of gathering sticks or chopping down trees. That's how the Israelites will take revenge on those who robbed and abused them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
The Burial of Gog
The Lord said:
11After Gog has been destroyed, I will bury him and his army in Israel, in Travelers' Valley, east of the Dead Sea. That graveyard will be so large that it will block the way of anyone who tries to walk through the valley, which will then be known as “The Valley of Gog's Army.” 12The Israelites will spend seven months burying dead bodies and cleaning up their land. 13Everyone will help with the burial, and they will be honored for this on the day the brightness of my glory is seen. 14After those seven months, the people will appoint a group of men to look for any dead bodies left unburied. This must be done for seven months to make sure that the land is no longer unclean. 15Whenever they find a human bone, they will set up a marker next to it. Then the gravediggers will bury it in “The Valley of Gog's Army” 16near the town of “Gog's Army.” After that, the land will be pure again.
17 Ezekiel, son of man, I am going to hold a feast on Israel's mountains and offer sacrifices there. So invite all the birds and wild animals to come from every direction and eat the meat of sacrifices and drink the blood. The birds and animals 18will feast on the bodies of warriors and foreign rulers that I will sacrifice like sheep, goats, and bulls. 19I want the birds and animals to eat until they are full and drink until they are drunk. 20They will come to my table and stuff themselves with the flesh of horses and warriors of every kind. I, the Lord God, have spoken.
Israel Will Be Restored
The Lord said:
21When I punish the nations of the earth, they will see the brightness of my glory. 22The people of Israel will know from then on that I am the Lord their God. 23Foreign nations will realize that the Israelites were forced to leave their own land because they sinned against me. I turned my back on my people and let enemies attack and kill them. 24Their lives were wicked and corrupt, and they deserved to be punished.
25Now I will show mercy to the people of Israel and bring them back from the nations where they are living. They are Jacob's descendants, so I will bless them and show that I am holy. 26They will live safely in their own land, but will be ashamed when they remember their evil ways and how they disgraced me. 27Foreign nations will watch as I take the Israelites from enemy lands and bring them back home, and those nations will see that I am holy.
28My people will realize that I, the Lord their God, sent them away as prisoners and now will bring them back to their own land. 29Never again will I turn my back on the people of Israel, and my Spirit will live in them. I, the Lord, have spoken.
translation_text:
Gɔɔgo anwo zo konimlilɛ
1Awulae Nyamenle dendɛle hilele me. Ɔse, “Sonla ra, ka Nyamenle nrɛlaleɛ ne mɔɔ tia Gɔɔgo la na se ye kɛ medame, Awulae Nyamenle, mese: Gɔɔgo, Mihyɛke nee Tubale belemgbunli, mekpo wɔ. 2Mebahakyi ɛ nye na meahwe wɔ me nee wɔ vi sɔlɔ lɔ ara, na meamaa wɔahɔteta Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ. 3Akee mebabɔ wɔ ɛda ne mɔɔ ɛlɛ ye ɛ sa bɛne ne anu la meado, na meamaa wɔ ɛda mbaka ne mɔ vi ɛ sa fema ne anu agua aze. 4Ɛdawɔ yɛɛ wɔ ɛlɔnema nee maanle maanle mɔɔ li ɛ nzi la amuala badɔ Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ azo. Mebava bɛ nwonane meamaa nloma nee nanemgbole ali. 5Bɛbadɔ fienemgbole ne anu; medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a. 6Mebamaa senle adɔ agua Meegɔɔgo nee bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde anwondɔlɛ nu wɔ ɛnweanloa la anwo zo, na bɛanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma a. 7Mebamaa me duma nwuanzanwuanza ne ala ali wɔ Yizilayɛma anu; menrɛmaa bɛnrɛgua me duma nwuanzanwuanza ne anwo evinli bieko, na maanle maanle ne mɔ anwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma, Yizilayɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne a.”
8Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Kenle ne mɔɔ meha nwolɛ edwɛkɛ la ɛlɛba. Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ biala la, ɔbara. 9Na Yizilayɛma mɔɔ dede azuamgbole zo la bahɔ na bɛahɔva bɛ konle ninyɛne, bɛ sa nu enyinlike mgbole nee ngyikyi, ɛda nee ɛda mbaka, yɛɛ atwɛ mɔ bɛayɛ ɛyɛne bɛawuda toonwo ɛvolɛ nsuu. 10Yemɔti ɔnrɛhyia kɛ bɛkɛhɔ ɛbɔ nu kɛ bɛkakpondɛ ɛyɛne anzɛɛ bɛkapepɛ mbaka wɔ kpɔkɛ nu bɛayɛ ɛyɛne, ɔluakɛ bɛbava konle ninyɛne ne mɔ bɛayɛ ɛyɛne bɛawuda. Bɛbave menli mɔɔ venle bɛ ninyɛne la ninyɛne na bɛasesa menli mɔɔ sesale bɛ ninyɛne hɔle la ninyɛne bɛahɔ.” Awulae Nyamenle a se a.
Gɔɔgo ɛzielɛ ne
11Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Kenle zɔhane mebamaa ɛleka wɔ Yizilayɛ na bɛazie Gɔɔgo zolɛ. Ɛleka ne a le Adendulɛma Bɔnza (Ebalem), mɔɔ la Nyevile Wulera ne aduduleɛ la. Ɔbadua adendulɛma adenle, ɔluakɛ ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛbazie Gɔɔgo nee ye menli ɛwolaa ne mɔɔ li ɔ nzi la a; bɛbavɛlɛ ɛkɛ ne Heemɔngɔɔgo Bɔnza. 12Yizilayɛma bava siane nsuu a azie avunli ne mɔ a, amaa bɛadu evinli biala bɛavi azɛlɛ ne azo. 13Awie biala mɔɔ wɔ maanle ne anu la baboa yeamaa bɛazie avunli ne mɔ, na kenle mɔɔ mebaye me anyunlunyia ne meahile la, ɛhye bamaa bɛanyia bɛ nyunlu kpole. Medame Awulae Nyamenle a mese a. 14Bɛbaye menli mɔɔ dahuu baluolua azɛlɛ ne azo azie avunli ne mɔ a, amaa bɛadu evinli biala bɛavi azɛlɛ ne azo. Saa siane nsuu dwu a yɛɛ menli ɛhye mɔ baluolua azɛlɛ ne azo akpondɛ avunli ne mɔ a. 15Saa bɛlua azɛlɛ ne azo na bɛkɔto sonla bowule bie a, ɛnee bɛyɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ bie bɛzie ɛkɛ, na menli mɔɔ sie avunli ne mɔ la arava ahɔzie ye wɔ Heemɔngɔɔgo Bɔnza. 16(Suakpole bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne afoa nu ala, bɛfɛlɛ ye Hamonaa.) Zɛhae yɛɛ bɛbayɛ bɛadu azɛlɛ ne azo evinli biala a.”
17 Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Na wɔmɔ, sonla ra, tendɛ kile nloma ngakyile kɔsɔɔti, nee ɛbɔ nu nane kɔsɔɔti kɛ: Bɛboɔboa bɛ nloa na bɛrɛla, bɛrabɔ azu ne mɔɔ melɛbɔ meamaa bɛ la ɛkponle ne anwo bɛyia. Ɔle azubɔlɛ ɛkponledolɛ kpole kpalɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ awoka ne mɔ azo lɔ, na bɛbali nwonane bɛanlo mogya. 18Bɛbali katakyiema nwonane na bɛanlo azɛlɛ ye azo arelemgbunli mogya, kɛ asɛɛ bɛle mboane nyinli nee mboane mralɛ, mbɔnkye, nlankɛ nyinli nee Beehyan nlankɛ dɔlera. 19Bɛbali bɛ ko ayi, na bɛanlo mogya toonwo bɛabo wɔ me azubɔlɛ ɛkponle ne mɔɔ mebado meamaa bɛ la abo. 20Bɛbali mgbɔnwɔ nee menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la nwonane bɛaboka katakyiema nee ɛlɔnema ngakyile dɔɔnwo nwonane. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”
Yizilayɛ sia ayɛ kɛ ye dɛba ne la
21Ɛdɛnkɛma zele kɛ, “Akee mebamaa maanle maanle anwu me anyunlunyia; maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti banwu me ndeanlɛ mɔɔ meva medea bɛ nee tumi mɔɔ meva meyɛ la. 22Ɔvi kenle ko ne mɔɔ kɔ la, Yizilayɛma banwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a. 23Na maanle maanle banwu kɛ Yizilayɛma ɛtane ti yɛɛ bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu a, yɛɛ kɛmɔ bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa me la ati yɛɛ menyele bɛ memanle bɛ kpɔvolɛma na mendole me nye ɛbɔ nu memanle bɛ muala bɛdɔle dadeɛ nloa a. 24Mendole me nye ɛbɔ nu na me nee bɛ lile wɔ bɛ mɛladonlɛ ne nee bɛ nwo evinli ne mɔ ati.”
25Awulae Nyamenle ne se, “Na kɛkala mebamaa Gyekɔbo abo zo amra akpazi bieko kɛ bɛ dɛba ne la. Mebanwu Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti anwunvɔne, yɛɛ mebanlea me duma nwuanzanwuanza ne boɛ. 26Bɛ rɛle bavi bɛ anyiemgba mɔɔ bɛbɔle, nee ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛle bɛtiale me la, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛdɛnla bɛ maanle ne anu anwondɔlɛ nu na awie ɛnwunlonwunla bɛ la. 27Saa meboɔboa bɛ nloa me nee bɛ vi bɛ kpɔvolɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu ba a, maanle maanle ne mɔ banwu me nwuanzanwuanzayɛlɛ ne. 28Na akee bɛbanwu kɛ medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne a, ɔboalekɛ memanle bɛhyele bɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu wɔ maanle maanle avinli, na eza meboɔboa bɛ nloa me nee bɛ ɛzia ɛra bɛdabɛ bɛ maanle nu. Menrɛgyakyi bie wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ bie anu. 29Menrɛye me nye menrɛdo ɛbɔ nu bieko, na mebava me Sunsum ne meawula Yizilayɛma kɔsɔɔti anu. Medame, Awulae Nyamenle a mese a.”

english_text:
Ezekiel Sees the Future Temple in Jerusalem
1-2 Twenty-five years after King Jehoiachin and the rest of us had been led away as prisoners to Babylonia, and 14 years after the Babylonians had captured Jerusalem, the Lord's power took control of me on the tenth day of the first month. The Lord showed me some visions in which I was carried to the top of a high mountain in Jerusalem. I looked to the south and saw what looked like a city full of buildings. 3 In my vision the Lord took me closer, and I saw a man who was sparkling like polished bronze. He was standing near one of the gates and was holding a tape measure in one hand and a measuring stick in the other. 4The man said, “Ezekiel, son of man, pay close attention to everything I'm going to show you—that's why you've been brought here. Listen carefully, because you must tell the people of Israel what you see.”
The East Gate
5 The first thing I saw was an outer wall that completely surrounded the temple area. The man took his measuring stick, which was three meters long, and measured the wall; it was three meters high and three meters thick. 6-7Then he went to the east gate, where he walked up steps that led to a long passageway. On each side of this passageway were three guardrooms, which were three meters square, and they were separated by walls two and a half meters thick. The man measured the distance between the opening of the gate and the first guardroom, and it was three meters, the thickness of the outer wall.
At the far end of this passageway, I saw an entrance room that faced the courtyard of the temple itself. There was also a distance of three meters between the last guardroom and the entrance room 8-9at the end of the passageway. The man measured this room: It was four meters from the doorway to the opposite wall, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one meter. 10The three guardrooms on each side of the passageway were the same size, and the walls that separated them were the same thickness.
11Next, the man measured the width of the passageway, and it was six and a half meters, but the two doors of the gate were only five meters wide. 12In front of the guardrooms, which were three meters square, was a railing about 50 centimeters high and 50 centimeters thick. 13The man measured the distance from the back wall of one of these rooms to the same spot in the room directly across the passageway, and it was twelve and a half meters. 14He measured the entrance room at the far end of the passageway, and it was ten meters wide. 15Finally, he measured the total length of the passageway, from the outer wall to the entrance room, and it was 25 meters. 16The three walls in the guardrooms had small windows in them, just like the ones in the entrance room. The walls along the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees.
The Outer Courtyard
17The man then led me through the passageway and into the outer courtyard of the temple, where I saw 30 rooms built around the outside of the courtyard. These side rooms were built against the outer wall, and in front of them was a sidewalk that circled the courtyard. 18This was known as the lower sidewalk, and it was 25 meters wide.
19I saw the gates that led to the inner courtyard of the temple and noticed that they were higher than those leading to the outer courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gates, and it was 50 meters.
The North Gate
20Next, the man measured the north gate that led to the outer courtyard. 21This gate also had three guardrooms on each side of a passageway. The measurements of these rooms, the walls between them, and the entrance room at the far end of the passageway were exactly the same as those of the east gate. The north gate was also 25 meters long and 12.5 meters wide, 22and the windows, the entrance room, and the carvings of palm trees were just like those in the east gate. The entrance room also faced the courtyard of the temple and had seven steps leading up to it. 23Directly across the outer courtyard was a gate that led to the inner courtyard, just as there was for the east gate. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was 50 meters.
The South Gate
24The man then took me to the south gate. He measured the walls and the entrance room of this gate, and the measurements were exactly the same as those of the other two gates. 25There were windows in the guardrooms of this gate and in the entrance room, just like the others, and this gate was also 25 meters long and 12.5 meters wide. 26Seven steps led up to the gate; the entrance room was at the far end of the passageway and faced the courtyard of the temple. Carvings of palm trees decorated the walls along the passageway. 27And directly across the outer courtyard was a gate on the south side of the inner courtyard. The man measured the distance between the outer and inner gate, and it was also 50 meters.
The Gates Leading to the Inner Courtyard
28We then went into the inner courtyard, through the gate on the south side of the temple. The man measured the gate, and it was the same size as the gates in the outer wall. 29-30In fact, everything along the passageway was also the same size, including the guardrooms, the walls separating them, the entrance room at the far end, and the windows. This gate, like the others, was 25 meters long and 12.5 meters wide. 31The entrance room of this gate faced the outer courtyard, and carvings of palm trees decorated the walls of the passageway. Eight steps led up to this gate.
32Next, we went through the east gate to the inner courtyard. The man measured this gate, and it was the same size as the others. 33The guardrooms, the walls separating them, and its entrance room had the same measurements as the other gates. The guardrooms and the entrance room had windows, and the gate was 25 meters long and 12.5 meters wide. 34The entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and the walls in the passageway were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate.
35Then the man took me to the north gate. He measured it, and it was the same size as the others, 36including the guardrooms, the walls separating them, and the entrance room. There were also windows in this gate. It was 25 meters long and 12.5 meters wide, 37and like the other inner gates, its entrance room faced the outer courtyard, and its walls were decorated with carvings of palm trees. Eight steps also led up to this gate.
The Rooms for Sacrificing Animals
38-39Inside the entrance room of the north gate, I saw four tables, two on each side of the room, where the animals to be sacrificed were killed. Just outside this room was a small building used for washing the animals before they were offered as sacrifices to please the Lord or sacrifices for sin or sacrifices to make things right. 40Four more tables were in the outer courtyard, two on each side of the steps leading into the entrance room. 41So there was a total of eight tables, four inside and four outside, where the animals were killed, 42-43and where the meat was placed until it was sacrificed on the altar.
Next to the tables in the entrance room were four stone tables 50 centimeters high and 75 centimeters square; the equipment used for killing the animals was kept on top of these tables. All around the walls of this room was a 75-millimeter shelf.
The Rooms Belonging to the Priests
44The man then took me to the inner courtyard, where I saw two buildings, one beside the inner gate on the north and the other beside the inner gate on the south. 45He said, “The building beside the north gate belongs to the priests who serve in the temple, 46and the building beside the south gate belongs to those who serve at the altar. All of them are descendants of Zadok and are the only Levites allowed to serve as the Lord's priests.”
The Inner Courtyard and the Temple
47Now the man measured the inner courtyard; it was 50 meters square. I also saw an altar in front of the temple.
48We walked to the porch of the temple, and the man measured the doorway of the porch: It was seven meters long, two and a half meters wide, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was one and a half meters. 49The porch itself was ten meters by six meters, with steps leading up to it. There was a column on each side of these steps.
translation_text:
KENLE BIE ƐZONLENLƐ SUA NE ANWO ƐNYELƐZODEƐNWUNLƐ
(40.1—48.35)
Bɛva Yizikeɛle bɛhɔ Gyɛlusalɛm
1 Bɛhyele yɛ bɛhɔle nlɔnu la, ye ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ nee nnu ne mɔlebɛbo siane ne ala anu, kenle bulu ne azo, mɔɔ ɛnee bɛhonle bɛvale suakpole ne la yeli ɛvolɛ bulu nee nna la, kenle ko zɔhane ala, Ɛdɛnkɛma tumi ne rawolole me, 2 na ɔvale me wɔ Nyamenle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ nu ɔrale Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ zo. Ɔvale me ɔziele boka tendenle bie, mɔɔ bɛyɛ ninyɛne bie mɔɔ kile kɛ bɛkyekye suakpole wɔ ɛkɛ ne la azo. 3 Ɔ nee me radwule ɛkɛ ne la, ɛnee nrenya bie mɔɔ anwo ta kɛ kɔbele la, lɛ bolɔfodɔ nyɛma nee nzuzulɛ baka ɔ sa nu gyi ɛkɛ; ɔgyi suakpole ne anuhɔlɛ kpole ne anloa.
4Na nrenya ne zele me kɛ, “Sonla ra, fa ɛ nye nea debie, fa ɛ nzo tie, na fa wɔ adwenle kɔ mɔɔ mefa meahile wɔ la azo, ɔluakɛ bɛ nee wɔ rale ɛke amaa meava meahile wɔ. Bɔ mɔɔ mefa meahile wɔ la nolo kile Yizilayɛma amuala.”
Aduduleɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne
5Mɔɔ menwunle la a le kɛ bɛlie Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo bane bɛyia. Nzuzulɛ baka ne mɔɔ nrenya ne lɛ la tendenle le mita nsa. Ɔzuzule bane ne la ɛnee ye ɛzamo le nzuzulɛ baka ne ko, yɛɛ ye anwumahɔlɛ noko le baka ne ko. 6Akee ɔhɔle anuhɔlɛ kpole ne mɔɔ wɔ aduduleɛ la anwo. Ɔvole ye kpolike ne na ɔzuzule anlenkɛ ne anloa anu. Ɔdaye noko ɔle mita nsa. 7Nwolodo ne, azua nsa a wɔ nu a. Ko biala tɛtɛlɛ nee ye tendenle sɛ. Biala le nzuzulɛ baka ne ko. Bɛ avinli bane ne mɔ ɛzamo le mita nwiɔ nee foa ko. Ɔvi azua ne mɔ anwo a nwolodo ko la ɛkɛ, ye tendenle le mita nsa. Sua kpandaanwo mɔɔ nee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anye bɔ zolɛ la gyi ɛkɛ. 8Ɔzuzule sua kpandaanwo ne anlenkɛ ne la ɔle mita nna; 9ye bane ne mɔ ɛzamo le mita ngoko. Sua kpandaanwo ɛhye a le Aduduleɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne akunlu anuhɔlɛ ne mɔɔ finde Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo a. 10(Sinzavolɛma azua ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ nwolodo ne anu la amuala sɛ mgbole, yɛɛ bane mɔɔ wɔ bɛ avinli la amuala ɛzamo sɛ.)
11Akee nrenya ne zuzule anlenkɛ kpole ne nwolodo ne tɛtɛlɛ. Ɔle mita nsia nee foa ko, yɛɛ anuhɔlɛ ne le mita nnu. 12Azua nsa ne mɔɔ wɔ nwolodo ne anu la, bɛlie bane mɔɔ ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita foa ko, ye ɛzamo noko le mita foa ko la wɔ ko biala anyunlu. (Azua ne mɔ mgbole sɛ, ko biala tɛtɛlɛ le mita nsa yɛɛ ye tendenle le mita nsa). 13Akee ɔzuzule anlenkɛ kpole ne, ɔvi sua ko anzi mɔɔ kɔkpula sua ko anzi la, na ɔle mita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko. 14Sua kpandaanwo ne gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie nwo ɛkɛ ne. Nrenya ne zuzule la, ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita bulu. 15Ɔvi anlenkɛ kpole ne findezo bane ne anwo mɔɔ kɔdwu azua nsa ne ati lɔ la le mita abulanwiɔ nee nnu. 16Adokule mɔɔ bɛ findezo tɛlɛ na bɛ kunlu le fefeɔ la gugua anlenkɛ kpole ne bane ne mɔ anwo. Nwolodo ne anu bane ne mɔ, bɛli mrɛlɛ adwinli bɛgua nwolɛ.
Findezo Alie nwo ɛdeɛ ne
17Akee ɔvale me ɔrale findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ. Ekpumgbunli abulasa a wɔ findezo bane ne anu a, na bɛva awolɛ bɛbo ɔ nyunlu. 18Bɛva awolɛ bɛbo alie ne anwo amuala. Alie nwo ɛhye wɔ aze tɛla ɔ kunlu lɔ alie nwo ɛdeɛ ne.
19Akee ɔzuzule ɔ kunlu lɔ alie nwo anuhɔlɛ ne anloa ɔhɔkpulale findezo alie nwo anuhɔlɛ ne anloa, na ɔnyianle mita abulanlu. Anuhɔlɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ sua ne akunlu lɔ alie ne anwo la wɔ anwuma tɛla findezo ɛdeɛ ne.
Sɔlɔ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne
20Akee nrenya ne lile me nyunlu na ɔ nee me hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛbɔ nu afoa nu. Alie nwo anlenkɛ kpole ko wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ anye di kɔ ɛbɔ nu afoa nu a, na ɔzuzule ye tendenle ne nee ye tɛtɛlɛ. 21Ɔzuzule ye foa ko nee ye foa ko ekpumgbunli nsa nsa ne mɔ, ye bane ne mɔ nee ye sua kpandaanwo ne, na bɛle kɛ alumua ɛdeɛ ne ala la. Ye tendenle le mita abulanwiɔ nee nnu, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko. 22Akee ye nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ, ye sua kpandaanwo ne nee mrɛlɛ mɔɔ bɛze wɔ bane ne mɔ anwo la amuala le kɛ mɔɔ wɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne mɔɔ di kɔ aduduleɛ la anwo la. Ye kpolike ne le nsuu, yɛɛ ye sua kpandaanwo ne wɔ ɔ kunlu lɔ alie nwo lɔ. 23Findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ ne, anlenkɛ kpole ko wɔ ɛkɛ kɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu alie nwo ɛkɛ, na ɔ nee findezo anlenkɛ kpole ne anye bɔ zolɛ, kɛmɔ aduduleɛ ɛdeɛ ne de la. Nrenya ne zuzule adenle mɔɔ la nlenkɛ mgbole nwiɔ ɛhye avinli la, na ɔle mita abulanlu.
Nyiakɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne
24Eza ɔvale me ɔhɔle sua ne nyiakɛ, anlenkɛ kpole ko wɔ ɛkɛ, na ɔzuzule ye bane ne mɔ nee ye debie biala, na bɛ muala bɛle kɛ alumua ɛdeɛ ne mɔ la. 25Nvɛnzɛlɛ wɔ nwolɛ toonwo yia, yɛɛ ye sua kpandaanwo ne anu le kɛ alumua nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ ɛdeɛ ne mɔ ala la. Ye tendenle le mita abulanwiɔ nee nnu, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita abulanlu. 26Ɔlɛ kpolike nsuu, yɛɛ ye sua kpandaanwo ne wɔ ɔ kunlu lɔ alie nwo ɛkɛ. Bɛli mrɛlɛ adwinli bɛgua ye bane ne mɔ anwo. 27Anlenkɛ kpole ko mɔɔ kɔ sua ne akunlu lɔ alie nwo ɛkɛ ne la nee ɛhye anye bɔ zolɛ. Nrenya ne zuzule adenle mɔɔ la bɛ avinli la ɔnyianle mita abulanlu.
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu alie nwo Nyiakɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne
28Akee nrenya ne nee me rale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu alie nwo ɛkɛ. Yɛvale nyiakɛ anlenkɛ kpole ne anu, na ɔzuzule anlenkɛ kpole ne. Ye kpole le kɛ nlenkɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ la. 29-30Ye bane ne mɔ mgbole nee bɛ ɛzamo nee nuhua ekpumgbunli ne mɔ le kɛ nlenkɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ la. Nvɛnzɛlɛ wɔ nwolɛ nee ye sua kpandaanwo ne anwo yia. Ye tendenle le mita abulanwiɔ nee nnu, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko. 31Ye sua kpandaanwo ne anye wɔ findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ, yɛɛ bɛli mrɛlɛ adwinli bɛgua ye bane ne mɔ anwo. Ɔlɛ kpolike mɔtwɛ.
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu alie nwo Aduduleɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne
32Nrenya ne eza vale me hɔle Aduduleɛ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anwo wɔ sua ne akunlu lɔ alie ne anwo na ɔzuzule. Ye tendenle nee ye tɛtɛlɛ le kɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ la. 33Ye nwolodo ne foa ko azua ne mɔ le kɛ nlenkɛ mgbole ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ ɛdeɛ ne la. Nvɛnzɛlɛ wɔ nwolɛ nee ye sua kpandaanwo ne anwo yia. Ye tendenle le mita abulanwiɔ nee nnu, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko. 34Ye sua kpandaanwo ne anye wɔ findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ, yɛɛ bɛli mrɛlɛ adwinli bɛgua ye bane ne mɔ anwo, ɔlɛ kpolike mɔtwɛ.
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu alie nwo Sɔlɔ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne
35Akee nrenya ne vale me hɔle sua ne sɔlɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anwo. Ɔzuzule, na ɔ nee ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ sɛ mgbole. 36Ye nwolodo ne anu azua ne mɔ amuala le kɛ ɛhendeɛ ne mɔ ɛdeɛ ne la. Nvɛnzɛlɛ wɔ nwolɛ yia. Ye tendenle le mita abulanwiɔ nee nnu, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita bulu nee nwiɔ nee foa ko. 37Ye sua kpandaanwo ne anye wɔ findezo alie ne anwo, yɛɛ bɛli mrɛlɛ adwinli bɛgua ye bane ne mɔ anwo. Ye kpolike ne le mɔtwɛ.
Azua mɔɔ wɔ Sɔlɔ Anlenkɛ Kpole ne anwo la
38Ekpumgbunli bie beta sɔlɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne sua kpandaanwo ne anwo. Ɛkɛ ne a bɛnrinzi ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ anwo a. 39Anlenkɛ kpole ne sua kpandaanwo ne anu, ɛkponle nna gyigyi ɛkɛ, nwiɔ wɔ ye tɛbanu yɛɛ nwiɔ noko wɔ ye tɛbanu. Ɛkponle ɛhye mɔ azo a bɛku ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ, ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, nee abozozielɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ a. 40Ɛkponle nna noko gyigyi sɔlɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne sua kpandaanwo ne anyunlu. Nwiɔ gyi foa ko yɛɛ nwiɔ noko gyi foa ko. 41Bɛ muala bɛbɔ nu a ɛnee ɛkponle mɔtwɛ a wɔ sɔlɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anloa a. Nna wɔ sua kpandaanwo ne anu yɛɛ nna noko gyigyi ɔ nyunlu alie nwo ɛkɛ. Ɛkponle ɛhye mɔ azo a bɛku azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ a. 42Eza awolɛ mɔɔ bɛze la ɛkponle nna wɔ ɛkɛ maa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ. Ko biala anwumahɔlɛ le mita foa ko yɛɛ zolɛ tɛtɛlɛ nee ye tendenle sɛ, ko biala le waa nna. Ɛkponle ɛhye mɔ azo a bɛfa ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ nee ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛfa bɛku nane azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ nee mɔɔ bɛfa bɛbia bɛ la bɛgua a. 43Ɛkponle ne mɔ anloa nna ne lɛ nzosɔnu, ko biala tendenle le waa ko. Ɛkponle ɛhye mɔ azo a bɛfa nane azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ bɛgua a.
44Akee nrenya ne nee me vi findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ hɔle sua ne akunlu lɔ alie ne anwo. Azua ekpumgbunli nwiɔ wɔ ɛkɛ, ko gyi sɔlɔ anlenkɛ kpole ne anwo, ɔ nye kɔne nyiakɛ, yɛɛ ko noko gyi nyiakɛ anlenkɛ kpole ne anwo, ɔ nye kɔne sɔlɔ. 45Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Ekpumgbunli ɛhye mɔɔ anye kɔne nyiakɛ la le sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ yɛ gyima wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la ɛdeɛ. 46Ekpumgbunli ne noko mɔɔ wɔ nyiakɛ na ɔ nye kɔne ɛbɔ nu la le sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ yɛ gyima wɔ azukponle ne azo la ɛdeɛ. Sɛlɛvolɛma ɛhye mɔ amuala le Zeedɔko abo zo amra, na bɛmɛ ala a bɛwɔ Livae abusua ekpunli ne anu, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi gyima mɔɔ le zɛhae, bɛbikye Ɛdɛnkɛma na bɛsonle ye a.”
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nee ɔ kunlu lɔ alie nwo ne
47Nrenya ne zuzule sua ne akunlu alie ne anwo, na ye tendenle le mita abulanlu yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita abulanlu. Azukponle ne gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anyunlu. 48Akee ɔvale me ɔrale Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ sua kpandaanwo ne anloa na ɔzuzule, ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita nsuu yɛɛ ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita nwiɔ nee foa ko. Ye bane ne mɔ ɛzamo le mita ko nee foa ko. 49Kpolike wɔ ɛkɛ mɔɔ bɛfa zolɛ bɛfo anuhɔlɛ ne a. Anuhɔlɛ ne tɛtɛlɛ le mita bulu yɛɛ ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita nsia. Mpila nwiɔ gyigyi anuhɔlɛ ne, ko gyi ye foa ko, yɛɛ ko noko gyi ye foa ko.

english_text:
1Next we went into the main room of the temple. The man measured the doorway of this room: It was 3 meters wide, 2five meters long, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was two and a half meters. The main room itself was 20 meters by 10 meters.
3-4Then the man walked to the far end of the temple's main room and said, “Beyond this doorway is the most holy place.” He first measured the doorway: It was one meter wide, 3 meters long, and the distance from the doorway to the wall on either side was 3.5 meters. Then he measured the most holy place, and it was 10 meters square.
The Storage Rooms of the Temple
5The man measured the wall of the temple, and it was three meters thick. Storage rooms two meters wide were built against the outside of the wall. 6There were three levels of rooms, with 30 rooms on each level, and they rested on ledges that were attached to the temple walls, so that nothing was built into the walls. 7The walls of the temple were thicker at the bottom than at the top, which meant that the storage rooms on the top level were wider than those on the bottom level. Steps led from the bottom level, through the middle level, and into the top level.
8The temple rested on a stone base three meters high, which also served as the foundation for the storage rooms. 9The outside walls of the storage rooms were two and a half meters thick; there was nothing between these walls 10and the nearest buildings ten meters away. 11One door led into the storage rooms on the north side of the temple, and another door led to those on the south side. The stone base extended two and a half meters beyond the outside wall of the storage rooms.
The West Building and the Measurements of the Temple
12I noticed another building: It faced the west end of the temple and was 35 meters wide, 45 meters long, and had walls over 2.5 meters thick.
13The man measured the length of the temple, and it was 50 meters. He then measured from the back wall of the temple, across the open space behind the temple, to the back wall of the west building; it was 50 meters. 14The distance across the front of the temple, including the open space on either side, was also 50 meters.
15Finally, the man measured the length of the west building, including the side rooms on each end, and it was also 50 meters.
The Inside of the Temple
The inside walls of the temple's porch and main room 16were paneled with wood all the way from the floor to the windows, while the doorways, the small windows, and the three side rooms were trimmed in wood. 17The paneling stopped just above the doorway. These walls were decorated 18-20with carvings of winged creatures and had a carving of a palm tree between the creatures. Each winged creature had two faces: A human face looking at the palm tree on one side, and a lion's face looking at the palm tree on the other side. These designs were carved into the paneling all the way around the two rooms.
21The doorframe to the temple's main room was in the shape of a rectangle.
The Wooden Altar
In front of the doorway to the most holy place was something that looked like 22a wooden altar. It was one and a half meters high and one meter square, and its corners, its base, and its sides were made of wood. The man said, “This is a reminder that the Lord is constantly watching over his temple.”
The Doors in the Temple
23Both the doorway to the main room of the temple and the doorway to the most holy place had two doors, 24and each door had two sections that could fold open. 25The doors to the main room were decorated with carvings of winged creatures and palm trees just like those on the walls, and there was a wooden covering over the porch just outside these doors. 26The walls on each side of this porch had small windows and were also decorated with carvings of palm trees.
translation_text:
1Eza nrenya ne vale me hɔle sua ne akunlu, Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne na ɔzuzule anuhɔlɛ ne; ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita nsa, 2yɛɛ ɔ nloa anu tɛtɛlɛ le mita nnu. Ye bane ne mɔ ɛzamo le mita nwiɔ nee foa ko. Akee ɔzuzule sua mumua ne anu, na ye tendenle le mita abulanwiɔ, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita bulu.
3Akee ɔwolole ɔhɔle sua ne akunlu ekpumgbunli ne anu na ɔzuzule anuhɔlɛ ne mɔɔ kɔ sua ne anu la, ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita ko yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita nsa. Bane mɔɔ wɔ nwolɛ la ɛzamo le mita nsa nee foa ko. 4Ɔzuzule ekpumgbunli mumua ne na ye tendenle le mita bulu. Ye tɛtɛlɛ nee ye tendenle sɛ. Na ɔzele me kɛ, “Ɛke a le Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne a.”
Ekpumgbunli ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛsisi bɛbetɛbeta Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bane ne mɔ la
5Akee nrenya ne zuzule Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bane ne; ye ɛzamo le mita nsa. Ekpumgbunli mɔɔ wɔ bane ne anwo la biala tɛtɛlɛ le mita nwiɔ. Ekpumgbunli ne mɔ wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bane ne anwo toonwo bɛnra yia. 6Ekpumgbunli ɛhye mɔ le nzɛzo nsa nsa yɛɛ nzɛzo ko biala le ekpumgbunli abulasa. Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bane ne mɔ lɛ bɛ bati mɔɔ nzɛzo ko biala mbaka kɔgua zolɛ a, amaa mbaka ne mɔ anwolowolo Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bane mumua ne anu. 7Ye zɔhane ati ekpumgbunli ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la le mgbole tɛla aze ɛdeɛ ne mɔ. Nzɛzo nsa ne ekpumgbunli ne mɔ le mgbole tɛla nzɛzo nwiɔ ne, yɛɛ nzɛzo nwiɔ ɛdeɛ ne mɔ anu buke tɛla ɔ bo ɛdeɛ ne. Bɛyɛ kpolike adenle wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne foa ko mɔɔ bɛfo zolɛ bɛkɔ ekpumgbunli ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ anwuma la anu a. 8-11Ekpumgbunli ɛhye mɔ findezo bane ne mɔ ɛzamo le mita nwiɔ nee foa ko. Anlenkɛ ko ala anu yɛɛ bɛdua bɛkɔ sɔlɔ ekpumgbunli ne mɔ anu a, yɛɛ ko noko ala a bɛdua nu bɛkɔ nyiakɛ ekpumgbunli ne mɔ anu a. Eza menwunle kɛ bɛbo bama mɔɔ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita nwiɔ nee foa ko la wɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo bɛyia. Ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita nsa na ɔ nee ekpumgbunli ne mɔ mɔɔ betɛbeta Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo la adiabo ne mɔ le sɛsɛ. Bama ne nee azua ne mɔ mɔɔ sɛlɛvolɛma ne wɔ nuhua la avinli, adenle mɔɔ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita bulu la la ɛkɛ ne toonwo bɛnra yia Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne.
Adɔleɛ sua ne
12Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne adɔleɛ, ɛleka wienyi ne abo lɔ, sua ko gyi ɛkɛ; ye tendenle le mita abulanla nee nnu, yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita abulasa nee nnu. Ye bane ne mɔ ɛzamo le mita nwiɔ nee foa ko.
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua mumua ne ɛzuzulɛ
13Akee nrenya ne zuzule Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua mumua ne. Ye tendenle le mita abulanlu; sua ne alie nwo ɛkɛ ne nee bane ne amuala le mita abulanlu. 14Akee Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne aduduleɛ tɛtɛlɛ mɔɔ alie nwo ne nee bane ne mɔ amuala wɔ nu la le mita abulanlu. 15Akee ɔzuzule sua ne mɔɔ gyi adɔleɛ alie nwo ɛkɛ ne la nee ye bane ne mɔ, na ɔdaye noko ɔle mita abulanlu.
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne
Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ekpumgbunli ne, Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne, yɛɛ Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne, 16bɛva ndaboa bɛzɛ azɛlɛ nwo toonwo yekpula nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ abo. Bɛduodua nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ ɛbonle. 17Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne akunlu bane ne mɔ anwo, toonwo mɔɔ kɔdwu nlenkɛ ne mɔ azo la, bɛva ndaboa mɔɔ 18bɛli mrɛlɛ nee abɔdeɛ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la adwinli bɛgua zolɛ la bɛzɛ nwolɛ. Mrɛlɛ ne mɔ didi abɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la avinli. Abɔdeɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la, ko biala lɛ ɔ nyunlu nwiɔ. 19Ɔ nyunlu ko mɔɔ zɔho sonla nyunlu la wɔ mrɛlɛ ne mɔ ko anwo. Bɛli zɛhae adwinli bɛgua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne bane ne anwo toonwo yeyia, 20ɔvi aze toonwo ɔdwu nlenkɛ ne mɔ azo. 21Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne anlenkɛ felɛmo mbaka nna ne amuala sɛ.
Baka azukponle ne
Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne anuhɔlɛ ne, debie bie wɔ ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ zɔho 22baka azukponle a. Ye anwumahɔlɛ le mita ko nee foa ko yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita ko. Bɛvale ndaboa a bɛyɛle ye mgbɛnezo ne mɔ, ɔ bo ne nee ye tɛbanu tɛbanu ne mɔ a. Na nrenya ne zele me kɛ, “Ɛkponle ɛhye a gyi Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu a.”
Nlenkɛ ne mɔ
23Anlenkɛ wɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne nwolodo ne mɔɔ bɛdua nu bɛkɔ Nwuanzanwuanza Nu Nwuanzaanwu Ɛleka ne anuhɔlɛ ne la; ɛkɛ ne noko, anlenkɛ wɔ ɛkɛ. 24Nlenkɛ nwiɔ ɛhye mɔ biala lɛ ɛbonta. 25Bɛli mrɛlɛ nee abɔdeɛ mɔɔ lɛ ndɛbalɛ la adwinli bɛgua Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne anlenkɛ ne anwo kɛ mɔɔ bɛli bɛgua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu bane ne mɔ anwo la. Akee bɛva ndaboa bɛbo kpɔda wɔ findezo anuhɔlɛ ekpumgbunli ne anyunlu. 26Nvɛnzɛlɛ wɔ ekpumgbunli ne foa ko nee ye foa ko, na bɛli mrɛlɛ adwinli bɛgua ye bane ne mɔ anwo.

english_text:
The Sacred Rooms for the Priests
1-2After the man and I left the temple and walked back to the outer courtyard, he showed me a set of rooms on the north side of the west building. This set of rooms was 50 meters long and 25 meters wide. 3On one side of them was the 10 meters of open space that ran alongside the temple, and on the other side was the sidewalk that circled the outer courtyard. The rooms were arranged in three levels 4with doors that opened toward the north, and in front of them was a walkway five meters wide and 50 meters long. 5The rooms on the top level were narrower than those on the middle level, and the rooms on the middle level were narrower than those on the bottom level. 6The rooms on the bottom level supported those on the two upper levels, and so these rooms did not have columns like other buildings in the courtyard. 7-8To the north was a privacy wall 25 meters long, 9-10and at the east end of this wall was the door leading from the courtyard to these rooms.
There was also a set of rooms on the south side of the west building. 11These rooms were exactly like those on the north side, and they also had a walkway in front of them. 12The door to these rooms was at the east end of the wall that stood in front of them.
13The man then said to me:
These rooms on the north and south sides of the temple are the sacred rooms where the Lord's priests will eat the most holy offerings. These offerings include the grain sacrifices, the sacrifices for sin, and the sacrifices to make things right. 14When the priests are ready to leave the temple, they must go through these rooms before they return to the outer courtyard. They must leave their sacred clothes in these rooms and put on regular clothes before going anywhere near other people.
The Size of the Temple Area
15After the man had finished measuring the buildings inside the temple area, he took me back through the east gate and measured the wall around this area. 16He used his measuring stick to measure the east side of this wall; it was 250 meters long. 17-19Then he measured the north side, the south side, and the west side of the wall, and they were each 250 meters long, 20and so the temple area was a perfect square. The wall around this area separated what was sacred from what was ordinary.
translation_text:
Azua nwiɔ mɔɔ zua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne la
1Akee nrenya ne vale me hɔle Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ ne na ɔlile me nyunlu yɛhɔle sua bie mɔɔ gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne ɛbɔ nu afoa nu la anwo. Sua ɛhye nee ko bie mɔɔ gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne adɔleɛ afoa nu la avinli anwa biala. 2Sua ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛbɔ nu afoa nu la tendenle le mita abulanlu yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita abulanwiɔ nee nnu. 3Sua ɛhye anyunlu ko kɔne ɛleka wienyi ne mɔɔ le mita bulu, mɔɔ la Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo la, yɛɛ ɔ nyunlu ko ne noko kɔne bama ne mɔɔ bɛbo wɔ findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ ne la anwo. Ɔle sua nzɛzo nsa. 4Sua ne nlenkɛ ne mɔ anye kɔne ɛbɔ nu afoa nu yɛɛ adenle la ɔ nyunlu; ye tendenle le mita abulanlu yɛɛ ye tɛtɛlɛ le mita nnu. 5Anwuma ekpumgbunli ne mɔ le ngyikyi, ɔluakɛ zolɛ abenlana ɛdeɛ ne anu buke tɛla avinli nee aze ɛdeɛ ne mɔ. 6Sua ne le nzɛzo nsa, noko ɔnlɛ mpila, kɛmɔ findezo alie nwo sua ne lɛ ye la; yemɔti mɔɔ sua ne ɛlɛkɔ anwuma la ɛnee ye ɛzamo ne ɛlɛyɛ ekyi. 7-8Sua ne aze bane ne mɔ ɛzamo le mita abulanwiɔ nee nnu, asɛɛ sua ne tendenle nu foa ko, yɛɛ ekpumgbunli ne mɔ wɔ mita abulanwiɔ nee nnu ne mɔɔ ɛha la anu. Anwuma nzɛzo ne ekpumgbunli ne mɔ fa sua ne tendenle nu amuala. 9Ekpumgbunli ɛhye mɔ abo, mɔɔ kɔne aduduleɛ la, adenle la ɛkɛ ne kɔ findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ ne, 10ɛleka mɔɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne alie nwo bane ne bɔ ɔ bo la.
Sua ko noko mɔɔ le kɛ ko ne mɔɔ gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne adɔleɛ la gyi Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne nyiakɛ; ɔ nee adɔleɛ sua ne avinli anwa fee. 11Adenle la sua ne ekpumgbunli ne mɔ anyunlu kɛ sua ɛhendeɛ ne mɔɔ wɔ ɛbɔ nu afoa nu la. Ye kpole, ye tendenle, ye tɛtɛlɛ, ye kɛnlɛma, yɛɛ ye ndenle mɔɔ gugua nwolɛ la le kɛ sua ɛhendeɛ ne ala la. 12Akee adenle la nyiakɛ ekpumgbunli ne mɔ abo, wɔ aduduleɛ afoa nu ɛleka mɔɔ bane ne wɔ la.
13Akee nrenya ne zele me kɛ, “Sua ne mɔɔ gyi ɛbɔ nu afoa nu nee ko ne mɔɔ gyi nyiakɛ la le azua mɔɔ anwo te a. Ɛkɛ ne ekpumgbunli ne mɔ anu yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ finde Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlu la bali bɛ aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ a. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ bɛbava aleɛ nwuanzanwuanza ne mɔ mɔɔ le ma azubɔdeɛ, ɛtane azubɔdeɛ, yɛɛ abozozielɛ azubɔlɛ ninyɛne ne mɔ bazie a, ɔluakɛ ɛleka ne le nwuanzanwuanza. 14Saa sɛlɛvolɛma ne kɔ Ɛleka Nwuanzanwuanza ne kɔsonle a, ɔnle kɛ bɛfa adɛladeɛ mɔɔ bɛwulale bɛhɔzonlenle la bɛkɔ findezo alie nwo ɛkɛ.
