Selea belemgbunli munzuvolɛ ne
21Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne hɔle zolɛ hilele nuhua kɛ, “Belemgbunli bieko mɔɔ tɛ awie a bazɔ ɔ sa ava ye azie ebia zo la bavinde azie Selea maanle ne; ɔnrɛhakye bɛ ɔnrɛzie, ɔbalua mɛlɛbɛla adenle zo a yeazie ɔ nwo belemgbunli a. 22Ɛlɔne biala ɛnrɛhola ɔ nyunlu gyinla, yɛɛ ɔnrɛdo Nyamenle Sɛlɛvolɛ Kpanyinli ne bɔbɔ sɛbe. 23Maanle mɔɔ ɔbazie la le ekyi bie, noko ɔbava mɛlɛbɛla adenle zo ɔ nee maanle maanle ayɛ ngyehyɛlɛ yeahakyi ɔ nwo belemgbunli kpole. 24Ɔbadwazo maanle maanle mɔɔ gyigyi boɛ la anwo zo arɛlevilɛ nu yeakpokpo bɛ, na yeayɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ kenle bie maanle nu ɔ ze mɔ nee ɔ nlenya mɔ anyɛ bie fee la, na ɔ nee ɔ sa zo ahyɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛwua la bɛali. Ɔbabɔ adwenle yeabɔ ɔ nwo bane mɔɔ kpɔvolɛ ɛngola ɛmbikye ye la, noko ɔnrɛli agyinla.
25“Ɔbazi ahonle yeava ɛlɔne kpole yeahɔteta Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne. Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne ɔdaye ɔbava ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ze konle nye zo la dɔɔnwo nee ye ahɔbɔ ye zo, na ɔnrɛhola Selea belemgbunli ne anyunlu gyinla, ɔluakɛ Selea belemgbunli ne babɛlɛbɛla ye yeawie ye yɛ. 26Menli bɔbɔ mɔɔ nee ye di, nee ye no la a bado ye bie nu a. Bɛbahu ye ɛlɔnema ne anu dɔɔnwo na mɔɔ kɛha la agua ɛbɔ nu. 27Arelemgbunli nwiɔ ne badɛnla ɛkponle ko anwo ali adwelie, noko adalɛ ɔ, biala babɔ ye kpɔkɛ ɔ ti anu, yemɔti mɔɔ bɛbaha la biala bayɛ bɛ gye zo amanie, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛ bɛdo ɛkɛ la ɛtɛdwule. 28Selea belemgbunli ne bava ninyɛne dɔɔnwo ne mɔɔ ɔnyianle bɛ konle nu la azia ahɔ sua nu, yɛɛ ɔbava adwenle kɛ ɔsɛkye Nyamenle menli ne nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne. Ɔbayɛ mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la na yeazia yeahɔ ye maanle nu.
29“Saa mekɛ ne dwu a ɔbadwazo Yigyibiti anwo zo bieko, na mekɛ ɛhye ɛnrɛyɛ kɛ alumua mekɛ ɛdeɛ ne la. 30Ɔboalekɛ Wulomuma bava meli aradoa ye bɛ nee ye aho. Ye ahonle badu na yeagua ye ɔ nzi.
“Ɔbava ɛya kpole yeazia ɔ nzi yeara Nyamenle menli ne nyamenlezonlenlɛ ne ɛzɛkyelɛ. Ɔsia ɔba a, ɔbali menli mɔɔ ɛgyakyi Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ la folɛdulɛ zo. 31 Ye ɛlɔnema ne bie mɔ bagua Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anwo evinli, bɛazɛkye aranemgbole ne, na bɛadua dahuu azubɔlɛ nee ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ɛvalɛ. Akee bɛbava ‘Munzudeɛ ne mɔɔ bɔ maanle’ la bɛazie Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. 32Belemgbunli ne babɛlɛbɛla bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛgyakyi Nyamenle ɛzonlenlɛ la yeamaa bɛali ɔ nzi, na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze bɛ Nyamenle ne la bagyinla bɛ gyakɛ anu na bɛaheha bɛ nwo. 33Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Nyamenle menli ne anu la bayɛ toonwo bɛamaa menli dɔɔnwo anyia ndelebɛbo, noko bie mɔ badɔ dadeɛ nloa, bɛbayela bie mɔ, bɛbahye bie mɔ nuokɛ, bɛawua bie mɔ anwo ninyɛne mekɛ dɔɔnwo anu. 34Saa Nyamenle menli ne kpo aze a, moalɛ ekyi bie a bɛbanyia ye a. Menli dɔɔnwo bava mɛlɛbɛla araboka bɛ. 35Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ la bie mɔ badu koti, amaa bɛahakyi bɛ subane nee bɛ nyɛleɛ na bɛ nwo ade saanwu ahɔkpula kɛ mekɛ ne kɛdwu la, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ ɛdo ɛkɛ ne la ɛtɛdwule.
36 “Selea belemgbunli ne bayɛ debie biala mɔɔ ɔdaye ɔkulo la; ɔbamemaa ɔ nwo zo yeayɛ ɔ nwo kpole yeadɛla nyamenle biala, na yeaheha azibɛnwo edwɛkɛ yeatia nyamenle ne mɔ Nyamenle ne. Ɔbayɛ ɛhye yeahɔdwu mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle kɛhwe ɔ nzo la, ɔluakɛ ɔwɔ kɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhyehyɛ ɛdo ɛkɛ la yɛ zɔhane. 37Belemgbunli ne bakpo nyamenle ne mɔ mɔɔ ɔ nlenya mɔ zonlenle la, yɛɛ nyamenle ne mɔɔ mraalɛ anye die nwolɛ la. Ɔbakpo nyamenle biala, ɔluakɛ ɔbamemaa ɔ nwo zo yeadɛla nyamenle kɔsɔɔti. 38Ɔbazonle aranemgbole nyamenle ɛdeɛ ne yeagyakyi ɛhye mɔ. Ɔbazonle nyamenle mɔɔ ɔ nlenya mɔ ɛnze ye la; ɔbava ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule, awolɛ mɔɔ sonle bolɛ nee ahyɛlɛ ninyɛne mɔɔ bɛ awolɛ yɛ se la yeazonle ye. 39Zɔhane ala a ɔbava yeayɛ maanle zo nyamenle mɔɔ kɛzɔ ɔ nye la wɔ aranemgbole ne mɔ anu a. Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛlie ye bɛkɛdo nu kɛ ɔle bɛ belemgbunli la, ɔbali bɛ eni kpole kpalɛ, ɔbamaa bɛ gyinlabelɛ na yeamaa bɛ azɛlɛ kɛ bɛ ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɔ.
40“Ɔka ekyii na mekɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛhile la adwu a, Yigyibiti belemgbunli ne bava konle ahɔdoa Selea belemgbunli ne. Selea belemgbunli ne bava ye anwosesebɛ muala, ye konle ehwili ne mɔ, ye mgbɔnwɔ nee ye meli dɔɔnwo ne ara ɔ nwo zo kɛ ahumuakyima. Ɔbahɔ maanle dɔɔnwo anwo zo na yeali bɛ nwo zo konim. 41Ɔbahɔvo azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ Nyamenle ɛva ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ la azo. Menli apenle apenle badɔ, noko bɛbalie Yidɔmma nee Mowabema nee Amɔn maanle mumua ne bɛavi ɔ sa nu. 42Ɔbaho yeava maanle dɔɔnwo, na Yigyibiti ɛnrɛvi nu. 43Yigyibiti anwonyia kpokpoti: ezukoa nvutuke, dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ sonle bolɛ la bapɛ ali ye ɛkɛ. Ɔbaho yeava Lebea nee Sudan. 44Noko nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ ɔbade yeavi aduduleɛ nee sɔlɔ la bamaa ye ahonle adu na yeava ɛya kpole yeahɔ bɛ nwo zo yeahɔzɛkye menli dɔɔnwo. 45Ɔbazi ye arelemgbunli ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ wɔ nyevile ne nee boka ne mɔɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne gyi zolɛ la avinli, noko ɔbawu; ɔnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛboa ye.”

english_text:
Part Four: The Dead Will Rise to Life
1 Michael, the chief of the angels, is the protector of your people, and he will come at a time of terrible suffering, the worst in all of history. And your people who have their names written in The Book will be protected. 2 Many of those who lie dead in the ground will rise from death. Some of them will be given eternal life, and others will receive nothing but eternal shame and disgrace. 3 Everyone who has been wise will shine as bright as the sky above, and everyone who has led others to please God will shine forever like the stars.
4 Daniel, I now command you to keep the message of this book secret until the end of time, even though many people will go everywhere, searching for the knowledge to be found in it.
The End of Time
5Daniel wrote:
I looked around and saw two other people—one on this side of the river and one on the other side. 6The angel who had spoken to me was dressed in linen and was standing upstream from them. So one of the two beside the river asked him, “How long before these amazing things happen?”
7 The angel then raised both hands toward heaven and said, “In the name of the God who lives forever, I solemnly promise that it will be a time, two times, and half a time. Everything will be over, when the suffering of God's holy people comes to an end.”
8I heard what the angel said, but I didn't understand. So I asked, “Sir, how will it all end?”
The angel in my vision then replied:
9Daniel, go about your business, because the meaning of this message will remain secret until the end of time. 10 Many people will have their hearts and lives made pure and clean, but those who are evil will keep on being evil and never understand. Only the wise will understand. 11 There will be 1,290 days from the time that the daily sacrifices are stopped, until someone sets up the “Horrible Thing” that causes destruction. 12God will bless everyone who patiently waits until 1,335 days have gone by.
13So, Daniel, be faithful until the end! You will rest, and at the end of time, you will rise from death to receive your reward.
translation_text:
Awieleɛ mekɛ ne
1 Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ wula Lenen tɛladeɛ ne la hanle kɛ, “Mekɛ zɔhane Nyamenle soanvolɛ Maekeɛle mɔɔ nea wɔ menli ne mɔ anwo zo la badwazo. Mekɛ zɔhane amaneɛnwunlɛ mɔɔ bie ɛtɛsile ɛlɛ la basisi, noko bɛbalie wɔ menli ne mɔ anu biala mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu kɛ bɛhɛlɛ ye duma wɔ Nyamenle buluku ne anu la ngoane. 2 Menli mɔɔ ɛwu la anu dɔɔnwo badwazo ara ngoane nu; bie mɔ banyia ngoane mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ, bie mɔ dɔɔnwo noko babɔ anyiemgba mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ. 3Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ nu la bada kɛ sɛnzɛne, yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛhilehile menli kpalɛyɛlɛ adenle la bada kɛ nwɔlɔra la wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnlɛ awieleɛ.
4 “Na wɔmɔ, Daneɛle, to buluku ne anu na sɔ ɔ nloa, yɛɛ mɔɔ wɔde la maa ɔha ɛ ti anu, kɔkpula awieleɛ mekɛ ne. Menli banriandi ahɔ ara, na ndelebɛbo bayɛ kpole.”
5Akee medame Daneɛle mendole me nye, na menwunle menli nwiɔ kɛ bɛgyigyi azule ne anloa, ko gyi azule ne foa ko yɛɛ ko ne ɔdaye ɔgyi ɔ nzi lɔ. 6Na membizale Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne mɔɔ wula lenen tɛladeɛ ne gyi azule ne azo la kɛ, “Kenlenzu a nwanwane ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti kɛyɛ zɔhane a?”
7 Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne kpogyale ɔ sa amu nwiɔ zo anwomanyunlu; na mendele kɛ ɔlɛfa Tease Nyamenle ne yeaha ndane kɛ, “Saa ɛvolɛ nsa siane nsia ne dwu, na bɛwie Nyamenle menli ne kpɔdekpɔde yɛ a, ɛhye mɔ amuala bayɛ zɔhane.”
8Mendele edwɛkɛ ɛhye, na meande ɔ bo. Yemɔti membizale kɛ, “O me menle, kɛ ɛhye mɔ bazi awie ye ɛ?”
9Ɔbuale me kɛ, “Daneɛle, suzu ɛ nwo na bɛzɔ edwɛkɛ ne anloa, ɔnle kɛ bɛbɔ zolɛ kɔkpula awieleɛ mekɛ ne. 10 Menli dɔɔnwo bahakyi bɛ subane nee bɛ nyɛleɛ, ade bɛ nwo saanwu na bɛayɛ menli fofolɛ. Na amumuyɛma ɛdeɛ, bɛbahɔ zolɛ bɛayɛ ninyɛndane; bɛ biala ɛnrɛde ɔ bo. Nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma mɔɔ wɔ nu la ala a bade ɔ bo a.
11 “Ɔvi mekɛ mɔɔ bɛbava bɛagyakyi dahuu azubɔlɛ nee ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne ɛvalɛ na bɛava ‘Munzudeɛ ne mɔɔ bɔ Maanle’ la bɛazie Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu la bayɛ kenle ngoko apenle ko ɛya nwiɔ abulahɔnla.
12“Nyilalɛ ɛha sonla ne mɔɔ kɛhendɛ toonwo ɔkɛhɔdwu kenle apenle ko ɛya nsa abulasa nee nnu ne awieleɛ la!
13“Na wɔmɔ, Daneɛle, di nɔhalɛ kɔ awieleɛ. Ɛbawu, na awieleɛ mekɛ ne dwu a, ɛbagyinla ɛleka mɔɔ bɛhyehyɛ bɛmaa wɔ la.”

english_text:
1 I am Hosea son of Beeri. When Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah were the kings of Judah, and when Jeroboam son of Jehoash was king of Israel, the Lord spoke this message to me.
Hosea's Family
2The Lord said, “Hosea, Israel has betrayed me like an unfaithful wife. Marry such a woman and have children by her.” 3So I married Gomer the daughter of Diblaim, and we had a son.
4 Then the Lord said, “Hosea, name your son Jezreel, because I will soon punish the descendants of King Jehu of Israel for the murders he committed in Jezreel Valley. I will destroy his kingdom, 5and in Jezreel Valley I will break the power of Israel.”
6Later, Gomer had a daughter, and the Lord said, “Name her Lo-Ruhamah, because I will no longer have mercy and forgive Israel. 7But I am the Lord God of Judah, and I will have mercy and save Judah by my own power—not by wars and arrows or swords and cavalry.”
8After Gomer had stopped nursing Lo-Ruhamah, she had another son. 9Then the Lord said, “Name him Lo-Ammi, because these people are not mine, and I am not their God.”
Hope for Israel
10 Someday it will be impossible to count the people of Israel, because there will be as many of them as there are grains of sand along the seashore. They are now called “Not My People,” but in the future they will be called “Children of the Living God.” 11Israel and Judah will unite and choose one leader. Then they will take back their land, and this will be a great day for Jezreel.
translation_text:
1 Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle Biyɛlae ara nrenya Hozia wɔ Dwuda arelemgbunli Ɛzaya, Dwotam, Ehaze, yɛɛ Hɛzikaya mekɛ zo la ɛne. Mekɛ ne anu ɛnee Gyɛhowahye ara nrenya Gyɛlɔbowam le Yizilayɛ belemgbunli.
Hozia aye nee ɔ mra
2Mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma dumua alua Hozia anwo zo adendɛ ahile Yizilayɛma la, ɔzele Hozia kɛ, “Kɔgya tuutuu raalɛ na wo tuutuu mralɛ. Ɔluakɛ azɛlɛ ne azo amra ɛkpo medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛlɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla.”
3Yemɔti Hozia gyale Debeleeyem ara raalɛ Gomɛ. Gomɛ nrenzɛle na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya. 4 Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Hozia kɛ, “To ye ‘Gyɛzelii’ ɔboalekɛ ɔnrɛhyɛ biala na meadea Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne wɔ mogya mɔɔ ɔ nlenya Gyɛhu hanle guale wɔ Gyɛzelii la anwo. Mefa Gyɛhu belemgbunlililɛ ne meara awieleɛ. 5Kenle zɔhane mebabubu Yizilayɛ ɛda ne anu wɔ Gyɛzelii Bɔnza.”
6Gomɛ nrenzɛle bieko na ɔwole ralɛ raalɛ. Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Hozia kɛ, “To ye ‘Bɛnzeyeanwunvɔne,’ ɔluakɛ menrɛze Yizilayɛma anwunvɔne bieko, yɛɛ menrɛva bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ menrɛhyɛ bɛ fee. 7Mebaze Dwudama anwunvɔne, medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle, mebalie bɛ ngoane, na tɛ konle nu ɔ, menrɛva konle dadeɛ anzɛɛ ɛda nee ɛda mbaka anzɛɛ mgbɔnwɔ nee menli mɔɔ ka mgbɔnwɔ la.”
8Mɔɔ Gomɛ pɛle ɔ ra ne nyɛfonlɛ la, ɔnrenzɛle na ɔwole ralɛ nrenya bieko. 9Ɛdɛnkɛma zele Hozia kɛ, “To ye ‘Bɛnlememenli,’ ɔboalekɛ Yizilayɛma ɛnle me menli, yɛɛ menle bɛ Nyamenle.”
Yizilayɛ banyia ye gyinlabelɛ dɛba ne
10 Yizilayɛma bazo kɛ ɛnweazo anwea mɔɔ bɛngola bɛnzuzu anzɛɛ bɛngola bɛndia la, na ɛleka ne mɔɔ bɛzele bɛ kɛ, “Bɛnle me menli” la, ɛkɛ ne a bɛbaha bɛahile bɛ kɛ, “Bɛle tease Nyamenle ne amra” a, 11na Dwudama nee Yizilayɛ bali ngamɔnu. Bɛbaye bɛ kpanyinli ko bɛamaa yeanlea bɛ nwo zo, bɛ nwo bazo na bɛakpazi wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. Ɔluakɛ Gyɛzelii kenle ne bayɛ kenle kpole!

english_text:
1So let your brothers be called “My People” and your sisters be called “Shown Mercy.”
The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
2Accuse! Accuse your mother!
She is no longer my wife,
and now I, the Lord,
am not her husband.
Beg her to give up prostitution
and stop being unfaithful,
3or I will strip her naked
like the day she was born.
I will make her barren
like a desert,
and she will die of thirst.
4You children are the result
of her unfaithfulness,
and I'll show you no pity.
5Your mother was unfaithful.
She was disgraceful and said,
“I'll run after my lovers.
Everything comes from them—
my food and drink,
my linen and wool,
my olive oil and wine.”
6I, the Lord, will build
a fence of thorns
to block her path.
7She will run after her lovers,
but not catch them;
she will search,
but not find them.
Then she will say, “I'll return
to my first husband.
Life was better then.”
8She didn't know that her grain,
wine, and olive oil
were gifts from me,
as were the gold and silver
she used in worshiping Baal.
9So I'll hold back the harvest
of grain and grapes.
I'll take back
my wool and my linen
that cover her body.
10Then I'll strip her naked
in the sight of her lovers.
No one can rescue her.
11I'll stop Israel's celebrations—
no more New Moon Festivals,
Sabbaths, or other feasts.
12She said, “My lovers gave me
vineyards and fig trees
as payment for sex.”
Now I, the Lord, will ruin
her vineyards and fig trees;
they will become clumps of weeds
eaten by wild animals.
13I'll punish her for the days
she worshiped Baal
and burned incense to him.
I'll punish her for the times
she forgot about me
and wore jewelry and rings
to attract her lovers.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
The Lord Will Help Israel
14Israel, I, the Lord,
will lure you into the desert
and speak gently to you.
15 I will return your vineyards,
and then Trouble Valley
will become Hopeful Valley.
You will say “Yes” to me
as you did in your youth,
when leaving Egypt.
16I promise from that day on, you will call me your husband instead of your master. 17I will no longer even let you mention the names of those pagan gods that you called “Master.” 18And I will agree to let you live in peace—you will no longer be attacked by wild animals and birds or by weapons of war. 19I will accept you as my wife forever, and instead of a bride price I will give you justice, fairness, love, kindness, 20and faithfulness. Then you will truly know who I am.
21I will command the sky to send rain on the earth, 22and it will produce grain, grapes, and olives in Jezreel Valley. 23 I will scatter the seeds and show mercy to Lo-Ruhamah. I will say to Lo-Ammi, “You are my people,” and they will answer, “You are our God.”
translation_text:
1Yemɔti bɛvɛlɛ bɛ mediema mrenya ne mɔ “Me Menli” na bɛvɛlɛ bɛ mediema mraalɛ ne mɔ “Bɛnwubɛanwunvɔne.”
Gomɛ ɛnli nɔhalɛ, Yizilayɛ ɛnli nɔhalɛ
2Me mra, bɛ nee bɛ nli ɛdendɛ; kɛkala ɔnle me ye bieko, yɛɛ medame noko menle ɔ hu bieko, noko bɛ nee ye ɛdendɛ. Bɛzɛlɛ ye kɛ ɔgyakyi ye tuutuu ɛbɛlabɔlɛ ne nee ye awuvolɛvalɛ mɛladonlɛ ne. 3Saa yeangyakyi a, mebakpa ɔ nwo meamaa yealɛ ɔ nwo zɔ kɛ kenle mɔɔ bɛwole ye la. Mebamaa yeayɛ kɛ fienemgbole nu azɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛwe la, na meamaa nzuhɔne ngome ahu ye ado ye lɔ. 4Menrɛze ɔ mra ne mɔ anwunvɔne, ɔboalekɛ bɛle tuutuu mralɛ, 5ɔluakɛ bɛ nli le tuutuunli. Raalɛ ne mɔɔ nrenzɛle bɛ la ɛbɔ anyiemgba ɛbɛla. Ɔluakɛ ɔhanle kɛ, “Metoa me kulovolɛma mɔɔ maa me aleɛ nee nzule, mboane enrinli nee lenen, ɔlivi nwole, yɛɛ nwanye la.”
6Yemɔti mebava mbowumbaka meagya ye anyiane na mealie bane meawa ye, amaa yeannwu ye ndenle ne mɔ. 7Ɔbadu ye kulovolɛma ako na ɔnrɛdo bɛ. Ɔbakpondɛ bɛ na ɔnrɛnwu bɛ. Na akee ɔbaha kɛ, “Mesia meadoa me hu ne mɔɔ lumuale gyale me la, ɔluakɛ ɛnee ɔle kpalɛ ɔmaa me ɔtɛla kɛkala.”
8Ɔnze kɛ medame a menvale abɛlɛ, nwanye, ɔlivi nwole, dwɛtɛ fufule, yɛɛ ezukoa nvutuke memanle ye a, yɛɛ bɛvale bɛzonlenle bozonle Beeyale ne a. 9Yemɔti ɛbuhenle ne dwu a mebalie me abɛlɛ, nwanye ne mɔ nee me mboane enrinli nee lenen ne mɔ mɔɔ menvale memanle ɔyɛle ndanlɛ ɔhedale la. 10Mebakpa ɔ nwo wɔlɔnwo wɔ ye kulovolɛma anyunlu, na awie biala ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛlie ye ɛnrɛvi me tumi bo. 11Mebamaa yeagyakyi ye anyelielɛ ne mɔ, ye ɛvoyia ne mɔ, ye siane fofolɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ne mɔ, ye Ɛnwomenlelielɛ Ɛvoyia ne mɔ, yɛɛ ye nyamenlezonlenlɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. 12Mebazɛkye ye vanye mbaka nee ye feege mbaka mɔɔ ɔse ɔle ye ɛkpabɔdeɛ mɔɔ ye kulovolɛma vale manle ye la. Mebamaa ye vanye nee ye feege egyinli ne mɔ ahakyi kpɔkɛ, nanemgbole arali. 13Mebadea ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ rɛle vile me na ɔhɔkpunle ɛyɛlɛ ɔmanle ye awozonle Beeyale ne mɔ, na ɔvale anwoneɛ ɔzieziele ɔ nwo ɔdoale ye kulovolɛma la; kɛ medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese la ɛne.
Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ ye menli ne anwo ɛhulolɛ
14Yemɔti nea, mebali ye adwenle na meava ye meahɔ fienemgbole ne anu, na meadendɛ kɛnlɛma meahile ye. 15 Ɛkɛ ne, mebava ye vanye egyinli ne mɔ meamaa ye na meamaa Ngyegyelɛ Bɔnza ayɛ anyelazo anlenkɛ. Na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mefɛlɛ ye a ɔbalie zo, kɛmɔ ye mbɛlɛra nu mɔɔ ɔvi Yigyibiti ɔrale la ɔyɛle la. 16Mekɛ ne anu medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛbavɛlɛ me “Me hu” na ɛnrɛvɛlɛ me, “Me Beeyale.” 17Ɔluakɛ menrɛmaa ɔnrɛbɔ Beeyale ne mɔ duma bieko, yɛɛ bɛnrɛbɔ bɛ duma bieko.
18Kenle zɔhane me nee ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole, anwomanyunlu nloma, yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ twenle ɔ kɛnra aze la bayɛ ngyekyeleɛ; mebaye ɛda, konle dadeɛ nee konle meavi azɛlɛ ne azo, na me menli ne adɛnla bɛ nwo adɔ bɛ.
19Yizilayɛ, mebayia wɔ meava wɔ meayɛ me ye dahuu.
Mebava tenleneyɛlɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ meagya wɔ,
mebava ɛhulolɛ kpundii nee anwunvɔnezelɛ meagya wɔ.
20Mebava wɔ meayɛ me ye nɔhalɛ nu,
na ɛbanwu kɛ mele Ɛdɛnkɛma.
21Mekɛ ne anu, medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mese,
mebadendɛ anwomanyunlu anwo
na anwomanyunlu badendɛ azɛlɛ ye anwo.
22Na azɛlɛ ye bamaa abɛlɛ, nwanye nee nwole
na aleɛ abu Gyɛzelii.
23 Mebalua ye azɛlɛ ne azo meamaa me nwo.
Mebaze “Bɛnzebɛanwunvɔne” anwunvɔne,
na meaze “Tɛmemenli ɔ” kɛ, “Bɛle me menli”
na ɔdaye ɔbaha kɛ, “Ɛle me Nyamenle.”

english_text:
God's Love Offers Hope
1Once again the Lord spoke to me. And this time he said, “Hosea, fall in love with an unfaithful woman who has a lover. Do this to show that I love the people of Israel, even though they worship idols and enjoy the offering cakes made with fruit.”
2So I paid 15 pieces of silver and about 150 kilograms of grain for such a woman. 3Then I said, “Now you are mine! You will have to remain faithful to me, though it will be a long time before we sleep together.”
4It will also be a long time before Israel has a king or before sacrifices are offered at the temple or before there is any way to get guidance from God. 5But later, Israel will turn back to the Lord their God and to David their king. At that time they will come to the Lord with fear and trembling, and he will be good to them.
translation_text:
Hozia nee raalɛ ne mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ la
1Ɛdɛnkɛma zele me kɛ, “Kɔ bieko na kɔhulo awuvolɛ raalɛ mɔɔ ɛlɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne na ye kulovolɛ ne le nrenya mɔɔ gya raalɛ la. Kulo ye kɛmɔ kɛkala medame Ɛdɛnkɛma mesi mekulo Yizilayɛma mɔɔ kakyi bɛ nwo kɔ nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne anwo, na bɛkulo vanye mra la.”
2Yemɔti menzule dwɛtɛ fufule bulu nee nnu nee baale nzuzuleɛ kilo ɛya ko abulanlu mengyale ye. 3Menganle mengilele ye kɛ, “Ɔwɔ kɛ ɛyɛ me ye, ɛkyɛ me sa nu; mmabɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla bieko anzɛɛ mmakɔfa nrenya fofolɛ; na medame noko mebali nɔhalɛ ko ne ala meamaa wɔ.” 4Ɔluakɛ Yizilayɛma badɛnla ahyɛ dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛnrɛnyia belemgbunli anzɛɛ mgbanyima; bɛnrɛbɔ azu yɛɛ bɛnrɛnyia awolɛ mpila, bɛnrɛnyia mmonle anzɛɛ ananze mɔɔ bɛfa bɛayɛ sɛkɛlɛneɛ bɛazonle nee ɛzonlenlɛ tɛladeɛ Yifɔdo. 5Ɛhye anzi Yizilayɛma bazia ara Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, nee bɛ belemgbunli Devidi ɛkɛ. Bɛbava ɛzulolɛ bɛazia bɛara Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ wɔ ye kpalɛyɛlɛ ne ati.

english_text:
Israel Is Unfaithful
1Israel, listen
as the Lord accuses
everyone in the land!
No one is faithful or loyal
or truly cares about God.
2Cursing, dishonesty, murder,
robbery, unfaithfulness—
these happen all the time.
Violence is everywhere.
3And so your land is a desert.
Every living creature is dying—
people and wild animals,
birds and fish.
The Lord Warns the Priests
4Don't accuse just anyone!
Not everyone is at fault.
My case is against you,
the priests.
5You and the prophets
will stumble day and night;
I'll silence your mothers.
6You priests have rejected me,
and my people are destroyed
by refusing to obey.
Now I'll reject you and forget
your children, because you
have forgotten my Law.
7By adding more of you priests,
you multiply the number
of people who sin.
Now I'll change your pride
into shame.
8You encourage others to sin,
so you can stuff yourselves
on their sin offerings.
9That's why I will punish
the people for their deeds,
just as I will punish
you priests.
10Their food won't satisfy,
and having sex at pagan shrines
won't produce children.
My people have rebelled
11and have been unfaithful
to me, their Lord.
God Condemns Israel's Idolatry
My people, you are foolish
because of too much pleasure
and too much wine.
12You expect wooden idols
and other objects of wood
to give you advice.
Lusting for sex at pagan shrines
has made you unfaithful
to me, your God.
13You offer sacrifices
on mountaintops and hills,
under oak trees, and wherever
good shade is found.
Your own daughters
and daughters-in-law
sell themselves for sex.
14But I won't punish them.
You men are to blame,
because you go to prostitutes
and offer sacrifices with them
at pagan shrines.
Your own foolishness
will lead to your ruin.
15Israel, you are unfaithful,
but don't lead Judah to sin.
Stop worshiping at Gilgal
or at sinful Bethel.
And quit making promises
in my name—the name
of the living Lord.
16You are nothing more
than a stubborn cow—
so stubborn that I, the Lord,
cannot feed you like lambs
in an open pasture.
17You people of Israel
are charmed by idols.
Leave those people alone!
18You get drunk, then sleep
with prostitutes;
you would rather be vulgar
than lead a decent life.
19And so you will be swept away
in a whirlwind
for sacrificing to idols.
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma somolɛbɔlɛ mɔɔ tia Yizilayɛ
1O Yizilayɛma, bɛdie Ɛdɛnkɛma edwɛkɛ ne, ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ edwɛkɛ tia bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛde azɛlɛ ne azo la. Ɔse, “Bɛnli nɔhalɛ anzɛɛ bɛnyɛ atiakunlukɛnlɛma yɛɛ bɛnlɛ Nyamenle anwo adwenle biala wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo. 2Bɛka ndane, bɛbɔ adalɛ, bɛku menli, bɛwua, yɛɛ bɛto awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne. Bɛdɛla anhwe yɛɛ menli ala a bɛku a. 3Yemɔti azɛlɛ ne bayɛ resee yɛɛ debie biala mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la bawu. Ɛbɔ nu nane kɔsɔɔti, anwomanyunlu nloma kɔsɔɔti, nyevile nu fɛlɛ bɔbɔ, bɛ muala bɛbawu.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ sɛlɛvolɛma somolɛ
4Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Awie biala mmasu ɛhye anwo kpolera, yɛɛ awie biala mmato menli ne ɛzonle; ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ sɛlɛvolɛma bɔbɔ yɛɛ me nee bɛ lɛ edwɛkɛ a. 5Bɛbadu koti alehyenlɛ nu, yɛɛ Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛma ne noko nee bɛ badu koti aledwolɛ nu, na mebazɛkye bɛ nli ne. 6Me menli ne ɛnlɛ adwenle la ati bɛzɛkye bɛ; kɛmɔ bɛkpo adwenlenubukelɛ la ati, medame noko mekpo bɛ kɛ bɛnle me sɛlɛvolɛma bieko, yɛɛ kɛmɔ bɛ rɛle ɛvi bɛ Nyamenle ne mɛla ne la, medame noko me rɛle bavi bɛ mra.
7“Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛlɛso la, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee bɛlɛyɛ ɛtane dɔɔnwo bɛatia me la ɛne, yemɔti mebamaa bɛ enililɛ ahakyi anyiemgba. 8Bɛdidi me menli ne ɛtane nwo, bɛyɛ adidikpoku wɔ me menli ne ɛtaneyɛlɛ nwo. 9Mɔɔ mebava meayɛ me menli ne la, zɔhane ala a mebava meayɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ a. Mebadea bɛ na meadua bɛ kakɛ wɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anwo. 10Bɛbali, na bɛ ko ɛnrɛyi. Bɛbali awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nu tuutuu kɛ bɛkɛwo mralɛ dɔɔnwo na bɛnrɛwo mralɛ, ɔboalekɛ bɛhakyi bɛ nzi bɛzi medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛdoɔdoa nyamenle gyɛne gyɛne.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma bua awozonlezonlenlɛma fɔlɛ
11Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Nwanye, dɛba o, fofolɛ o, sɛkye me menli ne ndelebɛbo! 12Bɛkɔ baka dosinli nwo abisa yɛɛ bɛdabɛ bɛ kpɔma bɔbɔ bɔ bɛ munzule. Ɔluakɛ tuutuulilɛ sunsum ɛva bɛ ɛminli, ɛmaa bɛgyakyi bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛzonlenlɛ na bɛlɛdi awozonlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu. Bɛbɔ azu wɔ awoka mgbole zo na bɛfa bɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛkɔ awoka ngyikyi ne mɔ azo, yɛɛ 13mbaka ndendenle ɛsesebɛ bubuzuu bo, ɔboalekɛ bɛ alubo ne mɔ anu yɛ anyelielɛ.
“Yemɔti bɛ mra mraalɛ bɔ awozonlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu ɛbɛla na bɛ mra mrenya aye mɔ to awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne. 14Noko saa bɛ mra mraalɛ ne mɔ bɔ awozonlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu ɛbɛla na bɛ mra mrenya ne mɔ aye mɔ to awuvolɛvalɛ mɛla ne a, menrɛdea bɛ, ɔluakɛ mrenya ne mɔ bɛdabɛ bɛfa ahane bɛkɔfa tuutuuma yɛɛ bɛ nee awozonle ɛzonlenlɛ nu tuutuuma bɔ nu bɔ azu. Bɛle menli mɔɔ ɛnlɛ ndelebɛbo a, na bɛbazɛkye bɛ noko.
15“Saa bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla a, Dwudama ɛnli nwolɛ fɔlɛ. Bɛmmakɔ Gelegale anzɛɛ Bɛteevɛn kɛ bɛkazonle, yɛɛ bɛmmafa ‘Tease Ɛdɛnkɛma’ duma bɛka ndane. 16Yizilayɛma anzo yɛ se kɛ mgbɔnwɔndua. Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ na meamaa bɛ aleɛ kɛ mboane mralɛ mɔɔ wɔ adidileka mɔɔ le tɛtɛlɛ la ɛ? 17Awozonlezonlenlɛ ɛgya Yizilayɛma; bɛgyakyi bɛ. 18Nzabovoma akpolane mɔɔ anye die tuutuulilɛ nwo a. Bɛkulo anyiemgba bɛtɛla anyunlunyia. 19Anwonyia ɛpia bɛ ɛhɔ, na bɛ awozonle azubɔlɛ ne mɔ ati, anyiemgba baha bɛ.

english_text:
Israel and Judah Will Be Judged
The Lord said:
1Listen, you priests!
Pay attention, Israel!
Listen, you members
of the royal family.
Justice was your duty.
But at Mizpah and Mount Tabor
you trapped the people.
2At the place of worship
you were a treacherous pit,
and I will punish you.
3Israel, I know all about you,
and because of your unfaithfulness,
I find you unacceptable.
4Your evil deeds are the reason
you won't return to me,
your Lord God.
And your constant craving for sex
keeps you from knowing me.
5Israel, your pride
testifies to your guilt;
it makes you stumble,
and Judah stumbles too.
6You offer sheep and cattle
as sacrifices to me,
but I have turned away
and refuse to be found.
7You have been unfaithful
to me, your Lord;
you have had children
by prostitutes.
So at the New Moon Festival,
you and your crops
will be destroyed.
The Lord Warns Israel and Judah
8Give a warning on the trumpet!
Let it be heard in Gibeah,
Ramah, and sinful Bethel.
Benjamin, watch out!
9I, the Lord, will punish
and wipe out Israel.
This is my solemn promise
to every tribe of Israel.
10Judah's leaders are like crooks
who move boundary markers;
that's why I will flood them
with my anger.
11Israel was brutally crushed.
They got what they deserved
for worshiping useless idols.
12Now I, the Lord,
will fill Israel with maggots
and make Judah rot.
13When Israel and Judah saw
their sickness and wounds,
Israel asked help from Assyria
and its mighty king.
But the king cannot cure them
or heal their wounds.
14So I'll become a fierce lion
attacking Israel and Judah.
I'll snatch and carry off
what I want,
and no one can stop me.
15Then I'll return to my temple
until they confess their guilt
and worship me,
until they are desperate
and beg for my help.
translation_text:
1“Bɛdie edwɛkɛ ɛhye, bɛmɛ sɛlɛvolɛma! Bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ, bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma! Bɛdie, bɛmɛ arelemgbunli! Ɔluakɛ ndɛnebualɛ ne gyi bɛ nwo zo. Ɔluakɛ bɛyɛ bɛ nwo kɛ ngane wɔ Mezepa, bɛyɛ kɛ avonle mɔɔ bɛdo wɔ Teebɔ Boka ne azo la, 2bɛpɛ kuma kuloonwu wɔ suakpole Akasea azo, yɛɛ menli ala a bɛku a; mebadea bɛ kɔsɔɔti. 3Meze Yifelaem, yɛɛ Yizilayɛ ɛnvea me nye zo. Na kɛkala, wɔmɔ Yifelaem, wɔbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla, evinli ɛha Yizilayɛ.”
Hozia bɔ awozonlezonlenlɛ nwo kɔkɔ
4Bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛmmaa bɛngola bɛnzia bɛngɔ bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ. Ɔluakɛ tuutuulilɛ sunsum ne wɔ bɛ nu, yɛɛ bɛnze Ɛdɛnkɛma. 5Yizilayɛma mgbanyizonle ne di daselɛ tia bɛ. Bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ bamaa Yifelaem nee Yizilayɛ adu koti. Dwudama noko nee bɛ a badu koti ne a. 6Bɛbava bɛ mboane nee bɛ nlankɛ bɛabɔ azu bɛakpondɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma, na bɛnrɛnwu ye, ɔluakɛ yehwe ɔ nwo yevi bɛ nwo. 7Bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɔluakɛ bɛwo nyɛvolɛ mralɛ. Yemɔti siane fofolɛ ɛvoyialilɛ ne bazɛkye bɛ nee bɛ azɛlɛ ne kɔsɔɔti.
Dwuda nee Yizilayɛ konle ne
8Bɛwu konle aweɛne ndendenle ne mɔ anu wɔ Gebɛya! Bɛbɔ nolo ne wɔ Releema! Bɛbɔ bubu wɔ Bɛteevɛn. Bɛli bɛ nzi, Bɛngyaman asa azo! 9Kenle ne ɛlɛba, na bɛbazɛkye Yifelaem maanle ne. Yizilayɛma, nɔhalɛ nu, ɛhye bazi!
10Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Dwuda arelemgbunli ɛyɛ bɛ nwo menli mɔɔ di azɛlɛ zo ɛweɛne tukpɔnla a. Yemɔti mebawola me ɛya ne meagua bɛ nwo zo kɛ nzule la. 11Yifelaem ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ wɔ ndeanlɛ nu, ɔboalekɛ yebɔ kpɔkɛ kɛ debie mgbane ala yɛɛ ɔdi ɔ nzi a. 12Yemɔti mebayɛ me nwo ɛlɛtɛba meazɛkye Yizilayɛ na meayɛ kɛ nrɛnlana meamaa Dwudama ayɛ mgbane.
13“Mɔɔ Yifelaem nwunle kɛ anwonyane ɛbɔ ye na Dwuda noko nwunle kɛ ɔdaye mumua ne yedudu nganlɛ la, Yifelaem hɔle Aselea maanle maanle belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ kɛ ɔkabiza ye moalɛ, noko Aselea angola anyɛ bɛ nee bɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ ayile. 14Mebateta Yifelaem kɛ awenade na meateta Dwuda kɛ awenade ralɛ. Medame mumua ne mebatete bɛ nzokanzoka na meagyakyi bɛ meahɔ. Saa me nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ a, awie biala ɛnrɛhola bɛ die.
15“Mebahwe me nwo meavi menli ne anwo kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛnwu bɛ ɛtane mɔɔ bɛyɛ, na wɔ bɛ amaneɛnwunlɛ ne anu, bɛkɛkpondɛ me bo zo la.”

english_text:
The Lord's People Speak
1Let's return to the Lord.
He has torn us to shreds,
but he will bandage our wounds
and make us well.
2In two or three days
he will heal us
and restore our strength
that we may live with him.
3Let's do our best
to know the Lord.
His coming is as certain
as the morning sun;
he will refresh us like rain
renewing the earth
in the springtime.
The Lord Speaks to Israel and Judah
4People of Israel and Judah,
what can I do with you?
Your love for me disappears
more quickly than mist
or dew at sunrise.
5That's why I slaughtered you
with the words
of my prophets.
That's why my judgments blazed
like the dawning sun.
6 I'd rather for you to be faithful
and to know me
than to offer sacrifices.
7At a place named Adam,
you betrayed me
by breaking our agreement.
8Everyone in Gilead is evil;
your hands are stained
with the blood of victims.
9You priests are like a gang
of robbers in ambush.
On the road to Shechem
you murder and commit
other horrible crimes.
10I have seen a terrible thing
in Israel—
you are unfaithful
and unfit to worship me.
11People of Judah,
your time is coming too.
The Lord Wants To Help Israel
I, the Lord, would like to make
my nation prosper again
translation_text:
Menli ne anlubɛnwo ɛnle nɔhalɛ
1Menli ne baha kɛ, “Bɛmaa yɛzia yɛdoa Ɛdɛnkɛma! Yemaa yɛnwu amaneɛ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔbayɛ yɛ ayile; yebodɛboda yɛ ɛdeɛ, noko ɔbayɛ yɛ nganlɛ ne mɔ ayile. 2Kenle nwiɔ ne azo ɔbamaa yɛabɔzɔbɔzɔ, na ye kenle nsa ne azo yeadwazo yɛ, na yɛadɛnla ngoane nu. 3Bɛmaa yɛbɔ mɔdenle yɛnwu Ɛdɛnkɛma. Nɔhalɛ, ye ɛralɛ ɛnli mgbanwo, kɛmɔ alehyenlɛ ɛnli mgbanwo la. Ɔbara kɛ nyenyensuo nyenye doɔloa azɛlɛ ye la.”
4Na Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “O Yifelaemma, kɛ menyɛ bɛ ɛ? O Dwudama, kɛ menyɛ bɛ ɛ? Me nwo ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ la le kɛ nwonlomɔ amungu, ɔle kɛ nwonlomɔ ɛbɔlɛ, ɔngyɛ na yeawe. 5Yemɔti memaa me kpɔmanvolɛma ɛpɛ bɛ ɛgua. Meva me nloa edwɛkɛ mehu bɛ, yɛɛ me ndɛnebualɛ ne le wienyi; 6 ɔluakɛ mekpondɛ ɛhulolɛ kpundii, na tɛ nane azubɔlɛ ɔ. Mekulo kɛ bɛnwu Nyamenle bɛtɛla ɛyelalɛ azubɔdeɛ ne mɔ.
7“Bɛle kɛ Adam la, bɛtulule ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la, bɛanli nɔhalɛ bɛammaa me. 8Geleade le suakpole mɔɔ munzulema nee ahɔdiawu ɛyi ye tɔ na mogya ɛbu zolɛ a. 9Sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ le kɛ nwule ekpunli mɔɔ ɛhɔ nzia kakpondɛ sonla akpokpo ye la. Bɛku menli wɔ Hyikɛm adenle zo yɛɛ bɛbɔ munzule ɛbɛla ɛhye amumuyɛ nu. 10Menwu debie ɛzulolɛ bie wɔ Yizilayɛ: Yifelaem awozonlezonlenlɛ nu tuutuu ɛbɛla ne wɔ ɛkɛ; evinli ɛha Yizilayɛ.
11“Na bɛmɛ Dwudama noko, mezie kenle mɔɔ mebava meadea bɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ la anwo a.

english_text:
1and to heal its wounds.
But then I see the crimes
in Israel and Samaria.
Everyone is deceitful;
robbers roam the streets.
2No one realizes
that I have seen their sins
surround them like a flood.
3The king and his officials
take great pleasure
in their sin and deceit.
4Everyone burns with desire—
they are like coals in an oven,
ready to burst into flames.
5On the day their king
was crowned,
his officials got him drunk,
and he joined
in their foolishness.
6Their anger is a fire
that smolders all night,
then flares up at dawn.
7They are flames
destroying their leaders.
And their kings are powerless;
none of them trust me.
8The people of Israel
have mixed with foreigners;
they are a thin piece of bread
scorched on one side.
9They don't seem to realize
how weak and feeble they are;
their hair has turned gray,
while foreigners rule.
10I am the Lord, their God,
but in all of their troubles
their pride keeps them
from returning to me.
No Help from Foreign Nations
The Lord said:
11Israel is a senseless bird,
fluttering back and forth
between Egypt and Assyria.
12But I will catch them in a net
as hunters trap birds;
I threatened to punish them,
and indeed I will.
13Trouble and destruction
will be their reward
for rejecting me.
I would have rescued them,
but they told me lies.
14They don't really pray to me;
they just howl in their beds.
They have rejected me for Baal
and slashed themselves,
in the hope that Baal
will bless their crops.
15I taught them what they know,
and I made them strong.
Now they plot against me
16and refuse to obey.
They are more useless
than a crooked arrow.
Their leaders will die in war
for saying foolish things.
Egyptians will laugh at them.
translation_text:
1“Mekɛ biala mɔɔ menwɔze kɛ meyɛ me menli Yizilayɛma ayile na meamaa bɛakpazi bieko la, debie mɔɔ menwu ye la ala a le Yifelaem amumuyɛ ɛbɛla ne nee Samɛlea munzule nyɛleɛ ne mɔ. Bɛdi bɛ nwo ndunlumi; bɛbubu nlenkɛ bɛwua; bɛkpokpo menli wɔ guabile ne mɔ azo. 2Bɛ ti moaba ɛnga ɛngile bɛ kɛ mebabu bɛ ɛtane ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti anwo mgbonda. Bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ ɛli bɛ bɔyia, ɔ muala gua me nyunlu.”
Suakunlu ɛkɛ ne maamɔlɛ adwenlevalɛ
3Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Menli fa bɛ maamɔlɛ adwenle ne bɛlɛbɛla belemgbunli nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ. 4Bɛ muala bɛle awuvolɛvalɛma; bɛle kɛ fonlomo mɔɔ ɛwie dɔ mɔɔ sonla ne mɔɔ to kpanwo ne la ɛnga nuhua bieko toonwo kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ ɔkɛwie ye kpanwo ne bɔ na ɔkɛwie tu la. 5Mekɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli ne di ye ɛvoyia ne la, ɔ nee ye mgbanyima ne mɔ nlonle nza na bɛyɛle tindaanwu na ɔbokale bɛ bɛzile amgbu. 6Bɛ ninyɛndane nwo adwenlevalɛ maa bɛ adwenle nu dɔ kɛ fonlomo; aledwolɛ nu amuala bɛ ɛya ne wu gbodogbodo kɛ ɔgyi senle zo, alehyenlɛ nu ɔsɔ kɛ sendɔlɔra.
7“Bɛ muala bɛlɔle kɛ fonlomo na bɛhunle bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ. Bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ amuala ɛwie wu yɛɛ bɛ biala anzɛlɛ ambiza me moalɛ.”
Yizilayɛ nee maanle maanle ne mɔ
8Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yifelaem le kɛ kpanwo mɔɔ ɛtɛwiele be la. Bɛfa bɛ nye bɛto maanle maanle mɔɔ zuozua bɛ la anwo zo. 9Bɛngola bɛnnwu ye kɛ nyɛvolɛ yɛɛ ɛmaa bɛ anwosesebɛ ɛwie a. Bɛbɔ egyɛne, na bɛnnwu ye. 10Yizilayɛma mgbanyizonle ne di daselɛ tia bɛ. Noko ɛhye mɔ kɔsɔɔti anzi, bɛnzia bɛndoa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne, yɛɛ bɛmkpondɛ me bo zo. 11Yifelaem di tɛnlatu kɛ abubule mɔɔ ɛnlɛ adwenle la. Bɛkɔ Yigyibiti bɛkɔbiza moalɛ, na bɛanriandi bɛahɔ Aselea bɛahɔbiza moalɛ. 12Na mɔɔ bɛlɛkɔ la, mebagua bɛ asawu meahye bɛ kɛ anwomanyunlu nloma la. Mebadea bɛ wɔ bɛ amumuyɛ ɛbɛla ne mɔ anwo.
13“Munzule ɛha bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛde bɛ nwo bɛvi me nwo! Mebazɛkye bɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛde me nwo atua. Mekulo kɛ medie bɛ, noko bɛbɔ me nwo adalɛ. 14Bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ ne mɔ ɛnvi bɛ ahonle nu, bɛda bɛ ɛkpa ne mɔ azo a bɛye awolɛ a. Abɛlɛ nee nza ti bɛbodɛboda bɛ nwo, bɛkpo me. 15Medame a mentetele bɛ mengilele bɛ anwosesebɛ a, noko bɛfa me nwo maamɔvo adwenle. 16Bɛgyakyi me na bɛtoa bozonle Beeyale ne. Bɛle kɛ ɛda kyealera. Bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ bawu dadeɛ nloa wɔ bɛ mgbanyizonle ɛdendɛlɛ ti. Yigyibitima bazi bɛ ti zo agole.”

english_text:
Israel Rejects the Lord
The Lord said:
1Sound a warning!
Israel, you broke our agreement
and ignored my teaching.
Now an eagle is swooping down
to attack my land.
2Israel, you say, “We claim you,
the Lord, as our God.”
3But your enemies
will chase you for rejecting
our good agreement.
4You chose kings and leaders
without consulting me;
you made silver and gold idols
that led to your downfall.
5City of Samaria, I'm angry
because of your idol
in the shape of a calf.
When will you ever
be innocent again?
6Someone from Israel built
that idol for you,
but only I am God.
And so it will be smashed
to pieces.
7If you scatter wind
instead of wheat,
you will harvest a whirlwind
and have no wheat.
Even if you harvest grain,
enemies will steal it all.
8Israel, you are ruined,
and now the nations
consider you worthless.
9You are like a wild donkey
that goes its own way.
You've run off to Assyria
and hired them as allies.
10You can bargain with nations,
but I'll catch you anyway.
Soon you will suffer abuse
by kings and rulers.
11Israel, you have built
many altars where you offer
sacrifices for sin.
But these altars have become
places for sin.
12My instructions for sacrifices
were written in detail,
but you ignored them.
13You sacrifice your best animals
and eat the sacrificial meals,
but I, the Lord,
refuse your offerings.
I will remember your sins
and punish you.
Then you will return to Egypt.
14Israel, I created you,
but you forgot me.
You and Judah built palaces
and many strong cities.
Now I will send fire to destroy
your towns and fortresses.
translation_text:
Ɛdɛnkɛma bua Yizilayɛ fɔlɛ wɔ mmonlezɔlɛ nwo
1Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu. Agbɔvolɛ ɛlɛba arali me azɛlɛ ye mutule kɛ ahɔleɛ! Ɔluakɛ menli ne ɛtulu me ngyekyeleɛ ne mɔɔ me nee bɛ kyekyele la na bɛbulu me mɛla ne azo. 2Bɛsu bɛfɛlɛ me kɛ, ‘Me Nyamenle, yɛze wɔ.’ 3Yizilayɛma ɛkpo mɔɔ le kpalɛ la. Ɛhye ati bɛ kpɔvolɛma badu bɛ mgbaliko.
4“Bɛziele arelemgbunli, noko bɛanlua me nwo zo a bɛziele a. Bɛzieziele mgbanyima mɔɔ menze nwolɛ bie. Bɛvale bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule nee bɛ ezukoa nvutuke bɛguale ananze bɛzɛkyele bɛ nwo. 5Mekyi nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ralɛ ananze ne mɔɔ suakpole Samɛlea amra zonlenle ye la. Me ahonle ɛfutu bɛ nwo. Kenlenzu yɛɛ bɛkɛgyakyi bɛ mmonlezɔlɛ ne a? 6Yizilayɛnli dwinvolɛ a yɛle ananze ne a, ɔnle Nyamenle. Bɛbagelegele Samɛlea nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ralɛ ananze ne dwɔkɔdwɔkɔ. 7Bɛdua anwoma, na bɛbabu ahumu. Ɛya avule nu abɛlɛ ɛnrɛvievia mralɛ, bɛnrɛnyia aleɛ wɔ nu, yɛɛ saa bɛfievia mralɛ bɔbɔ a, nyɛvolɛ a bali a. 8Yizilayɛ ɛli akoatɔ; kɛkala bɛhyɛ bɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu na bɛyɛ kɛ buakɛ mgbane bie la. 9Yizilayɛma le kɛ asoaso ahohonyinli, bɛdabɛ bɛpɛ adenle bɛhɔ kɛ bɛkabiza Aseleama moalɛ. Yifelaem ɛbɔ maanle maanle gyɛne ɛkpa kɛ bɛraboa ye. 10Saa kanza bɛluolua nu bɛbɔ maanle maanle ɛkpa a, akee mebaboɔboa bɛ nloa. Na bɛbagyakyi belemgbunli nee mgbanyima ɛzielɛ.
11“Kɛmɔ Yifelaemma ɛsisi azukponle dɔɔnwo ɛva ɛyɛ ɛtane la, bɛmaa azukponle ɛyɛ debie ɛtane me nye zo. 12Saa mekɛlɛ me mɛla apenle apenle bulu meamaa bɛ a, anrɛɛ bɛbabu bɛ debie ngakyile bie. 13Bɛkulo azubɔlɛ; bɛku nane bɛbɔ azu na bɛdi. Na medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, me nye ɛnlie nwolɛ. Akee mebahakye bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ na meadea bɛ wɔ nwolɛ, na meamaa bɛazia bɛahɔ Yigyibiti.
14“Yizilayɛma ɛsisi arelemgbunli azua na bɛ rɛle ɛvi bɛ Bɔvolɛ ne. Dwudama ɛsisi azuamgbole ɛbɔ bɛ nwo bane. Na mebakpomgbɔ senle meagua bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ azo na ɔbayela bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ.”

english_text:
Israel Will Be Punished
1Israel, don't celebrate
or make noisy shouts
like other nations.
You have been unfaithful
to your God.
Wherever grain is threshed,
you behave like prostitutes
because you enjoy
the money you receive.
2But you will run short
of grain and wine,
3and you will have to leave
the land of the Lord.
Some of you will go to Egypt;
others will go to Assyria
and eat unclean food.
4You won't be able to offer
sacrifices of wine
to the Lord.
None of your sacrifices
will please him—
they will be unclean
like food offered to the dead.
Your food will only be used
to satisfy your hunger;
none of it will be brought
to the Lord's temple.
5You will no longer be able
to celebrate the festival
of the Lord.
6Even if you escape alive,
you will end up in Egypt
and be buried in Memphis.
Your silver treasures
will be lost among weeds;
thorns will sprout in your tents.
7 Israel, the time has come.
You will get what you deserve,
and you will know it.
“Prophets are fools,” you say.
“And God's messengers
are crazy.”
Your terrible guilt
has filled you with hatred.
8Israel, the Lord sent me
to look after you.
But you trap his prophets
and flood his temple
with your hatred.
9 You are brutal and corrupt,
as were the men of Gibeah.
But God remembers your sin,
and you will be punished.
Sin's Terrible Results
10 Israel, when I, the Lord,
found you long ago
it was like finding
grapes in a barren desert
or tender young figs.
Then you worshiped Baal Peor,
that disgusting idol,
and you became as disgusting
as the idol you loved.
11And so, Israel, your glory
will fly away like birds—
your women will no longer
be able to give birth.
12Even if you do have children,
I will take them all
and leave you to mourn.
I will turn away,
and you will sink down
in deep trouble.
13Israel, when I first met you,
I thought of you as palm trees
growing in fertile ground.
Now you lead your people out,
only to be slaughtered.
Hosea's Advice
14Our Lord, do just one thing
for your people—
make their women unable
to have children
or to nurse their babies.
The Lord's Judgment on Israel
15Israel, I first began
to hate you because
you did evil at Gilgal.
Now I will chase you
out of my house.
No longer will I love you;
your leaders betrayed me.
16Israel, you are a vine
with dried-up roots
and fruitless branches.
Even if you had more children
and loved them dearly,
I would slaughter them all.
Hosea Warns Israel
17Israel, you disobeyed my God.
Now he will force you to roam
from nation to nation.
translation_text:
Hozia bɔ Yizilayɛ ndeanlɛ nwo nolo
1Yizilayɛma, bɛgyakyi fɛlɛkolilɛ! Bɛmmadi wulupe kɛ maanle maanle ne mɔ la, ɔluakɛ bɛmɛ Yizilayɛma, bɛbɔ tuutuu ɛbɛla, na bɛkpo bɛ Nyamenle. Bɛhulo kɛ bɛkɛbɔ bɛ ɛkpa kɛ tuutuuma la wɔ ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka ne mɔ. 2Aleɛ nee nza mɔɔ bɛbanyia bɛ wɔ ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka nee nwanyezielɛ ɛleka ne mɔ la ɛnrɛzɔ bɛ yɛɛ bɛnrɛnyia nwanye fofolɛ. 3Yizilayɛma ɛnrɛdɛnla Ɛdɛnkɛma azɛlɛ ne azo; Yifelaemma bazia ahɔ Yigyibiti na bɛali aleɛ mɔɔ nwolɛ ɛnde la wɔ Aselea. 4Wɔ maanle zɔhane mɔ anu, bɛnrɛgua nwanye aze bɛnrɛye ɛdɛne bɛnrɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma, yɛɛ bɛ azubɔlɛ ne mɔ ɛnrɛzɔ ɔ nye. Bɛ aleɛ bayɛ kɛ ɛzɛne aleɛ; awie biala mɔɔ kɛli bie la, evinli baha ye, ɔluakɛ bɛbali bɛava bɛakpɔda bɛ ko ala; bɛnrɛva bie bɛnrɛyɛ azubɔdeɛ bɛnrɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu. 5Na saa mekɛ ne dwu, mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi ɛvoyia ne mɔ bɛwula Ɛdɛnkɛma anyunlunyia a, duzu a bɛkɛyɛ a? 6Ɔluakɛ bɛnlea, anwubɛnyunlu ɛmaa bɛ nee bɛ ɛlɛkɔ Aselea, Yigyibitima baboɔboa bɛ nloa; bɛbaboɔboa bɛ nloa bɛahɔgua bɛ Mɛmefese na ɛkɛ ne a bɛbawu bɛagua a. Ndile nee mbowule bafifi ava bɛ dwɛtɛ fufule gyazielɛ ɛleka nee bɛ ndanlɛ azua ne mɔ.
7 Ndeanlɛ mekɛ ne ɛdwu, nzenralɛ mekɛ ne ɛdwu. Yizilayɛma banwu ye! Bɛlɛka kɛ, “Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne le koasea. Sonla ne mɔɔ sunsum ɛva ye la ɛzɛ.” Ɔboalekɛ bɛkpɔ me kpole kpalɛ, yɛɛ bɛ ɛtane ne le kpole kpalɛ. 8Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne le Yifelaemma, me Nyamenle ne menli ne sinzavolɛ. Noko ɛleka biala mɔɔ ɔfa la, bɛsua ye ɛhane kɛ anloma la, yɛɛ ɛkpɔlɛ ɛyi ye Nyamenle ne sua ne tɔ. 9 Bɛyɛ ɛtane wɔ debie biala mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anu, kɛmɔ bɛyɛle wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ Gebɛya la. Nyamenle bahakye bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ na yeadea bɛ wɔ nwolɛ.
Yizilayɛ ɛtane ne nee ɔ nzi edwɛkɛ
10 Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Mɔɔ mekanwu Yizilayɛ la, ɛnee ɔle kɛ vanye ma mɔɔ ɛfifi fienemgbole nu la. Mɔɔ mekanwu bɛ nlenya mɔ la, ɛnee bɛle kɛ feege mɔɔ ɛlɛdumua azo la ma mɔɔ ɛbolo la. Na mɔɔ bɛrale Piyɔ Boka la, bɛdule bɛ nwo bɛmanle bozonle Beeyale ne, na mengyile bɛ bɔkɔɔ kɛ bɛ bozonle ne mɔɔ bɛhulole ye la. 11Yifelaem anyunlunyia badu ahɔ kɛ anloma, bɛnrɛwo mralɛ, mraalɛ ɛnrɛnrenzɛ, yɛɛ bɛnrɛva ɛkolɛ. 12Saa bɛwo mralɛ bɔbɔ a, mebahu bɛ kɔsɔɔti; menrɛgyakyi ko bɔbɔ. Saa mefi bɛ avinli meye me nwo a, munzule baha bɛ!”
13Ɛdɛnkɛma, menwu kɛ bɛhyehyɛ kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku Yifelaem amra mrenya ne mɔ. Ɔwɔ kɛ Yifelaem fa ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ kɔ maa bɛku bɛ. 14O Ɛdɛnkɛma, duzu a ɛfa wɔayɛ menli ɛhye mɔ a? Maa bɛ mraalɛ ko ɛkpɔnekpɔne na maa bɛ nyɛfo ne mɔ ɛbɔndɔbɔndɔ.
Ɛdɛnkɛma badea Yizilayɛma
15Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti bɔle ɔ bo wɔ Gelegale. Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ membɔle ɔ bo kɛ mekyi bɛ a. Ɔlua bɛ amumuyɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ ati, mebadu bɛ me sua nu ɛkɛ. Menrɛhulo bɛ bieko ɛlɛ; bɛ arelemgbunli ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti ɛde me nwo atua. 16Yifelaemma ɛyɛ kɛ baka mɔɔ ye ndinli ɛwu na ewule ɛha ye la, bɛnrɛzo ma. Saa bɛwo bɔbɔ a, mebahu bɛ mra ne mɔ mɔɔ la bɛ ahonle nwo la.”
Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ ne ka Yizilayɛ anwo edwɛkɛ
17Me Nyamenle ne bakpo ye menli ne, ɔboalekɛ bɛandie ɔ ne. Bɛbali ahyimango wɔ maanle maanle ne mɔ anu.

english_text:
1You were a healthy vine
covered with grapes.
But the more grapes you grew,
the more altars you built;
the better off you became,
the better shrines you set up
for pagan gods.
2You are deceitful and disloyal.
So you will pay
for your sins,
because the Lord will destroy
your altars and images.
3“We don't have a king,”
you will say.
“We don't fear the Lord.
And what good are kings?”
4Israel, you break treaties
and don't keep promises;
you turn justice
into poisonous weeds
where healthy plants should grow.
5All who live in Samaria tremble
with concern for the idols
at sinful Bethel.
The idol there was the pride
of the priests,
but it has been put to shame;
now everyone will cry.
6It will be taken to Assyria
and given to the great king.
Then Israel will be disgraced
for worshiping that idol.
7Like a twig in a stream,
the king of Samaria
will be swept away.
8 The altars at sinful Bethel
will be destroyed
for causing Israel to sin;
they will be grown over
with thorns and thistles.
Then everyone will beg
the mountains and hills
to cover and protect them.
The Lord Promises To Punish Israel
9 Israel, you have never
stopped sinning
since that time at Gibeah.
That's why you
will be attacked at Gibeah.
10Your sins have doubled,
and you are rebellious.
Now I have decided
to send nations to attack
and put you in chains.
11Once you were obedient
like a calf
that loved to thresh grain.
But I will put a harness
on your beautiful neck;
you and Judah must plow
and cultivate the ground.
12 Plow your fields,
scatter seeds of justice,
and harvest faithfulness.
Worship me, the Lord,
and I will send my saving power
down like rain.
13You have planted evil,
harvested injustice, and eaten
the fruit of your lies.
You trusted your own strength
and your powerful forces.
14So war will break out,
and your fortresses
will be destroyed.
Your enemies will do to you
what Shalman did to the people
of Beth-Arbel—
mothers and their children
will be beaten to death
against rocks.
15Bethel, this will be your fate
because of your evil.
Israel, at dawn your king
will be killed.
translation_text:
1Yizilayɛma le kɛ vanye mbaka mɔɔ so kposekpose la. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nwo ɛlɛso la, ɛnee bɛlɛsisi azukponle dɔɔnwo. Mekɛ mɔɔ maanle ne ɛlɛkpazi la, ɛnee bɛlɛsisi awolɛ mpila dɔɔnwo mɔɔ bɛsonle nwolɛ la. 2Bɛnli nɔhalɛ, yemɔti ɔwɔ kɛ bɛdi bɛ ɛtane ne mɔ anwo ɛzonle. Ɛdɛnkɛma babubu bɛ azukponle ne mɔ, na yeazɛkye bɛ mpila ne mɔ.
3Akee menli ɛhye mɔ baha kɛ, “Yɛnlɛ belemgbunli, ɔluakɛ yɛanzulo Ɛdɛnkɛma. Na duzu yɛɛ belemgbunli kola yɛ maa yɛ a?” 4Bɛbuke bɛ nloa bɛkeha bie ala; bɛfa adalɛ ndane bɛkyekye ngyekyeleɛ, yemɔti ndeanlɛ fifi bɛ nwo kɛ ɛya nu ɛzezeane kuma nu ndile mɔɔ le pɔezen la.
5Menli mɔɔ de suakpole Samɛlea azo la bazulo, bɛ nwo awozo bɛ, wɔ bɛ nvutuke ɛnlankɛ ananze ne mɔɔ ɛvi Bɛtɛle la ati. Menli ne bazu ye, yɛɛ sɛlɛvolɛma ne mɔ mɔɔ sonle ananze ne la bazu aye awolɛ wɔ ye anyunlunyia ne mɔɔ ɛdɔ aze ɛbɔ la ati. 6Ɛhɛe, bɛbava ananze ne bɛayɛ adwule bɛahɔdua bɛamaa Aselea maanle maanle belemgbunli kpole ne. Anyiemgba baha Yifelaemma na nyiane ahu Yizilayɛma wɔ bɛ mmonlezɔlɛ ti. 7Samɛlea belemgbunli ne baminli kɛ taboa ebule nretee mɔɔ la azule nye la. 8 Bɛbazɛkye awoka zo ɛzonlenlɛ ɛleka ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Evɛn mɔɔ Yizilayɛma kɔ ɛkɛ kɔsonle na bɛyɛ ɛtane la. Mbowule nee ndile bafifi bɛ azukponle ne mɔ azo. Na bɛbaha bɛahile awoka ne mɔ kɛ, “Bɛheda yɛ nwo zo!” na bɛaha bɛahile awoka ngyikyi kɛ, “Bɛdu bɛgua yɛ nwo zo.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma bua Yizilayɛ ndɛne
9 Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Sumunli kɛ Yizilayɛma yɛle ɛtane tiale me wɔ Gebɛya la, bɛtɛgyakyile ɛtane ɛyɛlɛ ne. Yemɔti konle bava bɛ aze wɔ Gebɛya. 10Mebara menli ɛhye mɔ mɔɔ ɛde atua la anwo zo mearadea bɛ. Maanle maanle baha abɔ nu aho atia bɛ, wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛdua bɛ ɛtane dɔɔnwo ne mɔ anwo kakɛ la.
11“Ɛnee Yifelaem le kɛ ɛnlankɛ belɛ mɔɔ bɛtete ye, mɔɔ hulole kɛ ɔkɛwozo ma la. Noko mebava gyɛnvayile meagyɛnva ɔ kɔme kɛnlɛma ne meamaa yeayɛ gyima ɛsesebɛ. Ɔwɔ kɛ Dwuda funduvundu azɛlɛ ne yɛɛ ɔwɔ kɛ Yizilayɛ siezie azɛlɛ ne maa ɔ nwo. 12 Menganle kɛ, ‘Bɛlua tenleneyɛlɛ ma na bɛabu ɛhulolɛ kpundii. Bɛzo azɛlɛ ne mɔɔ la mgbane la, ɔluakɛ mekɛ ɛdwu mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ bɛkpondɛ medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma me bo zo a, amaa meara na mearawola ngoanelielɛ meagua bɛ nwo zo.’ 13Bɛlua amumuyɛ, bɛbu nzisi, bɛli adalɛ ma.
“Kɛmɔ bɛva bɛ rɛle bɛwula bɛ konle ehwili ne mɔ nee bɛ ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo ne mɔ anu la, 14konle bava bɛ menli ne aze na bɛbabubu bɛ aranemgbole ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti. Ɔbayɛ kɛ mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Hyaleman zɛkyele suakpole Bɛtabɛle la. Wɔ konle ne anu, bɛvale mrɛladane mraalɛ nee bɛ mra bɛfifinle debie bɛhunle bɛ. 15Bɛmɛ Bɛtɛlema, bɛ amumuyɛ ne ati, debie mɔɔ bɛbava bɛayɛ bɛ la ɛne. Konle ne anu bɛbahu Yizilayɛ belemgbunli ne.”

english_text:
God's Love for His People
1 When Israel was a child,
I loved him, and I called
my son out of Egypt.
2But as the saying goes,
“The more they were called,
the more they rebelled.”
They never stopped offering
incense and sacrifices
to the idols of Baal.
3I took Israel by the arm
and taught them to walk.
But they would not admit
that I was the one
who had healed them.
4I led them with kindness
and with love,
not with ropes.
I held them close to me;
I bent down to feed them.
5But they rejected me,
and so must return to Egypt;
now Assyria will rule them.
6War will visit their cities,
and their plans will fail.
7My people are determined
to reject me for a god
they think is stronger,
but he can't help.
8 Israel, I can't let you go.
I can't give you up.
How could I possibly destroy you
as I did the towns of Admah
and Zeboiim?
I just can't do it.
My feelings for you
are much too strong.
9Israel, I won't lose my temper
and destroy you again.
I am the Holy God—
not merely some human,
and I won't stay angry.
10I, the Lord, will roar like a lion,
and my children will return,
trembling from the west.
11They will come back,
fluttering like birds from Egypt
or like doves from Assyria.
Then I will bring them
back to their homes.
I, the Lord, have spoken!
Israel and Judah Compared
12Israel is deceitful to me,
their loyal and holy God;
they surround me with lies,
and Judah worships
other gods.
translation_text:
Nyamenle ɛhulolɛ mɔɔ wɔ ye menli mɔɔ ɛde atua la anwo la
1 Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Mɔɔ Yizilayɛ le kakula la, mengulole ye,
na menvɛlɛle me ra nrenya ne menvile Yigyibiti.
2Na fane dɔɔnwo mɔɔ menvɛlɛle ye la,
fane dɔɔnwo ɔhwenle ɔ nwo ɔvile me nwo.
Me menli ne bɔle azu manle awozonle Beeyale ne mɔ
na bɛkpunle ɛyɛlɛ bɛmanle mmonle.
3Noko medame yɛɛ mengilele Yifelaemma ɛdialɛ a;
mendedɛle bɛ me sa zo,
noko bɛnze kɛ medame a meneanle bɛ a.
4Menvale ahunlunyeleyɛlɛ nee ɛhulolɛ menlile bɛ ti,
menyele bɛ kɔme kpomgbolo,
na membutule memanle bɛ aleɛ.
5“Bɛkpole kɛ bɛnrɛzia bɛnrɛra me nwo bieko, yemɔti bɛbazia bɛahɔ Yigyibiti, na Aselea bazie bɛ. 6Konle bava bɛ azuamgbole ne mɔ aze, abubu bɛ azuamgbole nlenkɛ mgbole ne mɔ. 7Me menli ne gyi zolɛ ɛsesebɛ kɛ bɛte bɛ nwo bɛavi me nwo. Yemɔti bɛva kpomgbolo bɛgua bɛ kɔme, na bɛnrɛnyia awie ɛnrɛye ɛnrɛmaa bɛ.
8 “O Yifelaem, kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meye wɔ memaa ɛ?
O Yizilayɛ, kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meye wɔ memaa ɛ?
Asoo ɔwɔ kɛ mesɛkye wɔ kɛ menzɛkyele Adema la?
Kɛ ɔyɛ mɔɔ ɔwɔ kɛ meyɛ wɔ kɛ menyɛle Zɛboyem la ɛ?
Me ahonle ɛndie me!
Me kunlu yelɛyela me kpole wɔ ɛ nwo.
9Menrɛva me ɛya kpole ne menrɛgua ɛ nwo zo,
menrɛzɛkye Yifelaem,
ɔluakɛ mele Nyamenle, menle sonla.
Medame a mele Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne mɔɔ nee wɔ de la,
menrɛra kɛ mebazɛkye wɔ.
10“Saa metea me menli ne kpɔvolɛma ne mɔ nu kɛ awenade a, me menli ne akee badoa me bo zo. Saa metea nu a bɛbava anwowozolɛ bɛvi adɔleɛ bɛara. 11Bɛvi Yigyibiti bɛbava anwowozolɛ bɛara ndɛndɛ kɛ nloma la, yɛɛ bɛvi Aselea bɛbara kɛ abubule. Mebava bɛ meazia meahɔ bɛ azua nu. Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mese a.”
Bɛbu Yizilayɛ nee Dwuda ewule fɔlɛ
12Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Yifelaem ɛva adalɛ ngome ɛbɔ ɛyia me, yɛɛ Yizilayɛma noko le mɛlɛbɛla. Na Dwuda ɛdeɛ, Nyamenle ze ye, yɛɛ ɔdi nɔhalɛ ɔmaa Nwuanzanwuanza Ko ne.

english_text:
1All day long Israel chases
wind from the desert;
deceit and violence
are found everywhere.
Treaties are made with Assyria;
olive oil is taken to Egypt.
Israel and Judah Condemned
2The Lord also brings charges
against the people of Judah,
the descendants of Jacob.
He will punish them
for what they have done.
3 Even before Jacob was born,
he cheated his brother,
and when he grew up,
he fought against God.
4 At Bethel, Jacob wrestled
with an angel and won;
then with tears in his eyes,
he asked for a blessing,
and God spoke to us there.
5God's name is the Lord,
the Lord God All-Powerful.
6So return to your God.
Patiently trust him,
and show love and justice.
7Israel, you enjoy cheating
and taking advantage
of others.
8You say to yourself, “I'm rich!
I earned it all on my own,
without committing a sin.”
The Lord Is Still the God of Israel
9 Israel, I, the Lord,
am still your God,
just as I have been
since the time
you were in Egypt.
Now I will force you
to live in tents once again,
as you did in the desert.
10I spoke to the prophets—
often I spoke in visions.
And so, I will send my prophets
with messages of doom.
11Gilead is terribly sinful
and will end up ruined.
Bulls are sacrificed in Gilgal
on altars made of stones,
but those stones will be scattered
in every field.
12 Jacob escaped to Syria
where he tended sheep
to earn himself a wife.
13 I sent the prophet Moses
to lead Israel from Egypt
and to keep them safe.
14Israel, I will make you pay
for your violent crimes
and for insulting me.
translation_text:
1“Debie biala mɔɔ Yifelaem yɛ, ɔvi nwonlomɔ mɔɔ kɔdwu nɔsolɛ la le mgbane na ɔsɛkye ninyɛne. Bɛbɔ adalɛ mɔnwo na bɛka konle. Bɛ nee Aselea yɛ ngyehyɛlɛ na bɛfa nwole bɛkɔ Yigyibiti.”
2Ɛdɛnkɛma lɛ edwɛkɛ tia Dwuda; ɔbadea Gyekɔbo abo zo amra ne mɔ wɔ bɛ nyɛleɛ ne mɔ anwo. Ɔbadua bɛ kakɛ wɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo. 3 Bɛ nlenya Gyekɔbo nee ɔ diema Yisɔ pelele wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ bɛ nli akunlu la; na Gyekɔbo zɔle ɔ diema ne agyakɛ wɔ bɛ awolɛ nu; mɔɔ Gyekɔbo nyinle la, ɔ nee Nyamenle pelele. 4 Ɔ nee Nyamenle soanvolɛ ne pelele na ɔlile konim. Ɔzunle na ɔbizale ye nyilalɛ. Ɔyiale Nyamenle wɔ Bɛtɛle na ɛkɛ ne, Nyamenle nee ye dendɛle. 5Ɛhye a le Tumivolɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma Nyamenle ne, ye duma a le Ɛdɛnkɛma. 6Yemɔti, Gyekɔbo abo zo amra, bɛ Nyamenle ne moalɛ ti, bɛzia bɛrɛla na bɛzɔ ɛhulolɛ nee pɛlepɛlelilɛ nu kpundii na bɛhendɛ bɛ Nyamenle ne dahuu.
Ndɛnebualɛ nwo edwɛkɛ bieko
7Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Gualilɛnli mɔɔ lɛ tone ɛtane ɔ sa nu la kulo kɛ ɔdi ye ɛdɔvolɛma nzisi. 8Yifelaemma ɛha kɛ: Aa, yɛnyia yɛ nwo; yɛdu ahu! Noko bɛ anyiabɛnwo ne ɛnrɛhola ɛtane ne mɔ mɔɔ bɛyɛ la anwo kakɛ tua ɛlɛ. 9 Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ menyele bɛ menvile Yigyibiti la, mebamaa bɛadɛnlɛdɛnla ndanlɛ azua nu bieko, kɛmɔ ɛvoyialilɛ ne dwu zo a bɛyɛ la.
10“Mendendɛle mengilele me kpɔmanvolɛma ne mɔ, na memanle bɛnwunle ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ dɔɔnwo, na menluale me kpɔmanvolɛma ne anwo zo membule bɛ ɛrɛlɛ. 11Saa ninyɛndane bie tɛbɔ Geleade a, zolɛ ɛnrɛra nvasoɛ biala. Saa bɛfa nlankɛ nyinli bɛbɔ azu wɔ Gelegale a, azukponle ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ ɛkɛ la bayɛ awolɛ edukue wɔ ɛya nu kofie ne mɔ avinli.”
12 Yɛ nlenya Gyekɔbo nriandile hɔle Mɛsɔpɔteemea, na ɔyɛle gyima, na raalɛ ti ɔnleanle mboane ɔvale ɔgyale raalɛ. 13 Ɛdɛnkɛma zoanle Nyamenle kpɔmanvolɛ manle ɔhɔyele Yizilayɛma ɔvile Yigyibiti na ɔnleanle bɛ gyɛlɛɛnye. 14Yifelaemma ɛmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛva ɛya kpole kpalɛ, yemɔti Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa bɛ munzule ɛbɛla ne abɔ bɛ ti. Ɛdɛnkɛma bamaa anyiemgba mɔɔ bɛbɔ ye la abu azia bɛ.

english_text:
Israel Is Doomed
The Lord said:
1When your leaders spoke,
everyone in Israel trembled
and showed great respect.
But you sinned by worshiping Baal,
and you were destroyed.
2Now you continue to sin
by designing and making
idols of silver
in the shape of calves.
You are told to sacrifice
to these idols—
yes, even to kiss them.
3And so, all of you will vanish
like the mist or the dew
of early morning,
or husks of grain in the wind
or smoke from a chimney.
4I, the Lord, have been your God
since the time
you were in Egypt.
I am the only God you know,
the only one who can save.
5 I took care of you
in a thirsty desert.
6I fed you till you were satisfied,
then you became proud
and forgot about me.
7Now I will attack like a lion,
ambush you like a leopard,
8and rip you apart like a bear
robbed of her cubs.
I will gnaw on your bones,
as though I were a lion
or some other wild animal.
9Israel, you are done for.
Don't expect help from me.
10 You wanted a king and rulers.
Where is your king now?
What cities have rulers?
11 In my anger, I gave you a king;
in my fury, I took him away.
Israel's Terrible Fate
The Lord said:
12Israel, your terrible sins
are written down
and stored away.
13You are like a senseless child
who refuses to be born
at the proper time.
14 Should I, the Lord, rescue you
from death and the grave?
No! I call death and the grave
to strike you like a plague.
I refuse to show mercy.
15No matter if you prosper
more than the other tribes,
I, the Lord, will wipe you out,
just as a scorching desert wind
dries up streams of water.
I will take away
your precious treasures.
16Samaria will be punished
for turning against me.
It will be destroyed in war—
children will be beaten
against rocks,
and pregnant women
will be ripped open.
translation_text:
Yizilayɛ ndɛnebualɛ mɔɔ li amozi
1Dɛba ne, saa Yifelaem tendɛ a, menli nwo wozo bɛ; bɛkpogyale ye zo wɔ Yizilayɛma avinli; na ɔluale bozonle Beeyale anwo zo ɔyɛle ɛtane na ɔwule. 2Kɛkala bɛtɛkɔ zolɛ bɛtɛyɛ ɛtane; bɛfa dwɛtɛ fufule bɛgua mmonle ananze mɔɔ dwinvolɛma a ɛyɛ la, na bɛse kɛ, “Bɛbɔ azu bɛmaa bɛ.” Menli ala, bɛdabɛ bɛfo nlankɛ ananze nloa anwo! 3Yemɔti menli ɛhye mɔ abo zo baminli kɛ nwonlomɔ nzulemungu anzɛɛ ɛbɔlɛ la. Bɛbayɛ kɛ abonle mɔɔ anwoma ɛlɛbɔ ye avi ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka, anzɛɛ esike mɔɔ lua nvɛnzɛlɛ nu la.
4Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Medame a mele Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ yele bɛ vile Yigyibiti la. Bɛnlɛ Nyamenle biala kɛ medame ala. Bɛye me a bɛnlɛ dievolɛ biala. 5 Medame a meneanle bɛ wɔ fienemgbole ne mɔɔ nzule biala ɛnle nu la anu a. 6Na mɔɔ bɛdwule azɛlɛ kpalɛ ne azo na bɛlile bɛ ko yile la, bɛ mgbanyizonle yɛle kpole na bɛ rɛle vile me. 7Yemɔti mebayɛ bɛ kɔme nu kɛ awenade. Mebahakyi ɛrane meazia bɛ adenle nu. 8Mebateta bɛ kɛ bedi mɔɔ bɛhye ɔ mra, na meatete bɛ nu, na ɛkɛ ne, mebali bɛ kɛ awenade di nane, na meatete bɛ nzokanzoka kɛ nanemgbole tete nane la.
9“Yizilayɛma, mebazɛkye bɛ! Na nwane a kɛhola kɛboa bɛ a? 10 Bɛbizale bɛliele belemgbunli nee mgbanyima. Bɛ belemgbunli ne mɔɔ balie bɛ la wɔ nienwu? 11 Menvale ɛya yɛɛ menvale arelemgbunli ne mɔ memanle bɛ a, yɛɛ meva ɛya meye bɛ ɛkɛ.
12“Bɛbɔ Yifelaem ninyɛndane ne mɔ kpɔkɛ, bɛva ye ɛtane ne mɔ bɛzie ɛkɛ. 13Ɔmaa ɔ nli te awolɛ ne nyane, na ɔle koasea la ati, ɔmba. Ɔle kakula mɔɔ ye awolɛ mekɛ dwu a ɔnva ɔ ti ɔndua awodeɛ ne anloa a. 14 Memkpɔne bɛ menvi Ɛbolɔ tumi bo ɔ? Menlie bɛ menvi Ewule asa anu ɔ? O Ewule, wɔ bɔlɔ ne wɔ nienwu? O Ɛbolɔ, wɔ ɛzɛkyelɛ tumi ne wɔ nienwu? Anwunvɔnezelɛ ɛnle me nye zo bieko. 15Yifelaem banyi bokoboko kɛ baka ndɔ, noko mebamaa medame Ɛdɛnkɛma, me aduduleɛ anwoma wuluwulu ne adwazo ɛsɛlɛ ne azo abɔ asesa bɛ azɛlɛ bo nzule nee bɛ bula ne mɔ; ɔbaminli debie biala mɔɔ sonle bolɛ wɔ ye gya nu la abo zo. 16Mebadua Samɛlea kakɛ kɛ yede me nwo atua a. Ye menli ne bawu konle nu; bɛbava bɛ nlɔma ne mɔ bɛafifi debie bɛatete bɛ, na bɛatulutulu nrenzɛvolɛma ako.”

english_text:
Turn Back to the Lord
1Israel, return! Come back
to the Lord, your God.
Sin has made you fall.
2Return to the Lord and say,
“Please forgive our sins.
Accept our good sacrifices
of praise instead of bulls.
3Assyria can't save us,
and chariots can't help.
So we will no longer worship
the idols we have made.
Our Lord, you show mercy
to orphans.”
The Lord Promises To Forgive
4Israel, you have rejected me,
but my anger is gone;
I will heal you and love you
without limit.
5I will be like the dew—
then you will blossom like lilies
and have roots like a tree.
6Your branches will spread
with the beauty
of an olive tree
and with the aroma
of Lebanon Forest.
7You will rest in my shade,
and your grain will grow.
You will blossom
like a vineyard
and be famous as the wine
from Lebanon.
8Israel, give up your idols!
I will answer your prayers
and take care of you.
I am that glorious tree,
the source of your fruit.
9If you are wise, you will know
and understand what I mean.
I am the Lord, and I lead you
along the right path.
If you obey me,
we will walk together,
but if you are wicked,
you will stumble.
translation_text:
Hozia bodo Yizilayɛma
1Yizilayɛma, bɛzia bɛrɛla Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ, ɔluakɛ bɛ ninyɛndane ɛmaa bɛdu koti. 2Bɛzia bɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛkɛ na bɛva nzɛlɛlɛ ɛhye bɛdo ɔ nyunlu: “Fa yɛ ɛtane kɔsɔɔti kyɛ yɛ; die mɔɔ le kpalɛ la, na yɛbaye wɔ ayɛlɛ. 3Aselea ɛnrɛhola yɛ die, yɛɛ yɛnrɛvo konle mgbɔnwɔ zo bieko. Yɛnrɛha yɛnrɛhile yɛ mmonle ne mɔ mɔɔ yɛdayɛ yɛyɛ la bieko kɛ bɛle ‘Yɛ Nyamenle.’ O Ɛdɛnkɛma, ɛse nrisa anwunvɔne.”
Ɛdɛnkɛma bɔ Yizilayɛma ɛbɛla fofolɛ nwo ɛwɔkɛ
4Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Mebava me menli ne mɔɔ ɛnli nɔhalɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ meahyɛ bɛ.
Mebava me ahonle muala meahulo bɛ,
ɔluakɛ meye me ɛya ne bɛ nwo zo.
5Mebayɛ kɛ ɛbɔlɛ meadɔ meagua Yizilayɛma anwo zo.
Bɛbanyi bokoboko kɛ aloa,
bɛbasosɔ ndinli kɛ Lɛbanɔn mbaka.
6Bɛ ngane badɛlɛdɛlɛ,
bɛbayɛ ngɛnlɛma kɛ ɔlivi mbaka,
na bɛabɔ evuanlɛ kɛ Lɛbanɔn sida mbaka.
7Bɛbazia bɛaradɛnla me alubo ne anu.
Bɛbakpazi kɛ tola nu aleɛ;
bɛbabua kɛ vanye mbaka,
na bɛ evuanlɛ bayɛ kɛ Lɛbanɔn nwanye evuanlɛ la.
8O Yifelaem, duzu a me nee mmonle lɛ yɛ a?
Medame a mebua bɛ nzɛlɛlɛ nwo, menea bɛ nwo zo a.
Mele kɛ sepelɛse baka dokodoko,
medame a memaa bɛso ma a.”
Adwulaleɛ
9Bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ la, bɛde edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔ abo; bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛ deɛnwunlɛ la, bɛnwu ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ. Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ndenle ne mɔ le fɔɔnwo, tenlenema fa bɔ bɛ ɛbɛla, yɛɛ ɛtanevolɛma tu nwolɛ koti.

english_text:
1I am Joel the son of Pethuel.
And this is the message
the Lord gave to me.
Locusts Cover the Land
2Listen, you leaders
and everyone else
in the land.
Has anything like this
ever happened before?
3Tell our children!
Let it be told
to our grandchildren
and their children too.
4Swarm after swarm of locusts
has attacked our crops,
eating everything in sight.
5Sober up, you drunkards!
Cry long and loud;
your wine supply is gone.
6 A powerful nation
with countless troops
has invaded our land.
They have the teeth and jaws
of powerful lions.
7Our grapevines and fig trees
are stripped bare;
only naked branches remain.
8Grieve like a young woman
mourning for the man
she was to marry.
9Offerings of grain and wine
are no longer brought
to the Lord's temple.
His servants, the priests,
are deep in sorrow.
10Barren fields mourn;
grain, grapes, and olives
are scorched and shriveled.
11Mourn for our farms
and our vineyards!
There's no wheat or barley
growing in our fields.
12Grapevines have dried up
and so has every tree—
figs and pomegranates,
date palms and apples.
All happiness has faded away.
Return to God
13Mourn, you priests who serve
at the altar of my God.
Spend your days and nights
wearing sackcloth.
Offerings of grain and wine
are no longer brought
to the Lord's temple.
14Tell the leaders and people
to come together
at the temple.
Order them to go without eating
and to pray sincerely.
15 We are in for trouble!
Soon the Lord All-Powerful
will bring disaster.
16Our food is already gone;
there's no more celebrating
at the temple of our God.
17Seeds dry up in the ground;
no harvest is possible.
Our barns are in bad shape,
with no grain
to store in them.
18Our cattle wander aimlessly,
moaning for lack of pasture,
and sheep are suffering.
19I cry out to you, Lord.
Grasslands and forests are eaten
by the scorching heat.
20Wild animals have no water
because of you;
rivers and streams are dry,
and pastures are parched.
translation_text:
1Nrɛlaleɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma vale manle Pɛtuwɛle ara nrenya Dwowɛle la ɛne.
Menli ne di nyane wɔ bɛ bɛyɔba ɛzɛkyelɛ nwo
2Bɛdie, bɛmɛ mgbanyinli;
bɛyɛ ɛnzonlɛ, bɛmɛ mɔɔ bɛwɔ azɛlɛ ne azo.
Edwɛkɛ ɛhye, asoo bie ɛzi bɛ mekɛ zo,
anzɛɛ bɛ ze mɔ mekɛ zo ɛlɛ?
3Bɛha bɛhile bɛ mra,
na bɛ mra noko ɛha ɛhile bɛ mra,
na bɛdabɛ noko bɛha bɛhile awolɛndoazo mɔɔ bara la.
4Mɔɔ abɛbɛ mɔɔ pɛ la pɛle na mɔɔ hale la,
abɛbɛ tɔka ralile.
Mɔɔ abɛbɛ tɔka ne gyakyile la,
abɛbɛ bɛnyebɛnye ne mɔ ralile,
yɛɛ mɔɔ abɛbɛ bɛnyebɛnye ne mɔ gyakyile la,
abɛbɛ sɛkyevolɛma ralile.
5Bɛdwazo na bɛzu, bɛmɛ nzabovoma;
nwanye ne fɛlɛko ti,
bɛmɛ nwanyenovoma, bɛzu bɛye awolɛ,
ɔluakɛ bɛye bɛvi bɛ nloa.
6 Ɔluakɛ abɛbɛ ɛlɔne ɛteta azɛlɛ ye;
bɛ nwo yɛ se yɛɛ bɛ nwo zonle kpalɛ
mɔɔ bɛtia bɛ a ɔnyɛ boɛ a;
bɛ gye nlane le kɛ awenade gye,
yɛɛ bɛ gye ndendenle le kɛ awenade belɛ gye.
7Bɛzɛkye yɛ vanye mbaka ne mɔ,
na bɛli yɛ feege mbaka ne mɔ.
Bɛli, bɛkeka mbaka ne anwo abonle ne mɔ bɛgua;
bɛmaa ngane ne mɔ anwo ɛyɛ nwohyee.
8Bɛzu kɛ belamunli raalɛ mɔɔ ɛheda ɛrele
ɛlɛsu nrenya mɔɔ gyale ye ye mbɛlɛra nu la.
9Ma azubɔdeɛ nee nza azubɔdeɛ
ɛwie Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.
Sɛlɛvolɛma, Ɛdɛnkɛma sonvolɛma ne su di nyane,
(ɔboalekɛ bɛnnyia azubɔdeɛ bɛmmaa Ɛdɛnkɛma).
10Ɛya avule ne mɔ ɛdɔ mgbane;
ma ne mɔ ɛzɛkye,
ɔboalekɛ azɛlɛ ne ɛhete;
vanye ma ne mɔ ɛnwoso,
yɛɛ ɔlivi mbaka ne mɔ ɛwu.
11Bɛmɛ ɛyazonlɛma, bɛli nyane;
bɛzu, bɛmɛ vanye egyinli zo neavolɛma,
ɔboalekɛ hwiiti ne, baale ne,
ɛya ne mɔ anu bɛyɔba ne mɔ ɛzɛkye.
12Vanye mbaka ne mɔ ɛwu,
feege mbaka ne mɔ ɛdwɔlɔdwɔlɔ.
Ma mɔɔ le kɛ akutue, mrɛlɛ nee ampolo,
ɛbɔ nu mbaka kɔsɔɔti ɛwie wu.
Menli anyelielɛ ɛwie.
13O sɛlɛvolɛma, bɛheda ɛrele na bɛzu,
sonvolɛma mɔɔ sonle azukponle ne anwo, bɛzu.
Bɛhɔ Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu, bɛheda ɛrele nɔe ne kɔsɔɔti,
O me Nyamenle ne sonvolɛma!
Ɔboalekɛ ma azubɔdeɛ nee nza azubɔdeɛ
ɛwie bɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu.
14Bɛmaa menli ne ɛhye ɛhɔne;
bɛvɛlɛ Nyamenlezonlenlɛ ayia.
Bɛboɔboa mgbanyima ne mɔ
nee menli kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la anloa
wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu
na bɛzu bɛvɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma.
15 Ɔbayɛ ɛzulolɛ kpole wɔ kenle ne!
Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛbikye,
ɔle kenle mɔɔ Tumivolɛ ne bava azɛkye ninyɛne a.
16Bɛlɛsɛkye yɛ aleɛ ne mɔ,
noko yɛ nye gyi nwolɛ mgbane.
Anyelielɛ ɛnle yɛ Nyamenle ne Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anu ko.
17Ma ne mɔ nwoso kofie ne mɔ anu,
ninyɛne ɛzielɛ ɛleka ne mɔ ɛdɔ mgbane;
ma ɛzielɛleka ne mɔ ɛzɛkye,
ɔboalekɛ aleɛ anyɛ kpalɛ.
18Nanemgbole ɛlɛkponle!
Nlankɛ adwenle ɛha ɛbɔ nu,
ɔboalekɛ bɛnlɛ adidileka;
mboane bɔbɔ ɛlɛnwu amaneɛ.
19Mesu mefɛlɛ wɔ, O Ɛdɛnkɛma.
Ɔluakɛ senle ɛyela fienemgbole nu adidileka ne mɔ,
yɛɛ sendɔlɔra ɛyela kpɔkɛ nu mbaka kɔsɔɔti.
20Nanemgbole bɔbɔ su fɛlɛ wɔ,
ɔboalekɛ azudenle kɔsɔɔti ɛsesa,
yɛɛ senle ɛyela fienemgbole nu adidileka ne mɔ.

english_text:
Locusts and an Enemy Army
1Sound the trumpet on Zion,
the Lord's sacred hill.
Warn everyone to tremble!
The judgment day of the Lord
is coming soon.
2It will be dark and gloomy
with storm clouds overhead.
Troops will cover the mountains
like thunderclouds.
No army this powerful
has ever been gathered before
or will be gathered again.
3Fiery flames surround them;
no one escapes.
Before they invaded,
the land was like Eden;
now only a desert remains.
4 They look like horses
and charge like cavalry.
5They roar over mountains
like noisy chariots,
or a mighty army
ready for battle.
They are a forest fire
that feasts on straw.
6The very sight of them
is frightening.
7They climb over walls
like warriors;
they march in columns
and never turn aside.
8They charge straight ahead,
without pushing each other;
even arrows and spears
cannot make them retreat.
9They swarm over city walls
and enter our homes;
they crawl in through windows,
just like thieves.
10 They make the earth tremble
and the heavens shake;
the sun and moon turn dark,
and stars stop shining.
11 The Lord God leads this army
of countless troops,
and they obey his commands.
The day of his judgment
is so terrible
that no one can stand it.
The Lord's Invitation
12The Lord said:
It isn't too late.
You can still return to me
with all your heart.
Start crying and mourning!
Go without eating.
13Don't rip your clothes
to show your sorrow.
Instead, turn back to me
with broken hearts.
I am merciful, kind, and caring.
I don't easily lose my temper,
and I don't like to punish.
14I am the Lord your God.
Perhaps I will change my mind
and treat you with mercy.
Then you will be blessed
with enough grain and wine
for offering sacrifices to me.
15Sound the trumpet on Zion!
Call the people together.
Show your sorrow
by going without food.
16 Make sure that everyone
is fit to worship me.
Bring adults, children, babies,
and even bring newlyweds
from their festivities.
17 Tell my servants, the priests,
to cry inside the temple
and to offer this prayer
near the altar:
“Save your people, Lord God!
Don't let foreign nations
make jokes about us.
Don't let them laugh and ask,
‘Where is your God?’ ”
The Lord Will Bless the Land
18The Lord was deeply concerned
about his land
and had pity on his people.
19In answer to their prayers
he said,
“I will give you enough grain,
wine, and olive oil
to satisfy your needs.
No longer will I let you
be insulted by the nations.
20An army attacked from the north,
but I will chase it
into a scorching desert.
There it will rot and stink
from the Dead Sea
to the Mediterranean.”
The Lord works wonders
21and does great things.
So tell the soil to celebrate
22and wild animals
to stop being afraid.
Grasslands are green again;
fruit trees and fig trees
are loaded with fruit.
Grapevines are covered
with grapes.
23People of Zion,
celebrate in honor
of the Lord your God!
He is generous and has sent
the autumn and spring rains
in the proper seasons.
24Grain will cover
your threshing places;
jars will overflow
with wine and olive oil.
The Lord Will Rescue His People
25I, the Lord your God,
will make up for the losses
caused by those swarms
and swarms of locusts
I sent to attack you.
26My people, you will eat
until you are satisfied.
Then you will praise me
for the wonderful things
I have done.
Never again will you
be put to shame.
27Israel, you will know
that I stand at your side.
I am the Lord your God—
there are no other gods.
Never again will you
be put to shame.
The Lord Will Work Wonders
The Lord said:
28 Later, I will give my Spirit
to everyone.
Your sons and daughters
will prophesy.
Your old men
will have dreams,
and your young men
will see visions.
29In those days I will even give
my Spirit to my servants,
both men and women.
30I will work wonders
in the sky above
and on the earth below.
There will be blood and fire
and clouds of smoke.
31 The sun will turn dark,
and the moon
will be as red as blood
before that great
and terrible day
when I appear.
32 Then I, the Lord will save everyone who faithfully worships me. I have promised there will be survivors on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem, and among them will be my chosen ones.
translation_text:
Abɛbɛ ne mɔ le Ɛdɛnkɛma Kenle ne kɔkɔbɔlɛ
1Bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu wɔ Zayɔn;
bɛbɔ bubu wɔ me boka nwuanzanwuanza ne azo!
Bɛmaa menli mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la kɔsɔɔti anwo ɛwozo bɛ,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne ɛlɛba, yedwu bɔbɔ asɛɛ.
2Ɔbayɛ awozinli nee alɔbɔlɛ kenle,
amungu nee awozinli kabii kenle.
Abɛbɛ ɛlɔne ɛyɛ kɛ menli anwo ɛzulolɛ,
ɛheda awoka ne mɔ azo kɛ awozinli.
Ɛhye, ɔvi tete, bie ɛtɛsile ɛlɛ,
yɛɛ bieko ɛnrɛzi ɛlɛ
wɔ awolɛndoazo kɔsɔɔti mɔɔ bara la anu.
3Senle sɛkye ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nyunlu,
yɛɛ sendɔlɔra yela ninyɛne mɔɔ wɔ bɛ nzi la.
Azɛlɛ ne le kɛ Yidɛn Tola wɔ bɛ nyunlu,
bɛpɛ nu a bɛ nzi yɛ ɛsɛlɛ mɔɔ ɛdɔ mgbane a,
yɛɛ debie biala ɛnvi bɛ sa.
4 Ɛnwu bɛ a bɛle kɛ mgbɔnwɔ,
yɛɛ bɛnriandi kɛ konle mgbɔnwɔ.
5Saa bɛlɛwuluwulu awoka ne mɔ azo a,
bɛ nwo alɛra le kɛ konle ehwili;
bɛ nwo tetɛ kɛ senle la ndile welera nu.
Bɛsolo bɛ kɛ ɛlɔne kpole bie mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ konle la.
6Saa bɛye bɛ ti a, bɛ nwo ɛzulolɛ tɔ awie biala anwo zo;
awie biala anyunlu to.
7Bɛteta kɛ ɛlɔnema;
bɛfo bane kɛ ɛlɔnema.
Bɛ muala bɛkɔ bɛ nyunlu fɔɔnwo.
Bɛndɔ bɛngɔ fema zo yɛɛ bɛndɔ bɛngɔ bɛne zo.
8Bɛnzuhuzuhu bɛ nwo,
biala dua ye adenle ɛdeɛ ne anu.
Bɛbɔ bɛfa adendualɛ biala anu,
yɛɛ debie biala ɛngola ɛnzi bɛ aze.
9Bɛtu twi bɛkɔ suakpole ne azo;
bɛduolua bane ne mɔ anwo;
bɛfo bɛkɔ azua ne mɔ anu,
bɛdua nvɛnzɛlɛ ne mɔ anu kɛ nwule.
10Saa bɛlɛba a azɛlɛ kpusu,
anwumaneamra anwo wozo bɛ.
Sɛnzɛne ne nee siane ne du,
na nwɔlɔra gyakyi ɛdalɛ.
11Ɛdɛnkɛma tendɛ ɛsesebɛ zo
kile ye ɛlɔne ne.
Ɔluakɛ ye ɛlɔne ne le kpole;
mɔɔ di ye mɛla zo la anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ.
Ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle ne le kpole, ɔyɛ ɛzulolɛ.
Nwane a kɛhola gyinla a?
Bɛnlu bɛ nwo
12Ɛdɛnkɛma se, “Kɛkala bɔbɔ,
awie biala ɛva ɛhɔnehyelɛ, ɛzunlɛ nee nyanelilɛ,
yɛɛ ye ahonle kɔsɔɔti ɛzia ɛrɛla me nwo ɛke.
13Bɛtete bɛ ahonle nu na tɛ bɛ adɛladeɛ nu ɔ.”
Bɛzia bɛhɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ɛkɛ,
ɔluakɛ ɔle dovolɛ nee anwunvɔnezelɛnli;
ɔnva ɛya mgbane mgbane, ye ɛhulolɛ kpundii ne le kpole,
yɛɛ dahuu ɔfa ɛtane ɔkyɛ.
14Wɔannea Ɛdɛnkɛma bahakyi ye adwenle,
yeagyakyi bɛ nyilalɛ dɔɔnwo wɔ ɛhye anzi,
amaa bɛava ma nee nza azubɔdeɛ
bɛamaa Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne.
15Bɛwu aweɛne tendenle ne anu wɔ Zayɔn;
bɛmaa menli ne ɛhye ɛhɔne;
bɛvɛlɛ Nyamenlezonlenlɛ ayia.
16Bɛboɔboa menli ne anloa.
Bɛnlua menli mɔɔ ɛyia ɛlɛsonle la;
bɛboɔboa mgbanyima ne mɔ anloa;
bɛboɔboa ngakula ne mɔ anloa,
bɛboɔboa nlɔma mɔɔ la nyɛfonlɛ nloa la anloa.
Bɛmaa atɔfolɛ nrenya ne vi ye ekpumgbunli ne anu evinde,
na atɔfolɛ raalɛ ne vi ye suakunlu ɛvinde.
17Bɛmaa sɛlɛvolɛma mɔɔ ɛlɛsonle Nyamenle
wɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma Ɛzonlenlɛ Sua ne anuhɔlɛ ne nee azukponle ne avinli la ɛzu ɛzɛlɛ kɛ,
“O Ɛdɛnkɛma, nwu wɔ menli ne anwunvɔne.
Mmamaa maanle maanle ne mɔ
kpo yɛ, bɛsi yɛ amgbu bɛka kɛ,
‘Bɛ Nyamenle ne wɔ nienwu?’ ”
Nyamenle maa azɛlɛ ne ahye aleɛ bieko
18Akee Ɛdɛnkɛma hwenle ye azɛlɛ ne anwo nungule,
na ɔnwunle ye menli ne anwunvɔne.
19Ɛdɛnkɛma buale ye menli ne kɛ,
“Bɛnlea, melɛbɛlɛ bɛ ma, nwanye, nee nwole,
na bɛ nwo badɔ bɛ;
menrɛmaa maanle maanle ɛnrɛgolo bɛ nwo bieko.
20Mebavoa abɛbɛ ɛlɔne ne mɔɔ vi sɔlɔ rale la,
mebavoa bie mɔ meahɔgua ɛsɛlɛ ne azo lɔ.
Mebavoa bɛ ɛlɔne ne mɔɔ lumua la
meahɔgua Nyevile Wulera ne anu,
na meavoa mɔɔ li bɛ nzi la
meahɔgua Mɛdetɛlenia Nyevile ne anu.
Bɛ avunli ne mɔ babɔ,
ɔluakɛ ninyɛndane mɔɔ bɛyɛ la le kpole.
21“O azɛlɛ, mmasulo;
di fɛlɛko na maa ɛ nye ɛlie,
ɔluakɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛyɛ ninyɛne mgbole!
22Bɛmmasulo, bɛmɛ ɛbɔ nu nanemgbole,
ɔluakɛ fienemgbole nu adidileka ne mɔ ɛbua;
mbaka ne mɔ so ma,
feege baka nee vanye ɛzo dɔɔnwo.
23“Bɛli fɛlɛko, O Zayɔnoma,
na bɛmaa bɛ nye ɛlie Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne anwo,
ɔluakɛ yemaa ezule ɛdɔ ndɛ ɛbua bɛ benle,
yemaa ezule ɛdɔ, nzule ɛbu bɛ nwo zo,
alumua nee amozi ezule ɛdɔ kɛ dɛba ne ala la.
24Ma bayi ma ɛwozolɛ ɛleka ne mɔ,
nwanye nee nwole bayi angola mgbole ne mɔ.
25Ɛvolɛ dodo ma mɔɔ abɛbɛ ne mɔ lile la
mebava ɔ muala meamaa bɛ.
Abɛbɛ bɛnyebɛnye, sɛkyera nee
mɔɔ pɛ ma ne mɔ la, ɛlɔne kpole ne,
medame a menzoanle ɛlɔne ɛhye bɛ nwo zo a.
26Bɛbanyia aleɛ dɔɔnwo bɛali, bɛ ko ayi,
na bɛaye Ɛdɛnkɛma bɛ Nyamenle ne ayɛlɛ,
yemɔ a yeyɛ ninyɛne mgbole yemaa bɛ a.
Me menli ne anyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze bieko.
27Na Yizilayɛma banwu kɛ mede bɛ avinli,
na medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a mele bɛ Nyamenle a,
awie bieko ɛnle ɛkɛ.
Na menli ne anyunlu ɛnrɛgua aze bieko.
Ɛdɛnkɛma Kenle ne
28 “Na ɔbara kɛ nzinlii,
mebawola me Sunsum ne meagua awie biala anwo zo:
bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ baha me nrɛlaleɛ ne;
bɛ mgbanyinli baha ɛlalɛ,
na bɛ mgbavolɛ anwu ɛnyelɛzodeɛnwunlɛ.
29Mekɛ ne anu mebawola me Sunsum ne
meagua sonvolɛ mrenya nee mraalɛ anwo zo.
30“Mebahile kenle ne anwo sɛkɛlɛneɛ wɔ anwomanyunlu
nee azɛlɛ ye azo;
bɛbaha mogya bɛagua,
senle nee esike mungumungu bavinde.
31 Sɛnzɛne ne balu kisii,
na siane ne ayɛ kɔkɔlɛ kɛ mogya
kolaa na Ɛdɛnkɛma kenle kpole
anu ɛzulolɛ ne ara.
32 Na ɔbara kɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛvɛlɛ Ɛdɛnkɛma la
bɛbalie bɛ ngoane,
ɔluakɛ wɔ Zayɔn Boka nee Gyɛlusalɛm,
bie mɔ bavi ɛsalɛ, kɛmɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma ɛha la,
na bɛdabɛ mɔɔ bɛbaha la anu
yɛɛ bɛdabɛ mɔɔ Ɛdɛnkɛma bavɛlɛ bɛ la wɔ a.”

english_text:
The Lord Will Judge the Nations
1At that time I, the Lord, will make Judah and Jerusalem prosperous again. 2Then in Judgment Valley I will bring together the nations that scattered my people Israel everywhere in the world, and I will bring charges against those nations. They divided up my land 3and gambled to see who would get my people; they sold boys and girls to pay for prostitutes and wine.
4 You people of Tyre and Sidon and you Philistines, why are you doing this? Are you trying to get even with me? I'll strike back before you know what's happened. 5You've taken my prized possessions, including my silver and gold, and carried them off to your temples. 6You have dragged the people of Judah and Jerusalem from their land and sold them to the Greeks.
7But I'll make the people of Judah determined to come home, and what happened to them will happen to you. 8I'll hand over your sons and daughters to the people of Judah, and they will sell them to the Sabeans, who live far away. I, the Lord, have spoken!
Judgment in Judgment Valley
9Say to the nations:
“Get ready for war!
Be eager to fight.
Line up for battle
and prepare to attack.
10 Make swords out of plows
and spears out of garden tools.
Strengthen every weakling.”
11Hurry, all you nations!
Come quickly.
Ask the Lord to bring
his warriors along.
12You must come now
to Judgment Valley,
where the Lord will judge
the surrounding nations.
13 They are a field of ripe crops.
Bring in the harvest!
They are grapes piled high.
Start trampling them now!
If our enemy's sins were wine,
every jar would overflow.
14Crowds fill Decision Valley.
The judgment day of the Lord
will soon be here—
15no light from the sun or moon,
and stars no longer shine.
16 From the heart of Jerusalem
the Lord roars like a lion,
shaking the earth and sky.
But the Lord is a fortress,
a place of safety
for his people Israel.
God Will Bless His People
17I am the Lord your God.
And you will know I live on Zion,
my sacred hill,
because Jerusalem will be sacred,
untouched by foreign troops.
18On that day, fruitful vineyards
will cover the mountains.
And your cattle and goats
that graze on the hills
will produce a lot of milk.
Streams in Judah
will never run dry;
a stream from my house
will flow in Acacia Valley.
19Egypt and Edom were cruel
and brutal to Judah,
without a reason.
Now their countries will become
a barren desert,
20but Judah and Jerusalem
will always have people.
21I, the Lord, live on Mount Zion.
I will punish the guilty
and defend the innocent.
translation_text:
Nyamenle babua maanle maanle ne mɔ ndɛne
1Ɛdɛnkɛma se,
“Mekɛ zɔhane mɔɔ mebava Dwuda
nee Gyɛlusalɛm anwonyia ne meamaa bɛ la,
2mebaboɔboa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anloa
na me nee bɛ ahɔ Ndɛnebualɛ Bɔnza ne anu.
Ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ mebabua bɛ ndɛne
wɔ mɔɔ bɛva bɛyɛ me menli nee me agyadeɛ
Yizilayɛma la ati.
Bɛbɔ Yizilayɛma asande bɛgua maanle maanle zo,
na bɛhyɛ me azɛlɛ ne bɛva.
3Bɛguale me menli ne ati nzeleba
kɛ nwane mɔ a me menli nuokɛma ne kɛyɛ bɛ ɛdeɛ a.
Bɛdɔnenle mralɛ mrenya bɛvale ezukoa
ne bɛbɔle tuutuu ɛbɛla,
na bɛdɔnenle mralɛ mraalɛ bɛvale
ezukoa ne bɛnlonle nwanye.
4 “Taya, Saedɛn, nee Filisitia maanzinli ne mɔ, duzu a bɛkpondɛ kɛ bɛyɛ a? Bɛkulo kɛ bɛdi me nzenralɛ wɔ debie bie ati ɔ? Saa bɛyɛ zɔhane a, menwɔdua bɛ kakɛ ndɛndɛ wɔ bɛdabɛ bɛ nyɛleɛ nwo. Zɛf 2.4-7; Zɛk 9.1-7; Mat 11.21-22; Luk 10.13-14 5Bɛva me dwɛtɛ fufule nee me ezukoa nvutuke, na bɛzoa me anwonyia kɔsɔɔti bɛhɔ bɛ mmonle azua nu. 6Bɛva Dwudama nee Gyɛlusalɛmma bɛvi bɛ maanle nu bɛhɔ moa moa, bɛdɔne bɛ bɛmaa Gilikima. 7Na kɛkala meye bɛ meavi maanle mɔɔ bɛdɔnenle bɛ bɛhɔle nu la anu. Na mɔɔ bɛva bɛyɛ bɛ la, mebayɛ bɛ bie meadua. 8Mebadɔne bɛ mra mrenya nee bɛ mra mraalɛ meamaa Dwudama; bɛdabɛ noko bɛbadɔne bɛ bɛamaa Sabema mɔɔ wɔ moa moa lɔ la. Medame, Ɛdɛnkɛma a medendɛ a.
9“Bɛbɔ nolo ɛhye wɔ maanle maanle avinli:
Bɛboɔboa bɛ nwo wɔ konle nu;
Katakyiema, bɛkpusu bɛ nwo;
bɛmaa ɛlɔnema ɛhwe ɛbikye.
